jobs.title: DMR（営業職_東京）
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 職務内容
• 医療機関の臨床検査室を中心に、生化学(血液検査等)・免疫検査用の試薬・
• 検査機器などの提案営業をお任せします。
• 担当数は10～20施設。
• 病院の経営層(事務長・院長等)や臨床検査技師などの現場担当者と
• リレーションを構築し、抱えている課題を抽出。
• 経営・業務の効率化に向け、当社が持つリソースを組み合わせて、
• 課題を解決するソリューション観点で営業に取り組んでいただきます。

応募条件
• 業界を問わず、法人営業の経験をお持ちの方／キーマンアプローチの経験ある方
• ◎モノ売りではなく、自分のアイデアでお客様の課題解決に貢献したい方
• ◎業界トップクラスの企業で自己成長に取り組みたい方
• ◎関係各所へのコミュニケーション・調整を図れる方
• ◎将来はグローバルな視点で活躍したい方

＜必要資格＞
必要条件：普通自動車免許第一種

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Clinical Operation Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job
Clinical Trial Document Preparation and Archiving
·Be familiar with the content of clinical trial master file and
investigator site file based on the requirements of ICH GCP, China regulation
and Roche SOPs, guidance.
·Support to prepare site file before study start up
·Review the closed clinical trial documents, support archiving
responsible to arrange and archive them according to related SOP requirements.

Business Support to Department
·Understand ICH GCP, China GCP and related regulation on clinical trials.
·Support SSUS to prepare the essential EC submission package according to
required timeline.
·Support SSUS on site budget and contract preparation.
·Maintains and analyzes study data (metrics) on assigned studies. Support
PDG China to identify opportunities for continuous improvement
·Update and maintain the data in CDE platform according to regulatory and
SOP requirements.
·Support local clinical operation data cleaning and management

General Office Duties
·Provide general office support to PDG China department staff (including
but not limited to photocopying, distributing mail/faxes, scanning, faxing,).
·Organize courier services for documents/ goods pick-up.
·Help to arrange meetings or meeting logistics
·Perform other tasks, as assigned by line manager

Qualification and Experience

Education/
• Qualifications
·Bachelor degree or above
·Major in public health, data science, computer science, pharmacy,
biology or related

Personality
·Good ownership and focus on details
·Logical and efficient with highly compliance
·Be willing to learn, think and practice

Job Required Competencies
·Strong computer skill for Window 7, Microsoft 2010 (PPT, Excel, Word)
·Strong communication skills
·Fluent English written and oral capability

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: (Senior) Biostatistician for Clinical Algorithms

titleByLocale.it: Biostatistica senior per gli Algoritmi Clinici

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Your Department
We are a global team of 100+ biostatisticians and data scientists united by the ambition to advance diagnostic assays and elevate their use in clinical practice. Located across Roche Diagnostics sites in Penzberg, Mannheim, Indianapolis, and Sant Cugat del Vallès, our mission is to provide robust quantitative methods for all stages of the product lifecycle—from early research to market registration. By combining our statistical expertise with a profound understanding of the clinical questions at hand, we extract actionable information from data and deliver customer-tailored insights.

Your Team
Our team thrives on creating innovative solutions for both novel and traditional challenges in data analysis. We are heavily involved in early biomarker discovery projects, aiming to identify new biomarkers and develop clinical algorithms that solve unmet medical needs. To achieve our goals, we leverage data from clinical trials as well as real-world data. Collaboration is at our core; we work in close partnership with colleagues across clinical science, clinical operations, business, and assay development.

Your Main Objectives and Tasks

• Conduct exploratory data analysis of clinical data and develop clinical algorithms by applying state-of-the-art statistical and machine learning methods.

• Perform statistical analysis for clinical studies and real world data, generate analysis reports, and present findings to stakeholders.

• Analyze data from biomarker discovery experiments using multivariate and machine learning techniques.

• Support peer-reviewed publications that demonstrate the clinical utility of your results.

• Proactively contribute to and support cross-functional project teams.

Who You Are

• You hold a university degree (Master’s) in (Bio-)Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, (Bio-)Informatics, or a comparable field; a Ph.D. is a plus.

• You possess proven expertise in applying biostatistical and machine learning methods to clinical data, ideally in the context of biomarker evaluation or similar research tasks.

• You have excellent knowledge of R or a comparable programming language.

• You bring exceptional communication and analytical skills, with a strong desire to continuously expand your knowledge and apply new quantitative methodologies.

• You are fluent in English, both spoken and written.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position Your Department We are a global team of 100+ biostatisticians and data scientists united by the ambition to advance diagnostic assays and elevate their use in clinical practice. Located across Roche Diagnostics sites in Penzberg, Mannheim, Indianapolis, and Sant Cugat del Vallès, our mission is to provide robust quantitative methods for all stages of the product lifecycle—from early research to market registration. By combining our statistical expertise with a profound understanding of the clinical questions at hand, we extract actionable information from data and deliver customer-tailored insights. Your Team Our team thrives on creating innovative solutions for both novel and traditional challenges in data analysis. We are heavily involved in early biomarker discovery projects, aiming to identify new biomarkers and develop clinical algorithms that solve unmet medical needs. To achieve our goals, we leverage data from clinical trials as well as real-world data. Collaboration is at our core; we work in close partnership with colleagues across clinical science, clinical operations, business, and assay development. Your Main Objectives and Tasks
• Conduct exploratory data analysis of clinical data and develop clinical algorithms by applying state-of-the-art statistical and machine learning methods.
• Perform statistical analysis for clinical studies and real world data, generate analysis reports, and present findings to stakeholders.
• Analyze data from biomarker discovery experiments using multivariate and machine learning techniques.
• Support peer-reviewed publications that demonstrate the clinical utility of your results.
• Proactively contribute to and support cross-functional project teams. Who You Are
• You hold a university degree (Master’s) in (Bio-)Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, (Bio-)Informatics, or a comparable field; a Ph.D. is a plus.
• You possess proven expertise in applying biostatistical and machine learning methods to clinical data, ideally in the context of biomarker evaluation or similar research tasks.
• You have excellent knowledge of R or a comparable programming language.
• You bring exceptional communication and analytical skills, with a strong desire to continuously expand your knowledge and apply new quantitative methodologies.
• You are fluent in English, both spoken and written. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
# Roche - Global Talent Marketing Internship ## Mansioni In questo ruolo, ti unirai al team globale di Marketing del Talento, con l'obiettivo di posizionare Roche come il datore di lavoro preferito per i candidati chiave attraverso approcci mirati e innovativi per soddisfare e affrontare le esigenze di assunzione e del mercato. - Crea contenuti video, sui social media e visivi coinvolgenti che mostrano Roche come il datore di lavoro preferito per i talenti in tutto il mondo. - Acquisisci esperienza attraverso il supporto di campagne di contenuti ad alto impatto su LinkedIn, Instagram e sulla pagina delle carriere globale di Roche. - Gestisci i contenuti a livello globale, acquisendo esperienza pratica con le piattaforme globali di Roche, garantendo la qualità del marchio in tutti i canali. - Collabora con le funzioni di recruiting, comunicazione e creative per portare alla vita storie autentiche del datore di lavoro. - Produci contenuti che rappresentano autenticamente la cultura di Roche, aiutando a ispirare e aumentare le candidature dei candidati. - Innovare con nuovi formati sperimentando con le tendenze e gli strumenti digitali emergenti per mantenere il nostro linguaggio visivo all'avanguardia. - Esperienza una cultura di fiducia in cui le tue idee creative sono apprezzate e sei autorizzato a prendere il controllo dei tuoi progetti. ## Chi sei
• Stiamo cercando un narratore creativo appassionato di media digitali e collaborazione globale. - Narratore Visivo: Hai esperienza dimostrabile nella ripresa e nel montaggio video, indipendentemente dal fatto che sia attraverso progetti accademici, un portfolio personale o lavoro professionale. La familiarità con gli strumenti come Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere Pro, After Effects) o piattaforme simili è un vantaggio. - Consapevole del Marchio: Capisci come il linguaggio visivo coerente rafforza un messaggio e ti piace lavorare all'interno delle linee guida del marchio per garantire la qualità. - Curioso e Autodriven: Prendi l'iniziativa, ti piace sperimentare con nuovi formati di contenuti e prosperi in un ambiente che incoraggia la crescita continua. - Comunicatore Forte: Sei fluente in inglese e ti senti a tuo agio nel collaborare con team internazionali diversi in diversi fusi orari. - Background Educativo: Sei uno studente o un neolaureato in Comunicazione, Marketing, Media o un campo creativo correlato. Si prega di notare che la data di laurea non deve superare i 12 mesi dalla data di inizio. ## Processo di applicazione Carica un CV aggiornato e una Lettera di Motivazione, in cui si indica la data preferita per l'inizio del tirocinio. ## Informazioni aggiuntive Si prega di notare che, a causa dei regolamenti, i cittadini non UE/EEA devono fornire un certificato dall'università che attesti che un tirocinio è obbligatorio come parte dei documenti di applicazione e devono essere costantemente iscritti all'università per tutta la durata di questo tirocinio. Se sei entusiasta di contribuire e senti di avere la dedizione al lavoro di squadra e all'innovazione che cerchiamo, allora Roche è l'organizzazione per te. Ogni ruolo in Roche gioca un ruolo nel fare la differenza per le vite dei pazienti. Se vuoi lavorare in un team appassionato, lasciare il tuo segno e migliorare le vite, applica ora! ## Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge all'innovazione. Insieme, più di 100.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati ad avanzare la scienza, garantendo che tutti abbiano accesso alle cure sanitarie oggi e per le generazioni future. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri medicinali e più di 30 miliardi di test effettuati utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici.

descriptionByLocale.de: Roche - Global Talent Marketing Praktikum Sendungen In dieser Rolle werden Sie dem globalen Talent Marketing Team beitreten, mit dem Ziel, Roche als bevorzugten Arbeitgeber für Schlüsselanwärter durch gezielte und innovative Ansätze zu positionieren, um die Bedürfnisse von Aufnahme und Markt zu erfüllen. - Erstellen Sie Videoinhalte, auf immersive Social Media und Visuals, die Roche als bevorzugten Arbeitgeber für Talente auf der ganzen Welt zeigen. - Erkundigen Sie sich durch die Unterstützung von hochwirksamen Content-Kampagnen auf LinkedIn, Instagram und Roches globaler Karriereseite. - Content global verwalten, praktische Erfahrungen mit Roches globalen Plattformen sammeln und Markenqualität auf allen Kanälen gewährleisten. - Zusammenarbeit mit Rekrutierung, Kommunikation und kreativen Funktionen, um authentische Arbeitgebergeschichten zu leben. - Produzieren Sie Inhalte, die die Kultur von Roche authentisch repräsentieren und helfen, die Bewerbungen zu inspirieren und zu erhöhen. - Innovieren Sie mit neuen Formaten, indem Sie mit neuen digitalen Trends und Tools experimentieren, um unsere visuelle Sprache avantgarde zu halten. - Erleben Sie eine Vertrauenskultur, in der Ihre kreativen Ideen geschätzt werden und Sie sind berechtigt, die Kontrolle über Ihre Projekte zu übernehmen. Wer sind Sie? Wir suchen einen kreativen Erzähler mit Leidenschaft für digitale Medien und globale Zusammenarbeit. - Visive Narrator: Sie haben Erfahrung in Videoaufnahmen und -bearbeitung, unabhängig davon, ob es sich um akademische Projekte, ein persönliches Portfolio oder eine professionelle Arbeit handelt. Die Vertrautheit mit Tools wie Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere Pro, After Effects) oder ähnlichen Plattformen ist ein Vorteil. - Achtung der Marke: Verstehen Sie, wie konsistente visuelle Sprache eine Nachricht stärkt und Sie gerne in den Richtlinien der Marke arbeiten, um Qualität zu gewährleisten. - Kurios und Autodriven: Nehmen Sie die Initiative, Sie möchten mit neuen Inhaltsformaten und -reifen in einer Umgebung experimentieren, die ein kontinuierliches Wachstum fördert. - Pressemitteilung: Sie sind fließend in Englisch und fühlen sich wohl, mit verschiedenen internationalen Teams in verschiedenen Zeitzonen zu arbeiten. - Bildungshintergrund: Sie sind Student oder Absolventen in Kommunikation, Marketing, Medien oder einem verwandten kreativen Bereich. Bitte beachten Sie, dass das Abschlussdatum 12 Monate ab dem Startdatum nicht überschreiten sollte. Anwendungsprozess Hochladen eines aktualisierten Lebenslaufs und eines Motivationsschreibens, das das bevorzugte Datum für den Beginn des Praktikums anzeigt. Weitere Informationen Bitte beachten Sie, dass Nicht-EU/EWR-Bürger aufgrund der Verordnungen eine Bescheinigung der Universität vorlegen müssen, die bescheinigt, dass ein Praktikum im Rahmen der Bewerbungsunterlagen obligatorisch ist und für die Dauer dieses Praktikums an der Universität ständig eingeschrieben werden muss. Wenn Sie sich freuen, einen Beitrag zu leisten und das Gefühl haben Sie Engagement für Teamwork und Innovation, die wir suchen, dann ist Roche die Organisation für Sie. Jede Rolle in Roche spielt eine Rolle bei der Differenzierung des Patientenlebens. Wenn Sie in einem leidenschaftlichen Team arbeiten wollen, verlassen Sie Ihre Marke und verbessern Sie das Leben, bewerben Sie sich jetzt! Wer sind wir? Eine gesündere Zukunft führt uns zu Innovation. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass alle heute und für zukünftige Generationen Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung haben. Unsere Bemühungen führen zu mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen, die mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden, und mehr als 30 Milliarden Tests, die mit unseren diagnostischen Produkten durchgeführt werden.
descriptionByLocale.fr: Roche - Stage en marketing de talents mondiaux Expéditions Dans ce rôle, vous rejoindrez l'équipe mondiale Talent Marketing, dans le but de positionner Roche comme employeur privilégié pour les candidats clés grâce à des approches ciblées et innovantes pour répondre aux besoins de l'accueil et du marché. - Créer du contenu vidéo, sur les médias sociaux immersifs et les visuels qui montrent Roche comme l'employeur préféré pour les talents partout dans le monde. - Acquérir de l'expérience grâce au soutien de campagnes de contenu à fort impact sur LinkedIn, Instagram et la page de carrière mondiale de Roche. - Gérer le contenu à l'échelle mondiale, acquérir une expérience pratique avec les plateformes mondiales de Roche, assurant la qualité de la marque sur tous les canaux. - Collaborer avec le recrutement, la communication et les fonctions créatives pour donner vie à des histoires d'employeurs authentiques. - Produire du contenu qui représente authentiquement la culture de Roche, aidant à inspirer et à augmenter les candidatures. - Innovez avec de nouveaux formats en expérimentant les nouvelles tendances et outils numériques pour garder notre langage visuel avant-gardiste. - Vivez une culture de confiance dans laquelle vos idées créatives sont appréciées et vous êtes autorisé à prendre le contrôle de vos projets. Qui êtes-vous ? Nous recherchons un narrateur créatif passionné par les médias numériques et la collaboration mondiale. - Visive Narrator: Vous avez prouvé votre expérience dans le tournage et l'édition vidéo, que ce soit par des projets académiques, un portfolio personnel ou un travail professionnel. La familiarité avec des outils comme Adobe Creative Suite (Premier Pro, After Effects) ou des plateformes similaires est un avantage. - Connaissance de la marque: Comprenez comment un langage visuel cohérent renforce un message et vous aimez travailler dans les lignes directrices de la marque pour assurer la qualité. - Curious et Autodrived: Prenez l'initiative, vous aimez expérimenter de nouveaux formats de contenu et prospérer dans un environnement qui encourage la croissance continue. - Communiqué de presse: Vous maîtrisez couramment l'anglais et vous sentez à l'aise de travailler avec différentes équipes internationales dans différents fuseaux horaires. - Contexte éducatif: Vous êtes étudiant ou diplômé en communication, marketing, médias ou un domaine de création connexe. Veuillez noter que la date du diplôme ne doit pas dépasser 12 mois à compter de la date de début. Processus de demande Télécharger un CV mis à jour et une lettre de motivation, en indiquant la date préférée pour le début du stage. Informations complémentaires Veuillez noter que, en raison de la réglementation, les citoyens non européens/EEE doivent fournir un certificat de l'université qui certifie qu'un stage est obligatoire dans le cadre des documents de candidature et doit être constamment inscrit à l'université pour la durée de ce stage. Si vous êtes heureux de contribuer et de vous sentir dévoué au travail d'équipe et à l'innovation que nous recherchons, Roche est l'organisation pour vous. Chaque rôle de Roche joue un rôle dans la vie des patients. Si vous voulez travailler dans une équipe passionnée, laissez votre marque et améliorez vos vies, appliquez maintenant! Qui sommes-nous ? Un avenir plus sain nous conduit à l'innovation. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés du monde entier se consacrent à faire progresser la science, en veillant à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations futures. Nos efforts mènent à plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et à plus de 30 milliards de tests effectués avec nos produits de diagnostic.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Stell Dir vor, Du bist der Architekt hinter den Kulissen, der die Vision einer vollautomatisierten Gesundheitsversorgung Realität werden lässt. Bei Roche Diagnostics treiben wir die Wissenschaft voran, damit jeder Mensch die bestmögliche Behandlung erhält. Als Projektmanager bist Du die treibende Kraft, die komplexe Laborsysteme zum Leben erweckt und so einen direkten Einfluss auf die Schnelligkeit und Präzision von Diagnosen für Millionen von Patient:innen weltweit nimmt.

Dein neues Team:
Du wirst Teil unseres Teams Field Force Workflow Solutions im Customer Service Außendienst. Wir sind eine dynamische Gemeinschaft aus Spezialist:innen, die technische Exzellenz, Erfahrung mit Laborprozessen mit einer großen Portion Teamgeist verbindet.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
In dieser Rolle gestaltest Du die Zukunft der Labordiagnostik durch professionelles Projektmanagement und Workflow-Optimierung:

• Du leitest überregionale Implementierungsprojekte für Automatisierungslösungen und behältst dabei Planung, Steuerung und Kontrolle fest im Griff.

• Du koordinierst Teilprojektleiter:innen sowie externe Partner, um Projektziele termingerecht und in höchster Qualität zu erreichen.

• Du steuerst die Kommunikation zu unseren Kunden und internen Stakeholdern und begleitest Veränderungsprozesse durch aktives Change Management.

• Du wirkst bei technischen Installationen mit, führst Testläufe durch und trainierst Kunden, um ihre Workflows perfekt auf ihre Bedürfnisse abzustimmen.

• Du analysierst abgeschlossene Projekte ("Lessons Learned"), optimierst unsere Prozesse und berätst Kunden als Spezialist:in für Prozessoptimierung.

jobs.title: P&C Enabling Support Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
People & Culture Enabling Support Specialist

The Opportunity

The P&C Enabling Support Network (ESN) is a global network of P&C professionals supporting the People & Culture organization through operational excellence, collaboration, coordination, and organizational enablement activities. As a member of the Enabling Support Network, you will contribute to and benefit from a broader ecosystem of enabling support functions across the P&C organisation in Roche, strengthening organizational capabilities and cross-functional alignment at scale.The P&C Enabling Support Specialist acts as a key connector across local and global P&C teams, Organizational Enablement teams, business stakeholders, and chapter organizations. The role supports alignment across the matrix organization by enabling collaboration, supporting follow-ups, coordinating actions, and helping ensure smooth communication and execution across teams.
The role also supports the operational effectiveness of the RSS P&C Leadership Team through coordination, communication, follow-up, and organizational enablement activities across cross-location initiatives and stakeholder groups.
This position is ideal for a proactive, organized, and collaborative professional who enjoys working in a dynamic global environment, connecting stakeholders, and enabling teams to operate effectively together.

• Act as the central coordination point between RSS P&C teams, global P&C stakeholders, Organizational Enablement teams, and business partners, serving as the primary contact point for cross-functional alignment and information flow

• Orchestrate and facilitate all collaborative forums and events including coordination of meetings, workshops, governance forums, and cross-functional discussions with full lifecycle support (agenda preparation, documentation, action tracking, and follow-up)

• Drive alignment and follow-through across RSS P&C leadership and cross-location initiatives by facilitating communication, collaboration, and coordination to ensure organizational and P&C priorities are understood and executed consistently

• Maintain comprehensive visibility and tracking of priorities, timelines, deliverables, and agreed next steps, proactively identifying and escalating dependencies, potential blockers, and risks to relevant stakeholders

• Identify and support operational improvements and continuous enhancement by partnering with P&C teams to surface alignment opportunities, streamline processes, and support transformation activities across local and global stakeholders

• Prepare and consolidate all supporting materials and insights including presentations, dashboards, reports, and stakeholder updates that enable informed leadership discussions and support organizational initiatives

• Execute administrative and coordination activities with excellence in a fast-paced global matrix environment, ensuring all work adheres to company guidelines, SOPs, and compliance expectations

Who You Are

• Formal education and relevant professional background: University degree or commercial diploma (or equivalent work experience) with demonstrated experience in People & Culture, business support, professional assistance, event management, dynamic project coordination, or organizational enablement

• Foundation for success in matrix and global environments: Proven ability to navigate complex matrix organizations, connect stakeholders across different reporting lines and geographies, and work effectively in global and/or cross-fun

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Data/Information Architect - Data Platforms

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

We are seeking a visionary Data/Information Architect within the RDT Data Platforms function to lead the strategic design and implementation of our AI-driven Master Data Management (MDM) solutions. In this role, you will be the core architect enabling artificial intelligence across our MDM ecosystem, transforming legacy relational master records into intelligent, context-aware, and AI-ready data assets.

The first key priority of this architectural roadmap will focus on the modernization of Healthcare Professional (HCP) and Healthcare Organisation (HCO) master data programs , with a broader scaling strategy across alternative master data domains in future waves. A defining focus of your architectural design will be bridging the gap between traditional MDM platforms and advanced enterprise semantic layers, seamlessly transitioning master datasets into unified knowledge graphs that fuel cutting-edge Generative AI applications.

The Data Management and Data Quality Platforms area serves as the foundational intelligence engine of our global digital enterprise. Our mission is to scale a harmonized, FAIR-compliant master data framework that integrates heavily with an automated, AI-enabled Semantic Layer . By injecting contextual meaning, ontology standards, and relationship graphs into raw master data, we provide the enterprise with a single, high-trust, and discoverable view of our network. Joining this area means taking a leading role in ensuring that healthcare-specific data models remain contextually accurate, highly secure, compliant with global regulatory standards, and completely optimized for state-of-the-art machine learning deployment.

The opportunity:

• AI-Enabled MDM Architecture: Architect, design, and lead the technical execution of modernizing enterprise Master Data Management systems by integrating AI/ML capabilities for data matching, entity resolution, and data enrichment.

• HCP & HCO Program Leadership: Act as the primary technical architect for the foundational Healthcare Professional (HCP), Healthcare Organisation (HCO), and Business Partner/Vendor master data initiatives, ensuring high-fidelity modeling and scalability for subsequent domains.

• Semantic Layer Integration: Define the blueprints and mapping rules required to connect transactional master data with unified semantic layers, ontologies, and enterprise knowledge graphs.

• AI-Ready Data Engineering: Ensure that master data models are fully machine-readable and explicitly struct

descriptionByLocale.it:
Mansioni Data/Information Architect - Piattaforme di dati Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è dove l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. Come squadra globale al centro di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi imprenditoriali impegnati a plasmare il futuro digitale della sanità. La nostra missione è potenziare Roche attraverso le tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando il potenziale dell'intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidati dalla scopo e dalla passione, stanno preparando un futuro in cui il digitale è un punto di forza capace di crescere in tutta Roche, volendo modi di lavorare più intelligenti, radicando il potenziale umano e guidando i progressi che contano veramente per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. A Roche, offrendo un modello di lavoro ibrido che abbina flessibilità con la collaborazione in presenza. Per ora, richiediamo ai nostri dipendenti di essere nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici in ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, riunioni di squadra e altri eventi collaborativi.
• Stiamo cercando un architetto di dati/informazione visionario all'interno della funzione RDT Data Platforms per guidare la progettazione e l'implementazione strategica delle nostre soluzioni di gestione dei dati master (MDM) guidate dall'AI. In questo ruolo, sarai l'architetto centrale che abilita l'intelligenza artificiale nell'ecosistema MDM, progetta i registri master relazionali legacy in asset dati intelligenti, contestualmenteassunzione e pronta per l'AI. La prima priorità chiave di questa roadmap architettonica si concentrerà sulla modernizzazione dei programmi di gestione dei dati dei professionisti sanitari (HCP) e delle organizzazioni sanitarie (HCO), con una strategia di scalabilità più ampia per i domini dei dati master alternativi nelle future ondate. Un focus definito della tua progettazione architettonica sarà colmare il potenziale tra le piattaforme MDM e gli strati semantici aziendali avanzati, passando senza soluzione di continuità i dataset master in grafica della conoscenza unificati che alimentano le applicazioni di generazione dell'AI all'avanguardia. L'area di gestione dei dati e delle piattaforme di qualità dei dati servono come motore di intelligenza fondazionale della nostra impresa digitale globale. La nostra missione è scalare un framework di dati master armonizzato, conformi alle specifiche FAIR, che si integra pesantemente con uno strato semantico automatizzato, AI-abilitato. Inserendo il significato contestuale, gli standard ontologici e i grafici delle relazioni nei dati master grezzi, per all'impresa una visuale unica, ad alta fiducia e scopribile della nostra rete. Unendoti a questa area, assumonorai un ruolo di primo piano nell'assicurarti che i modelli dei dati specifici del settore sanitario paganono accurati contestualmente, altamente sicuri, conformi agli standardtivi globali e completamente ottimizzati per il deployment del machine learning all'avanguardia. Opportunità - Architettura MDM abilitata all'AI: Architettare, progettare e guidare l'esecuzione tecnica della modernizzazione dei dati master dell'impresa integrando le capacità AI/ML per la corrispondenza dei dati, la risoluzione delle elezioni e l'arricchimento dei dati. - Leadership del programma HCP & HCO: Fare da architetto principale tecnico per le iniziative di gestione dei dati dei professionisti sanitari (HCP), delle organizzazioni sanitarie (HCO) e dei partner commerciali/venditori, assicurando la modellazione ad alta fedeltà e la scalabilità per i domini successivi. - Integrazione dello strato semantico: Definire i progetti e le regole di mappatura obbligatoria per connettere i dati master transazionali con gli strati semantici un, le onlogie e i grafici della conoscenza aziendale. - Ingegneria dei dati pronta per l'AI: Assicurarsi che i modelli dei dati master siano completamente leggibili dalle macchine e strutturati esplicitamente.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
YOUR TEAM
You will report to the HGR Officer and partner closely with the global biosample operations teams across the enterprise. You will be recognized as a leader and work autonomously in both local as well as global cross functional study teams.
ROLE PURPOSE
As a China Biosample Operations Asset Lead, you will provide biosample operational expertise to one or more cross-functional local or global study teams through all phases and stages in accordance with the appropriate quality standards and applicable local regulations.
WHAT YOU WILL DO

• PROVIDE BIOSAMPLE OPERATIONS GUIDANCE TO CLINICAL CHINA STUDY TEAMS AND GLOBAL STUDY TEAMS FOR CHINA RELATED ACTIVITIES by planning, coordinating, and overseeing all operational activities required to manage the lifecycle of study samples (collection, processing, analysis, data delivery and final disposition).

• LEAD THE DEVELOPMENT OF A CHINA SPECIFIC BIOMARKER MANAGEMENT PLAN WITHIN CLINICAL STUDIES based on input from scientific and operational stakeholders to execute biosample operational strategies in China

• PROVIDE INPUT TO HGRAC APPLICATION to support Country Study Managers - when applicable - and within Biosample Operations’ remit.

• PARTNER CLOSELY WITH BIOMARKER SCIENTISTS AND BIOSAMPLE OPERATIONS PROGRAM LEADS LOCALLY AND GLOBALLY to align study specific activities with program sample collection strategies. Evaluate the operational feasibility of specific testing in China and provide input to global program teams.

• PROVIDE OPERATIONAL INPUT AND RECOMMENDATIONS INTO STUDY RELATED DOCUMENTATION AND PROCESSES (e.g. protocol, ICF, HGRAC applications)

• PRESENT CHINA STUDY SAMPLE COLLECTION STRATEGY AT OPERATIONS TEAM MEETINGS AND CHINA INVESTIGATOR MEETINGS

• CONTRIBUTE TO LOCAL LAB/ REGIONAL VENDOR SELECTION FOR SPECIFIC TESTING in collaboration with Biosample Ops Lead, biomarker scientist, Procurement and based on technology expertise, performance and compliance.

• ESTABLISH BIOSAMPLE ANALYSIS AND DATA DELIVERY MILESTONES AND ENSURE ACCURATE TRACKING AND REPORTING OF BIOSAMPLE METRICS (sample collection, assay status, analyses updates). Provide study level updates to the study and global biomarker teams. Support study teams in addressing local vendor/site sample queries. Actively partner with Data Management to oversee and coordinate data format, and delivery timelines.

• PROVIDE DAY TO DAY OPERATIONAL MANAGEMENT OF CHINA BIOSAMPLE VENDORS. Partner with internal/external stakeholders in the central lab set up, providing sample collection and processing instructions. Review central lab documents to ensure alignment with protocol and HGRAC submissions. Perform ongoing biomarker vendor management including development and oversight of scope of work, budget and performance management. Interact with vendors to help evaluate data size for compliance, plan sample shipments, export, storage, define data retention, ensure samples are analysed and data are transferred.

• IDENTIFY AREAS OF BEST PRACTICE AND PROCESS IMPROVEMENTS. Contribute to the development of internal guidelines within Biosample Operations’ remit, based on HGRAC process and local regulations as well as program needs. Partner with relevant stakeholders, both locally and globally, to optimize processes for sample management in China.

jobs.title: Disease Area Lead (Oncology / Lung)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Disease Area Lead (Oncology / Lung) is an empowered leader responsible for the respective DA business in Roche Turkiye, leveraging the global Roche network as an active catalyst. In this role, you will report to the Leadership Team Member responsible for all disease areas and develop a clear business strategy for identifying, leveraging, scaling, adapting, and executing the business by providing launch and commercial excellence for the DA portfolio. DA experience is required for this role.

Key Responsibilities
Establish strategic direction and lead the execution of the Strategy

• Responsible for setting the DA vision, high ambitions, and outcomes for the squad by harnessing insights from Primary Point of Contacts (PPOCs) and other key stakeholders across the enterprise. Holding overall accountability for delivering market leadership and the P&L, whilst working in the context of shared responsibility.

• Responsible for developing effective strategies to manage the lifecycle and the financial and resource planning for the products.

• Promote innovation and the development of projects and pull in resources from the broader Roche network to deliver value-added solutions.

• Maximize opportunities and synergize across other disease areas and establish a strong collaboration within the affiliate and cross-affiliates within Pharma International.

• Closely collaborate with stakeholders and customer-facing teams to translate disease area needs into clear execution.

• Ensure Cross-Functional Leadership by inspiring teams to meet ambitious outcomes, fostering an environment where cross-functional teams can collaborate, develop, and achieve outcomes

• Manage DA Members by embracing the role of recruiter, coach, and retainer of talent & performance, sharing the responsibility with leaders in other disciplines.

• Ensure the right resource prioritization, with an enterprise mindset, taking into account the affiliate strategy and portfolio priorities. Within this context, effectively prioritize DA outcomes and ensure resource requirements are met to deliver outcomes

• In collaboration with the PPOCs, ensure that key stakeholders are well-supported and view us as their preferred partner. Mobilize the network with speed when necessary to meet the urgent needs of these key stakeholders.

People Leadership & Mindset

• Provide Inspirational leadership by uniting people around a shared vision and a common purpose, inspiring them to achieve squad-aligned outcomes. Ensure individuals and teams are developing and growing in line with the needs of the organization

• Build High-Performing Teams that deliver business outcomes by promoting a collaborative, innovative & creative environment

• Stay at the leading edge of learning & adapting according to external insights (strategy, outcomes & execution) for impact

• Ensure clarification of outcomes for the team so everyone is aligned on their role in delivering ambitious outcomes, and play an active role in execution as required.

• Act as a People Manager of Patient Journey Partners (PJP), and you are a thought partner for all DA members and others in the DA to bring perspective as a matrix lead. The role embraces the performance dynamics of all members.

• Have a very strong Entrepreneurial Mindset (We before Me) with outstanding partnering & leadership capabilities (coaching, consulting, ability to deeply listen, question, and understand).

• A catalyst and mobilize appropriate resources around common goals/outcomes to genera

titleByLocale.fr: Strategischer Leiter Bau-Governance & Projekt Manager Capex

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Mit der Zukunft im Blick gestalten wir den Standort von Roche in Rotkreuz aktiv weiter. Einen wichtigen Beitrag hierzu leistet die Abteilung Engineering & Project: Hier liegt die Verantwortung für die strategische Weiterentwicklung des Standortes und sämtliche Investitionen in Gebäude und Anlagen. Dazu gehören Bauprojekte im Bereich Produktion, Forschung und Infrastruktur. Dabei legen wir besonderen Wert auf Nachhaltigkeit, Sicherheit, Mitarbeiterzufriedenheit und Wirtschaftlichkeit.

In dieser anspruchsvollen Schlüsselfunktion bist du die zentrale Instanz für die operative Exzellenz und die baurechtliche Strategie auf dem Areal Rotkreuz. Du vereinst tiefgreifendes technisches Verständnis mit strategischem Prozessmanagement und repräsentierst das Unternehmen gegenüber Behörden und Partnern.

Die Möglichkeit
Strategisches Construction Management

• Standardisierung: Definition und Überwachung globaler Standards für die Auswahl, das Onboarding und die Steuerung von CM-Partnern, Generalplanern und Unternehmern.

• Schnittstellenmanagement: Agieren als entscheidendes Bindeglied zwischen Vendor Management und Projektleitung zur Sicherstellung prozesskonformer Projektabläufe.

• Beratung: Fachspezifischer Input bei komplexen Ausschreibungen und strategische Beratung der Projektleiter in allen Belangen des Construction Managements.

Bebauungsplanung & Bewilligungsmanagement

• Arealstrategie: Verantwortung für die Einhaltung und strategische Weiterentwicklung bestehender Bebauungspläne in enger Abstimmung mit internen und externen Stakeholdern.

• Process Ownership: Zentrale Steuerung sämtlicher Baubewilligungsprozesse sowie Definition standortweiter Bewilligungsstrategien für alle Investitionsprojekte.

• Behördenmanagement: Repräsentation der Unternehmensinteressen in städtebaulichen Gremien und erste Ansprechperson für Ämter und Behörden im Bereich Baurecht.

Areal-Koordination & Safety (SHE)

• Sicherheitsstrategie: Implementierung von SHE-Standards (Safety, Health, Environment) und Befähigung der Projektteams zur sicheren Durchführung komplexer Bauvorhaben.

• Logistiksteuerung: Strategische Koordination der zeitlichen und logistischen Abfolgen aller Baustellen, um einen unterbrechungsfreien Betrieb der Kernprozesse am Standort zu garantieren.

Capex-Projekt Manager

• Projektsteuerung (End-to-End): Verantwortung für die erfolgreiche Erreichung der Projektziele (Termine, Kosten, Qualität, Sicherheit) von der Initiierung bis zum Projektabschluss.

• Anforderungs- & Scope-Management: Gemeinsame Definition der Projektanforderungen mit den internen Nutzern, Aufzeigen von Lösungsalternativen sowie konsequentes Risiko- und Change-Management.

• Teamführung & Stakeholder Management: Fachliche Anleitung des (agilen) Projektteams sowie zielgerichtete Kommunikation und Interessenvertretung gegenüber internen Schnittstellen und externen Partnern.

jobs.title: Facharbeiter Ansatz/Abfüllung
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Als Pharmafacharbeiter Ansatz / Abfüllung (m/w/d) bist Du für die Vorbereitung, Überwachung, Reinigung und Desinfizierung der Abfüllmaschine, der Gefriertrocknungsanlage und den optischen Kontrollmaschinen verantwortlich.

Verantwortlichkeiten
In dieser Rolle bist Du für die sichere Durchführung von Standardaufgaben und komplexen Prozessen in der Wirkstoffverarbeitung verantwortlich:

• Du gewährleistest den reibungslosen Ablauf der Abfüllung von sterilen Lösungen in Vials unter Berücksichtigung aseptischer Arbeitsweise nach Herstellanweisung und Einhaltung von GMP- und Hygienevorschriften

• Du führst mikrobiologische Umgebungskontrollen durch und bist verantwortlich für die Störungsbeseitigung auch von schwierigen Störungen an der Abfüll- und Gefriertrocknungsanlage

• Ein wichtiger Bestandteil Deiner Aufgabe besteht zudem in der GMP-gerechten Dokumentation und Kontrolle der durchgeführten Arbeiten in Herstellprotokollen (zukünftig elektronisch), elektronischen Logbüchern sowie Belegbüchern etc.

• Im Rahmen der Arbeitsvorbereitung reinigst, desinfizierst und sterilisierst Du Geräte und Kleinteile

• Du bist für die kontinuierliche Pflege und Aktualisierung von SOPs im Arbeitsbereich zuständig und unterstützen bei der Erstellung von GMP-Dokumenten (SOPs, Formulare)

• Darüber hinaus engagierst Du dich im Rahmen unseres KVP-Prozesses zur Verbesserung unsere Arbeitsabläufe

• Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch und verfügst generell über ausgezeichnete kommunikative Fähigkeiten. Als Teamplayer bist du in der Lage, effektiv mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern zusammenzuarbeiten und komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich zu vermitteln.

Das bringst du mit

• Du hast idealerweise eine dreijährige abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Chemikant, Pharmakant oder Pharmazeutisch-technischer Assistent (PTA) (m/w/d).

• Deine mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung in der pharmazeutischen Produktion, ggf. Berufserfahrung in der Parenteralia-Herstellung zeichnet Dich aus.

• Fundierte Kenntnisse im Hygienebereich und in der Einhaltung der GMP-Richtlinien sind für Dich selbstverständlich.

• Du bist routiniert im Umgang mit Dokumentationsarbeiten und gängigen IT-Anwendungen (insbesondere MS Office, MES, Unilab).

• Du verfügst über ein ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis für die Bedienung und Kenntnis von Produktionsanlagen und Maschinen.

• Du arbeitest gerne im Team und überzeugst durch deine zuverlässige Arbeitsweise.

• Fähigkeit und Offenheit, die Chancen und die Vorteile von Veränderungen zu erkennen und das Warum zu vermitteln.

• Du begegnest allen Mitarbeitenden offen mit Respekt und Wertschätzung.

• Es besteht die Bereitschaft, in flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodellen eingesetzt zu werden. Darüber hinaus bist Du bereit, in Schichtsystemen mit Früh/Spät/Nacht zu arbeiten. Bei der Schichtplanung ist uns Deine Gesundheit wichtig und wir achten ebenso auf faire Zulagen

Deine Bewerbung
Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:

• Aktueller Lebenslauf

Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt.

Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden können.

Diese Stelle ist auf 2 Jahre befristet!

Bewerbungszeitraum bis mindestens 05.06.2026
(Bewerbung möglich, solange die Stelle ausgeschrieben ist)

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. To

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• We are looking for a Product Manager at Roche Diagnostics Central Asia and Caucasian countries.
• Location: Kazakhstan, Almaty

• What will you do?
• · You will join the healthcare innovation team.
• · You will be responsible for growing the portfolio; delivering on the marketing plan and working cross functionally with related colleagues.
• · You will prepare short term (annual) and medium term business/marketing plans for the products.
• · You will be expected to maintain and communicate a high level of market and product knowledge.
• · You will organize training programs for commercial team about products, product marketing strategies and competition.
• · You will organize product related marketing events (congresses, conferences, etc.) in cooperation with related parties

• Who are you?
• · Bachelor's Degree in medicine, biology, chemistry
• · Preferably 1-2 years’ experience of product management in the diagnostic, pharmaceutical or related industry
• · Budget management and product launch experience preferred
• · Strong communication, analytical and presentation skills
• · At least upper-intermediate level of English and fluent Russian
• · Having driving license and willing to travel as required to support business needs, attend events, and engage with stakeholders.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Medical Software Engineer - Complaint Handling

titleByLocale.it: Ingegnere di software medico - Manipolazione di reclami
titleByLocale.fr: Ingénieur en logiciel médical - Traitement des plaintes

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Software Engineer in Post Market Quality (PMQ), you will be at the forefront of ensuring the quality and performance of Roche’s Digital Solutions, handling complaints related to Hospital/Laboratory Information Systems (HIS/LIS), medical data networks, middleware solutions, data communication, apps, and algorithms.

Joining the Digital Solutions Chapter means working in a highly transversal software environment, giving you the opportunity to engage with cutting-edge technologies and diverse programming languages for both on-premise and cloud-based software.

Your core mission will be to act as a focused investigative detective. Supported by senior experts, you will dive into code and logs to untangle software issues , growing your expertise in both cutting-edge IT and medical compliance frameworks. While your focus is on root cause analysis, you will not be responsible for the final bug fixes. This role is set within an Agile environment where your innovative ideas and proposals are highly valued, contributing directly to a team focused on continuous improvement.

Main tasks:

• You are accountable for handling medical software complaints, safety issues, and product inquiries for software products (on premise, cloud, mobile, apps,...).

• Independently manage standard cases through their lifecycle, while partnering with senior colleagues to navigate complex or critical safety issues. For cases that cannot be directly resolved, you take ownership of escalating to the development department.

• You act as a technical expert for case resolution, using your ability to read and understand source code to identify the root cause factor of software malfunctions. You can reference the Roche internal process confidently in discussions to justify decisions. You will consult with senior experts on technical and process-related aspects as needed.

• You will be responsible for the timely communication of essential quality-related information and supporting initiatives to stakeholders in close collaboration with senior colleagues

• You use your automation and data analytics skills to enhance the case handling process and proactively monitor product performance data

Requirements:

• A degree in computer science or an IT related field.

• 2+ years of work experience in the area of Software engineering or IT support related functions is desired

• Solid IT skills, especially the strong foundational ability to navigate and read source code in multiple languages, with an eagerness to learn complex system dependencies quickly

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken)

• Automation skills and experience with data analytics are a plus

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Sant Cugat del Vallès. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete stimati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione A Roche, siamo appassionati di trasformare la vita dei pazienti, e siamo coraggiosi sia nella decisione che nell’azione - crediamo che il buon business significhi un mondo migliore. Ecco perché andiamo al lavoro ogni giorno. Ci impegniamo al rigore scientifico, all'etica insopportabile e all'accesso alle innovazioni mediche per tutti. Lo facciamo oggi per costruire un domani migliore. Il nostro successo si basa sull'innovazione, la curiosità e la diversità . Con oltre 100 iniziative di tecnologia digitale e dati già in corso, Roche sta lavorando con aziende innovative nei campi dei dati, analisi e software per trasformare la fornitura di assistenza sanitaria attraverso soluzioni digitali. Inoltre, Roche è uno dei più alti spender per la ricerca e lo sviluppo (R&D) tra i farmaci globali, spendendo più del 20% di ricavi. Questo sostanziale investimento ha portato a prodotti che hanno avanzato la comprensione della malattia e trasformato la pratica della medicina. In qualità di Ingegnere del Software nella Qualità del Mercato Postale (PMQ), sarete in prima linea nel garantire la qualità e le prestazioni delle Soluzioni Digitali di Roche, la gestione delle lamentele relative ai Sistemi Informativi Ospedalieri/Laboratori (HIS/LIS), reti di dati medici, soluzioni middleware, comunicazione dei dati, app e algoritmi. Unire il Capitolo Soluzioni Digitali significa lavorare in un ambiente software altamente trasversale, dandovi l'opportunità di impegnarsi con tecnologie all'avanguardia e linguaggi di programmazione diversi per il software on-premise e cloud-based. La vostra missione principale sarà quella di agire come un investigatore approfondito: Analizzerai casi, file di registro e codice sorgente per determinare la causa principale o il fattore causale di un malfunzionamento/problema del software. Mentre la vostra attenzione è sull'analisi della causa principale, non sarete responsabili per le correzioni di bug finali. Questo ruolo è ambientato in un ambiente Agile dove le tue idee e le tue proposte innovative sono altamente apprezzate, contribuendo direttamente a un team focalizzato sul miglioramento continuo.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Beschreibung Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell gedeihen können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Bei Roche sind wir leidenschaftlich daran, das Leben der Patienten zu transformieren, und wir sind mutig in Entscheidung und Tat - wir glauben, dass gutes Geschäft eine bessere Welt bedeutet. Deshalb kommen wir jeden Tag zur Arbeit. Wir verpflichten uns zu wissenschaftlicher Strenge, unerklärlicher Ethik und Zugang zu medizinischen Innovationen für alle. Wir tun das heute, um morgen besser zu werden. Unser Erfolg basiert auf Innovation, Neugier und Vielfalt. Mit mehr als 100 digitalen Technologie- und Dateninitiativen arbeitet Roche mit innovativen Unternehmen in den Daten-, Analyse- und Softwarebereichen zusammen, um die Gesundheitsversorgung durch digitale Lösungen zu transformieren. Darüber hinaus ist Roche einer der höchsten Ausgaben für Forschung und Entwicklung (FuE) unter globalen Arzneimitteln, die mehr als 20 % des Umsatzes ausmachen. Diese beträchtliche Investition hat zu Produkten geführt, die das Verständnis der Krankheit vorangebracht haben und die Praxis der Medizin transformiert haben. Als Software-Ingenieur in Post Market Quality (PMQ) sind Sie an der Spitze der Sicherstellung der Qualität und Leistung von Roche’s Digital Solutions, Behandlung von Beschwerden im Zusammenhang mit Hospital/Laboratory Information Systems (HIS/LIS), medizinische Datennetze, Middleware-Lösungen, Datenkommunikation, Apps und Algorithmen. Mit dem Digital Solutions Chapter arbeiten Sie in einem hochtransversalen Software-Umfeld und bieten Ihnen die Möglichkeit, sich mit modernsten Technologien und verschiedenen Programmiersprachen sowohl für On-Premise als auch für Cloud-basierte Software zu engagieren. Ihre Kernaufgabe wird es sein, als tiefgreifender Ermittler zu fungieren: Sie analysieren Fälle, Log-Dateien und Quellcode, um die Ursache oder den Kausalfaktor einer Software-Fehler/Problem zu bestimmen. Während Ihr Fokus auf der Wurzelursanalyse liegt, werden Sie nicht für die letzten Fehlerbehebungen verantwortlich sein. Diese Rolle ist in einer Agile-Umgebung festgelegt, in der Ihre innovativen Ideen und Vorschläge hoch geschätzt werden und direkt zu einem Team beitragen, das sich auf eine kontinuierliche Verbesserung konzentriert.
• Mansioni principali - Sie sind verantwortlich für die Behandlung von komplexen medizinischen Softwarebeschwerden, Sicherheitsfragen und Produktanfragen für Softwareprodukte (auf Prämisse, Cloud, Mobile, Apps,...). - Sie verwalten den gesamten Fall-Lebenszyklus, von der ersten Erstellung und Klassifizierung bis zur eingehenden Untersuchung, Zusammenarbeit mit dem fehlerbefreienden Team vor Ort, Dokumentation und abschließende Auflösung. Für Fälle, die nicht direkt gelöst werden können, nehmen Sie das Eigentum an der Eskalation an der Entwicklungsabteilung. - Sie fungieren als technischer Experte für Fallauflösung, indem Sie Ihre Fähigkeit verwenden, Quellcode zu lesen und zu verstehen, um die Ursache/Kausalfaktor von Softwarestörungen zu identifizieren. Sie werden bei Bedarf mit hochrangigen technischen Experten zu technischen und verfahrensbezogenen Aspekten beraten. - Sie sind die kritische Schnittstelle zu Affiliates und Country Organizations. Sie werden für die rechtzeitige Kommunikation wesentlicher qualitätsbezogener Informationen und unterstützende Initiativen verantwortlich sein, die unsere regionalen Partnerschaften verbessern. - Sie nutzen Ihre Automatisierungs- und Datenanalysefähigkeiten, um den Fallbearbeitungsprozess zu verbessern und Produktleistungsdaten proaktiv zu überwachen Voraussetzungen - Ein Abschluss in Informatik oder ein IT-bezogenes Feld. - Starke IT-Fähigkeiten, insbesondere die Fähigkeit, Quellcode verschiedener Programmiersprachen zu lesen und zu debuggen, um die Hauptursache gemeldeter Probleme zu verstehen - Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten auf Englisch (schriftlich und gesprochen) sind essentiell - Arbeitserfahrung im Bereich Softwaretechnik oder IT-Unterstützung sind erwünscht - Automatisierung

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Chez Roche, nous sommes passionnés par la transformation des vies des patients, et nous sommes audacieux tant dans la décision que dans l'action - nous croyons que les bonnes affaires signifient un monde meilleur. C'est pourquoi nous venons travailler tous les jours. Nous nous engageons à la rigueur scientifique, à l'éthique inlassable et à l'accès à des innovations médicales pour tous. Avec plus de 100 initiatives de technologie numérique et de données déjà en cours, Roche travaille avec des entreprises innovantes dans les domaines des données, de l'analyse et des logiciels pour transformer la prestation des soins de santé par des solutions numériques. De plus, Roche est l'un des plus grands investisseurs en recherche et développement (R-D) parmi les produits pharmaceutiques mondiaux, dépensant plus de 20 % des revenus. Cet investissement important a permis d'obtenir des produits qui ont permis de mieux comprendre la maladie et transformé la pratique de la médecine. En tant qu'ingénieur logiciel en qualité post-commercialisation (PMQ), vous serez à l'avant-garde de la qualité et des performances des solutions numériques de Roches, du traitement des plaintes liées aux systèmes d'information hospitaliers/laboratoires (HIS/LIS), aux réseaux de données médicales, aux solutions intermédiaires, à la communication de données, aux applications et aux algorithmes. Rejoindre le chapitre Solutions numériques signifie travailler dans un environnement logiciel hautement transversal, vous donnant la possibilité de vous engager avec des technologies de pointe et divers langages de programmation pour les logiciels sur site et cloud.
• Votre mission principale sera d'agir en tant qu'enquêteur en profondeur : Vous analyserez les cas, les fichiers log et le code source pour déterminer la cause fondamentale ou le facteur causal d'un dysfonctionnement ou problème logiciel. Bien que votre attention soit sur l'analyse de la cause racine, vous ne serez pas responsable de la correction finale du bug. Ce rôle est établi dans un environnement agile où vos idées et propositions innovantes sont très appréciées, contribuant directement à une équipe axée sur l'amélioration continue. Autres - Vous êtes responsable du traitement des plaintes complexes concernant les logiciels médicaux, des problèmes de sécurité et des demandes de renseignements sur les produits logiciels (sur place, cloud, mobile, applications,...). - Vous gérerez tout le cycle de vie de l'affaire, de la création et de la classification initiales à l'enquête approfondie, la collaboration avec l'équipe de dépannage sur place, la documentation et la résolution finale. Pour les cas qui ne peuvent être résolus directement, vous prenez en main l'escalade vers le département du développement. - Vous agissez comme un expert technique pour la résolution de cas, en utilisant votre capacité à lire et comprendre le code source pour identifier la cause racine / facteur causal de dysfonctionnements logiciels. Vous consulterez des experts techniques de haut niveau sur les aspects techniques et liés aux processus au besoin. - Vous êtes l'interface critique avec les affiliés et les organisations de pays. Vous serez responsable de la communication en temps opportun de l'information essentielle liée à la qualité et des initiatives de soutien qui améliorent nos partenariats régionaux. - Vous utilisez vos compétences d'automatisation et d'analyse de données pour améliorer le processus de traitement des cas et surveiller de manière proactive les données de performance des produits
• Requisiti - Diplôme en informatique ou en informatique. - Fortes compétences en TI, en particulier la capacité de lire et de déboguer le code source des différents langages de programmation pour comprendre la cause profonde des problèmes signalés - De solides compétences en communication en anglais (écrit et parlé) sont essentielles - Une expérience de travail dans le domaine de l'ingénierie logicielle ou des fonctions de support informatique est souhaitée - Automatisation

The Position
In Basel arbeiten 650 Mitarbeiter im Bereich Drug Substance Manufacturing und produzieren Large und Small Molecule APIs (Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients) für die kommerzielle und klinische Versorgung.

Die Möglichkeit

• Als User-Vertreter in technischen Projekten sind Sie für die Produktionsanlagen von der Planung bis zur Inbetriebnahme verantwortlich.

• Sie planen und koordinieren Werkstattarbeiten wie Revisionen, Umbauten und die Behebung von Störungen.

• Sie optimieren, entwickeln innovativ weiter und harmonisieren technische Lösungen innerhalb der Manufacturing Unit.

• Sie arbeiten bei der Erstellung von technischen Risikoanalysen sowie bei der Planung und Umsetzung von Validierungsaktivitäten mit.

• Sie sind zuständig für die Kosten-Nutzen-Analyse und die Beantragung der finanziellen Mittel für Projekte.

• Sie führen anlagen- und prozessspezifische Schulungen für die Mitarbeiter durch und erstellen und prüfen SOPs für die Anlagen.

• Sie arbeiten konstruktiv mit anderen Abteilungen und externen Lieferanten zusammen.

Wer du bist

• Sie verfügen über einen Hochschulabschluss oder sind ein erfahrener Produktionsexperte mit abgeschlossener Berufsausbildung, idealerweise im Bereich der pharmatechnologischen Herstellung oder einem verwandten Gebiet.

• Sie besitzen ein sehr gutes GMP-Verständnis sowie ein hohes Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsbewusstsein.

• Sie haben Erfahrung mit hochautomatisierten Anlagen im Produktionsmaßstab und ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an technischen Aspekten der Produktion.

• Sie zeigen eine hohe Motivation, Flexibilität und eine selbstständige Arbeitsweise in einem komplexen Umfeld.

• Sie verfügen über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Bereit für den nächsten Schritt? Wir freuen uns darauf, von dir zu hören. Bewirb dich jetzt, um diese spannende Möglichkeit zu entdecken!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere alti i nostri ambiziosi, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. jobs.title: Senior Partner Business Excellence
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love
Purpose
The purpose of this position is to actively promote Roche DIA product under responsibility to all targeted HCP/Labs. To ensure that all activities are in accordance with the SOP standards & to achieve all set sales budgets of all assigned products on cycle basis. The Position is responsible for sales and profitability objectives from existing and new accounts or clients

Your Opportunity
Sales Management

• Achievement of monthly/quarterly/yearly sales targets.

• Stock/expiry monitoring at institutional, customer and distributor levels.

• Implementation of marketing strategies and plans.

• Prospecting and developing new client relationships within a defined geography or market

• Build & maintain strong & credible relationships with HCP(s).

• Visit HCP(s) to collect market feedback and build product advocacy.

• Continuously improve the product, disease, market knowledge and promotion skills through self-reading and attending all products, marketing and medical training as assigned by the Management.

• To achieve all the agreed timelines planned for the assigned official tasks.

• Effective & productive database sales call

• Corporate image building with ethics and behaviour.

• In-Dept knowledge of HCPs, Customers, and accounts profile of his territory & update when required

• Focus on developing non-users HCP, customer and accounts

• Preparation/recommendations for tender business

• Maintaining existing accounts

• Regular reporting on day to day activities

• Additional tasks assigned by the management from time to time

Performance Management

• Align with supervisor to set mutually agreed objectives and tasks.

Resource Utilization

• Strive to the best for utilization of resources provided in the best interest of the business-like; data, team & financial resources etc.

Team Coordination

• Interdepartmental & intradepartmental coordination & collaboration to achieve overall business objectives

Additional Responsibilities

• Employees are expected to perform their duties to the benefit of the company, using common sense and the best of their knowledge. They are personally responsible for SHE in line with their know-how, skill and experience. They are required to learn and follow all programs, procedures and instructions relating to SHE, to report unsafe conditions or acts and to inform their line managers/supervisors if they are uncertain or unable to deal with a particular situation.

• It is mandatory for all employees to always display the company badge when inside the office, highlight or if necessary, stop or report the unauthorized movement to the site security officer.

• Comply with all applicable guidelines of Symphony, compliance and PRI/PSI

Who you are

• University degree (in science / related field/Lab) or

• Marketing degree with an aptitude for medical/technical information

Experience and knowledge

• Minimum 3-5 years of sales experience

• Understanding of the Diagnostic Industry

• Product Knowledge

• Market Knowledge

• Computer Literate (especially Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Word & Microsoft PowerPoint).

• Sales Data Analysis

Competencies

• Roche Leadership Competencies:

Job Specific Competencies

• Outstanding written and oral communication skills

• Superior business and negotiation skills

• Extensive industry contacts

• Ability and willingness to travel

• Negotiation & Influencing skills

• Teamwork

• Organization and planning skill
