jobs.title: Medical Affairs Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity
As a Medical Affairs Lead, you will play a central, highly collaborative role in our global mission by planning and implementing medical activities for our products in the customer area of Core Lab Reagents with focus on our women's health and endocrinology portfolio. You will join a fast-paced, matrixed environment where your scientific acumen and operational focus will directly shape our Global Medical Plan. This is an opportunity to combine science with strategy, ensuring that clinical value and medical insights are seamlessly integrated across our product lifecycle.

Your main responsibilities

• Shape Global Medical Plans: Contribute to annual and ongoing medical planning, delivering situational analysis and defined strategy to drive the lifecycle of our diagnostic innovations .

• Master Stakeholder Engagement: Drive the mapping of global Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and professional societies, managing lists of current and emerging experts to bring external know-how in-house .

• Execute High-Impact Activities: Lead the end-to-end execution of medical education, advisory boards, and scientific activities at major international congresses in close collaboration with our local affiliates .

• Manage Strategic Budgets: Oversee medical activity budgets and plan resource allocation in alignment with broader product teams and corporate finance .

• Ensure Scientific Integrity: Conduct thorough reviews of non-promotional medical materials, ensuring absolute alignment with global legal, regulatory, and company codes of practice .

• Cultivate Global Partnerships: Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with cross-functional leaders, clinical trial investigators, and external alliance partners, including Contract Research Organizations (CROs) .

• Drive Process Optimization: Permanently optimize processes to increase quality and efficiency standards across our medical operations .

Who You Are
You are a proactive, adaptable professional who thrives when collaborating across diverse teams . You are deeply patient-centric, possessing the strategic mindset and communication skills needed to translate complex data into clear medical concepts and influence diverse points of view .

To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Advanced Scientific Background: An advanced degree in Life Science or a related field, combined with relevant expertise in the healthcare industry or academia .

• Deep Sector Experience: 5+ years of experience in medical affairs, clinical development or scientific communication functions is preferred; project management or product marketing experience is a plus. As well as experience in one or more of the following indications Women's Health, Endocrinology, Laboratory Medicine

• Matrix Leadership Mastery: A proven track record of leading within matrixed organizations, making strategic decisions, and effectively influencing stakeholders .

• Cross-Cultural Agility: Demonstrated capability to partner across diverse regions, cultures, and time zones to actively build an environment of belonging and inclusion .

• Effective Communication: Excellent verbal and written English communication skills, allowing you to independently navigate complex situations and explain difficult concepts .

At Roche, inclusion isn’t just a policy—it’s a way of life. Together, we don’t just accept individuality—we embrace it.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Mansioni L'opportunità Come Leader per gli Affari Medici, svolgerai un ruolo centrale e altamente collaborativo nella nostra missione globale, pianificando e implementando attività mediche per i nostri prodotti nell'area clienti di Core Lab Reagents con particolare attenzione al portafoglio di salute e e endocrinologia femminile. Ti unirai a un ambiente a matrice rapida, dove il tuo acum scientifico e il tuo focus operativo plasmaranno direttamente il nostro Piano Medico Globale. Questa è un'opportunità per combinare la scienza con la strategia, assicurando che il valore clinico e le intuizioni mediche siano perfettamente integrate nel nostro ciclo di vita del prodotto. Le tue principali responsabilità - Forma Piani Medici Globali: Contribuisci alla pianificazione medica annuale e continua, fornendo analisi situazioni e strategia definita per guidare il ciclo di vita delle nostre innovazioni diagnostiche. - Master Stakeholder Engagement: Guidare la mappatura dei leader globali delle opinioni chiave (KOL) e società professionali, gestendo liste di esperti attuali ed emergenti per portare il know-how esterno in-house. - Esecuzione di attività ad alto impatto: condurre l'esecuzione end-to-end di educazione medica, consiglieri e attività scientifiche nei principali congressi internazionali in stretta collaborazione con i nostri affiliati locali. - Gestione dei bilanci strategici: supervisionare i bilanci delle attività mediche e pianificare l'allocazione delle risorse in allineamento con le squadre di prodotto più ampie e la finanza aziendale. - Assicurare l'integrità scientifica: Condurre valutazioni approfondite di materiali medici non promozionali, garantendo un allineamento assoluto con i codici di pratica legali, regolamentari e aziendali globali. - Coltivare partenariati globali: costruire e mantenere relazioni forti e collaborative con leader interfunzionali, ricercatori di sperimentazione clinica e partner di alleanza esterna, tra cui le Organizzazioni di Ricerca Contrattuali (CRO). - Ottimizzazione del processo di trasmissione: ottimizzare costantemente i processi per aumentare la qualità e gli standard di efficienza nelle nostre operazioni mediche.
• Requisiti Chi sei Sei un professionista proattivo e adattabile che prospera quando collabora tra diverse squadre. Sei profondamente paziente-centrico, possedendo le competenze strategiche e di comunicazione necessarie per tradurre i dati complessi in chiari concetti medici e influenzare diversi punti di vista. Per avere successo in questo ruolo, si porta: - Sfondo scientifico avanzato: un grado avanzato in Life Science o un campo correlato, combinato con competenze rilevanti nel settore sanitario o accademia. - Esperienza nel settore profondo: 5+ anni di esperienza negli affari medici, lo sviluppo clinico o le funzioni di comunicazione scientifica è preferito; la gestione del progetto o l'esperienza di marketing del prodotto è un plus. Oltre all'esperienza in una o più delle seguenti indicazioni: Salute femminile, Endocrinologia, Medicina di laboratorio. - Matrix Leadership Mastery: un comprovato track record di leader all'interno di organizzazioni matrici, prendere decisioni strategiche e influenzare efficacemente gli stakeholder. - Agility interculturale: Capacità dimostrata di collaborare in diverse regioni, culture e fusi orari per costruire attivamente un ambiente di appartenenza e inclusione. - Comunicazione efficace: eccellenti capacità di comunicazione inglese verbali e scritte, permettendo di navigare in modo indipendente situazioni complesse e spiegare concetti difficili. Cosa? A Roche, l’inclusione non è solo una politica: è un modo di vivere. Insieme, non accettiamo solo l’individualità – lo abbracciamo. Contatto Se si applica la trasparenza dei pagamenti, i dettagli vengono forniti in base alla posizione di pubblicazione primaria. Per questo ruolo, l'intervallo di paga non è fornito.

Mansion Die Chance Als Medical Affairs Lead spielen Sie eine zentrale, hochkollaborative Rolle in unserer globalen Mission, indem Sie medizinische Aktivitäten für unsere Produkte im Kundenbereich von Core Lab Reagents planen und implementieren, die sich auf das Gesundheits- und Endokrinologieportfolio unserer Frauen konzentrieren. Sie werden sich einer rasanten, Matrix-Umgebung anschließen, in der Ihr wissenschaftlicher Schwerpunkt und Ihr operativer Schwerpunkt direkt unseren globalen medizinischen Plan prägen. Dies ist eine Gelegenheit, Wissenschaft mit Strategie zu kombinieren, um sicherzustellen, dass klinische Werte und medizinische Erkenntnisse nahtlos in unseren Produktlebenszyklus integriert sind.
• Ihre Hauptaufgaben - Shape Global Medical Plans: Beitrag zur jährlichen und laufenden medizinischen Planung, Bereitstellung von Situationsanalysen und definierter Strategie, um den Lebenszyklus unserer diagnostischen Innovationen voranzutreiben. - Master Stakeholder Engagement: Führen Sie die Mapping von globalen Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) und Berufsgesellschaften, Managementlisten von aktuellen und aufstrebenden Experten, um externes Know-how in-house zu bringen. - Execute High-Impact-Aktivitäten: Führen Sie die End-to-End-Ausführung der medizinischen Ausbildung, Beratung und wissenschaftlichen Aktivitäten auf großen internationalen Kongressen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren lokalen Affiliates. - Verwalten Sie Strategische Budgets: Beaufsichtigen Sie die Budgets für medizinische Aktivitäten und planen Sie Ressourcenzuweisung in Abstimmung mit breiteren Produktteams und Unternehmensfinanzierung. - Vergewissern Sie sich, dass wissenschaftliche Integrität: Durchführung gründlicher Überprüfungen von nicht-promotionalen medizinischen Materialien, Sicherstellung absoluter Übereinstimmung mit globalen Rechts-, Regulierungs- und Unternehmenscodes der Praxis. - Cultivate Global Partnerships: Aufbau und Aufrechterhaltung starker, kollaborativer Beziehungen zu funktionsübergreifenden Führungskräften, klinischen Tester und externen Allianzpartnern, einschließlich Contract Research Organizations (CROs). - Prozessoptimierung: Prozessoptimierung permanent optimieren, um Qualitäts- und Effizienzstandards im gesamten medizinischen Betrieb zu erhöhen. Voraussetzungen Wer bist du? Sie sind ein proaktiver, anpassungsfähiger Profi, der bei der Zusammenarbeit zwischen verschiedenen Teams lebt. Sie sind zutiefst geduldig, besitzen die strategischen Denkweise und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, die benötigt werden, um komplexe Daten in klare medizinische Konzepte zu übersetzen und verschiedene Gesichtspunkte zu beeinflussen. Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, bringen Sie: - Fortgeschrittener wissenschaftlicher Hintergrund: Ein fortgeschrittener Abschluss in Life Science oder einem verwandten Bereich, kombiniert mit relevanten Fachkenntnissen in der Gesundheitsbranche oder in der Wissenschaft. - Deep Sector Experience: 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in medizinischen Angelegenheiten, klinische Entwicklung oder wissenschaftliche Kommunikationsfunktionen ist bevorzugt; Projektmanagement oder Produktmarketing-Erfahrung ist ein Plus. Neben der Erfahrung in einem oder mehreren der folgenden Hinweise: Frauengesundheit, Endokrinologie, Labormedizin. - Matrix Leadership Mastery: Ein bewährter Track-Recording von führenden in Matrix-Organisationen, strategische Entscheidungen zu treffen und effektiv Einfluss auf die Interessengruppen. - Cross-Cultural Agility: Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, in verschiedenen Regionen, Kulturen und Zeitzonen zusammenzuarbeiten, um aktiv ein Umfeld der Zugehörigkeit und Inklusion aufzubauen. - Effektive Kommunikation: Ausgezeichnete verbale und geschriebene englische Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, so dass Sie selbstständig komplexe Situationen navigieren und schwierige Konzepte erklären.
• Cosa offriamo Bei Roche ist die Integration nicht nur eine Politik – es ist eine Lebensweise. Gemeinsam akzeptieren wir nicht nur Individualität – wir umarmen es. Contattoo Bei Anwendung der Bezahlungstransparenz werden auf der Basis des primären Buchungsorts Angaben gemacht. Für diese Rolle wird der Lohnbereich nicht bereitgestellt.

Mansioni L'opportunité En tant que responsable des affaires médicales, vous jouerez un rôle central et hautement collaboratif dans notre mission mondiale en planifiant et en mettant en œuvre des activités médicales pour nos produits dans le secteur client de Core Lab Réactifs, en mettant l'accent sur notre portefeuille de femmes et d'endocrinologie. Vous vous joindrez à un environnement matricié et rapide où votre acuité scientifique et votre concentration opérationnelle façonneront directement notre Plan Médical Mondial. C'est l'occasion de combiner la science et la stratégie, en veillant à ce que la valeur clinique et les connaissances médicales soient intégrées de façon transparente dans notre cycle de vie des produits. Vos principales responsabilités - Former des plans médicaux mondiaux : contribuer à la planification médicale annuelle et continue, fournir une analyse de situation et une stratégie définie pour conduire le cycle de vie de nos innovations diagnostiques. - Maîtriser l'engagement des parties prenantes : Conduire la cartographie des leaders mondiaux de l'opinion et des sociétés professionnelles, gérer les listes d'experts actuels et émergents pour apporter un savoir-faire externe en interne. - Exécuter des activités à haut impact : Diriger l'exécution de bout en bout de l'enseignement médical, des conseils consultatifs et des activités scientifiques dans les grands congrès internationaux en étroite collaboration avec nos affiliés locaux. - Gérer les budgets stratégiques : Surveiller les budgets des activités médicales et planifier l'affectation des ressources en fonction des équipes de produits et des finances de l'entreprise. - Assurer l'intégrité scientifique : procéder à des examens approfondis du matériel médical non promotionnel, en assurant un alignement absolu sur les codes de pratique mondiaux en matière de droit, de réglementation et d'entreprise. - Cultiver des partenariats mondiaux : établir et maintenir des relations de collaboration solides avec des chefs de file interfonctionnels, des chercheurs en essais cliniques et des partenaires d'alliance externes, y compris des organismes de recherche contractuels. - Optimisation des processus d'entraînement : Optimisation permanente des processus pour améliorer la qualité et l'efficacité de nos opérations médicales.
• Requisiti Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un professionnel proactif et adaptable qui prospère en collaborant entre différentes équipes. Vous êtes profondément axé sur le patient, possédant l'état d'esprit stratégique et les compétences de communication nécessaires pour traduire des données complexes en concepts médicaux clairs et influencer divers points de vue. Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous apportez : - Contexte scientifique avancé : Diplôme d'études supérieures en sciences de la vie ou dans un domaine connexe, associé à une expertise pertinente dans l'industrie de la santé ou les universités. - Expérience de secteur profond: 5 ans et plus d'expérience dans les affaires médicales, le développement clinique ou les fonctions de communication scientifique est préféré; la gestion de projet ou l'expérience de marketing de produits est un plus. En plus de l'expérience dans une ou plusieurs des indications suivantes: santé des femmes, endocrinologie, médecine de laboratoire. - Maîtrise du leadership matricielle : une expérience éprouvée de leadership au sein des organisations matricielles, de prise de décisions stratégiques et d'influence efficace des intervenants. - Agilité transculturelle : Capacité démontrée de s'associer à diverses régions, cultures et fuseaux horaires pour construire activement un environnement d'appartenance et d'inclusion. - Communication efficace : Excellentes compétences de communication verbale et écrite en anglais, vous permettant de naviguer de façon indépendante dans des situations complexes et d'expliquer des concepts difficiles.

jobs.title: Clinical Site Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Clinical Site Manager for the Study Delivery Near Patient Care CVMD team, you are designing, planning, coordinating, and conducting all activities involved in initiating, monitoring, and completing clinical research studies at the clinical study sites. You are delivering other data generation methodologies, working independently to ensure studies are delivered, recorded, and reported in accordance with protocol, standard operating procedures, good clinical practices, and other applicable regulatory requirements.

The Opportunity

Acting as the primary contact and clinical trial expert for assigned study site personnel, coordinating training, certification, and providing technical assistance to ensure successful study execution.

• Performing site assessments and qualification visits to support the site selection decision process and site activation activities, including contracting and obtaining IRB/EC/Health Authority approvals in compliance with regulatory requirements.

• Developing and managing key study site documentation, such as Study Monitoring Plans, informed consent documents, source documents, patient instruction guides, and case report forms, while contributing technical expertise to review study protocols, data management plans, reports, and manuscripts.

• Overseeing CROs for the delivery of site management activities, including training CRO CRAs, escalating issues, and collaborating with international investigators and key customers while mentoring and supporting colleagues to enhance their skills and expertise.

• Executing site management activities for sponsored studies in assigned focus areas across all phases of study (start-up, conduct, and close-out) for both registrational and non-registrational purposes.

• Validating product performance claims, supplying data for critical regulatory submissions, defining the functional and clinical utility of products, and gathering feedback and opinions from laboratories or customers regarding the products.

jobs.title: Clinical Contract Administrator
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity
As a Clinical Contract Administrator, you will play a vital role in ensuring the smooth financial and operational execution of our clinical studies. You will act as a key collaborator between Clinical Operations, Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Procurement, Legal, and Finance to manage the lifecycle of supplier contracts and payments. This is an opportunity to join a high-performing team where your attention to detail directly supports the delivery of innovative healthcare solutions.

The key accountabilities for this position include but are not limited to

• Drive Financial Accuracy: Create and track purchase orders (POs), invoices, and accruals using our financial systems to ensure all supplier payments are precise and timely.

• Optimize Data Integrity: Maintain and update contract information within our tracking tools to ensure completeness and accuracy at all times.

• Master Contract Lifecycle Management: Take end-to-end responsibility for the contract signature process, from initial request through to service termination and final reconciliation. Track, maintain, and update assigned contract information within the CDMA tracking tools to ensure completeness and accuracy, as applicable.

• Champion Compliance Reporting: Prepare and submit reports regarding transfers of value to healthcare providers, ensuring full adherence to industry transparency standards like the Sunshine Act.

• Build Strategic Partnerships: Cultivate strong, collaborative relationships with cross-functional leaders and external suppliers to meet ambitious business goals.

• Help drive the site budget negotiations in alignment with Fair Market Value.

• Other tasks may be assigned from time to time to support the overall CDMA function.

Who You Are
You are an organized and detail-oriented professional who thrives in fast-paced, matrixed environments. You are a natural collaborator who enjoys solving complex financial administrative challenges while working alongside diverse global teams.

To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Educational Foundation: A Bachelor’s degree in Business or a related field (or equivalent relevant expertise in the healthcare industry).

• Sector Experience: 3-5+ years of professional experience, with specific expertise in purchase order (PO) creation and invoice management. Experience with negotiating budgets with clinical sites is a plus.

• Technical Proficiency: Proven experience tracking financial data such as accruals and payments within complex business environments.

• Collaborative Mindset: The ability to work independently while effectively partnering across functions like Legal, Procurement, and Clinical Operations.

• Demonstrate flexibility and adaptability to perform in a fast-paced, matrixed environment where fluid, cross-team collaboration is crucial.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills (English).

At Roche, you’ll thrive in a culture that values different perspectives and creates a place of belonging, where we challenge ourselves to excel and achieve strong results, together.

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Sant Cugat del Vallès. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.

Collaborerai consapevole con le funzioni di Clinical Operations, Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Procurement, Legale e Finance per gestire il ciclo di vita dei contratti e dei pagamenti dei fornitori. Unisciti al nostro team di alto rendimento, dove la tua attenzione ai support direttamente la consegna di soluzioni sanitarie innovative. Compiti chiave I compiti chiave per questo ruolo includono, ma non si limitano a: - Guidare l'Accuratezza Finanziaria: Creare e monitorare gli ordini di acquisto (POs), le fatture e accantonamenti utilizzando i nostri sistemi finanziari per garantire che tutti i pagamenti dei fornitori siano precisi e tempestivi. - Ottimizzare l'Integrità dei Dati: Mantenere e aggiornare le informazioni contrattuali all'interno dei nostri strumenti di tracciamento per garantire la completezza e l'accuratezza in ogni momento. - Gestire il Ciclo di Vita del Contratto: Assumi la responsabilità end-to-end del processo di firma del contratto, dalla richiesta iniziale alla terminazione del servizio e alla confession finale. Traccia, mantiene e aggiorna le informazioni contrattuali assegnate all'interno degli strumenti di tracciamento CDMA per garantire la completezza e l'accuratezza, se applicabile. - Promuovere la Conformità alle Relazioni: Preparare e presentare i rapporti sulle restrizioni di valore con i fornitori sanitari, garantendo il rispetto degli standard di trasparenza del settore come l'Act Sunshine. - Costruire Partnership Strategiche: Coltiva relazioni collaborative e solide con i leader cross-functionali e i fornitori esterni per raggiungere gli ambiziosi obiettivi aziendali. - Contribuire alla Negoziazione del Budget del Sito: Aiutare a guidare il budget del sito in linea con il Valore di Mercato Equo. - Altri compiti potrebbero essere assegnati di volta in volta per supportare la funzione CDMA nel suo insieme. Chi sei? Sei un professionista organizzato e attento ai dettagli che prospera in ambienti veloci e matricizzati. Sei un collaboratore nato che gode nel risolvere complessi problemi amministrativi lavorando con team globali diversi. Per avere successo in questo ruolo, porti: - Formazione Educativa: Un diploma di laurea in Business o in un campo correlato (o esperienza equivalente e rilevante nel settore sanitario). - Esperienza di Settore: 3-5+ anni di esperienza professionale, con esperienza specifica nella creazione degli ordini di acquisto (POs) e nella gestione delle fatture. L'esperienza nella definizione dei budget con i siti clinici è un plus. - Competenze Tecniche: Prova esperienza nel tracciamento dei dati finanziari come accantonamenti e pagamenti all'interno di ambienti aziendali complessi. - Mentalità Collaborativa: La capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente mentre si collabora con le funzioni come Legal, Procurement e Clinical Operations. - Flessibilità e Adattabilità: Dimostra flessibilità e adattabilità per operare in un ambiente veloce e matricizzato in cui la collaborazione cross-team fluida è fondamentale. - Eccellenti Abilità di Comunicazione Verbale e Scritta** (Inglese). Cosa? A Roche, prospererai in una cultura che apprezza le diverse prospettive e pieghe un posto di appartenenza, dove ci sfidiamo a eccellere e raggiungere risultati forti insieme. Per questo ruolo, la percentuale viene fornita in base alla località principale di pubblicazione. Per questo ruolo, la località principale è Sant Cugat del Vallès. Se sei interessato ad altre località in cui il ruolo potrebbe essere disponibile, perniamo i dettagli sulla percezione durante il processo di assunzione. Contatto Per ulteriori informazioni o per candidarsi, visita il nostro sito web o contatta il nostro team delle risorse umane.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalise treatment because every patient is unique. Our Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) team drives innovation to improve healthcare outcomes globally.

We see ourselves and our customers as a team that can only reach its full potential together. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitalisation and new technologies, we get closer to their real-world needs. This collaborative spirit creates an environment where ideas can grow and new ways of doing things can be tried - resulting in competitive products that get to patients faster .

Our work spans the entire product lifecycle, from discovery to post-launch. By collaborating with internal teams, external partners, and patients, the CDMA chapter provides crucial medical insights, designs and executes clinical studies, and offers on-market support. Ultimately, we generate the comprehensive clinical evidence that demonstrates product safety, effectiveness, and scientific validity - facilitating smooth product registration, adoption and reimbursement globally so we can save lives and improve patient quality of life .

The Opportunity

At Roche, we believe care should start before disease takes hold. As a Senior Clinical Data Specialist within our Clinical Operations team, you will perform expert-level data management activities that directly enable innovation, data-driven insights, and continuous improvement across our clinical and development projects. In this pivotal role, you will ensure the delivery of complete, accurate data ready for analysis and regulatory submission, helping us deliver life-changing healthcare solutions faster and more efficiently.

Key Responsibilities :

• Lead Complex Projects : Function as the Lead Data Manager (LDM) and primary point of contact for clinical data management issues, guiding data management teams on large-scale programs and managing timelines and resource planning.

• Define Data Architecture : Use your professional expertise to define study-specific data workflows, clinical database requirements, and create comprehensive data management documentation (including CRFs, DMPs, database specifications, and data transfer specifications).

• Ensure Data Excellence : Oversee data quality by defining performance metrics, analysing trends, and performing expert data reviews to identify and resolve incomplete or discrepant data.

• Collaborate Cross-Functionally : Represent Data Management in cross-functional study team meetings, providing technical clarification and fostering strong partnerships across departments.

• Mentor and Coach : Drive departmental excellence by mentoring team members, sharing best practices, and supporting the implementation of new technologies.

Who You Are

You are a collaborative, analytical problem-solver who thrives in a dynamic environment and excels at translating complex technical data concepts for non-technical colleagues. You bring strong professional judgment, a dedication to data quality, and a passion for mentoring others to reach their full potential. To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Educational Background : A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a scientific discipline.

• Clinical Data Expertise : Extensive, progressive experience in clinical data management with a comprehensive understanding of the clinical study process.

• Regulatory Knowledge : A solid understanding of regulatory and

descriptionByLocale.it: # Mansioni At Roche, ogni voce conta. Qui puoi essere te stesso, apprezzato per le tue unicità e incoraggiato a esprimerti personalmente, dialogare apertamente e creare connessioni genuine. La nostra cultura valorizza, accetta e rispetta ogni individuo, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. Questo è il modo in cui miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie, garantendo a tutti l'accesso alle cure oggi e per le generazioni future. Unisciti a Roche e contribuisci a fare la differenza. ## La Posizione Presso Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), la nostra missione è chiara: diagnosticare prima, sviluppare più velocemente e personalizzare il trattamento perché ogni paziente è unico. Il nostro team di Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) guida l'innovazione per migliorare i risultati sanitari a livello globale. Ci consideriamo una squadra che può raggiungere il suo pieno potenziale solo lavorando insieme ai nostri clienti. Ascoltando attentamente i pazienti e i medici e sfruttando la digitalizzazione e le nuove tecnologie, ci avviciniamo alle loro esigenze reali. Questo spirito collaborativo crea un ambiente in cui le idee possono crescere e si possono provare nuovi modi di fare le cose - con il risultato di prodotti competitivi che arrivano ai pazienti più velocemente. Il nostro lavoro copre l'intero ciclo di vita del prodotto, dalla scoperta al post-lancio. Collaborando con i team interni, i partner esterni e i pazienti, il capitolo CDMA fornisce preziose informazioni mediche, progetta ed esegue gli studi clinici e offre il supporto sul mercato. Infine, generiamo le prove cliniche complete che dimostrano la sicurezza, l'efficacia e la validità scientifica del prodotto - facilitando la registrazione, l'adozione e il rimborso dei prodotti a livello globale per salvare vite e migliorare la qualità della vita dei pazienti. ## L'Opportunità In Roche crediamo che le cure debbano iniziare prima che la malattia si manifesti. Come Senior Clinical Data Specialist nel nostro team di Clinical Operations, svolgerai attività di gestione dei dati di livello esperto che consentono directly l'innovazione, le intuizioni basate sui dati e il miglioramento continuo sui nostri progetti clinici e di sviluppo. In questo ruolo chiave, ti assicurerai che i dati completi e accurati siano pronti per l'analisi e la presentazione regolamentare, aiutandoci a consegnare soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita più velocemente ed efficientemente. ## Responsabilità Chiave - **Guida Progetti Complessi**: Funziona come Lead Data Manager (LDM) e punto di contatto principale per le questioni di gestione dei dati clinici, guida i team di gestione dei dati sui programmi di grandi dimensioni e gestisce i tempi e la pianificazione delle risorse. - **Definizione dell'Architettura dei Dati**: Utilizza la tua esperienza professionale per definire i flussi di lavoro dei dati specifici dello studio, le esigenze del database clinico e crea la documentazione di gestione dei dati completa (inclusi i moduli CRF, i piani di gestione dei dati, le specifiche del database e le specifiche del trasferimento dei dati). - **Garantire l'Eccellenza dei Dati**: Sorveglia la qualità dei dati definendo le metriche di prestazione, analizzando le tendenze e eseguendo revisioni dei dati esperte per identificare e risolvere i dati incompleti o discordanti. - **Collaborazione Cross-Funzionale**: Rappresenta la Gestione dei Dati negli incontri del team di studio cross-funzionale, fornendo chiarimenti tecnici e favorendo forti partnership tra i dipartimenti. - **Mentoring e Coaching**: Promuovi l'eccellenza del dipartimento mentendo i membri del team, condividendo le migliori pratiche e supportando l'implementazione di nuove tecnologie. ## Chi Sei Sei un collaboratore analitico che risolve i problemi e che prospera in un ambiente dinamico, eccellendo nella traduzione dei complessi concetti tecnici dei dati per i colleghi non tecnici. Porti un forte giudizio professionale, una dedizione alla qualità dei dati e una passione per la mentoring degli altri per raggiungere il loro pieno potenziale. Per avere successo in questo ruolo, porti: - **Formazione Accademica**: Una laurea o una laurea magistrale in una disciplina scientifica. - **Esperienza nella Gestione dei Dati Clinici**: Esperienza estesa e progressiva nella gestione dei dati clinici con una comprensione completa del processo di studio clinico. - **Conoscenza Regolamentare**: Una solida conoscenza delle normative e delle linee guida internazionali per la gestione dei dati clinici. ## Contatto Per ulteriori informazioni o per candidarsi, visita il nostro sito web o contatta il nostro team delle risorse umane.

descriptionByLocale.de: Sendungen Bei Roche zählt jede Stimme. Hier können Sie sich selbst sein, für Ihre Einzigartigkeit geschätzt und ermutigt, sich persönlich auszudrücken, offen Dialog und echte Verbindungen zu schaffen. Unsere Kulturwerte, akzeptiert und respektiert jedes Individuum und ermöglicht es Ihnen, sowohl auf persönlicher als auch auf professioneller Ebene zu leben. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen, den Zugang zur Pflege heute und für zukünftige Generationen gewährleisten. Begleiten Sie Roche und helfen, einen Unterschied zu machen. Die Lage Bei Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) ist unsere Mission klar: zuerst diagnostizieren, schneller entwickeln und die Behandlung anpassen, weil jeder Patient einzigartig ist. Unser Team von Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) leitet Innovationen, um die Gesundheitsergebnisse weltweit zu verbessern. Wir betrachten uns als ein Team, das sein volles Potenzial nur durch die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden erreichen kann. Wenn wir Patienten und Ärzte aufmerksam zuhören und die Digitalisierung und neue Technologien nutzen, nähern wir uns ihren wirklichen Bedürfnissen. Dieser kollaborative Geist schafft eine Umgebung, in der Ideen wachsen können, und Sie können neue Wege versuchen, Dinge zu tun - mit dem Ergebnis von wettbewerbsfähigen Produkten, die zu Patienten schneller kommen. Unsere Arbeit deckt den gesamten Lebenszyklus des Produktes ab, von der Entdeckung bis zum Post-Lunch. In Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams, externen Partnern und Patienten bietet das CDMA-Kapitel wertvolle medizinische Informationen, Designs und führt klinische Studien durch und bietet Marktunterstützung. Schließlich generieren wir komplette klinische Studien, die die Sicherheit, Wirksamkeit und wissenschaftliche Gültigkeit des Produktes demonstrieren - die Registrierung, Annahme und Erstattung von Produkten weltweit, um Leben zu retten und die Qualität des Patientenlebens zu verbessern. Die Chance In Roche glauben wir, dass die Behandlung beginnen sollte, bevor sich die Krankheit manifestiert. Als Senior Clinical Data Specialist in unserem Klinischen Operations-Team werden Sie kompetente Datenmanagement-Aktivitäten durchführen, die Innovationen, datenbasierte Erkenntnisse und kontinuierliche Verbesserungen in unseren klinischen und Entwicklungsprojekten direkt ermöglichen. In dieser Schlüsselrolle stellen Sie sicher, dass vollständige und genaue Daten für die regulatorische Analyse und Präsentation bereit sind und helfen uns, Gesundheitslösungen zu liefern, die das Leben schneller und effizienter verändern. Schlüsselverantwortung - Guide Complex Projects: Es arbeitet als Lead Data Manager (LDM) und Hauptkontaktpunkt für klinische Datenmanagement-Probleme, führt Datenmanagement-Teams zu großen Programmen und verwaltet Zeit- und Ressourcenplanung. - Definition von Data Architecture: Benutzen Sie Ihre Berufserfahrung, um studienspezifische Daten-Workflows, klinische Datenbankanforderungen zu definieren und eine vollständige Datenverwaltungsdokumentation zu erstellen (einschließlich CRF-Module, Datenmanagementpläne, Datenbankspezifikationen und Datentransferspezifikationen). - Datenschutz-Exzellenz: Es überwacht die Qualität der Daten durch Definition von Leistungsmetriken, Analyse von Trends und Durchführung von Expertendaten-Revisionen, um unvollständige oder diskrete Daten zu identifizieren und zu lösen. - Cross-Function-Kollaboration: Es stellt das Data Management in den Sitzungen des funktionsübergreifenden Studienteams dar und bietet technische Klärung und Förderung starker Partnerschaften zwischen den Abteilungen. - Mentoring and Coaching: Fördern Sie die Exzellenz der Abteilung durch lügende Teammitglieder, teilen Sie die besten Praktiken und unterstützen Sie die Umsetzung neuer Technologien. Wer sind Sie? Sie sind ein analytischer Mitarbeiter, der Probleme und Drives in einem dynamischen Umfeld löst und sich in der Übersetzung komplexer technischer Datenkonzepte für nichttechnische Kollegen auszeichnet. Bringen Sie ein starkes professionelles Urteil, Engagement für die Datenqualität und eine Leidenschaft für Mentoring andere, um ihr volles Potenzial zu erreichen. Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, bringen Sie: - Akademische Ausbildung: Master-Abschluss oder Abschluss in einer wissenschaftlichen Disziplin. - Erfahrung im klinischen Datenmanagement: Umfangreiche und fortschrittliche Erfahrung im klinischen Datenmanagement mit einem vollständigen Verständnis der klinischen Studie. - Regelmäßiges Wissen: Ein fundiertes Wissen über internationale Vorschriften und Richtlinien für die Verwaltung von klinischen Daten. Kontakt Für weitere Informationen oder um sich zu bewerben, besuchen Sie unsere Website oder kontaktieren Sie unser Personalteam.
descriptionByLocale.fr: Chez Roche, chaque voix compte. Ici vous pouvez être vous-même, apprécié pour votre unicité et encouragé à vous exprimer personnellement, dialoguer ouvertement et créer de véritables connexions. Nos valeurs culturelles, accepte et respecte chaque individu, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois au niveau personnel et professionnel. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies, en assurant l'accès aux soins aujourd'hui et pour les générations futures. Rejoignez Roche et aidez à faire la différence. Position Chez Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), notre mission est claire : diagnostiquer d'abord, développer plus rapidement et personnaliser le traitement car chaque patient est unique. Notre équipe Développement clinique et affaires médicales (CDMA) guide l'innovation pour améliorer les résultats de soins de santé à l'échelle mondiale. Nous nous considérons comme une équipe qui ne peut atteindre son plein potentiel qu'en travaillant avec nos clients. En écoutant attentivement les patients et les médecins et en profitant de la numérisation et des nouvelles technologies, nous abordons leurs besoins réels. Cet esprit de collaboration crée un environnement où les idées peuvent grandir et vous pouvez essayer de nouvelles façons de faire - avec le résultat de produits compétitifs qui arrivent aux patients plus rapidement. Notre travail couvre tout le cycle de vie du produit, de la découverte à la post-lancement. En collaboration avec des équipes internes, des partenaires externes et des patients, le chapitre CDMA fournit des informations médicales précieuses, conçoit et réalise des études cliniques et offre un soutien commercial. Enfin, nous produisons des essais cliniques complets qui démontrent l'innocuité, l'efficacité et la validité scientifique du produit - facilitant l'enregistrement, l'adoption et le remboursement des produits dans le monde entier pour sauver des vies et améliorer la qualité de vie des patients. Possibilités À Roche, nous pensons que les soins devraient commencer avant que la maladie ne se manifeste. En tant que spécialiste principal des données cliniques au sein de notre équipe des opérations cliniques, vous effectuerez des activités de gestion des données d'experts qui permettent directement l'innovation, les idées fondées sur les données et l'amélioration continue de nos projets cliniques et de développement. Dans ce rôle clé, vous veillerez à ce que des données complètes et précises soient prêtes pour l'analyse et la présentation réglementaires, nous aidant à fournir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie plus rapidement et efficacement. Key Responsibility - Guida Progetti Complessi: Il fonctionne comme gestionnaire de données principal (DND) et principal point de contact pour les questions de gestion des données cliniques, guide les équipes de gestion des données sur les grands programmes et gère la planification du temps et des ressources. - Définition de l'architecture des données : Utilisez votre expérience professionnelle pour définir les flux de données spécifiques à l'étude, les besoins des bases de données cliniques et créer une documentation complète de gestion des données (y compris les modules CRF, les plans de gestion des données, les spécifications des bases de données et les spécifications de transfert de données). - Assurer l'excellence des données : Il supervise la qualité des données en définissant des paramètres de rendement, en analysant les tendances et en effectuant des révisions de données d'experts pour identifier et résoudre des données incomplètes ou discordantes. - Collaboration interfonctions : Représente la gestion des données aux réunions de l'équipe d'étude interfonctionnelle, fournissant des éclaircissements techniques et favorisant des partenariats solides entre les ministères. - Mentorat et coaching : Promouvoir l'excellence du département en faisant partie de l'équipe, en partageant les meilleures pratiques et en appuyant la mise en oeuvre de nouvelles technologies. Qui êtes-vous un collaborateur analytique qui résout les problèmes et prospère dans un environnement dynamique, excellent dans la traduction de concepts de données techniques complexes pour les collègues non techniques. Apportez un jugement professionnel fort, un dévouement à la qualité des données et une passion pour le mentorat afin d'atteindre leur plein potentiel. Pour y arriver, vous devrez : - Formation académique : Maîtrise ou diplôme dans une discipline scientifique. - Expérience en gestion des données cliniques: Expérience étendue et progressive en gestion des données cliniques avec une compréhension complète de l'essai clinique. - Connaissances régulières : Une connaissance solide des règlements et lignes directrices internationaux pour la gestion des données cliniques. Contact Pour plus d'informations ou pour postuler, visitez notre site Web ou contactez notre équipe de ressources humaines.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalise treatment because every patient is unique. Our Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) team drives innovation to improve healthcare outcomes globally.

We see ourselves and our customers as a team that can only reach its full potential together. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitalisation and new technologies, we get closer to their real-world needs. This collaborative spirit creates an environment where ideas can grow and new ways of doing things can be tried - resulting in competitive products that get to patients faster .

Our work spans the entire product lifecycle, from discovery to post-launch. By collaborating with internal teams, external partners, and patients, the CDMA chapter provides crucial medical insights, designs and executes clinical studies, and offers on-market support. Ultimately, we generate the comprehensive clinical evidence that demonstrates product safety, effectiveness, and scientific validity - facilitating smooth product registration, adoption and reimbursement globally so we can save lives and improve patient quality of life .

We are looking for a dynamic and experienced Global Study Lead to join our team. In this pivotal role, you will lead global study teams to ensure the successful execution of clinical studies. You will be responsible for delivering high-quality study designs, adhering to timelines and budgets, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to support evidence generation strategies. If you have a passion for advancing clinical trials in the cardiovascular/metabolic area, specifically in Near Patient Care , we would love to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities :

• Lead and oversee the global study team, ensuring full accountability for study deliverables including quality, budget, and timelines.

• Collaborate with Program Leadership to prepare different scenarios for evidence generation (e.g., study, real-world evidence) and ensure cross-functional cooperation with Regulatory Affairs, R&D, Biostatistics, Data Management, Medical Affairs and CDMA Project Teams.

• Develop key study documents such as Design Validation Plans, study protocols, training materials, study forms, templates, and study reports.

• Maintain responsibility for the study-level budget of assigned studies.

• Ensure compliance with regulations, guidelines, and standard operating procedures, while ensuring audit/inspection readiness.

• Oversee execution of sponsored studies for registrational and non-registrational purposes through all study phases (planning, start-up, conduct, and close-out).

• Manage study activities outsourced to service providers, including CROs, ensuring timely and quality execution.

• Work with the Publication Team to ensure study results are effectively published.

• Track project performance and ensure that projects are completed on time, within scope, and within budget.

• Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including cross-functional teams, CROs, opinion leaders, investigators, and key customers.

Your Profile:

• Strong experience in clinical trial management, particularly in the cardiovascular/metabolic indication and Near Patient Care or Point of Care. Experience with studies in an emergency department setting is a plus.

• You have a degree in Life Sciences, Healthcare, or a related field. A backgro

Collaborando con i team interni, i partner esterni e i pazienti, il capitolo CDMA fornisce preziose informazioni mediche, pianifica ed esegue gli studi clinici e offre il supporto sul mercato. Infine, generiamo le prove cliniche complete che visualizza la sicurezza, l'efficacia e la potenza scientifica del prodotto - facilitando la registrazione, l'adozione e il rimborso del prodotto a livello globale per salvare vite e migliorare la qualitÃ della vita dei pazienti.
• Stiamo cercando un Global Study Lead ed esperto da unire al nostro team. In questo ruolo chiave, guiderai i team di studio globale per garantire l'esecuzione degli studi clinici. Sarai responsabile della consegna di progetti di studio di alta qualità, dell'aderenza ai tempi e ai budget e della collaborazione con i team multifunzionali per supportare le strategie di generazione delle prove. Se hai una passione per lontano avanzare gli studi clinici nell'area cardiovascolare/metabolica, ordinati nell'Assistenza Vicina al Paziente, impossibilitati di sentirti! Responsabilità Chiave - Guida e supervisiona il team di studio globale, garanzia la piena responsabilità per le consegne dello studio, inclusi qualità, budget e tempi. - Collabora con la Direzione del Programma per preparare diversi scenari per generazione delle prove (ad esempio, studio, prove del mondo reale) e garantire la cooperazione multifunzionale con gli Affari Regolatori, R&D, Biostatistica, Gestione dei Dati, Medi Affarico e i Team di Progetto CDMA. - I documenti chiave dello studio, come i Piani di Validazione del Design, i protocolli dello studio, i materiali di formazione, i moduli dello studio, i template e i rapporti dello studio. - Mantiene la responsabilità del budget a livello di studio degli studi assegnati. - Garantisce il rispetto delle normative, delle linee guida e delle procedure operative standard, mentre garantisce la prontezza all'audit/ispezione. - Supervisa l'esecuzione degli studi finanziati per scopi registrativi e non registrativi attraverso tutte le fasi dello studio (pianificazione, avvio, condotta e chiusura). - Gestisce le attività dello studio delegato ai fornitori di servizi, inclusi i CRO, garantendo l'esecuzione tempestiva e di qualità. - con il Team di Pubblicazione per garantire che i risultati dello studio legale. - Monitora le prestazioni del progetto e garanzie che i progetti si completano nei tempi, nella portata e nel budget. - Costruisce e mantiene relazioni collaborative forti con i stakeholder interni ed esterni, inclusi i team multifunzionali, i CRO, i leader del settore, gli investigatori e i clienti chiave. Profilo - Forte esperienza nella gestione degli studi clinici, in particolare nell'indicazione cardiovascolare/metabolica e nell'Assistenza Vicina al Paziente o al Punto di Cura. L'esperienza con gli studi in un setting del Pronto Soccorso è un plus. - Hai un titolo di studio in Scienze della Vita, Sanità o un campo affine. Un background in ricerca clinica o sviluppo di prodotti farmaceutici è un vantaggio. - Conoscenze approfondite delle normative e delle linee guida internazionali per gli studi clinici. - Esperienza nella gestione di progetti complessi e nella collaborazione con team multifunzionali. - Capacità di comunicazione efficace e di costruzione di relazioni con stakeholder interni ed esterni. - Capacità di prendere decisioni e risolvere problemi in modo autonomo e in ambienti incerti. - Disponibilità a viaggiare internazionalmente per incontri di progetto e visite ai siti degli studi. Cosa somministra - Un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo e collaborativo che valorizza la diversità e l'inclusione. - Opportunità di crescita professionale e sviluppo delle competenze in un'azienda globale leader nel settore della salute. - No. Un pacchetto retributivo competitivo e vantaggi sociali. - L'opportunità di contribuire a fare la differenza nella vita delle persone attraverso il nostro lavoro. Contatto Se sei interessato a questa opportunità di carriera, ti compete a candidarti online attraverso il nostro sito web. Ti ringraziamo per l'interesse dimostrato per Roche e il nostro team di Clinical Development & Medical Affairs.

jobs.title: Global Study Lead (Molecular Lab)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalise treatment because every patient is unique. Our Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) team drives innovation to improve healthcare outcomes globally.

We see ourselves and our customers as a team that can only reach its full potential together. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitalisation and new technologies, we get closer to their real-world needs. This collaborative spirit creates an environment where ideas can grow and new ways of doing things can be tried - resulting in competitive products that get to patients faster .

Our work spans the entire product lifecycle, from discovery to post-launch. By collaborating with internal teams, external partners, and patients, the CDMA chapter provides crucial medical insights, designs and executes clinical studies, and offers on-market support. Ultimately, we generate the comprehensive clinical evidence that demonstrates product safety, effectiveness, and scientific validity - facilitating smooth product registration, adoption and reimbursement globally so we can save lives and improve patient quality of life .

The Opportunity

As a Global Study Lead, you will take full accountability for the design, planning, and execution of global sponsored clinical trials from protocol development through to close-out. Joining a dynamic, matrixed team within our Clinical Development and Medical Affairs communities, you will oversee diverse study portfolios, including companion diagnostics, early adopter programs, and research collaborations, ensuring operational excellence, budget control, and absolute inspection readiness.

• Drive Study Excellence : Lead the global cross-functional study team with full accountability for high-quality study designs, clinical deliverables, budgets, and timelines.

• Shape Evidence Strategies : Partner with Program Leadership to map out innovative scenarios for global evidence generation, collaborating across Regulatory Affairs, R&D, and medical project teams.

• Author Core Study Documentation : Develop critical, high-impact clinical documents including study protocols, Design Validation Plans, study forms, and comprehensive study reports.

• Champion Strategic Partnerships : Oversee external service providers and Contract Research Organisations (CROs), driving vendor performance, selection, and relationship management at the study level.

• Advance Diagnostics Innovation : Direct the operational aspects of companion diagnostics studies sponsored by external partners alongside early access and research collaboration portfolios.

• Cultivate Expert Networks : Collaborate closely with international medical opinion leaders, investigators, and key external stakeholders to bring advanced external insights in-house.

Who You Are

You are a proactive, analytical clinical operations professional who thrives in fast-paced, global environments. You bring a collaborative mindset, excellent communication skills, and a passion for delivering life-changing clinical insights.

• A degree in Life Sciences, Healthcare, or a related scientific field (an advanced degree is a plus).

• Strong, progressive experience in clinical trial management or study-level execution within the healthcare, pharmaceutical, or biotechnology sectors. Preferably experience study managing Molecular IVD clinical trials.

• Solid working knowledge of clinical research standards and gl

De préférence, l'expérience d'une étude portant sur la gestion des essais cliniques de DIV moléculaires.
• Bonne connaissance pratique des normes de recherche clinique

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalise treatment because every patient is unique. Our Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) team drives innovation to improve healthcare outcomes globally.

We see ourselves and our customers as a team that can only reach its full potential together. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitalisation and new technologies, we get closer to their real-world needs. This collaborative spirit creates an environment where ideas can grow and new ways of doing things can be tried - resulting in competitive products that get to patients faster .

Our work spans the entire product lifecycle, from discovery to post-launch. By collaborating with internal teams, external partners, and patients, the CDMA chapter provides crucial medical insights, designs and executes clinical studies, and offers on-market support. Ultimately, we generate the comprehensive clinical evidence that demonstrates product safety, effectiveness, and scientific validity - facilitating smooth product registration, adoption and reimbursement globally so we can save lives and improve patient quality of life .

We are looking for a dynamic and experienced Global Study Lead to join our team. In this pivotal role, you will lead global study teams to ensure the successful execution of clinical studies. You will be responsible for delivering high-quality study designs, adhering to timelines and budgets, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to support evidence generation strategies.

If you have a passion for advancing clinical trials in the cardiovascular/metabolic disease area (CVMD), specifically in Core Lab SWA (Serum Work Area) Systems and Automation, we would love to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities :

• Lead and oversee the global study team, ensuring full accountability for study deliverables including quality, budget, and timelines.

• Collaborate with Program Leadership to prepare different scenarios for evidence generation (e.g., study, real-world evidence) and ensure cross-functional cooperation with Regulatory Affairs, R&D,Biostatistics, Data Management and CDMA Project Teams.

• Develop key study documents such as Design Validation Plans, study protocols, training materials, study forms, templates, and study reports.

• Maintain responsibility for the study-level budget of assigned studies.

• Ensure compliance with regulations, guidelines, and standard operating procedures, while ensuring audit/inspection readiness.

• Oversee execution of sponsored studies for registrational and non-registrational purposes through all study phases (planning, start-up, conduct, and close-out).

• Manage study activities outsourced to service providers, including CROs, ensuring timely and quality execution.

• Work with the Publication Team to ensure study results are effectively published.

• Track project performance and ensure that projects are completed on time, within scope, and within budget.

• Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including cross-functional teams, CROs, opinion leaders, investigators, and key customers.

Who are you:

• Strong experience in clinical trial management, particularly in the cardiovascular/metabolic indication. Experience with IVD clinical and analytical system studies in the Core Lab Serum Work Area setting is a plus.

• You have a degree in Life Sciences, Healthc

• Collaborate cross-functionally with global, local, and virtual teams, demonstrating diversity, cultural awareness, and fostering strong, collaborative relationships with cross-functional team members, internal stakeholders, and external partners to achieve business goals and ensure operational excellence.

As a Clinical Site Manager specialising in our molecular lab portfolio, you will be responsible for designing, planning, coordinating, and conducting clinical research studies across assigned sites. This role offers an exciting opportunity to validate product performance claims, supply crucial data for regulatory submissions, and directly help deliver innovative diagnostic solutions to patients worldwide.

Key Responsibilities :

• Conduct Site Assessments : Perform comprehensive site assessments and qualification visits to drive informed site selection decisions.

• Manage Site Activation : Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure investigational sites properly obtain and maintain institutional approvals and meet all regulatory compliance needs before trial initiation.

• Deliver End-to-End Monitoring : Execute all data generation, data validation, and comprehensive site visits across all study phases, from start-up through to close-out.

• Partner Cross-Functionally : Work dynamically within local, global, and virtual study teams, collaborating with R&D, Field Service, Study Management, and Biometrics to deliver top-tier solutions.

jobs.title: Clinical Development Lead (Neuroscience)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalise treatment because every patient is unique. Our Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) team drives innovation to improve healthcare outcomes globally.

We see ourselves and our customers as a team that can only reach its full potential together. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitalisation and new technologies, we get closer to their real-world needs. This collaborative spirit creates an environment where ideas can grow and new ways of doing things can be tried - resulting in competitive products that get to patients faster .

Our work spans the entire product lifecycle, from discovery to post-launch. By collaborating with internal teams, external partners, and patients, the CDMA chapter provides crucial medical insights, designs and executes clinical studies, and offers on-market support. Ultimately, we generate the comprehensive clinical evidence that demonstrates product safety, effectiveness, and scientific validity - facilitating smooth product registration, adoption and reimbursement globally so we can save lives and improve patient quality of life .

The Opportunity

Are you ready to shape the future of healthcare by leading the clinical development strategy for next-generation diagnostic solutions? As a Clinical Development Lead, Neuroscience within our Clinical and Medical Affairs organisation in Diagnostics, you will play a pivotal role in planning and implementing clinical development activities that bring medically-differentiated solutions to patients globally. In this role, you will act as a senior strategic voice and trusted advisor, fostering an environment where science and collaboration thrive.

Key Responsibilities :

• Drive Clinical Strategy : Lead the clinical development strategy for clinical diagnostic studies and complex programs, in the Neuroscience area, defining clinical utility, intended use, and claim extensions across our portfolio.

• Lead Health Authority Interactions : Work closely with Global Regulatory Affairs in the completion and submission of global regulatory filings, authoring critical sections of meeting packages and reviewing clinical documents for international regulatory submissions.

• Forge Stakeholder Partnerships : Act as the clinical lead in external interactions with health authorities, build strategic relationships with international Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), and drive development partnerships across industry and academia.

• Foster Communication Excellence : Oversee the implementation of communication strategies for clinical studies, representing the organisation at major medical congresses, advisory boards, and in key publications.

• Champion Innovation & Excellence : Act as a key driver for competitive differentiation, innovation, and early pipeline activities while developing intellectual property strategies and optimising clinical processes.

• Coach and Mentor : Act as a dedicated coach for team members, nurturing confidence and helping colleagues develop their skills and expertise.

Who You Are

You are an analytical, strategic thinker who thrives in a fast-paced, matrixed environment. You are passionate about customer and patient-centricity, and you excel at integrating multiple cross-functional perspectives into a unified clinical strategy.

• Education : Medical degree (MD) or an advanced degree (PhD) in Neuroscience or related fields.

• Experien

Chi sei? Sei un pensatore strategico e analitico che prospera in un ambiente veloce e matriciale. Sei appassionato alla concentrazione sul cliente e sul paziente e eccelli nell'integrare le prospettive multifunzionali in una strategia clinica unificata.

jobs.title: Training & Service Quality Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

• The mission of the GPC Training & Service Quality Specialist is to collaborate with local and
• global colleagues to design and deliver comprehensive training for both new and existing team
• members.

• This role is also responsible for executing Service Quality Assurance in line with
• the GPC Training and Quality Framework involving case, channel and documentation reviews,
• to ensure that customer interactions meet established GPC standards. While maintaining
• awareness of the regulated environment, the focus is on driving continuous improvement in
• advisor performance, soft skills, and documentation accuracy.

The Opportunity:
• ● Service Quality Optimization: Develop measures for the continuous maintenance and
• optimization of service quality standards.
• ● Monitoring & Review: Monitor customer interactions and documentation (calls, cases,
• and chats) to ensure they correspond to set GPC quality standards and service
• guidelines.
• ● Soft Skills Coaching: Lead activities to increase the quality of advisor documentation
• and soft skills through regular feedback and targeted coaching sessions.
• ● Proactive Training: Train team members on service quality issues and quality
• concepts, involving internal or external partners as needed to close identified gaps.
• ● Interface Participation: Act as an active contact person for quality, knowledge, and
• product launch topics; participate in GPC projects and initiatives.
• ● Information Flow: Ensure all relevant information (e.g., product launches, quality
• notifications) is delivered and communicated to the organization in a timely manner.
• ● Knowledge Management: Maintain and further develop the customer services
• knowledge database in partnership with local and global colleagues.
• ● Training Coordination: Act as the recipient of “Train the Trainer” instruction and
• coordinate the rollout of training for internal and external team members.
• ● Onboarding & Side-by-Sides: Coordinate and deliver training for new advisors,
• including classroom sessions and side-by-side (buddy-up) training/monitoring.
• ● External Partner Certification: Responsible for Train the Trainer for external partners,
• including the formal certification of external trainers to ensure they are fully qualified
• and compliant with all Roche service quality requirements.
• ● Content Maintenance: Create, review, and maintain training content and
• documentation for job-oriented training.

Who you are:
• ● Associate Degree with at least 2 years’ industry-related experience.
• ● Specialized in-depth knowledge and experience in call center operations
• ● Good understanding of knowledge management solutions and the specific requirements
• of a multiskilled, matrix organized contact center.
• ● Experience in Training and Learning Management.
• ● Understanding of documentation compliance within a medical environment, though the
• primary focus is on service quality.
• ● Excellent listening, communication, and presentation skills.
• ● Proactive and results-oriented with a strong team-player attitude.
• ● Agile and flexible to adapt to changes in a fast-paced environment.
• ● Strong organization and planning skills with an ability to work autonomously.
• ● Role model in IT navigation and a fast learner of new technologies and support tools.
• ● Fluent spoken and written English.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in mor

jobs.title: ERP Business Analyst - Finance
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a ERP Business Analyst - Finance, you will independently manage end-to-end business analysis, tackling complex business problems with emerging ambiguity, strong ability to translate complex business-finance processes into functional specifications. You will demonstrate a full understanding of the business-finance domain, as well as integrate with other domains like commercial, supply chain and procurement, and related technologies, eco-systems and the interdependencies, applying advanced tools and techniques to translate requirements into strategic implementation plans. In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to cross-functional teams, shaping stakeholder perspectives, handling process interdependencies, and significantly contributing to the design and validation of effective solutions. You will also mentor junior analysts and actively shape team processes, methodologies, and best practices within the broader Community of Practice.

Description of the area
Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Independently manages end-to-end business analysis workstreams without guidance, tackling problems with emerging ambiguity. Proficiently adapts a range of standard frameworks, mentors junior and intermediate BAs, and proactively shapes team ways of working and best practices.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads the analysis of business problems, performs thorough domain research, and drives root cause analysis. Accountable for delivering comprehensive requirements, contributing significantly to solution selection, and proactively identifying needs-solution discrepancies to propose creative improvements.

• Stakeholder Management: Identifies a diverse range of cross-functional stakeholders and builds reliance through deep business understanding to act as a trusted advisor. Facilitates workshops, resolves conflicts, and proactively shapes stakeholder perspectives to strategically manage expectations and align them with project goals.

• Impact/Strategy: Delivers impact that extends to a specific product, initiative, or cluster, contributing to domain goals by ensuring solutions provide demonstrable business value. Translates requirements into strategic implementation plans, influences tactical decisions, and contributes to long-term solution roadmaps.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Works at a solution or product level involving multiple solutions, handling ambiguous requirements and systematically interacting with stakeholders across a broader product environment. Evaluates solution impacts considering both immediate and long-term business implications.

• Business / Technical ability: Demonstrates a deep understanding of business and technical domains, technologies, and their interdependencies. Independently applies tools, principles, and techniques related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis to manage interconnections and improve overall efficiency.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• 2+ years of solid finance experience with SAP S4 and integrated eco-systems, with demonstrated ability to translate complex business-finance processes into functional specifications;

• Rich Business Analysis or project experience in finance and integrate with commercial, supply chain and procurement;

• Proven experience independently managing end-to-end BA workstreams, navigating ambiguous requirements, and evaluating strategic solution options.

• Demonstrated experience in translating requirements into strategic implementation

jobs.title: Specjalista / Specjalistka ds. Serwisu Technicznego
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Service Engineer

W Roche Diagnostics skupiamy się na wprowadzaniu innowacyjnych rozwiązań w obszarze medycyny laboratoryjnej. W Polsce działamy od kilkudziesięciu lat i należymy do wiodących pracodawców na światowym rynku diagnostycznym. Opracowujemy i wdrażamy rozwiązania diagnostyczne, które odpowiadają dzisiejszym wyzwaniom i są przygotowane na przyszłe potrzeby.

Do naszego zespołu poszukujemy Specjalisty/-ki ds. Serwisu Technicznego z województwa mazowieckiego .

Zatrudnienie przez zewnętrzną agencję na okres 18 miesięcy

Zadania:

• Instalacje i wdrażanie aparatury laboratoryjnej

• Naprawy gwarancyjne i pogwarancyjne sprzętu

• Szkolenia klientów z obsługi aparatury i systemów laboratoryjnych

• Pomoc techniczna dla klientów

• Raportowanie wyników pracy

O Tobie:

• Mieszkasz na terenie województwa mazowieckiego

• Posiadasz wyższe wykształcenie techniczne (preferowane: mechanika precyzyjna, elektronika lub pokrewne)

• Z łatwością potrafisz zrozumieć potrzeby Klienta i efektywnie się komunikować

• Posiadasz prawo jazdy kategorii B

• Dobrze znasz język angielski (min. B2)

• Umiesz priorytetyzować zadania i pracować pod presją czasu

• Doświadczenie w pracy na podobnym stanowisku będzie dodatkowym atutem

Oferujemy:

• Zatrudnienie na podstawie umowy o pracę tymczasową

• Pracę w przyjaznej atmosferze w międzynarodowym środowisku

• Możliwość wdrażania własnych inicjatyw

• Program szkoleniowy i wdrożeniowy

Brzmi interesująco? Nie czekaj - aplikuj!

Administratorem danych osobowych jest spółka Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o. z siedzibą w Warszawie przy ul. Domaniewskiej 28 (02-672). Dane przetwarzane są w celu prowadzenia rekrutacji. Osobom, które zaaplikują przysługuje prawo dostępu do danych, ich sprostowania, usunięcia, ograniczenia przetwarzania, przenoszenia oraz – w sytuacji, gdy są one przetwarzane na podstawie udzielonej zgody – cofnięcia tejże zgody w dowolnym momencie. Kontakt do Inspektora Ochrony Danych: dia.daneosobowe@roche.com. Więcej informacji o zasadach przetwarzania przez Roche danych osobowych pod linkiem: https://www.roche.pl/klauzula-informacyjna-rekrutacja-dia-pl

Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o. działa w pełnej zgodności z przepisami prawa i nie toleruje żadnych naruszeń. W Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o. obowiązuje Procedura zgłaszania naruszeń prawa. W przypadku chęci zgłoszenia nieprawidłowości związanych z naszą działalnością, wszelkie niezbędne informacje dotyczące zgłaszania naruszeń znajdują się na naszej stronie internetowej: https://www.roche.pl/kontakt/ochrona-sygnalistow-zglaszanie-naruszen .

Compensation & Benefits
Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Poland. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.
Information about the compensation package for this position will be provided ahead of any interview

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing hea
