jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Business Analyst Professional - RDT Group Function

We are looking for an experienced Technical Business Analyst and Product Owner to partner with the Business Product Owners in translating compliance requirements into strategic digital solutions. You will drive the strategic vision, roadmap, and delivery of Compliance-related products within Roche . This includes platforms supporting Group Audit and Risk Advisory, Group Compliance spanning global teams across Pharma and Diagnostics. The Technical Business Analyst and Product Owner will play a key role in analyzing complex business processes, identifying optimization opportunities, and enabling automation and digitization of the compliance processes, from review, approval, oversight, to monitoring, review and governance frameworks, ensuring alignment with the "One Roche" philosophy.

Description of the area
About RDT Group Functions Compliance Product in Legal, Compliance & Group Communication sub-function: as a trusted and agile partner, we are empowered to boost global innovative solutions on the group risk, compliance and assurance digital prioritization journey.
The Compliance Product allows Roche to manage global risk, ensure financial and legal compliance and provide assurance of compliant processes and behavior in other words ensuring that the provisions of these regulations are met in practice. As part of the Compliance Product, Roche Digital Technology (RDT) creates, manages and operates solutions which improve processes, efficiency, effectiveness and collaboration especially among Group Compliance communities, Group Audit and Risk Advisory (GA & RA).

The opportunity:

• Drive the detailed discovery, scoping, and analysis of compliance, audit, and risk processes across global teams to target current pain points and maximize optimization opportunities .

• Translate complex business requirements into clear, functional specifications and technical specifications for development teams, bridging the gap between business and tech .

• Develop comprehensive business cases, cost-benefit analyses, and impact assessments for compliance products to systematically quantify and deliver measurable business value .

• Collaborate closely with the Business Product Owner to define compliance product strategies, roadmap priorities, and long-term tech goals like AI-driven solutions .

• Lead vendor selection processes by defining business criteria, conducting fit-for-purpose assessments, and partnering with Procurement to satisfy privacy and data security rules .

• Facilitate global requirements workshops across Compliance, GA&RA, Pharma, and Diagnostics teams to seamlessly harmonize and prioritize cross-functional business needs .

• Own the technical solution definition and requirements management from initial ideation and prototyping through to testing, adoption, and support transitions .

• Ensure all compliance platforms fully align with Roche’s legal, regulatory, data privacy, and security standards while strictly maintaining requirement traceability trails .

Who you are:

• Education & Experience: You possess a Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field, combined with previous experience as a Technical Business Analyst or Product Owner.

• Industry Expertise: You have a proven track record working within compliance, audit, risk, or governance environments, ideally within the global corporate, pharmaceutical, or diagnostics industries.

• Analyt

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Business Analyst Professional - Funzione Gruppo RDT Siamo alla ricerca di un esperto Analista tecnico e Proprietario del Prodotto per collaborare con i Proprietari del Prodotto Business nel tradurre i requisiti di conformità in soluzioni digitali strategiche. Potrai guidare la visione strategica, roadmap e la consegna di prodotti correlati a conformità all'interno di Roche. Questo include piattaforme che supportano il Gruppo Audit e Risk Advisory, Compliance di Gruppo che spazia tra i team globali di Pharma e Diagnostics. Il Technical Business Analyst e Product Owner svolgeranno un ruolo chiave nell'analisi di processi aziendali complessi, nell'individuazione delle opportunità di ottimizzazione e nell'automazione e nella digitalizzazione dei processi di conformità, dalla revisione, approvazione, supervisione, al monitoraggio, alla revisione e ai quadri di governance, garantendo l'allineamento con la filosofia "One Roche". Descrizione dell'Area Informazioni su RDT Group Functions Compliance Product in Legal, Compliance & Group Communication sotto-funzione: come partner affidabile e agile, siamo autorizzati a rafforzare soluzioni innovative globali sul rischio di gruppo, sulla conformitÃ e sulla garanzia del viaggio di priorizzazione digitale. Il Prodotto di Compliance consente a Roche di gestire il rischio globale, garantire la conformità finanziaria e legale e garantire processi e comportamenti conformi in altre parole assicurando che le disposizioni di queste normative siano soddisfatte in pratica. Nell'ambito del prodotto Compliance, Roche Digital Technology (RDT) crea, gestisce e gestisce soluzioni che migliorano processi, efficienza, efficacia e collaborazione soprattutto tra le comunità di Compliance Group Audit e Risk Advisory (GA & RA). L'Oportunità: - Guidare la scoperta dettagliata, scoping, e l'analisi di conformità, audit e processi di rischio in team globali per individuare i punti di dolore attuali e massimizzare le opportunità di ottimizzazione. - Traduci i complessi requisiti aziendali in specifiche chiare e funzionali e specifiche tecniche per i team di sviluppo, colmare il divario tra business e tecnologia. - Sviluppare casi aziendali completi, analisi dei costi e valutazioni di impatto per i prodotti di conformità per quantificare sistematicamente e fornire un valore commerciale misurabile. - Collaborare a stretto contatto con il proprietario del prodotto aziendale per definire le strategie di conformità del prodotto, le priorità della roadmap e gli obiettivi tecnologici a lungo termine come soluzioni AI-driven. - Processi di selezione dei fornitori di piombo definendo criteri aziendali, conducendo valutazioni fit-for-purpose e collaborando con Procurement per soddisfare le regole di privacy e sicurezza dei dati. - Facilitare i workshop sui requisiti globali attraverso i team di Compliance, GA&RA, Pharma e Diagnostics per armonizzare e dare priorità alle esigenze aziendali interfunzionali. - Proprio la definizione della soluzione tecnica e la gestione dei requisiti da ideazione iniziale e prototipazione fino a test, adozione e transizioni di supporto. - Assicurare tutte le piattaforme di conformità pienamente allineare con gli standard legali, regolamentari, privacy dei dati e sicurezza di Roche, mantenendo rigorosamente i percorsi di tracciabilità dei requisiti. Chi Sei: - Istruzione & Esperienza: Possiedi una laurea o Master in Informatica, Business Administration, o un campo correlato, combinato con l'esperienza precedente come analista tecnico o proprietario del prodotto. - Esperienza Settoriale: Hai una comprovata esperienza nel campo della conformità, dell'audit, del rischio o della governance, idealmente all'interno delle industrie aziendali, farmaceutiche o diagnostiche globali. - Analitico

L'Oportunità: - Führen Sie die detaillierte Entdeckung, das Scoping und die Analyse von Compliance-, Audit- und Risikoprozessen in globalen Teams aus, um aktuelle Schmerzpunkte anzusprechen und Optimierungsmöglichkeiten zu maximieren. - Übersetzen Sie komplexe Geschäftsanforderungen in klare, funktionale Spezifikationen und technische Spezifikationen für Entwicklungsteams, überbrücken Sie die Lücke zwischen Business und Tech. - Entwicklung umfassender Geschäftsfälle, Kosten-Nutzen-Analysen und Folgenabschätzungen für Compliance-Produkte, um messbare Unternehmenswerte systematisch zu quantifizieren und zu liefern. - Mit dem Business Product Owner eng zusammenarbeiten, um Compliance-Produktstrategien, Roadmap-Prioritäten und langfristige Tech-Ziele wie AI-getriebene Lösungen zu definieren. - Führen Sie die Auswahlprozesse des Anbieters durch die Festlegung von Geschäftskriterien, die Durchführung von zweckgerechten Bewertungen und die Zusammenarbeit mit der Beschaffung, um die Datenschutz- und Datensicherheitsvorschriften zu erfüllen. - Erleichtern Sie globale
• Anforderungen Workshops über Compliance-, GA&RA-, Pharma- und Diagnostics-Teams, um funktionsübergreifende Geschäftsanforderungen nahtlos zu harmonisieren und zu priorisieren. - Besitzen Sie die technische Lösungsdefinition und das Anforderungsmanagement von der ersten Idee bis zum Testen, Adoption und Support-Übergänge. - Stellen Sie sicher, dass alle Compliance-Plattformen vollständig mit den gesetzlichen, regulatorischen, Datenschutz- und Sicherheitsstandards von Roche übereinstimmen, während Sie die Rückverfolgbarkeitspfade streng einhalten. descriptionByLocale.fr: Descrizione Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La Posizione Analyste d'affaires professionnel - Fonction de groupe RDT Nous recherchons un analyste technique d'affaires et un propriétaire de produits expérimentés pour nous associer aux propriétaires de produits d'affaires afin de traduire les exigences de conformité en solutions numériques stratégiques. Vous dirigerez la vision stratégique, la feuille de route et la livraison des produits liés à la conformité à Roche. Cela comprend des plateformes d'appui à la vérification de groupe et à l'avis sur les risques, la conformité de groupe couvrant les équipes mondiales à travers Pharma et Diagnostics. L'analyste technique des affaires et le propriétaire du produit joueront un rôle clé dans l'analyse des processus opérationnels complexes, la détermination des possibilités d'optimisation et la facilitation de l'automatisation et de la numérisation des processus de conformité, depuis l'examen, l'approbation, la surveillance, jusqu'aux cadres de surveillance, d'examen et de gouvernance, en passant par l'harmonisation avec la philosophie « One Roche ». Descrizione dell'Area À propos du Groupe RDT Fonctions Conformité Produit dans la sous-fonction juridique, Conformité & Communication du Groupe: en tant que partenaire fiable et agile, nous sommes habilités à stimuler des solutions innovantes au niveau mondial sur le parcours de priorité numérique de risque, de conformité et d'assurance de groupe. Le produit de conformité permet à Roche de gérer le risque mondial, d'assurer la conformité financière et juridique et d'assurer la conformité des processus et des comportements, c'est-à-dire de s'assurer que les dispositions de ces règlements sont respectées dans la pratique. Dans le cadre du produit Conformité, Roche Digital Technology (RDT) crée, gère et exploite des solutions qui améliorent les processus, l'efficience, l'efficacité et la collaboration, en particulier entre les communautés Conformité de Groupe, Audit de Groupe et Avis de Risque (GA & RA). L'Oportunità: - Diriger la découverte détaillée, la détermination de la portée et l'analyse des processus de conformité, d'audit et de risque dans les équipes mondiales afin de cibler les points de douleur actuels et de maximiser les possibilités d'optimisation. - Traduire des exigences opérationnelles complexes en spécifications fonctionnelles claires et techniques pour les équipes de développement, combler l'écart entre les entreprises et les technologies. - Élaborer des analyses de rentabilisation complètes, des analyses coûts-avantages et des analyses d'impact pour les produits de conformité afin de quantifier et de produire systématiquement une valeur opérationnelle mesurable. - Collaborer étroitement avec le propriétaire de produit d'entreprise pour définir les stratégies de conformité des produits, les priorités de la feuille de route et les objectifs technologiques à long terme comme les solutions axées sur l'IA. - Diriger les processus de sélection des fournisseurs en définissant les critères opérationnels, en procédant à des évaluations adaptées à l'usage et en établissant des partenariats avec Approvisionnement pour satisfaire aux règles de confidentialité et de sécurité des données. - Faciliter l'organisation d'ateliers sur les exigences mondiales à l'échelle des équipes Conformité, AG&RA, Pharma et Diagnostics afin d'harmoniser et de prioriser les besoins opérationnels interfonctionnels. - Posséder la définition de la solution technique et la gestion des exigences, de l'idée initiale et du prototypage à l'essai, l'adoption et le soutien des transitions. - Veiller à ce que toutes les plateformes de conformité s'harmonisent pleinement avec les normes légales, réglementaires, de confidentialité des données et de sécurité de Roche, tout en maintenant strictement les pistes de traçabilité des exigences. C'est quoi ? - Istruzione & Esperienza: Vous possédez un baccalauréat ou une maîtrise en technologie de l'information, administration des affaires, ou un domaine connexe, combiné avec une expérience antérieure en tant qu'analyste technique des affaires ou propriétaire de produit. - Esperienza Settoriale: Vous avez une expérience éprouvée de travail dans des environnements de conformité, d'audit, de risque ou de gouvernance, idéalement dans les industries mondiales de l'entreprise, pharmaceutique, ou de diagnostic. - Analyse

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities
Leadership & People Management

• Exhibit exceptional leadership aligned with the VACC model, demonstrating a capacity to craft and execute forward-thinking strategies. Cultivate a high-impact environment by systematically eliminating barriers, advancing both people and technical capabilities, and enabling individuals to perform at their peak potential.

• Lead and develop a high-performing team, with a strong emphasis on people development, fostering individual growth, and enhancing collective skillsets to meet evolving organizational needs. Champion team building and cohesion to create a collaborative environment where shared success is prioritized.

• Serve as an unwavering advocate for Roche's mission of advancing and boldly championing diversity, equity, and inclusion, shaping an organizational ethos that reflects these pillars in all initiatives.

• Forge and sustain strategic alliances with site leaders to ensure alignment on high-priority initiatives, drive synergy across cross-functional operations, and achieve mutually advantageous relationships that deliver enduring organizational success.

• Oversee the implementation and continuous evolution of site SHE procedures, embedding best-in-class programs to surpass corporate/site SHE KPIs. Lead cultural transformation by embedding SHE principles into the organizational DNA and fostering a proactive employee safety mindset.

• Inspire, mentor, and direct the organization, while driving performance excellence and advancing team members’ development toward achieving both organizational objectives and their personal and professional aspirations.

• Build a strong pipeline of talent and robust succession plans for key positions.

• Spearhead a culture of relentless continuous improvement by embodying and advocating lean leadership principles, driving operational excellence that aligns with global benchmarks.

• Instill a transparent, innovation-driven, and high-performance culture built on empowerment, ownership, and bold thinking, ensuring the organization sustains a competitive edge in a dynamic market environment.

• Acts as a mentor and coach to less experienced colleagues, providing guidance in mastering complex Q&V workflows, troubleshooting technical challenges, and developing skills in MSAT operations.

Technical
Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:

• Actively contribute to the design and construction of the new facility, encompassing key activities such as IOPQ, APS, and process/cleaning validation for seamless technology transfer, ensuring successful project execution and delivery.

• Lead and develop a high-performing qualification and validation team, fostering a culture of innovation, technical rigor, and cross-functional collaboration.

• Act as a technical Subject Matter Expert (SME) and people leader, guiding team members in qualification, process and cleaning validation, manufacturing support and troubleshooting to drive operational excellence.

• Collaborate with MSAT leadership to align qualification and validation strategies with site and global technical roadmaps, ensuring seamless integration and strategic consistency.

• Qualification and Validation: Lead Qualification and Validation team and also serve as a SME in qualification and validation, be accountable to develop, deploy and optimize business processes for the qualification/validation of equipment, utility systems, and facilities, maintaini

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Head of Technology Accounts and Software Asset Management

Head of Technology Accounts and Software Asset Management ( Practice Leader) is accountable for the integrated management of major Technology Accounts (Platform, Cloud, and Software providers) and the Software Asset Management (SAM) practice. You will lead a team responsible for optimizing technology spending, maximizing ROI, and ensuring strict license compliance across the RDT landscape. This role requires a distinctive blend of technical proficiency in modern technology stacks and deep expertise in software licensing and asset governance.

Description of the area

Asset Management & Technology Accounts manages the lifecycle of RDT’s technology assets. This includes the governance of major technology partners (e.g., SAP, AWS, Microsoft) and the execution of SAM processes to ensure compliance and financial optimization. This sub-function ensures that these high-scale partnerships deliver maximum value through structured governance, risk management, and continuous improvement frameworks.

Job Responsibilities

• SAM Governance: Own the functional roadmap for Software Asset Management. Ensure the entire lifecycle of software assets is managed to maintain compliance and minimize risk.

• Stakeholder & Business Partnership: Serves as the main contact for internal partners, actively managing relationships and expectations regarding the (sub-)function's performance and deliverables. Works closely with IT stakeholders and internal users to identify, prioritize, and address the needs for policies, their operationalization, and associated controls.

• Technology Account Strategy: Align technology account roadmaps with modern architecture (Cloud, AI/ML, SaaS) in regulated environments.

• Asset Compliance: Lead enterprise-wide technology risk assessments and ensure timely remediation of findings or licensing deviations.

• Operational Execution: Implement and oversee tools and processes for tracking asset utilization and license entitlement.

• Operational Excellence: Define and monitor KPIs/OKRs to analyze vendor performance. Use data to drive continuous improvement and optimize the service delivery model.

• Team Leadership: Lead and develop a high-performing team of vendor account managers. Mentor staff and ensure alignment of resources with RDT project requirements.

• Influence & Collaboration: Partner closely with Architecture, Security, and Finance to ensure technology platforms support critical business processes efficiently.

Qualifications

• Education/Experience: 10+ years in IT Asset Management, Technology Sourcing, or IT Operations. Leadership experience in global, multidisciplinary teams is required.

• Functional Skills: Strong understanding of modern technology landscapes (Cloud, DevOps, Digital Platforms). Expert knowledge of SAM frameworks and major vendor licensing models.

• Leadership: Ability to lead through influence and partnership. Strong ability to mentor a technical team in a complex, global stakeholder ecosystem.

What you get*:

• Salary range 23,300 - 43,300 PLN gross based on the employment contract.

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance (target 20%).

• Company car or car allowance.

• Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths etc.).

• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available).

• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose).

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Capo dei conti tecnologici e della gestione dei beni software Responsabile dei conti tecnologici e della gestione patrimoniale software (Practice Leader) è responsabile per la gestione integrata dei principali account tecnologici (Platform, Cloud e fornitori di software) e della pratica Software Asset Management (SAM). Potrai guidare un team responsabile per ottimizzare la spesa tecnologica, massimizzare il ROI e garantire una rigorosa conformità della licenza attraverso il paesaggio RDT. Questo ruolo richiede un mix distintivo di competenza tecnica negli stack tecnologici moderni e una profonda esperienza nel software di licensing e asset governance. Descrizione dell'Area Asset Management & Technology Accounts gestisce il ciclo di vita dei beni tecnologici di RDT. Questo include la governance dei principali partner tecnologici (ad esempio SAP, AWS, Microsoft) e l'esecuzione dei processi SAM per garantire la conformità e l'ottimizzazione finanziaria. Questa sotto-funzione garantisce che queste partnership di alto livello forniscono il massimo valore attraverso la governance strutturata, la gestione dei rischi e i quadri di miglioramento continuo. Mansioni - SAM Governance: proprio la roadmap funzionale per la gestione del patrimonio software. Assicurare l'intero ciclo di vita dei beni software è gestito per mantenere la conformità e minimizzare il rischio. - Stakeholder & Business Partnership: Serve come il principale contatto per i partner interni, gestendo attivamente le relazioni e le aspettative circa le prestazioni e i consegnabili della (sub-)funzione. Funziona a stretto contatto con le parti interessate IT e gli utenti interni per identificare, prioritizzare e affrontare le esigenze delle politiche, la loro operativizzazione e controlli associati. - Strategia dell'account tecnologico: Allineare le roadmap della tecnologia con l'architettura moderna (Cloud, AI/ML, SaaS) in ambienti regolamentati. - Asset Compliance: Guidare le valutazioni di rischio di tecnologia a livello aziendale e garantire una tempestiva bonifica dei risultati o delle deviazioni di licenze. - Esecuzione Operativa: implementare e supervisionare strumenti e processi per il monitoraggio dell'utilizzo e del diritto di licenza. - Eccellenza Operativa: Definire e monitorare i KPI/OKR per analizzare le prestazioni del fornitore. Utilizzare i dati per migliorare continuamente e ottimizzare il modello di consegna del servizio. - Team Leadership: Guidare e sviluppare un team di manager di account fornitori altamente performanti. Personale di mentore e garantire l'allineamento delle risorse con i requisiti di progetto RDT. - Influenza e collaborazione: collaborare a stretto contatto con Architettura, Sicurezza e Finanza per garantire che le piattaforme tecnologiche supportino in modo efficiente i processi aziendali critici.
• Requisiti - Istruzione/Esperienza: 10+ anni in IT Asset Management, Technology Sourcing o IT Operations. È richiesta un'esperienza di leadership in team multidisciplinari globali. - Competenze Funzionali: Forte comprensione dei paesaggi tecnologici moderni (Cloud, DevOps, Piattaforme digitali). Utilisez les données pour obtenir une amélioration continue et optimiser le modèle de prestation de services. - Leadership d'équipe : Diriger et développer une équipe de gestionnaires de comptes fournisseurs hautement performants. Le personnel du mentor et assurer l'alignement des ressources sur les exigences du projet RDT. - Influence et collaboration : S'associer étroitement avec Architecture, Sécurité et Finances pour s'assurer que les plateformes technologiques soutiennent efficacement les processus opérationnels critiques.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Principal Domain Architect designs business-driven, future-ready solutions for our International Pharma Commercial Marketing & Customer Engagement portfolio. In this strategic role, you will define the architectural vision for how we engage with patients and HCPs across international markets. You will align technology deployments with commercial priorities, ensuring our "Global-to-Local" scaling strategy is seamless, compliant, and data-driven
Description of the area

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Designs solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards within a Multiple Solution, Platform, or Product Line Context. Manages Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle and strictly aligns with the architecture community for governance.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Guides others in resolving highly complex issues and problems with implications on cross-functional organizational processes and outcomes. Defines and manages architecture, governance, and technology aligned with stakeholder needs. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for a complete platform or product line. Creates Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, Ontologies, and Integration pathways. Defines and drives reference architectures, patterns, NFRs, and fitness functions, ensuring Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) are systematically recorded and published across the platform. Drives external technology trends and assesses feasibility, including comprehensive vendor assessments.

• Stakeholder Management: Communicates complex ideas and influences senior-level stakeholders to adopt new approaches. Deeply connects with and understands the business needs, closely partnering with Commercial Excellence, Medical Affairs and Marketing stakeholders. Drives seamless information sharing across the complete customer engagement products .

• Impact: Provides high-level technical oversight, guidance, and consultation on specific technologies for product teams. Improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies. Identifies strategic opportunities to enhance value and business processes within a Platform or Product.

• Domain Strategy: Maintain the technology roadmap for the International Commercial landscape, focusing on CRM, Omnichannel Marketing, and other capabilities

• Business / Technical ability: Applies in-depth and expert-level knowledge across multiple technology areas. Serves as a recognized leader in Architecture Practices development and mentoring.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• 5+ years of experience in designing and architecting business-driven, standards-based, future-ready solutions within a multiple solution, platform, or product line context.

• Experience resolving highly complex issues with implications on cross-functional organizational processes and outcomes.

• Proven track record acting as a recognized leader in architecture practices, including significant experience mentoring and developing architectural talent.

• Experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare technology industry

Technical Skills

• Demonstrates deep technical authority across diverse technology stacks to solve complex, enterprise-scale challenges.

• Expert at designing Conceptual and Logical Data Models, Taxono

The Position

We are looking for an IT senior engineer to join one of our teams in Roche Digital Technology.
In Roche Digital Technology we focus on delivering technology that evolves the practice of medicine and helps patients live longer, better lives.
You will be responsible for the Design and Implementation of Directory Services (mainly Microsoft Active Directory) solutions and tier 2-3 operational support, performance, lifecycle management and continuous improvement of the underlying technologies. You will be part of multiple initiatives or projects with multiple specialists across multiple time zones in order to achieve the organizational objectives.

As a Manufacturing Specialist Directory Services you would be part of a multicultural and global team protecting our information and assets from unauthorized access, security risks and cyber attacks.

Job Responsibilities

• Collaborate in small to medium sized technical teams and contribute to the end to end design of infrastructure solutions producing and maintaining sufficient documentation.

• Interact with senior internal and external partners on significant technical matters and contribute to determining success criteria and evaluation of promising solutions/technologies via Proofs of Concepts (PoC’s) and feasibility studies.

• Providing 2nd and 3rd level support. Operationally manage and support and implement the Directory Services Infrastructure on premises for manufacturing environments and its associated compliments and applications.

• Proactively monitor systems and platforms for performance, availability and capacity management and ensure that the solution and component escalations are minimized.

• Promptly responding to customer requests, resolve incidents and implement changes, ensuring a high level of customer engagement and satisfaction

• Understanding, implementing and following relevant concepts of ITIL, GxP and Project Management. These include Request Management, Incident Management, Change Management, Problem Management, Document Management, Qualification and Validation and Project Management

• Actively focusing on own self-development and creating actionable plans to improve

• Provide 24x7 on-call support. Flexibility regarding working hours

• Occasional international travel is required

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Bachelor's Degree in computer science, engineering or related discipline; or recognition of prior working experience which is equivalent.

• 4+ years experience administering and advance troubleshooting in Active Directory

• Robust experience working in a major global organization, preferably in a regulated industry

Technical Skills

• Strong design and hands-on technical background. Solid experience on Microsoft Active Directory, Lightweight Directory Services (LDAP) and desirable in Entra ID.

• Powershell Scripting skills will be required

• Ability to apply tools, principles, concepts, and techniques related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis in practical scenarios

• Skill in evaluating change and technology impacts with increasing accuracy, and breaking down complex technical concepts with minimal guidance

Additional Qualifications

• Proven interpersonal skills to interact effectively with individuals in multiple countries and in varying cultures

• Willingness to continually evolve, acquire and maintain the technical and soft skills appropriate to the requirements of this position

• Committing to operational excellence, with a willin

jobs.title: Regional Sales Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.

Your Opportunity

• Formulate and implement strategic and tactical sales in the assigned territory

• Oversee all necessary commercial activities to fulfill strategic objectives

• Develop relationships with existing clients and maximize revenue potential

• Provide timely and reliable sales reporting via REXIS and in company meetings/ presentations to senior management

• Product Knowledge: Ensure good understanding the product portfolio and competitive advantages of the products

• Develops and leverages relationships with the leadership of key/strategic customers to deliver value-based solutions and achieve business results.

• Tender Management: establishes priorities in the hospitals/groups with product listing for tender submission

• Apply existing marketing activities to ensure awareness of the company among all target groups

• Conduct presentations at small and medium customer sites and work with marketing for key account sites

• Build strong relationships with key accounts and develop a long term strategy how to grow business in key accounts

• Identify and seize opportunities for new business in existing (increase Roche share) and new customers

• Represent Vietnam in regional initiatives, projects and meetings as assigned by senior management

• Work closely with marketing team to ensure accurate forecasting for respective customer segments

• Work closely with Service and Applications to understand potential issues at the customer and work together to ensure high customer satisfaction

• Inform Service and Applications timely about customer needs, e.g. installations, trouble shootings…

• Upskill DSMs and Sales Reps in their team and ensure high performance spirit among the team

Who you are

• Medical Doctor, Pharmaceutical or Biotechnology University Degree

• Multinational companies in a similar industry with sales management at least 5 years is preferred

• Good commercial understanding and understanding of Diagnostics buying cycle

• Sales experience in related industries is required.

• Supervisory/Managerial experience is required

• Languages: Conversant in both English and Vietnamese (conversational & writing)

• Key Account Management Skills

• Effective Communication Skill

• Good Interpersonal Skill

• Creative Problem Solving and Negotiation Skill

• Customer Complaint Handling Skill

• Time Management Skill

• Leadership and Coaching Skill

• Computer skills: <Google WorkSpace, Google Docs Editor, Microsoft Office

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

As a Procurement Analyst, you play a key role in performing the day-to-day activities for procurement matters according to the highest standards of financial control, compliance and effective practices.

The Opportunity:
Job Responsibilities:

• Execute the day-to-day activities according to the highest standards of financial control, compliance and best practice. Ensure quality and accurate delivery of services within agreed key performance indicators (KPIs) and as defined in the Service Level Agreement (SLA) and SOPs of the respective business sub-process.

• Follow the instructions of the Managers regarding the daily work coordination.

• Develop knowledge and capability to raise competence to expected levels to meet current and future business needs.

• Contribute process and technical expertise to process improvement initiatives.

• Support on assigned projects or programs.

Key Accountabilities:

• Validate and process (fix & check) Purchase Requisitions to ensure completeness and in compliance with Procurement Policy.

• Convert Purchase Requisitions to Purchase Orders.

• Purchase Order amendment, close and cancellation.

• Manage and resolve internal and external queries.

• Participate in invoice reconciliation process. Work closely with Accounts Payable team to resolve any outstanding invoice reconciliation or mismatch.

• Execute and produce accurate and timely reports.

• Manage and execute the quote collections and multiple source biddings when applicable.

• Review and update SOP, DTP & LP timely.

• Ensure adherence to the Procurement Policy, Directive, Guidelines and Local Procurement SOPs.

• Actively participate in new project, such as ASPIRE/MyBuy and etc. Attend related meetings, trainings, knowledge transfer and etc.

Who you are:

• Degree or Diploma in Business Studies, Finance & Accounting/Commerce, Supply Chain or Procurement equivalent.

• Good communication skill and able to communicate effectively in English and Japanese (N1/N2 level)

• 3-years experience in a centralized purchasing environment and Supply Chain with production planning background.

• Experience of working in a shared service center across a global / large organization will be an added advantage.

• Good negotiation and analytical skills, resourceful in identifying new sources of items requested and results oriented.

The Opportunity: Job Responsibilities:
• Execute the day-to-day activities according to the highest standards of financial control, compliance and best practice. Ensure quality and accurate delivery of services within agreed key performance indicators (KPIs) and as defined in the Service Level Agreement (SLA) and SOPs of the respective business sub-process.
• Follow the instructions of the Managers regarding the daily work coordination.
• Develop knowledge and capability to raise competence to expected levels to meet current and future business needs.
• Contribute process and technical expertise to process improvement initiatives.
• Support on assigned projects or programs. Key Accountabilities:
• Validate and process (fix & check) Purchase Requisitions to ensure completeness and in compliance with Procurement Policy.
• Convert Purchase Requisitions to Purchase Orders.
• Purchase Order amendment, close and cancellation.
• Manage and resolve internal and external queries.
• Participate in invoice reconciliation process. Work closely with Accounts Payable team to resolve any outstanding invoice reconciliation or mismatch.
• Execute and produce accurate and timely reports.
• Manage and execute the quote collections and multiple source biddings when applicable.
• Review and update SOP, DTP & LP timely.
• Ensure adherence to the Procurement Policy, Directive, Guidelines and Local Procurement SOPs.
• Actively participate in new project, such as ASPIRE/MyBuy and etc. Attend related meetings, trainings, knowledge transfer and etc. Who you are:
• Degree or Diploma in Business Studies, Finance & Accounting/Commerce, Supply Chain or Procurement equivalent.
• Good communication skill and able to communicate effectively in English and Japanese (N1/N2 level)
• 3-years experience in a centralized purchasing environment and Supply Chain with production planning background.
• Experience of working in a shared service center across a global / large organization will be an added advantage.
• Good negotiation and analytical skills, resourceful in identifying new sources of items requested and results oriented. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Healthcare Systems Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
El Especialista en Sistemas de Salud (Healthcare System Partner - HSP) a nivel central es un líder en Roche que trabaja muy de cerca con hospitales privados, aseguradoras, administradoras de salud y ecosistema general mercado privado. Actúa en los diferentes niveles de su ecosistema y con los diferentes actores del cuidado de la salud privado tales como responsables de formular políticas y procedimientos, tomadores de decisión en los sistemas de aseguradoras, personal administrativo y de finanzas, área médica, etc. Construye relaciones confiables y estratégicas con los directivos y administradores en el sector y pueda anticipar las barreras de acceso y cumplir con las agendas, planes y objetivos en este mercado.

Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad:
Las principales responsabilidades del role incluyen:

• Gestiona, administra, genera, prioriza y ejerce los recursos, para impulsar soluciones que entreguen resultados más rápidamente en su ecosistema.

• El Especialista en Sistemas de Salud (HSP) a nivel central para el sector privado, actúa de conformidad con el modelo del líder Visionario, Arquitecto, Coach, Catalizador (VACC), es catalizador y coach interna y externamente.

• Colabora estrechamente y reúne la experiencia de diferentes áreas a nivel local y en la red de Roche, según sea necesario, incluyendo a otros Especialistas en Sistemas de Salud (HSPs) y Especialistas en Experiencia del Paciente (PJPs), MVLs, equipo de economía de la salud, precio, etc.

• Alcanza un profundo entendimiento de su ecosistema, da seguimiento y se actualiza en las tendencias y patrones de los sistemas de salud, particularmente del ecosistema de salud bajo su responsabilidad.

• Provee a Roche del conocimiento de su ecosistema que tiene para trabajar estratégicamente y brindar experiencia, ciencia y conocimiento al Ecosistema bajo su responsabilidad.

• Desarrolla las estrategias y coordina los proyectos de inclusión de los medicamentos e indicaciones terapéuticas nuevas aprobadas por la Cofepris para que el formulario de medicamentos de las aseguradoras cuenten con los medicamentos e indicaciones de Roche así como participar en las licitaciones y concretar los contratos y adjudicaciones para los medicamentos de Roche en este sector.

• Coordina el trabajo estratégico para este sector y junto con el chapter médico y el equipo de economía de la salud y de precios brindar la información médica, económica y de precios que apoyen el rápido acceso de nuestros medicamentos en este sector.

• Trabaja junto con los directivos y administradores para detectar posibles barreras para mejorar la calidad de atención de los pacientes y junto con ellas busca posibles soluciones para mejorar los ecosistemas del sector para beneficio de los pacientes a nivel público. Trabaja en forma coordinada con los equipos de Roche en la entrega de los mensajes médicos y FE que sustentan el uso de nuestros medicamentos.

• Participa con los squads para definir y alinear las estrategias de acceso para este sector bajo su responsabilidad, así como la detección de obstáculos y oportunidades para que los medicamentos e indicaciones de Roche se incluyan para beneficio lo más rápidamente posible de los pacientes en este sector.

Tu perfil:

La persona en esta posición tiene la capacidad de colaborar y construir relaciones con diversos actores en el ecosistema de atención médica. Excelentes habilidades de comunicación e interpersonales.
Capacidad para adaptarse y prosperar en un entorno rápido y cambiante, así como fuertes hab

jobs.title: Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Coordinar de manera integral la ejecución de las estrategias de mercadotecnia y educación médica continua. El rol es clave para garantizar que los materiales creativos, la logística de eventos de alto nivel y el control financiero del Squad se ejecuten con excelencia operativa, cumpliendo con los tiempos de planeación estratégica y las normativas vigentes.

Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad:

Las principales responsabilidades del role incluyen:

• Planeación de Eventos: Liderar la ejecución de eventos académico-científicos, promocionales y no promocionales de corte nacional e internacional. Asegurar el cumplimiento de los ciclos de planeación anticipada, gestionando hitos críticos y entregables.

• Responsable de la logística integral, en tiempo y forma, que garantice la apertura, desarrollo y cierre exitoso de cada evento, incluyendo la gestión de sedes, viajes y el branding del evento

• Gestión administrativa total en sistemas (Veeva/Simple Buy/ ROME): solicitudes de servicio, aprobación de contratos y cartas de honorarios de ponentes.

• Colaborar en la creación de contenido promocional y no promocional, asegurando que el mensaje esté alineado a la estrategia del portafolio y a las necesidades del Patient Journey.

• Gestionar la logística y distribución de materiales especiales, promocionales y de entrenamiento para la fuerza de ventas (PJPs) y otros canales de comunicación. Asegurar que todo material y obsequio esté apegado estrictamente al código de conducta y procesos de aprobación regulatoria.

• Soporte activo en el monitoreo del presupuesto, seguimiento de la ejecución del PVC y gestión de Órdenes de Compra (OCs).

• Planeación de la Demanda: Colaborar con las áreas de supply para asegurar que la planeación de la demanda esté alineada con las cantidades proyectadas.

• Soporte en el análisis de mercado (tendencias, competencia, auditorías) y conversión de datos a pacientes para ajustar las tácticas comerciales.

• Actuar como el brazo operativo del Squad Lead y el Medical Value Lead para la implementación de estrategias digitales y de segmentación.

• Gestión de Proveedores: Identificación, alta (RFI) y contacto constante con proveedores estratégicos para asegurar la calidad de los servicios contratados.

Tu perfil:

Buscamos candidatos con un alto sentido de responsabilidad, atención al detalle y mentalidad de crecimiento:

• Licenciaturas económicas administrativas, ingenieras industriales o afines

• Inglés intermedio-avanzado (capacidad de interactuar en entornos globales).

• Experiencia previa en la industria farmacéutica. Dominio de google environment, paqueteria microsoft, capacidad de análisis de datos y comprensión de auditorías de mercado.

•
Manejo de Veeva, SAP, Simple buy es un diferencial

• Comunicación asertiva e influencia. Pensamiento analítico y orientación a resultados. Resiliencia y gestión del cambio.

• Capacidad de colaboración en equipos multidisciplinarios.

Beneficios de relocalización no están disponibles para esta posición

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare soluti

jobs.title: Internship | Medical & Health Policy Chapter
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Internship | Medical & Health Policy Chapter
Roche Diagnostics, Portugal

The Opportunity
We are looking for a dedicated and self-motivated talent to join Roche Diagnostics Portugal for a 1-year professional internship with the Medical Affairs and Health Policy team, ideally starting in September 2026.

As part of a dynamic team, during the internship you will have the opportunity to collaborate with experienced business partners and stakeholders on meaningful projects related to Roche high medical value areas, offering you the opportunity to gain valuable experience in the diagnostics industry! Your role will allow you to develop your skills and grow in the following areas:

• Provide support in medical review for materials like brochures, websites, learning centers, etc. Ensure these materials, targeted at Healthcare Professionals (HCPs), are scientifically and medically accurate, balanced, and compliant.

• Assist in the planning of educational events by providing support for both logistical and content-related elements, ensuring adherence to defined procedures and guidelines and the smooth execution of these events.

• Assist the Medical & Health Policy chapter by supporting the preparation of Advisory Boards and Focus Groups. This involves coordinating and supporting interactions with experts to gather valuable insights that will be used to refine our strategy and tactics, which is crucial for strategic decision-making.

• Assist in creating educational content for internal and external audiences, including webinars, training materials (slides and presentations), e-learning modules, infographics, fact sheets, etc.

• Support internal training activities, ensuring our teams have the required knowledge and resources, and are properly equipped.

• Understand local clinical and economic evidence needs and how to translate those into action, driving the implementation of local studies and initiatives to close the evidence gaps.

• Participate in the development of disease awareness and patient advocacy campaigns

Who you are

You excel in building successful working relationships with colleagues and external partners, and you demonstrate curiosity, eagerness to learn, strategic thinking, and a strong enthusiasm for how science can lead to improved outcomes for patients:

• You recently completed your Medical Degree (MD) or a master in Public Health (MPH) and have an healthcare related background.

• You are passionate about health innovation

• You enjoy collaborating with others, thriving in a fast-paced team environment.

• You embrace challenges in a positive way and feel confident and comfortable in sharing your views and ideas.

• Your ability to communicate in both Portuguese and English, combined with your interpersonal skills, makes you a highly effective communicator.

• Your strong analytical skills allow you to turn data into actionable insights.

• You are proficient in Google workspace.

If you are eager to start your career in Roche, have a look at this opportunity to join us! Applications close by 16th June, 2026.

What we offer:
Hybrid and flexible work practices, competitive internship subsidy, meal allowance, health insurance, life and personal accident insurance, subsidised restaurant in the office and free access to Roche gym and wellbeing program, among many other, in a highly dynamic, collaborative, agile and innovative environment.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Solution Architect (Demand to Pay, Travel & Expense Management) focuses on designing, implementing, and optimizing business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions within a complex enterprise context. In this role, you will play a critical role in translating complex business requirements into technical designs for the T&E solutions which includes the Concur platform and other systems, ensuring seamless integration with other enterprise systems and driving continuous improvement. You will lead others to solve complex problems, maintain the vision and roadmap for the T&E landscape, and serve as a key leader and point of escalation for Concur-related issues within the organization.

Your Responsibilities

• Design T&E solutions that meet product requirements and enterprise standards across a multiple-solution context, managing non-functional requirements (NFRs) and fitness functions while ensuring configurations adhere to data privacy (GDPR/CCPA) and audit requirements.

• Define and drive reference architectures, ensuring that Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), taxonomies, ontologies, and integration pathways are documented and published for the T&E product.

• Develop comprehensive architecture documentation and manage data flows between Concur and other enterprise systems, including Workday, SAP ERP, ServiceNow (EPP), IQVIA, and Oversight.

• Lead the design and management of non-standard integrations utilizing RESTful APIs, WebServices, and secure SFTP, leveraging middleware platforms such as Mulesoft and Denodo.

• Optimize system performance and business objectives by utilizing reporting systems and data platforms, including Concur Intelligence, Snowflake, and standard reporting configurations.

• Proactively contribute to the development of global Architecture Practices and provide technical oversight and mentoring to product teams.

• Maintain the roadmap for T&E solutions, evaluating external technology trends—such as AI-driven expense categorization and RPA— to enhance value and manage technical debt.

Who You Are

• You have a minimum of 10 years of experience in designing and implementing solutions within the Concur platform, with at least 5 years focused on integration enhancements to and from Concur Intelligence, Travel, and Expense.

• You possess expert-level knowledge of the Concur modules and a proven track record of integrating them with SAP ERP, HR systems (Workday), and other enterprise applications.

• You are experienced in RESTful API consumption, data transformation via middleware (Mulesoft/Denodo), and creating conceptual and logical data models.

• You are capable of maintaining a vision for multiple solutions and assessing the impacts of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape.

• You bring exceptional negotiation skills and the ability to communicate difficult concepts, influencing stakeholders to adopt different points of view or innovative solutions.

• You have a strong understanding of database concepts, SQL, web services, and XML/JSON data formats.

• You understand financial accounting principles and industry-specific T&E best practices; experience with pharmaceutical industry regulations is a significant plus.

• You hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field; a "Certified Professional - Expense Configuration" credential is preferred.

Compensation & Benefits
The expected salary range for this position, based on the primary location of Warsaw Grafit is 228

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity:
As the Legal & Compliance Manager at Roche Latvia Pharma Division , you will play a critical role in ensuring that our operations and business interactions comply with all relevant requirements and internal Roche policies, and will also support the organization in day-to-day legal matters.
As the Legal & Compliance Manager at Roche Latvia Pharma Division, you will be:

• Strategic Partner: Collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders to ensure the fulfillment of all Roche divisional and local requirements.

• Role Model: Serve as a role model in ethical behavior and decision-making, promoting a culture of integrity and compliance across the organization.

• Strategic Influence: Drive compliance integration into business processes and decision-making.

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Work proactively with various departments to help them achieve their business goals in compliance with Roche policies and guidelines.

• Culture Building: Lead the development and nurturing of a robust compliance culture within the Roche Latvia Pharma organization to ensure business processes align with legal requirements and internal policies.

Legal support: support Roche Latvia Pharma organization and Director Legal & Compliance Pharma Baltics Cluster with day to day legal matters, which includes legal advice, drafting and reviewing contracts, etc.
Compliance support to Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) Riga: you will extend, scale and apply compliance work done for Pharma also to the Roche Services & Solutions site in Riga (e.g. joint SOPs & training). Serve as Compliance Officer for RSS Riga and report to the Head of RSS Riga in this capacity.

Key Compliance Responsibilities
Under the oversight of and in collaboration with the Director Legal & Compliance Pharma Baltics Cluster, perform the following tasks in the Compliance Manager capacity:

• Guidance and Support: With a solution-oriented mindset, provide clear and actionable guidance to other departments to enable them to achieve their business goals in a compliant manner and in accordance with policies and guidelines. Escalate more complex inquiries to, and work with, the Director Legal & Compliance Pharma Baltics Cluster to address these.

• Global Standardization: Ensure adherence to Roche global standards such as the Code of Conduct and all Pharma Compliance-related Directives and guidelines, relevant Latvian legislation and local industry association Code of Ethics and any other relevant global and local regulations.

• Process Enhancement: Identify opportunities for efficiency in the compliance function and implement improvement initiatives. Develop compliance SOPs or policies and provide targeted training to employees. Strive for simplification & user-friendliness while maintaining a robust compliance system that adequately protects the organization’s license to operate and reputation.

• Strategic Risk Assessment: Identify, assess, and manage compliance risks associated with business operations, products, and services using data-driven approaches.

• Monitoring Activities: Conduct periodic monitoring activities, including spot checks and approvals, to confirm compliance with company policies.

• Comprehensive Training Programs: Design and deliver training on directives, guidelines, standards, and industry regulations. Customize training for different organizational levels. Conduct compliance onboarding training for new employees, tailored to their function and role.

• Promoting Compliance

• Culture Building: Lead the development and nurturing of a robust compliance culture within the Roche Latvia Pharma organization to ensure business processes align with legal requirements and internal policies. Legal support: support Roche Latvia Pharma organization and Director Legal & Compliance Pharma Baltics Cluster with day to day legal matters, which includes legal advice, drafting and reviewing contracts, etc. Compliance support to Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) Riga: you will extend, scale and apply compliance work done for Pharma also to the Roche Services & Solutions site in Riga (e.g. joint SOPs & training). Serve as Compliance Officer for RSS Riga and report to the Head of RSS Riga in this capacity. Key Compliance Responsibilities Under the oversight of and in collaboration with the Director Legal & Compliance Pharma Baltics Cluster, perform the following tasks in the Compliance Manager capacity:
• Guidance and Support: With a solution-oriented mindset, provide clear and actionable guidance to other departments to enable them to achieve their business goals in a compliant manner and in accordance with policies and guidelines. Escalate more complex inquiries to, and work with, the Director Legal & Compliance Pharma Baltics Cluster to address these.
• Global Standardization: Ensure adherence to Roche global standards such as the Code of Conduct and all Pharma Compliance-related Directives and guidelines, relevant Latvian legislation and local industry association Code of Ethics and any other relevant global and local regulations.
• Process Enhancement: Identify opportunities for efficiency in the compliance function and implement improvement initiatives. Develop compliance SOPs or policies and provide targeted training to employees. Strive for simplification & user-friendliness while maintaining a robust compliance system that adequately protects the organization’s license to operate and reputation.
• Strategic Risk Assessment: Identify, assess, and manage compliance risks associated with business operations, products, and services using data-driven approaches.
• Monitoring Activities: Conduct periodic monitoring activities, including spot checks and approvals, to confirm compliance with company policies.
• Comprehensive Training Programs: Design and deliver training on directives, guidelines, standards, and industry regulations. Customize training for different organizational levels. Conduct compliance onboarding training for new employees, tailored to their function and role.
• Promoting Compliance

jobs.title: Becario planeador de logística
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Sobre Roche:

Un futuro más saludable. Es lo que nos impulsa a innovar. Avanzar continuamente en la ciencia y garantizar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y en las generaciones futuras. Crear un mundo en el que todos tengamos más tiempo con las personas que amamos. Eso es lo que nos hace ser Roche.

Oportunidad:

El becario apoyará al área de logística en actividades administrativas y operativas dentro del proceso de entrega y retiro de instrumentos acorde al marco de cumplimiento siguiendo los procedimientos establecidos dentro de las políticas con la finalidad de concretar proyectos y cumplir con los objetivos de venta.

Responsabilidades:

• Coordinar con las diferentes áreas la instalación y puesta en marcha de equipos de diagnóstico en base a las políticas, con la finalidad de concretar proyectos y cumplir con los targets de venta.

• Solicitar la compra de equipos/accesorios de diagnóstico de acuerdo a la demanda del área comercial.

• Coordinar con el área de servicios y logística el retiro de los instrumentos de diagnóstico.

• Mantener la base instalada (actualización de proyectos, actualización de instrumentos de acuerdo al sitio de instalación) - SAP.

• Llevar el seguimiento a los indicadores del proceso.

• Mantener un control sano de inventarios de instrumentos

Quien eres:

Pasión por el propósito: Te motiva saber que tu trabajo detrás de cámaras permite que un paciente reciba un diagnóstico a tiempo.
Agilidad: Te adaptas rápido a los cambios y tienes facilidad para priorizar tareas en un entorno dinámico.
Integridad : El cumplimiento de normas y políticas es fundamental para ti; eres ético y responsable con el manejo de información e inventarios.
Analítico : Te gusta trabajar con datos e indicadores para medir el éxito de tus actividades.
Resiliencia y Enfoque: Entiendes que la logística tiene retos inesperados; mantienes la calma ante la presión y te enfocas en encontrar soluciones efectivas en lugar de detenerte ante los obstáculos (tolerancia a la frustración).
Mentalidad de Innovación: No te conformas con "así se ha hecho siempre". Buscas constantemente formas de simplificar y automatizar tareas operativas para hacer los procesos más eficientes y libres de errores.

Beneficios de reubicación no están disponibles para esta posición.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Support Network offers an exciting opportunity for individuals who are passionate about problem solving. As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche is dedicated to discovering, developing, and providing innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products. With a commitment to employee development and a work environment that values respect and empowerment, Roche offers exciting career prospects for those seeking to make a significant impact on patient care.

This role offers the opportunity to support our Donor Screening business, which plays a critical role in detecting antibodies and antigens to aid in diagnosing infections, ensuring blood safety, and monitoring immune responses.

The Opportunity:
Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers. As a Field Engineering Specialist you will:

• Showcase your expertise in technical repair for Roche assigned product lines.

• Offer valuable service to laboratory customers in your assigned territory.

• Provide routine technical support, on-site service and repair of Roche products.

• Serve as a customer contact for technical and service-related issues and perform preventative maintenance.

• Diagnose and resolve mechanical, hardware, software, and system failures.

• Document all activities, contribute to quality improvement, and focus on maximizing customer satisfaction.

This field-based role requires up to 50% travel. This person will support Detroit, MI and surrounding areas.

Who You Are:

• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or equivalent work experience

• 5 years of progressive experience repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking OR a Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemistry or related field plus 1-2 years of progressive experience repairing or servicing complex mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking

• Successfully training or certification as defined by RD Services Leadership and policy

• Ability to travel, including some overnight travel, is required

Preferred Qualifications:

• 8+ years of progressive experience or a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field plus 4+ years of progressive experience are required.

• Advanced knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, information technology, and basic chemistry.

• The ability to serve as an internal technical resource, provide support after hours and on weekends/holidays, and maintain strong customer relationships is essential.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Detroit, MI is 71,100.00 - 132,000.00 USD Annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.

jobs.title: Senior Patient Safety Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Join Our Team: Senior Patient Safety Partner
Are you a pharmacovigilance (PV) professional looking to make a strategic impact on patient safety? We are looking for a Senior Patient Safety Partner to drive excellence in our local PV systems and help shape the future of patient care.

Job Purpose
In this role, you will be the guardian of our local PV system for Spain. Your mission is to ensure we remain fully compliant with Roche global standards and local regulatory requirements, safeguarding our License to Operate. You will lead the execution of International Patient Safety (IPS) strategies, turning global solutions into high-quality local results.

Key Responsibilities

• PV System Excellence: Partner with global and local teams to monitor safety profiles of Roche Products and manage their risks effectively.

• Operational Oversight: Manage critical PV activities including individual case safety reports, Pharmacovigilance Agreements (e.g. Safety Data Exchange Agreement), Risk Management and Safety Communication, Local Studies, Programs and other projects with PV implications (e.g., Interventional Clinical Trials, Non-interventional studies, Market Research Programs, Patient Support Programs, Compassionate Use Programs, Post Trial Access Programs, Digital Activities).

• Local Safety Risk Management

• Identify, analyze and share safety insights by understanding disease areas (Roche portfolio, patient journey), engaging with key stakeholders, and ensuring timely, proactive integration into Affiliate and global strategies.

• Implementation of safety solutions and launch readiness activities: Implement global safety solutions locally within the integrated therapeutic strategy, and execute product safety launch readiness activities.

• Risk management and safety communication: Support the country-level risk management strategy to optimize patient outcomes in collaboration within relevant networks and ensure compliant and transparent PV communications (e.g., DHPCs) to healthcare professionals, patients, and external partners in collaboration with Medical Affairs and the cross-functional team.

• Strengthen cross-functional and cross-country collaboration: Foster strong cross-functional partnerships and represent affiliate safety interests in IPS forums, strategically influencing cross-country initiatives and implementing global solutions into local clinical practice

• Regulatory Influence: Actively shape local PV regulations and ecosystems by collaborating with industry associations and health authorities.

What You Bring

• Education: A degree in life sciences or a healthcare-related field (e.g., PharmD, Medical Doctor, Bachelor in Life Sciences, or Nursing).

• Experience:

• At least 5 years experience in pharmacovigilance, ideally in an affiliate setting

• PV Compliance Expertise: In-depth knowledge of global & local PV regulations and the ability to oversee comprehensive compliance monitoring systems.

• Decision-making ability in the local & global PV ecosystem

• Experienced in collaborating within global and local matrix environments, including proven ability in stakeholder management and influencing

• Advantage : Experience in other affiliate medical functions (e.g., Regulatory, Medical Affairs, Clinical Operations, Medical Information) or global functions such as Clinical Safety

Core Competencies & Skills
1. Strategic Leadership & Big-Picture Thinking

• Strategic Planning: Ability to align complex projects with the company’s long-term goals.

• Syst
