jobs.title: Medical Software Engineer - Complaint Handling
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As a Software Engineer in Post Market Quality (PMQ), you will be at the forefront of ensuring the quality and performance of Roche’s Digital Solutions, handling complaints related to Hospital/Laboratory Information Systems (HIS/LIS) , medical data networks, middleware solutions, data communication, apps, and algorithms.

Joining the Digital Solutions Chapter means working in a highly transversal software environment, giving you the opportunity to engage with cutting-edge technologies and diverse programming languages for both on-premise and cloud-based software.

Your core mission will be to act as a focused investigative detective . Supported by senior experts, you will dive into code and logs to untangle software issues, growing your expertise in both cutting-edge IT and medical compliance frameworks. While your focus is on root cause analysis, you will not be responsible for the final bug fixes. This role is set within an Agile environment where your innovative ideas and proposals are highly valued, contributing directly to a team focused on continuous improvement.

The Opportunity:

• You are accountable for handling medical software complaints, safety issues, and product inquiries for software products (on premise, cloud, mobile, apps,...).

• You independently manage standard cases through their lifecycle, while partnering with senior colleagues to navigate complex or critical safety issues. For cases that cannot be directly resolved, you take ownership of transfering to the development department.

• You act as a technical expert for case resolution, using your ability to read and understand source code to identify the root cause factor of software malfunctions. You can reference the Roche internal process confidently in discussions to justify decisions. You will consult with senior experts on technical and process-related aspects as needed.

• You will be responsible for the timely communication of essential quality-related information and supporting initiatives to stakeholders in close collaboration with senior colleagues

• You use your automation and data analytics skills to enhance the case handling process and proactively monitor product performance data

Who you are:

• A degree in computer science or an IT related field.

• 2+ years of work experience in the area of Software engineering or IT support related functions is desired

• Solid IT skills, especially the strong foundational ability to navigate and read source code in multiple languages, with an eagerness to learn complex system dependencies quickly

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken)

• Automation skills and experience with data analytics are a plus

What you get:

• Employment contract (Umowa o pracę),

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance;

• Private healthcare ( LuxMed packages) and group life insurance (UNUM);

• Training, language courses, and diversified career paths are available

• Recharge Days (2 days off per quarter)

• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose)

• Flex Location (possibility to perform our work from different places in the world for a certain period of time)

• Take Time for Charity (additional paid leave of maximum 2 weeks to engage in the charity action of your choice)

• Stock share purchase additions;

• Yearly sales of company equipment and many more!

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Senior Software Engineer in Post Market Quality (PMQ), you will be at the forefront of ensuring the quality and performance of Roche’s Digital Solutions, handling complaints related to Hospital/Laboratory Information Systems (HIS/LIS) , medical data networks, middleware solutions, data communication, apps, and algorithms.

Joining the Digital Solutions Chapter means working in a highly transversal software environment, giving you the opportunity to engage with cutting-edge technologies and diverse programming languages for both on-premise and cloud-based software.

Your core mission will be to act as a highly autonomous, deep-dive technical investigator . You masterfully dissect complex, edge-case software failures, bridging the gap between field trouble-shooting and core R&D development teams. While your focus is on root cause analysis, you will not be responsible for the final bug fixes. This role is set within an Agile environment where your innovative ideas and proposals are highly valued, contributing directly to a team focused on continuous improvement.

The Opportunity:

• You are accountable for handling complex medical software complaints, safety issues, and product inquiries for software products (on premise, cloud, mobile, apps,...).

• You will independently manage the entire case lifecycle, from initial creation and classification to in-depth investigation, collaboration with the on-site trouble-shooting team, documentation and final resolution. For cases that cannot be directly resolved, you take ownership of transfering to the development department.

• You act as a senior technical expert for case resolution, using your ability to read and understand complex source code to identify the root cause/causal factor of software malfunctions. You master the Roche internal quality processes and understand their regulatory background to justify decisions.

• You are an interface with Affiliates and Country Organizations. You will be responsible for the timely communication of essential quality-related information and supporting initiatives that enhance our regional partnerships.

• You use your automation and data analytics skills to enhance the case handling process and proactively monitor product performance data

• You serve as a trusted technical proxy for the Principal Engineer when required.

Who you are:

• A degree in computer science or an IT related field.

• 5+ years of proven track records of working in the area of Software engineering or IT support related functions

• Strong IT skills, especially the ability to read and debug complex source code of different programming languages to understand the root cause of reported issues

• Good ability to work independently even when faced with uncertainty.

• Good ability to present technical work to stakeholders, influence and negotiate to push initiatives forwards

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken)

What you get:

• Employment contract (Umowa o pracę),

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance;

• Private healthcare ( LuxMed packages) and group life insurance (UNUM);

• Training, language courses, and diversified career paths are available

• Recharge Days (2 days off per quarter)

• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose)

• Flex Location (possibility to perform our work from different places in the world for a certain period of time)

• Take Time for Charity (additional paid leave of maximum 2 weeks to engage in the charity

jobs.title: Estágio em Finanças - Propostas Comerciais
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Estagiário(a) de Finanças e Propostas Comerciais você terá a oportunidade de criar impacto sendo essencial para o time, auxiliando na criação, revisão e envio das propostas comerciais da afiliada. Se você tem vontade de aprender e possui os requisitos necessários, junte-se a nós para aprimorar-se continuamente em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo.

A Oportunidade:

• Você elabora e acompanha as propostas comerciais para a equipe de Diagnóstica, oferecendo uma visão financeira estratégica para as demandas dos clientes.

• Você auxilia na revisão, no acompanhamento e no controle das propostas com os clientes, contribuindo ativamente para o cumprimento das cláusulas financeiras estabelecidas.

• Você gerencia stakeholders de diferentes áreas e realiza conexões com marketing, vendas e finanças para garantir a execução das estratégias comerciais da companhia.

• Você apoia o uso de ferramentas para o gerenciamento e acompanhamento contínuo dos indicadores gerenciais (KPIs).

• Você identifica oportunidades de melhoria nos processos diários e atua diretamente nas suas implementações.

• Você colabora com a equipe de pricing na execução, análise e definição das estratégias de precificação para produtos e serviços.

• Você suporta o time de finanças na preparação das análises de rentabilidade e de preços.

• Você prepara apresentações e mantém uma interface clara e contínua com a equipe de liderança.

Quem você é:

• Você possui habilidade colaborativa, gosta de lidar com pessoas, tem comunicação clara e assertiva e se adapta facilmente a contextos de mudanças.

• Você demonstra agilidade no aprendizado, foco e organização nas atividades processuais, e proatividade para buscar melhorias.

• Você está cursando o Ensino Superior em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas correlatas (a partir do 2º ano de formação).

• Você possui forte habilidade analítica, facilidade com números e dados, e extrema atenção aos detalhes.

• Você tem conhecimento intermediário em Excel (tabelas dinâmicas, fórmulas, etc.) e valoriza o trabalho em equipe em seu dia a dia.

Diferenciais:

• Você tem conhecimento prático em ferramentas de análise de dados (Power BI, SQL, Python, R).

• Você possui nível de inglês intermediário ou avançado para interações corporativas.

Benefícios de recolocação não estão disponíveis para esta vaga.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Estagiário de Pricing e Contratos
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A Roche Diagnóstica está em busca de um Estagiário de Pricing e Contratos para se juntar à nossa equipe de Finanças. Esta posição oferece uma excelente oportunidade para desenvolver as suas habilidades financeiras, monitorização comercial e gestão de projetos numa das maiores empresas do setor farmacêutico do mundo!

A Oportunidade:

• Auxilia na preparação e análise de dados de preços e realiza a monitorização ativa de contratos.

• Colabora diretamente com as equipas de vendas para desenvolver estratégias de gestão de faturação e pagamentos.

• Participa ativamente na preparação de relatórios e apresentações para a gestão sénior.

• Ajuda na implementação de medidas de eficiência e monitoriza a sua execução no dia a dia.

• Dá suporte à manutenção de sistemas de preços e ferramentas analíticas vitais para a equipa.

• Lidera o processo de implementação de reajustes com uma vasta carteira de clientes.

• Contribui com impacto em projetos especiais relacionados com preços, custos e reajustes.

Quem você é:

• Formação Acadêmica: em Administração, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia, Farmácia ou áreas correlatas. Com previsão de conclusão de curso para 2028 .

• Disponibilidade: Carga horária de 6 horas diárias .

• Disponibilidade para estagiar de 1 a 2 anos , mantendo vínculo ativo com a instituição de ensino durante todo o período.

• Idiomas: Inglês nível intermediário.

• Ferramentas: Excel do nível intermediário ao avançado .

• Possui forte capacidade analítica e atenção aos detalhes na execução das suas tarefas.

• Demonstra excelentes competências de comunicação verbal e escrita.

• Tem capacidade para trabalhar de forma independente e em equipa, interagindo com stakeholders de diversas áreas e níveis de senioridade.

• Possui conhecimentos de Excel de nível intermediário a avançado e inglês de nível intermediário.

Preferencial:

• Tem conhecimentos prévios em SAP.

*Benefícios de realocação não estão disponíveis para esta vaga.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Especialista de Compliance, Riscos e Auditoria, você irá atuar como um parceiro estratégico que assegura a conformidade com frameworks globais e legislação local. Você será responsável por monitorar o ciclo de riscos, conduzir auditorias e promover uma cultura de integridade, transformando análises complexas em planos de mitigação práticos e melhorias contínuas que protejam o negócio e suportem a tomada de decisão da liderança .

Sobre a oportunidade:

• Coordenação do ciclo anual de Riscos e Oportunidades, garantindo que a metodologia esteja alinhada às estratégias globais e locais.

• Suporte às áreas de negócio na identificação de riscos e no desenvolvimento de planos de ação para ameaças estratégicas, operacionais e de compliance.

• Acompanhamento constante da implementação das melhorias e reporte estruturado da evolução dos riscos para a alta liderança.

• Revisão de políticas internas para garantir conformidade regulatória e condução de auditorias temáticas com foco em recomendações práticas.

• Atuação como principal ponto de contato com o time global (Assuntos Governamentais e Assuntos Regulatórios), assegurando o alinhamento de diretrizes e a atualização de ferramentas corporativas.

• Execução do programa local, com foco em due diligence , análise de riscos de parceiros e implementação de métricas de efetividade.

• Revisão contínua de políticas e procedimentos internos para garantir total alinhamento entre as normas globais e as legislações locais.

• Promoção da cultura de integridade por meio de treinamentos, campanhas de engajamento e planos de lessons learned baseados em desvios identificados.

Habilidades e Experiências desejadas:

• Graduação completa em Contabilidade, Engenharia, Administração, Economia, Finanças ou áreas correlatas;

• Inglês avançado e Espanhol desejável.

• Experiência em Auditoria, Riscos e Compliance

• Proficiência em normas e regulamentos de compliance, bem como em metodologias de gestão de risco

• Conhecimento em frameworks (COSO, ISO), SAP, ferramentas de análise de dados e governança corporativa

• Experiência em gestão de projetos;

• Disponibilidade para atuar em modelo híbrido (3x na semana no escritório - Zona Sul de São Paulo)

Os benefícios de realocação não estão disponíveis para essa posição.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Principal Medical Software Engineer - Complaint Handling

titleByLocale.it: Principal Medical Software Ingegnere - Complaint Handling
titleByLocale.en: Principal Medical Software Engineer - Complaint Handling
titleByLocale.de: Principal Medical Software Ingenieur - Complaint Handling
titleByLocale.fr: Principal Medical Software Ingénieur - Complaint Handling

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As a Principal Software Engineer in Post Market Quality (PMQ), you will be at the forefront of ensuring the quality and performance of Roche’s Digital Solutions, handling complaints related to Hospital/Laboratory Information Systems (HIS/LIS), medical data networks, middleware solutions, data communication, apps, and algorithms.

Joining the Digital Solutions Chapter means working in a highly transversal software environment, giving you the opportunity to engage with cutting-edge technologies and diverse programming languages for both on-premise and cloud-based software.

Your core mission will be to act as the most experienced deep-dive investigator and internal-facing team organizer : You will analyze complex cases, log files and source code to determine the root cause or causal factor of a software malfunction/issue. While your focus is on root cause analysis, you will not be responsible for the final bug fixes. This role is set within an Agile environment where you encourage your team to innovative ideas, evaluate and support their proposals, shaping a high performing team.

The Opportunity:

• You will be accountable for handling complex medical software complaints, safety issues, and product inquiries for software products (on premise, cloud, mobile, apps,...).

• You will independently manage the entire case lifecycle, from initial creation and classification to in-depth investigation, collaboration with the on-site trouble-shooting team, documentation and final resolution. For cases that cannot be directly resolved, you take ownership of escalating to the development department.

• You will act as the most senior technical expert for case resolution, using your ability to read and understand complex source code to identify the root cause factor of software malfunctions.

• You will be able to propose process changes, following your knowledge of quality processes and how they fit together as an integrated system.

• You will coach and support more junior team members in technical and process aspects.

• You will be the main interface with Affiliates and Country Organizations. You will be responsible for the timely communication of essential quality-related information and supporting initiatives that enhance our regional partnerships.

• You will orchestrate work distribution, manage internal alignments, and ensure the team consistently meets its performance and compliance KPIs. Furthermore you coach your team members to systematically elevate the debugging and automation skillsets of the entire team

Who you are:

• A degree in computer science or an IT related field

• 7+ years of proven track records of working in the area of Software engineering or IT support related functions showcasing strong lateral leadership, a passion for coaching people and develop agile processes

• Excellent ability to work independently even when faced with uncertainty, pressure and ambiguous information.

• Strong resilience and proven ability to steer a team smoothly through high-pressure, uncertain, and highly visible product quality crises.

• Excellent ability to interact with stakeholders, influence and negotiate to push initiatives forwards

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken)

What you get:

• Employment contract (Umowa o pracę),

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance;

• Private healthcare ( LuxMed packages) and group life insurance (UNUM);

• Training, language courses, and diversified career paths are available

• Recharge

The Position As a Principal Software Engineer in Post Market Quality (PMQ), you will be at the forefront of ensuring the quality and performance of Roche’s Digital Solutions, handling complaints related to Hospital/Laboratory Information Systems (HIS/LIS), medical data networks, middleware solutions, data communication, apps, and algorithms. Joining the Digital Solutions Chapter means working in a highly transversal software environment, giving you the opportunity to engage with cutting-edge technologies and diverse programming languages for both on-premise and cloud-based software. Your core mission will be to act as the most experienced deep-dive investigator and internal-facing team organizer : You will analyze complex cases, log files and source code to determine the root cause or causal factor of a software malfunction/issue. While your focus is on root cause analysis, you will not be responsible for the final bug fixes. This role is set within an Agile environment where you encourage your team to innovative ideas, evaluate and support their proposals, shaping a high performing team. The Opportunity:
• You will be accountable for handling complex medical software complaints, safety issues, and product inquiries for software products (on premise, cloud, mobile, apps,...).
• You will independently manage the entire case lifecycle, from initial creation and classification to in-depth investigation, collaboration with the on-site trouble-shooting team, documentation and final resolution. For cases that cannot be directly resolved, you take ownership of escalating to the development department.
• You will act as the most senior technical expert for case resolution, using your ability to read and understand complex source code to identify the root cause factor of software malfunctions.
• You will be able to propose process changes, following your knowledge of quality processes and how they fit together as an integrated system.
• You will coach and support more junior team members in technical and process aspects.
• You will be the main interface with Affiliates and Country Organizations. You will be responsible for the timely communication of essential quality-related information and supporting initiatives that enhance our regional partnerships.
• You will orchestrate work distribution, manage internal alignments, and ensure the team consistently meets its performance and compliance KPIs. Furthermore you coach your team members to systematically elevate the debugging and automation skillsets of the entire team Who you are:
• A degree in computer science or an IT related field
• 7+ years of proven track records of working in the area of Software engineering or IT support related functions showcasing strong lateral leadership, a passion for coaching people and develop agile processes
• Excellent ability to work independently even when faced with uncertainty, pressure and ambiguous information.
• Strong resilience and proven ability to steer a team smoothly through high-pressure, uncertain, and highly visible product quality crises.
• Excellent ability to interact with stakeholders, influence and negotiate to push initiatives forwards
• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken) What you get:
• Employment contract (Umowa o pracę),
• Annual bonus payment based on your performance;
• Private healthcare ( LuxMed packages) and group life insurance (UNUM);
• Training, language courses, and diversified career paths are available
• Recharge

jobs.title: Gerente de Producto
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Diseñar, desarrollar e implementar estrategias/ tácticas de marketing de las líneas y/o soluciones Roche, que permitan incrementar la adopción de los productos que están a su cargo, así como aquellas ligadas a condiciones de salud, otras soluciones, plataformas y equipos comercializados por Roche Diagnóstica, dirigidas a instituciones de salud (laboratorios / hospitales y/u otros), alcanzando metas de ventas y rentabilidad establecidas.

Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad:

Las principales responsabilidades del role incluyen:

• Desarrollar estrategias de mercadeo para el portafolio de productos a su cargo.

• Diseñar, implementar y medir el impacto de tácticas de mercadeo, incluyendo: Congresos promocionales, Nuevas herramientas y/o recursos promocionales, Interacciones estratégicas con clientes , Advisory boards sobre temas comerciales, entre otros

• Administra el presupuesto de promoción del producto

• Optimizar la disponibilidad de producto para la venta

• Capacitar al área de de ventas en la estrategia y tácticas de las líneas y/o soluciones de Roche a su cargo

• Trabajar en conjunto con el área de acceso para que más pacientes se beneficien de las ventajas del portafolio a su cargo

• Contribuir al éxito del nuevo modelo organizacional y marcos de trabajo Agile de RD México

Tu perfil:

La persona en este puesto tiene excelentes habilidades de colaboración, posee la capacidad de establecer relaciones e interactuar con partes interesadas médicas, jefes de laboratorio, asociaciones profesionales y responsables de la toma de decisiones en instituciones, entre otras partes interesadas.

• Estudios Universitarios completos en Mercadotecnia, Negocios, Económico Administrativa, o a fin, Ingeniería (Titulado)

• Experiencia relevante en marketing o gestión de productos dentro de las industrias de diagnóstico, dispositivos médicos o farmacéutica con una trayectoria comprobada en lanzamientos exitosos de productos y gestión estratégica de proyectos.

• Competencia en Microsoft Office, sistemas CRM y conocimiento profundo del mercado de diagnóstico mexicano/regional.

• Conocimiento de metodologías ágiles, marketing digital y ventas estratégicas es un diferencial

• Conocimiento avanzado del idioma inglés es un requisito.

Beneficios de relocalización no están disponibles para esta posición.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position
• 1. 职位职责：
• （1 ） 协助 在公司政策和程序指引下向指定客户群传达医学信息
• （2 ） 协助 进行区域内外部客户医学信息沟通和传递，医学教育活动和培训

• （1 ）在校大学生

• （3 ）拥有良好的沟通能力、学习能力、执行能力、抗压能力以及团队合作精神
• （4 ）熟练运用Excel、PPT、Word等办公应用软件

titleByLocale.it: Piombo di Oncologia e Neurologia Medica & Access

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Beneficios de relocalización no están disponibles para esta posición.

OBJETIVOS DEL CARGO: Planear y liderar la implementación de estrategias de educación médica y de acceso al sistema sanitario para el área de Oncología y Neurología, impulsando el reembolso y la adopción médica de la tecnología diagnóstica. Generar proyectos, establecer y mantener una relación de estrecho contacto académico, profesionales de la salud y tomadores de decisión, en todo el país, con el objeto de facilitar el acceso de los pacientes y la diseminación de evidencia relacionada con las áreas diagnósticas de Oncología y Neurología.
Ser punto de contacto para resolver dudas de la comunidad médica y científica que requieran de información sustentada en evidencia, mediante el desarrollo e implementación de programas educativos específicos y medibles. Ser parte de un equipo estratégico para el desarrollo de planes que mejoren la penetración al sistema de salud de los productos de Alto Valor Médico.

Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad:

• Diseñar y ejecutar, junto a las Unidades de Negocio, estrategias de acceso y educación médica en Oncología y Neurología, liderando su implementación en centros estratégicos a nivel nacional.

• Liderar la generación y diseminación de evidencia médico-científica en entornos remotos y presenciales hacia profesionales de la salud, investigadores y tomadores de decisión, asegurando un enfoque no promocional y cumplimiento regulatorio.

• Construir relaciones estratégicas de largo plazo con la comunidad médica y stakeholders clave, identificando oportunidades de colaboración, investigación y co-creación de soluciones innovadoras que mejoren resultados en pacientes y optimicen costos del sistema de salud.

• Impulsar la generación de evidencia clínica y económica local, liderando actividades educativas, presentaciones científicas y proyectos multidisciplinarios, asegurando alineación con estándares de compliance, políticas internas y normativas vigentes.

Tu Perfil:

• Título universitario en el área de la salud.

• Deseable posgrado, maestría o PhD en Administración y Gestión en Salud, Economía de la Salud o Salud Pública.

• Experiencia en el sector salud público o privado, ya sea en prestadores de salud o proveedores de tecnologías sanitarias.

• Nivel de inglés intermedio y deseable experiencia en metodologías ágiles.

Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities
(Major functions of the position)
1. Act as PPoC to CE-I2, which consists of 2 Franchises Anti-Infectious and Immunology.
2. Take lead the identification of business pain points, root cause, and lead to take business actions, via strong business insight based on analysis
3. Coordinate bi-annual FFE business planning (including HC, Territory and objective setting) across all TA’s both of CE-O, CE-ON, as well as CE-I2
4. Proactively work together with Commercial Excellence internal team, especially BDC (Business Data Center) team, to ensure successful implementation of business initiatives
5. Work closely with Finance partner, HR partner to manage HC and resource
6. Integrate internal and external stakeholders to build end-to-end business solutions
7. Explore business opportunities and business models to sustain growth
8. Drive business initiatives via strong interpersonal skills as well as hard skills, with sense of ownership.
9. Coach team members to accommodate business requests with high efficiency and effectiveness
10. Healthcare experience is mandatory, strong analysis and presentation skills are mandatory, MBA and consulting background is preferred

Qualification and Experience

Education/Qualifications

• Bachelor degree is mandatory, and MBA or consulting experience is highly preferred.

Leadership Competencies

• Open-minded, optimistic and think in a win-win way

• Happy to collaborate with other team members and cross-functional colleagues

Job Required Competencies

• More than 10 years pharmaceutical industry experience or >3 years management/strategy consulting background

• Strong business analytical and interpretation skills

• Good at communication and manage complicated cases

• English verbal & written skills are preferred

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
生态圈负责人负责管理生态圈资源，并率领区域生态圈团队服务客户，建立内外部合作，把罗氏产品的关键信息准确及时的传达给客户，实现区域生态圈罗氏对应疾病领域策略目标，最终提高患者获益。

A. 目标与计划管理

• 基于区域生态群属地策略，制定本生态圈发展目标，并对目标的负责实施计划和跟进有效性

• 分析区域业务，发现机会及风险，并率领团队共同制定并执行相应计划

B. 客户管理与区域合作

• 率领团队与客户建立广泛的合作和信任，并共同为罗氏产品组合相关领域的规范诊疗水平提高而积极采取行动

• 同生态圈合作伙伴合作，提高当地生态圈医疗质量，提升患者获益

• 和准入团队合作提升区域内治疗药物的可及性。

C. 团队管理

• 参与制定区域生态群人员及业务管理计划，并率领团队执行相应计划

• 吸引、招聘、辅导和发展生态圈各角色职能的团队成员，实现生态圈人才的复合性发展

• 打造绩效和影响为先的团队氛围，创新工作模式，以实现公司愿景

D. 财务和合规管理

• 分配并管理公司资源、预算以实现生态圈目标

• 确保业务开展符合公司和国家合规要求，通过必要的合规培训，以身作则和监管，打造一个合规的工作环境

我们期待这样的您加入：

• 5年以上医药行业工作经验，有管理经验者优先

• 充分践行领导者的角色，即远见者，架构师，教练及促成者

• 拥有正确的思维方式和领导力特质

• 思维方式：使命驱动，协作，成长思维

• 领导力特质：系统思维，真诚无畏，协作共赢，辅导培养

• 业务及资源规划能力

• 优秀的沟通，合作和资源整合能力

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Capital Investment Finance GBPS (Secondment-Temporary)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting. This is a temporary or secondment position

As Global Business Process Specialist—Capital Investment Finance , you are part of the Business Process Management Finance team at Roche Services & Solutions. This position actively pursues the implementation of the E2E BPM strategy and is responsible for global, cross-divisional, state-of-the-art process design related to financial processes in the domains of asset accounting, CAPEX & Lease accounting. The person in this role is the empowered decision-maker for their area across divisions and in line with the E2E Business Process Management guardrails from the Global Business Process Managers. This position works closely with various stakeholders in the Business Process Management organization & beyond, with the goal to ensure fit-for-purpose solutions and contributes as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in an ongoing large scale global SAP S4 deployment across our Pharmaceutical and Diagnostics Division.

The Opportunity:

• Lead and drive the deployment of large-scale SAP S4 initiatives, owning key areas such as Asset Accounting, CAPEX, and Lease Accounting while ensuring successful project delivery and integration.

• Execute and continuously enhance end-to-end business process management (E2E BPM) strategies, delivering integrated solutions across processes, technology, and analytics while enabling global business adoption.

• Design and redesign global, cross-divisional processes to be standardized, lean, and fit-for-purpose, ensuring alignment with best practices and organizational goals.

• Govern business processes by prioritizing and implementing change requests, ensuring effective execution, documentation, automation, and continuous improvement, while creating meaningful impact across both business and IT.

Who You Are:

• You bring a bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Informatics, Engineering, or a related field, along with 5–7 years of experience in business process management, finance, accounting, or similar functions.

• You possess strong technical and process expertise, including deep knowledge of end-to-end processes, IFRS Accounting, SAP FI/CO, ICFR, procurement, and hands-on experience in asset and lease accounting within SAP environments.

• You demonstrate a strong methodological foundation (BPM, Six Sigma, Lean, Scrum, PDCA, Kaizen) combined with an agile, customer-centric mindset and high attention to detail and quality.

• You excel in stakeholder management, communication, and leadership, with a proven ability to influence, manage change, navigate ambiguity, and collaborate effectively across global, multicultural, and matrixed organizations, with business-fluent English.

Please note: Resumes must be submitted in English, as our interview panel may include participants from outside your local country.

#LI-DC1

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunit

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we believe it’s urgent to deliver medical solutions right now – even as we develop innovations for the future. We are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are fearless in both decision-making and taking action.

You will be the primary operational anchor and practitioner-leader for our delivery organization, bridging the gap between strategic intent and technical execution. This role offers a unique opportunity to lead engineering teams in building sustainable products that accelerate the delivery of life-changing diagnostics and medicines.

Description of the Area
We are seeking a hands-on leader, ideally with experience as an STE, RTE, Program Manager or Initiative Owner, to guide a diverse delivery team, including Senior Project/Program Managers, Deployment Leads, RTEs, and STEs. You will operate as a practitioner-leader, balancing deep mentorship with Network Execution. Success in this role relies on establishing absolute trust with Business and IT leaders through constant communication and active partnership.
The Opportunity:

• Drive Product Strategy: Accountable for setting the product direction, ensuring all features and roadmaps align with defined financial objectives and organizational goals.

• Lead Cross-Functional Excellence: Orchestrate the continuous flow of the Agile Value Stream while simultaneously driving distinct programs and projects to successful completion.

• Foster Trusted Partnerships: Build deep alliances with Business and IT executives through transparent communication to bridge the gap between strategy and execution.

• Champion Customer-Centricity: Act as the primary owner of the customer's problem, prioritizing internal user needs to deliver solutions that provide tangible value.

• Execute End-to-End Lifecycle Management: Lead the entire product lifecycle from initial ideation and strategic planning through to launch, scaling, and eventual retirement.

• Innovate with AI: Proactively integrate relevant Artificial Intelligence (AI) capabilities into the product roadmap to maintain a competitive and future-ready portfolio.

• Optimize Performance: Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) and user satisfaction metrics to inform data-driven product iterations and optimizations.

• Nurture Team Development: Act as a practitioner-coach, mentoring your team to master SAFe facilitation and navigate complex hybrid (Agile/Waterfall) landscapes.

Who you are:

• Experienced Product Leader: You bring 5+ years of experience in product management or business analysis with a proven track record of launching technology products.

• Industry Specialist: You possess 2+ years of experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare technology industry.

• Proven People Lead: You have 1+ years of experience in a leadership role managing multidisciplinary technical teams and holding people authority.

• Technically Proficient: You have a strong understanding of software architecture (APIs, cloud) and the product development lifecycle, including GxP and GDPR.

• Strategic Communicator: You excel at translating high-level scientific goals into concrete roadmaps and influencing diverse groups toward a common vision.

• Agile Expert: You are skilled in SAFe facilitation and capable of removing systemic impediments to maintain operational excellence and flow.

• Academic Foundation: You are highly educated in a relevant scientific, technical, or business field, supporting your ability

**Dirige l'Eccellenza Cross-Funzionale:** Orchestra il flusso continuo del flusso di valore Agile mentre guida distinti programmi e progetti verso il completamento riuscito. - **Favorisce Partnerships Fiduciarie:** Costruisce alleanze profonde con i dirigenti aziendali e IT attraverso una comunicazione trasparente per colmare il divario tra strategia ed esecuzione. - **Promuove la Centralità del Cliente:** Funziona come il proprietario principale del problema del cliente, priorizzando i bisogni interni degli utenti per consegnare soluzioni che forniscono un valore tangibile. - **Esegue la Gestione del Ciclo di Vita End-to-End:** Guida l'intero ciclo di vita del prodotto, dalla pianificazione strategica iniziale all'ideazione, al lancio, all'espansione e alla fine al pensionamento. - **Innova con l'IA:** Integra proattivamente le capacità rilevanti dell'Intelligenza Artificiale (AI) nella roadmap del prodotto per mantenere un portafoglio competitivo e pronto per il futuro. - **Ottimizza le Prestazioni:** Definisce e traccia gli indicatori chiave delle prestazioni (KPI) e le metriche di soddisfazione dell'utente per informare le iterazioni e le ottimizzazioni del prodotto basate sui dati. - **Specialista del Settore:** Possiedi 2+ anni di esperienza nel settore farmaceutico, biotecnologico o nella tecnologia regolamentata del settore sanitario. - **Leader Esperto:** Possiedi 1+ anni di esperienza in una posizione di leadership nella gestione di squadre tecniche multidisciplinary e nell'esercizio dell'autorità sulle persone. - **Tecnicamente Proficuo:** Hai una forte comprensione dell'architettura del software (API, cloud) e del ciclo di vita dello sviluppo del prodotto, compresi GxP e GDPR. - **Comunicatore Strategico:** Eccelli nella traduzione degli obiettivi scientifici di alto livello in roadmap concrete e nell'influenzare gruppi diversi verso una visione comune. - **Esperto di Agile:** Sei esperto nella facilitazione SAFe e sei in grado di rimuovere gli ostacoli sistemici per mantenere l'eccellenza operativa e il flusso. - **Fondamento Accademico:** Sei altamente istruito in un campo scientifico, tecnico o aziendale rilevante, che sostiene la tua capacità. # Contatto - Sie schafft durch ständige Kommunikation und aktive Partnerschaft absolutes Vertrauen in die Führungskräfte von Unternehmen und IT. Wer sind Sie: - Expert Product Leader: 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Produktmanagement- oder Unternehmensanalyse mit einem bewährten Rekord von der Einführung technologischer Produkte. - Spezialist für den Bereich: Sie haben 2+ Jahre Erfahrung in der pharmazeutischen, biotechnologischen oder regulatorischen Gesundheitstechnologie. - Expert Leader: Sie haben 1+ Jahre Erfahrung in einer Führungsposition in der Verwaltung von multidisziplinären technischen Teams und der Ausübung Autorität über Menschen. - Technisch rentabel: Sie haben ein starkes Verständnis für Softwarearchitektur (API, Cloud) und Produktentwicklungslebenszyklus, einschließlich GxP und DSGVO. - Strategische Kommunikation: Eccelli bei der Umsetzung hochrangiger wissenschaftlicher Ziele in konkrete Fahrpläne und der Beeinflussung verschiedener Gruppen in Richtung einer gemeinsamen Vision. - Experte von Agile: Sie sind Experte für SAFe-Facilitation und sind in der Lage, systemische Hindernisse zu beseitigen, um operative Exzellenz und Fluss zu erhalten. - akademische Stiftung: Sie sind hoch ausgebildet in einem wissenschaftlichen, technischen oder relevanten Geschäftsfeld, das Ihre Fähigkeit unterstützt. descriptionByLocale.fr: Mansioni - Gestionnaire de produits - Organisation de livraison - Secteur principal de l'ancrage opérationnel et du chef de file Description - Guidez une équipe de livraison diversifiée, composée de gestionnaires principaux de projets et de programmes, de chefs de déploiement, d'ETR et d'ECE. - Travaille comme un chef de file en conciliant le mentorat approfondi et l'exécution en réseau. - Oui. Il établit une confiance absolue avec les chefs d'entreprise et de TI par une communication constante et un partenariat actif. Possibilité : - Guider la stratégie du produit : Responsable de la gestion du produit, s'assurer que toutes les caractéristiques et les feuilles de route correspondent aux objectifs financiers et aux objectifs organisationnels définis. - Dirige l'excellence trans-fonction : orchestre le flux continu de la valeur Agile tout en conduisant des programmes et des projets distincts vers la réussite. - Promotion des partenariats fiduciaires : Elle crée des alliances profondes avec les dirigeants des entreprises et des TI grâce à une communication transparente pour combler le fossé entre la stratégie et l'exécution. - Promotion de la centralité client: Il fonctionne comme le principal propriétaire du problème du client, en priorisant les besoins internes de l'utilisateur pour fournir des solutions qui fournissent une valeur tangible. - Exécute la gestion du cycle de vie de bout en bout : Dirigez tout le cycle de vie du produit, de la planification stratégique initiale à l'idée, le lancement, l'expansion et éventuellement la retraite. - Innovation avec l'IA: intègre de manière proactive les capacités pertinentes de l'intelligence artificielle (IA) dans la feuille de route des produits afin de maintenir un portefeuille compétitif et prêt à porter. - Excellente performance : Définit et suit les indicateurs de performance clés (ICP) et les mesures de la satisfaction des utilisateurs pour éclairer les itérations et les optimisations de produits basées sur les données. - Développement de l'équipe Nurture : Il travaille comme entraîneur, mentor de l'équipe pour maîtriser la facilitation SAFe et naviguer dans des paysages hybrides complexes (Agile/Waterfall). Qui êtes-vous : - Expert Product Leader : 5+ ans d'expérience dans la gestion de produits ou l'analyse d'affaires avec une expérience éprouvée de lancement de produits technologiques. - Spécialiste du Secteur : Vous avez plus de 2 ans d'expérience dans les technologies pharmaceutiques, biotechnologiques ou réglementaires de la santé. - Chef d'équipe : Vous avez 1+ ans d'expérience en leadership dans la gestion d'équipes techniques multidisciplinaires et l'exercice de l'autorité sur les gens. - Techniquement rentable: Vous avez une bonne compréhension de l'architecture logicielle (API, cloud) et du cycle de vie du développement de produits, y compris GxP et GDPR. - Communication stratégique: Eccelli traduit les objectifs scientifiques de haut niveau en feuilles de route concrètes et influence les différents groupes vers une vision commune. - Expert d'Agile: Vous êtes expert en facilitation Safe et êtes en mesure d'éliminer les obstacles systémiques pour maintenir l'excellence opérationnelle et le flux. - Fondement académique: Vous êtes très instruit dans un domaine scientifique, technique ou pertinent, qui soutient votre capacité. Contact - Pour plus d'informations ou pour postuler, visitez le site Web de Roche ou contactez votre recruteur dédié.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
You will be :

• Actively pursue the implementation of the E2E BPM strategy, according to guardrails set by the E2E GBPO and GBPMs

• Deliver solutions including processes, technology & analytics for the Receivables, Sales & Treasury Integration Sub Chapter in line with the E2E BPM strategy & guardrails as well as continuous improvements, with support of the GBPM and GBPSs

• Support business acceptance globally across divisions and functions on an operating level for the dedicated business process area

• Drive and implement the BPM strategy for his/her own dedicated area

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Informatics, Engineering or a comparable education

Who you are :

• 5 - 7 years professional experience in Business process management, Finance & accounting or equivalent function

• Strong E2E business process area understanding and deep process knowledge as well as technical expertise for his/her dedicated area . Strong technical competencies in IFRS Accounting, SAP FI/CO, ICFR, Procurement, Transparency Laws and Regulations

• Proven methodological skills e.g. BPM, Six Sigma (DMAIC), agile ways of working (Scrum), continuous improvement (Lean, PDCA, Kaizen) . Agile mindset (speed, stability, flexibility) - works according to and brings in the agile mindset and concepts in daily operations

• Good collaboration, teamwork and interpersonal skills ; Strong analytical thinking and problem solving mindset ; Proven customer-centric mindset (internal & external) ; High attention to qualqity and details ; Highly comfortable with handling ambiguity and taking decisions

• Experience in working in multicultural teams, organizational and project management skills, especially in matrix structures, considering/balancing interests of senior stakeholders from different functions . Strong influencing skills and ability to work in complex global networks with international teams

• Extensive change management and conflict management skills and experience . Business fluency in English . Willingness to travel internationally (up to 10%)

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Head of Healthcare Transformation
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role Purpose

• The Head of Healthcare Transformation serves as a cornerstone in advancing Roche Diagnostics' commitment to enhancing patient care. By synthesizing clinical evidence, access frameworks, and governmental advocacy with business development, this leader ensures that breakthrough diagnostics gain market entry, clinical recognition, and financial sustainability within Taiwan. This executive role fundamentally evolves the local medical landscape while establishing Roche as a premier partner in the health ecosystem.

• A primary focus involves the evaluation and refinement of healthcare pathways and public policy to foster robust internal and external partnerships, thereby modernizing the local environment to drive substantive commercial growth. Achieving systemic change necessitates the seamless integration of policy shaping, medical insights and reimbursement expertise. Furthermore, you will identify and cultivate emerging business opportunities that respond to shifting clinical trends, overseeing the launch of programs that improve healthcare delivery and ensure the enduring availability of innovative diagnostic tools.

• Possessing a profound sense of purpose, the incumbent will mobilize teams to achieve superior outcomes under the "Pioneering Diagnostics and Shaping Effective Healthcare in Taiwan" vision, directly contributing to the execution of the RDTW 1000 days strategic roadmap.

• In this capacity, you will demonstrate an entrepreneurial spirit and system-wide perspective, converting visionary concepts into disciplined, high-impact strategies that secure organizational success across both immediate and future horizons.

• As a member of the RD Taiwan Leadership Team, you will role model VACC behaviors and uphold the LT Purpose Statement. Close collaboration with peers across the Leadership Team is essential to realize the company's broader objectives. This leadership approach centers on cultivating high-performing, customer-centric teams within an agile and continuously evolving organizational culture.

• Ultimately, you must exhibit the determination and resilience required to transform Taiwan's healthcare landscape, embodying the core Roche mission: "Doing what patients need next."

Key Responsibilities:

• Strategic Leadership: Develop and execute an integrated medical, market access & policy strategy aligned with global/regional guidelines and local business objectives.

• Medical Affairs Strategy: Lead the generation and dissemination of scientific evidence, foster strategic relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and medical societies, and ensure scientific accuracy in all activities.

• Market Access & Reimbursement: Drive successful NHI (National Health Insurance) listing and optimal pricing strategies for key diagnostic products, utilizing health economics and outcomes research (HEOR).

• Public Policy & Government Affairs: Proactively monitor the healthcare policy landscape. Engage collaboratively with government authorities (e.g., MOHW, NHIA), industry associations, and patient advocacy groups to shape favorable policies for diagnostic innovations.

• Business Development: Identify, develop, and manage strategic emerging business opportunities and partnerships that promote growth and innovation and ensure the delivery of scalable and impactful healthcare solutions.

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer - Manufacturing Cybersecurity
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Senior Security Engineer plays a vital role in protecting Roche Manufacturing systems and networks against cybersecurity threats. This role is responsible for local architecture and engineering support, helping system owners and administrators in keeping their manufacturing environment up to date with the latest Roche Manufacturing Cybersecurity standards, baselines and industry best practices. Some of this role’s responsibilities are:

• Taking part in technical design reviews, integration, testing, and documentation activities concerning new OT systems and/or changes to existing manufacturing system or infrastructure

• Supporting development of Manufacturing Cybersecurity standards and baselines OT Cybersecurity Advisor during OT System planning phase and OT System Risk Assessment process

• Advising System Owners in selecting appropriate security measures to mitigate risk

• Coordinating of OT services and activities delivered by Vendors

• Reviewing local technical designs as part of Manufacturing Cybersecurity Requests (in ServiceNow)

• Designing and sustaining OT Security Monitoring (IIDS) at the Manufacturing Site

• Providing technical support during Incident Response process including steps to minimize the impact, conducting a technical and forensic investigation into how the breach happened and the extent of the damage

• Working closely with System Owners, Cybersecurity Site Representative and is a catalyst for cross-site collaboration on topics related to Manufacturing Cybersecurity

The Senior Security Engineer is a member of the Manufacturing Cybersecurity Engineering team led by the Head of Manufacturing Cybersecurity Engineering and part of the Security Platforms subfunction in the Information Security function at Roche.

Job Responsibilities

• Independently manages end-to-end security analysis tasks across various capabilities and contributes to more complex problems

• Mentors more junior team members and contributes to the development of security best practices

• Stakeholder Management

• Identifies a diverse range of security stakeholders across functional areas and effectively manages relationships to build reliance through deep business and technical understanding, acting as a trusted advisor

• Acts as a strategic influencer, defining and driving stakeholder engagement strategies for complex initiatives, facilitating workshops, resolving conflicts, and proactively shaping stakeholder perspectives to align with project goals

• Impact/Strategy

• Demonstrates strong and consistent performance across diverse products, with an impact that typically extends to a specific product, initiative, or cluster

• Translates requirements into strategic implementation plans that align with overall business objectives, and takes a proactive role in shaping team processes Complexity

• Manages business analysis activities on more complex projects or across multiple products within a domain

• Capable of handling ambiguous requirements, navigating intricate stakeholder environments, and evaluating solution impacts considering both immediate and longer-term implications within the domain

• Business/Technical ability

• Demonstrates a strong understanding of the business domain, related technologies, and their interdependencies

• Can independently apply tools, principles, concepts, and techniques related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis, effectively managing interconnections to improve overall efficiency and effectiveness

jobs.title: Account Value Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Position: Account Value Partner
Report to: Account Value Lead
Area : Petchaburi, Prachuabkhirikhan, Chumporn, Ranong

Purpose of the Job
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.
As an Account Value Partner, you are at the forefront of our mission, driving the sales of Roche's innovative diagnostic products within your assigned territory in Thailand. You will be a trusted partner to healthcare professionals, providing them with the solutions and expertise they need to improve patient outcomes. This is a dynamic field-based role where you will build strong relationships, exceed sales targets, and be a key contributor to our success.

Role-Specific Accountabilities

• Define and own the medical education event and KOL engagement strategy.

• Gather and analyze insights to co-create solutions with hospital management, KOLs, and key customers.

• Take accountability for achieving budgeted sales while keeping costs under control.

• Seek out opportunities in key accounts and lead/organize promotional activities or product/solution presentations to achieve sales growth.

• Develop and implement territory and key account plans that align with the marketing plan, demonstrating effective time management and prioritization.

• Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction post-sale, including coordinating technical support or addressing initial product inquiries to maintain long-term partnerships.

• Manage the entire sales cycle, from prospecting and lead generation to negotiation, closing deals, and contract implementation.

QUALIFICATIONS
Experience and Competencies:

• Deep understanding of business drivers, products, the local market, and competition.

• Ability to influence at all levels, position/sell ideas to client groups, and manage expectations in line with the agreed portfolio.

• Builds trustful and effective relationships.

• Capable of finding creative solutions to complex problems, taking responsibility, driving results, and achieving expected outcomes.

Industry Experience:

• Bachelor's degree in Medical Technology.

• 3+ years of work experience in a related sales or clinical field.

• Flexibility to be based in various locations across Thailand, including Bangkok, upcountry provinces, or in a hybrid model, depending on the assigned territory.

• Preferred area Petchaburi, Prachuabkhirikhan, Chumporn, Ranong

• Proficient language skills in Thai and a good command of spoken and written English.

• A valid driver's license and willingness to travel frequently are required.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. jobs.title: Praktikum im Marketing & Produktmanagement Labordiagnostik (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Unsere Abteilung

Im Produktmanagement & Marketing des Bereichs Labordiagnostik der Roche Diagnostics Deutschland GmbH betreuen und vertreiben wir Lösungen für diagnostische Labore im deutschen Markt. Unser Produktportfolio umfasst Analysensysteme und Assays für die Klinische Chemie, Immunologie, Gerinnungs- und Urindiagnostik. Ganzheitliche Konzepte für Labore aller Größenordnungen werden durch innovative Hardware und Software Lösungen zur automatisierten Prä- und Postanalytik, zur Steuerung des Proben- und Datenflusses sowie zur Unterstützung der operativen und medizinischen Entscheidungsfindung realisiert. Im Marketing- und Produktmanagement stellen wir eine zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden, Verkauf, Service und Produktentwicklung dar.

Die Position

Bist Du auf der Suche nach einem Praktikum, in dem Du Dich sowohl fachlich als auch persönlich weiterentwickeln kannst? In diesem Praktikum bieten wir Bachelor- und Masterstudierenden die Möglichkeit, die Arbeit im Marketing und Produktmanagement kennenzulernen und aktiv mitzugestalten. Hier werden naturwissenschaftliche Grundlagen mit betriebswirtschaftlichen und technologischen Themen vereint. Mögliche Aufgabenfelder beinhalten:

• Unterstützung bei der Planung und Durchführung von Multi-Channel Marketingkampagnen, Schulungen und Events

• Mitarbeit bei der Einführung von neuen Produkten

• Konzeption von Marketingmaterialien (z.B. Online- und Social Media Marketing, Präsentationen und Broschüren)

• Identifikation, Analyse und Zusammenfassung von wissenschaftlicher Literatur und Studienergebnissen

• Markt- und Potentialanalysen

Qualifikationen

Für Dein Praktikum im Produktmanagement und Marketing bringst Du folgende Voraussetzungen und Kenntnisse mit:

• Du bist immatrikulierte/r, fortgeschrittene/r Bachelor- oder Masterstudierende/r der Natur- oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften, der Medizin, des Ingenieurwesens, der Informationstechnologie oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs

• Du bist es gewohnt, selbständig und mit hohem Engagement zu arbeiten und verfügst über eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe

• Komplexe Fragestellungen aus dem Gesundheitswesen motivieren Dich und Herausforderungen treiben Dich an

• Du hast Spaß, im Team zu arbeiten und gemeinsam Erfolge zu erzielen

• Du bist sicher in der Anwendung der gängigen MS Office und Google-Programme

• Deutsch ist Deine Muttersprache oder Du hast C2 Niveau

• Deine Kommunikationsfähigkeit sowie Einsatzbereitschaft runden Dein Profil ab

Die Benefits

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung

• 2268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum > 4 Monate

• Vergünstigte Essenspreise (-50 %) in unserer Mitarbeiterkantine

• Fitnesszentrum auf dem Roche-Campus

• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden

Die Bewerbung

Bitte bewirb Dich ausschließlich online und füge Deiner Bewerbung Lebenslauf, Motivationsschreiben, Zeugniskopien sowie eine aktuelle Immatrikulationsbescheinigung in einem Dokument bei.

Denke daran, daß sich dieses Praktikum ausschließlich an Studierende (m/w/d) bei laufender Immatrikulation während des gesamten Zeitraums des Praktikums richtet oder alternativ an Personen in einem maximal einjährigen Gap-Year (zwischen Bachelor und Master Studium), wo es schriftlich nachgewiesen werden kann, auf welcher Universität/Hochschule und genau wann (Monat/Jahr) innerhalb eines Jahres die Studien fortgesetzt werden.

Beachte bitte, dass Empfehlungen für alle studentischen Tätigkeiten (z.B. Praktika, Abschlussarbeiten, etc.) ausgeschlossen sind.

Zeitraum : für 6 Monat

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come.
Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

The Opportunity
Roche Diagnostics is seeking a Key Account Manager (Histology & Sequencing) based preferably in the Western Cape with commercial experience in the Diagnostic / Medical industry. The role will involve developing account and portfolio strategies, identifying and securing sales opportunities, building relationships with key executive decision makers in customers to grow Roche market share. While the focus is on the Western Cape, the role will involve travel to other provinces.

Key Challenges

Stakeholder Engagement and Management

• To build customer relationships by participating in Roche and industry events, identifying and engaging with executive decision makers, understanding market trends and provide feedback and input as required

• To create and maintain the customer account mapping by identifying stakeholders, preparing a profile on the formal and informal decision makers and create an organogram of the account as required

• To maintain effective internal relationships by engaging with relevant individuals and departments, influencing alignment and mobilisation towards key account and portfolio strategies, providing information and feedback and addressing any queries as required

• To maintain relevant product, industry and sector knowledge by engaging with the market players including but not limited to competitors and customers, analysing information and activities, identifying issues and trends and providing feedback to the relevant individuals or departments as required

Account Management

• To implement the account and portfolio strategy by understanding customer requirements, collaborating with marketing, implementing strategies in market segments and securing new clients and/or expanding footprint in existing clients as required

• To respond to sales related queries by understanding the issue, sourcing the appropriate feedback and providing feedback to clients as required

descriptionByLocale.it: Roche - Descrizione del lavoro Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. L'opportunità Roche Diagnostics sta cercando un Key Account Manager (Histology & Sequencing) basato preferibilmente nel Western Cape con esperienza commerciale nel settore diagnostico / medico. Il ruolo coinvolgerà lo sviluppo di strategie di conto e portafoglio, l'identificazione e la sicurezza delle opportunità di vendita, la costruzione di relazioni con i decisori esecutivi chiave nei clienti per aumentare la quota di mercato Roche. Mentre l'attenzione è sul Capo occidentale, il ruolo coinvolgerà i viaggi in altre province. Le sfide chiave Stakeholder Engagement and Management - Per costruire relazioni con i clienti partecipando a Roche e eventi del settore, identificare e coinvolgere i decisori esecutivi, comprendere le tendenze del mercato e fornire feedback e input come richiesto - Per creare e mantenere la mappatura dell'account cliente identificando gli stakeholder, preparando un profilo sui decisori formali e informali e creando un organogramma del conto come richiesto - Per identificare le tendenze dei dati di vendita a livello di portafoglio estraendo i dati di vendita, intraprendendo l'analisi, identificando le tendenze e le variazioni e coinvolgendo queste informazioni e fornendo motivi mensili - Capire le esigenze del cliente e vuole - Mantenere relazioni interne efficaci coinvolgendo persone e dipartimenti pertinenti, influenzando l'allineamento e la mobilitazione verso le strategie di account e portafoglio chiave, fornendo informazioni e feedback e affrontando eventuali quesiti come richiesto - Mantenere le conoscenze relative ai prodotti, all'industria e al settore, coinvolgendo i giocatori di mercato, inclusi ma non limitati ai concorrenti e ai clienti, analizzando le informazioni e le attività, identificando i problemi e le tendenze e fornendo un feedback alle persone o ai dipartimenti pertinenti, come richiesto Gestione account - Per implementare la strategia di account e portfolio comprendendo i requisiti dei clienti, collaborando con il marketing, implementando strategie nei segmenti di mercato e garantendo nuovi clienti e/o espandendo l'impronta nei clienti esistenti, come richiesto - Per identificare le opportunità di vendita impegnandosi con i clienti a comprendere nuovi prodotti o opportunità, analizzando l'opportunità, sviluppando proposte e presentando ai clienti mensilmente e come richiesto - Per implementare campagne coinvolgendo Product Managers, coinvolgendo i clienti e facendo eventi campagna come richiesto - Per rispondere alle domande relative alle vendite comprendendo il problema, sourcing il feedback appropriato e fornire feedback ai clienti come richiesto - Per segnalare le prestazioni di vendita comprendendo i KPI, analizzando quotidianamente i dati di vendita, identificando tendenze e modelli, fornendo feedback sulle prestazioni, monitoraggio e raggiungimento della redditività e redazione report mensili e come richiesto - Per raggiungere gli obiettivi di vendita gestendo le opportunità di vendita, caricando sul sistema CRM, impegnandosi con i clienti, preparando e presentando proposte, assicurando offerte, monitorando la soddisfazione del cliente nell'implementazione, identificando i rischi e implementando azioni correttive ogni giorno - Per amministrare il processo di vendita caricando tutte le informazioni di vendita nel sistema CRM, aggiornando le informazioni, tracciando il progresso delle tubazioni, identificando le aree di rischio e opportunità e implementando un'azione appropriata
