descriptionByLocale.de: Roche - Job Beschreibung Beschreibung Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns zur Innovation. Um die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die sie heute und für Generationen benötigen. Erstellen einer Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns Roche. Die Chance Roche Diagnostics sucht einen Key Account Manager (Histology & Sequencing), der vorzugsweise im Westkap mit kommerziellen Erfahrungen in der Diagnostischen / Medizinischen Industrie basiert. Die Rolle wird die Entwicklung von Konto- und Portfoliostrategien, die Identifizierung und Sicherung von Vertriebsmöglichkeiten, die Zusammenarbeit mit den wichtigsten Entscheidungsträgern der Geschäftsleitung bei Kunden zur Steigerung des Marktanteils von Roche beinhalten. Während der Schwerpunkt auf dem Westkap liegt, wird die Rolle Reise in andere Provinzen beinhalten. Die wichtigsten Herausforderungen Stakeholder Engagement und Management - Um Kundenbeziehungen durch die Teilnahme an Roche- und Branchenveranstaltungen aufzubauen, Entscheidungsträger zu identifizieren und zu engagieren, Markttrends zu verstehen und nach Bedarf Feedback und Input zu liefern - Erstellung und Aufrechterhaltung des Kundenkontos durch Identifizierung von Interessenvertretern, Erstellung eines Profils auf den formellen und informellen Entscheidungsträgern und Erstellung eines Organogramms des Kontos nach Bedarf - Ermittlung der Verkaufsdatentrends auf Portfolioebene durch Extraktion der Verkaufsdaten, Analyse, Identifizierung von Trends und Abweichungen und Einbeziehung dieser Informationen und Bereitstellung von Gründen monatlich - Verständnis der Kundenbedürfnisse und Wünsche - effektive interne Beziehungen zu pflegen, indem sie relevante Individuen und Abteilungen einbeziehen, die Ausrichtung und Mobilisierung auf Key-Account- und Portfoliostrategien beeinflussen, Informationen und Feedback bereitstellen und alle erforderlichen Abfragen ansprechen - Um relevante Produkt-, Branchen- und Branchenkenntnisse zu erhalten, indem sie mit den Marktteilnehmern zusammenarbeiten, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf Wettbewerber und Kunden, die Analyse von Informationen und Aktivitäten, die Identifizierung von Problemen und Trends und die Bereitstellung von Rückmeldungen für die betreffenden Personen oder Abteilungen nach Bedarf Kontoverwaltung - Um die Konto- und Portfoliostrategie durch das Verständnis der Kundenanforderungen zu implementieren, mit Marketing zusammenzuarbeiten, Strategien in Marktsegmenten umzusetzen und neue Kunden zu sichern und/oder den Footprint in bestehenden Kunden nach Bedarf zu erweitern - Um Vertriebschancen zu identifizieren, indem sie sich mit den Kunden beschäftigen, um neue Produkte oder Möglichkeiten zu verstehen, die Möglichkeit zu analysieren, Vorschläge zu entwickeln und den Kunden monatlich und nach Bedarf zu präsentieren - Um Kampagnen zu implementieren, indem Sie sich mit Product Managers engagieren, mit Kunden und laufenden Kampagnen-Events wie erforderlich einbinden - Um auf verkaufsrelevante Fragen zu reagieren, indem Sie das Problem verstehen, das passende Feedback ausgeben und den Kunden nach Bedarf Feedback geben - Bericht über die Verkaufsleistung durch das Verständnis von KPIs, Analyse von Verkaufsdaten täglich, Identifizierung von Trends und Mustern, Feedback zu Leistung, Überwachung und Erzielung von Rentabilität und Erstellung von Berichten monatlich und nach Bedarf - Um Verkaufsziele durch die Verwaltung von Verkaufsmöglichkeiten zu erreichen, das Laden auf das CRM-System, das Mitnehmen mit Kunden, die Vorbereitung und Präsentation von Vorschlägen, die Sicherung von Angeboten, die Überwachung der Kundenzufriedenheit bei der Umsetzung, die Identifizierung von Risiken und die Umsetzung von Korrekturmaßnahmen täglich - Verwalten des Verkaufsvorgangs durch Verladen aller Verkaufsinformationen in das CRM-System, Aktualisierung von Informationen, Verfolgung von Pipeline-Fortschritten, Identifizierung von Risiko- und Gelegenheitsbereichen und Umsetzung geeigneter Maßnahmen
descriptionByLocale.fr: Roche - Description du travail Descrizione Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. L'opportunité Roche Diagnostics est à la recherche d'un responsable de compte clé (Histologie et séquençage) basé de préférence dans l'ouest du Cap avec une expérience commerciale dans l'industrie diagnostique / médicale. Le rôle consistera à élaborer des stratégies de compte et de portefeuille, à identifier et à obtenir des débouchés commerciaux, à établir des relations avec les principaux décideurs de la clientèle afin d'accroître la part de marché de Roche. Bien que l'accent soit mis sur le cap ouest, le rôle consistera à se rendre dans d'autres provinces. Principaux défis Engagement et gestion des intervenants - Établir des relations avec la clientèle en participant aux événements de Roche et de l'industrie, en identifiant les décideurs et en les engageant avec eux, en comprenant les tendances du marché et en fournissant des commentaires et des commentaires au besoin - Créer et maintenir la cartographie des comptes clients en identifiant les parties prenantes, en établissant un profil des décideurs officiels et informels et en créant un organigramme du compte au besoin - Déterminer les tendances des ventes au niveau du portefeuille en extrayant les données sur les ventes, en procédant à l'analyse, en identifiant les tendances et les écarts et en s'engageant avec ces informations et en fournissant des raisons mensuelles - Comprendre les besoins et les désirs du client - Maintenir des relations internes efficaces en s'engageant avec les personnes et les départements concernés, en influençant l'alignement et la mobilisation vers les principales stratégies de comptabilité et de portefeuille, en fournissant des informations et des commentaires et en répondant aux demandes de renseignements, au besoin - Maintenir les connaissances pertinentes en matière de produits, d'industries et de secteurs en s'engageant avec les acteurs du marché, notamment les concurrents et les clients, en analysant l'information et les activités, en identifiant les problèmes et les tendances et en fournissant des commentaires aux personnes ou aux ministères concernés au besoin Gestion des comptes - Mettre en œuvre la stratégie de compte et de portefeuille en comprenant les besoins des clients, en collaborant avec le marketing, en mettant en œuvre des stratégies dans les segments de marché et en obtenant de nouveaux clients et/ou en élargissant l'empreinte des clients existants au besoin - Identifier les opportunités de vente en s'engageant avec les clients pour comprendre les nouveaux produits ou opportunités, en analysant les opportunités, en développant des propositions et en présentant aux clients chaque mois et selon les besoins - Mettre en œuvre des campagnes en s'engageant avec les responsables de produits, en s'engageant avec les clients et en organisant des manifestations de campagne au besoin - Répondre aux questions relatives aux ventes en comprenant le problème, en obtenant les commentaires appropriés et en fournissant les commentaires aux clients au besoin - Faire rapport sur les résultats des ventes en comprenant les KPI, en analysant les données sur les ventes chaque jour, en identifiant les tendances et les tendances, en fournissant une rétroaction sur les résultats, en surveillant et en réalisant la rentabilité et en rédigeant des rapports mensuels et au besoin - Pour atteindre les objectifs de vente en gérant les opportunités de vente, en chargeant sur le système CRM, en engageant les clients, en préparant et en présentant des propositions, en obtenant des offres, en surveillant la satisfaction des clients dans la mise en œuvre, en identifiant les risques et en mettant en œuvre des mesures correctives quotidiennement - Administrer le processus de vente en chargeant toutes les informations sur les ventes dans le système CRM, en mettant à jour les informations, en suivant les progrès des pipelines, en identifiant les risques et les possibilités et en mettant en œuvre les mesures appropriées

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Solution Architecture Practice Lead & Architecture Community Lead

As the Enterprise Architect - Solution Architecture Practice Lead & Architecture Community Lead, you will be the principal orchestrator of our global Architecture Community. You will bridge the gap between high-level strategy and practical execution, ensuring our architectural practices are co-created with the very teams that bring them to life. Join us in transforming architecture into a dynamic catalyst for global delivery and innovation.

Description of the area
The Enterprise Architecture Foundations team acts as the backbone of the architecture function, focusing on Community, Ways of Working, and Enablement. We define Enterprise and Solution Architecture practices, oversee our integrated toolchain (including ArchiMEDES/SAP LeanIX, ITONICS, and our AI Architecture Co-Pilot), and build organizational capability through learning curriculums and the Tech University. Our goal is to connect architects across a federated organization, empowering them to design sustainable technology solutions through shared principles and active community engagement.

The Opportunity:

• Lead the continuous maturation of Solution Architecture practices to adapt to evolving business needs and agile delivery models.

• Drive the transition from static documentation to dynamic solution modeling by leveraging our ArchiMEDES platform.

• Design and host global engagement forums, workshops, and community events to foster knowledge sharing and collaboration.

• Serve as the principal facilitator for the Architecture Community, inspiring a shared sense of identity across our global network.

• Partner with federated delivery teams to co-create standards that reduce friction and accelerate high-quality product delivery.

• Collaborate with Tech University to develop learning curriculums and upskill the community on modern solution design.

• Own and evolve the Solution Architect Onboarding Kit to ensure a seamless entry for new joiners into our culture and tools.

• Champion a data-driven approach to architecture, promoting the use of integrated toolchains to support transparent decision-making.

Who you are:

• You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with professional background in solution or enterprise architecture within complex organizations.

• You possess applied experience as a Solution Architect, demonstrating a deep understanding of the practical realities of technology delivery.

• You offer comprehensive expertise in solution architecture methodologies and modern digital platforms like Cloud, Data, and AI.

• You are proficient with architecture modeling platforms (e.g., SAP LeanIX) and can translate enterprise principles into actionable designs.

• You have a proven track record in cultivating, motivating, and facilitating vibrant and active communities of practice.

• You demonstrate a co-creation mindset, viewing practice development as a shared journey rather than a top-down mandate.

• You are a master of influencing and storytelling, with the ability to engage senior stakeholders through empathy and clear communication.

What you get:

• Salary range 23 300 - 43 300 PLN gross based on the employment contract.

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance.

• Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths etc.).

• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available).

• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose).

• Vacation subs

Ponteggerai il divario tra la strategia di alto livello e l'escuzione pratica, assicurandoti che le nostre pratiche di architettura siano co-create con i team che le rendono vive. Unisciti a noi per trasformare l'architettura in un catalizzatore dinamico per la consegna globale e l'novazione. Descrizione dell'area Il team di Enterprise Architecture Foundations agisce come la spina dorsale della funzione di architettura, concentrrandosi sulla Comunità, i Modi di Lavorare e l'Enablement. Definiamo le pratiche di Enterprise e Solution Architecture, sovrintendiamo alla nostra catena di strumenti integrata (compresi ArchiMEDES/SAP LeanIX, ITONICS e il nostro AI Architecture Co-Pilot) e costruiamo la capacità organizzativa attraverso i curricula di apprendimento e la Tech University. Il nostro obiettivo è connettere gli architetti in un'organisazione federata, responsabilisationli a progettare soluzioni tecnologicalhe sostenibili attraverso princi condivisi e l'impegno attivo della comunità. Annexe - Guidare la maturazione continue delle pratiche di Solution Architecture per adattarsi alle esigenze aziendali in evoluzione e ai modelli di consegna agile. - Guidare la transizione dalla documentazione statica al modelo di soluzione dinamico usingzando la nostra piattaforma ArchiMEDES. - Progettare e ospitare forum di impegno globale, workshop e eventi comuntari per favorire la condivisione delle conoscenze e la collaboration. - Fare da facilite principale per la comunità di architettura, ispirando un senso di identità condiviso nella nostra rete globale. - Collaborare con i team di consegna federati per co-creare gli standard che riducono gli attriti e accelerano la consegna dei prodotti di alta qualità. - Collaborare con la Tech University per sviluppare i curricula di apprendimento e aggiornare la comunità sulle moderne progettazioni di soluzione. - Possedere e evolvere il Kit di Onboarding del Solution Architecte par garantie un ingresso fluido per i nuovi arrivati nella nostra cultura e negli strumenti. - Promuovere un approccio basato sui dati all'architettura, promuovendo l'uso delle catene di strumenti intégrer per supportare le decisioni trasparenti. Les - Hai un Bachelor's o Master con un'espérienza professionnelle en solution o architecture d'entreprise all'interno di organizzazioni complesse. - Offri un'esperienza applicata come Solution Architect, dimostrando una profonda comprensione delle realtà pratiche della consegna tecnologica. - Offri un'esperienza completa nelle metodologie di solution architecture e nelle piattaforme digitali moderne come Cloud, Data e AI. - Sei esperto nelle piattaforme di modellazione dell'architettura (ad esempio, SAP LeanIX) e puoi tradurre i princi aziendali in progettazioni azionabili. - Hai un'esperienza comprovata nella coltivazione, motivazione e facilitazione di comunità di pratica ative e vivaci. - Dimostri un mindset di co-creazione, vedendo lo sviluppo delle pratiche come un viaggio condiviso piuttosto che un mandato dall'alto. - Sei un maestro dell'influenza e della narrazione, con la capacità di coinvolgere i senior partnership attraverso l'empatia e la comunicazione chiara.
• Cosa offriamo - Gamma samariale 23 300 - 43 300 PLN lordi basata sul contratto di lavoro. - Bonus annuel basato sulla tua performance. - Budget di formazione dedicato (formazione, certificatcazioni, conferenze, percorsi di carriera diversificati, etc.). - Venerdì di rica (2 vénérì liberi par trimestre disponible). - Programme di congedo (fino a 3 mesi di congedo da usingzare per qualsiasi scopo). - Congedo vacanza

jobs.title: Zonal Manager - Molecular Lab (Bhubaneswar)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Position - Zonal Manager - Molecular Lab

Your Opportunity

In this role you will be responsible for total account management and selling the full Molecular portfolio. You will have the responsibility to drive molecular business in Bhubaneswar and the states of Odisha, Bihar, and Jharkhand . Understanding of the market and also willingness to travel for better penetration in the given territory will be required. You will manage channel partners. Exposure of working with Molecular segment would be added preference. As part of the Roche Molecular portfolio you will also be positioning IT solutions that will connect instruments across the continuum of care in both inpatient and outpatient settings. This position requires conducting presentations and business reviews to potential customers thereby demonstrating in-depth knowledge of our product line, as well as relevant healthcare/industry trends including related products or services.

Role Responsibilities:

• Generates new customer demand and expansion for Molecular products.

• Penetrates large, complex accounts to gain access to and favor with all buying influences and key decision makers.

• Demonstrates strong clinical and financial acuity with ability to listen and understand customer needs and align Roche Molecular products within segment.

• Translates customers’ defined business/technical and personal goals into internal action while balancing key business priorities and goals.

• Balances the need to advocate for customers while also demonstrating the drive and ability to negotiate and achieve strong business results for Roche.

• Develops territory-specific executional strategies to consistently meet and exceed sales targets.

• Applies competitive, customer, and product knowledge to establish competitive barriers.

• Works cross functionally with internal colleagues and peers to share information and best practices while remaining actively involved in industry/customer organizations that impact business.

• Demonstrates strong oral and written communication skills including making impactful presentations.

• Conducts system demonstrations & presentations where applicable; Molecular Committee Meetings, Trade Shows, VIPS, etc.

Who you are

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

• 5+ years relevant sales or equivalent experience

• Participation in an approved accelerated development, fellowship or rotational program may be considered in lieu of experience

Preferred Qualifications

• 5+ years of field sales experience in Molecular Diagnostics/ Oncology

• 5+ years of experience negotiating contracts with Integrated Health Networks

• 5+ years of experience driving revenue growth via strategic territory development

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Pharmazeutischer Assistent (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Unsere Pharma-Vision
Medikamente schnell zu den Patienten zu bringen und das beste Ergebnis für unsere Kunden zu schaffen. Das ist es, was uns in Sterile Drug Product Manufacturing (SDPM) in Mannheim antreibt. So tragen wir auch dazu bei, bis 2029 unser Ziel zu erreichen: 20 bahnbrechende Medikamente zur Behandlung der Krankheiten mit der größten gesellschaftlichen Belastung bereitzustellen. Unsere Arbeit, unser täglicher Einsatz und unser Engagement bedeuten für sehr viele große Hoffnung und Zuversicht und deswegen müssen wir anders denken und arbeiten. Mit dem Patient im Fokus setzen wir auf eine neue Organisation und zwar #WIRGEMEINSAM in SDPM! ​

Was Dich erwartet:
Als Pharmazeutischer Assistent (m/w/d) unterstützt Du die Leitung der Herstellung im Produktionsbetrieb im Rahmen der folgenden Aufgaben:

• Du stellst sicher, dass die GMP-konforme Herstellpraxis und die GMP-gerechte Dokumentation im Produktionsbetrieb eingehalten werden. Für den Chargenreview sowie konzeptionelle Erstellung der GMP-Dokumente in deutscher und englischer Sprache bist Du verantwortlich

• Du bearbeitest die Chargendokumentation (Batch Record Review) vor der Freigabe durch den Leiter der Herstellung.

• Du erstellst und bearbeitest Abweichungen, Reklamationen und Changes.

• Du erstellst und aktualisierst Arbeitsanweisungen und Vorschriften eigenständig.

• Du wirkst bei behördlichen Inspektionen mit und unterstützt bei der Umsetzung von Maßnahmen.

Wer Du bist:

• Du hast ein abgeschlossenes naturwissenschaftliches Studium (Master), idealerweise mit Approbation als Apotheker.

• Du bringst erste Erfahrungen in der Pharmaindustrie mit, zum Beispiel in den Bereichen Verpackung, aseptische Produktion, Qualitätskontrolle oder Qualitätssicherung.

• Du überzeugst mit deinen Sprachkenntnissen und deinem Ausdrucksvermögen in Deutsch und Englisch (in Wort und Schrift)

• Du besitzt ein hohes Maß an Teamfähigkeit und Verantwortungsbereitschaft

• Die Fähigkeit zu interdisziplinärem Denken, Konfliktbewältigung sowie Integrations- und Überzeugungsfähigkeit runden dein Profil ab

Diese Stelle ist befristet auf 24 Monate.

Soweit so gut? Es geht noch besser. Wir bieten dir vielfältige Top-Benefits an unseren Standorten. Nur mit dir zusammen können wir das Leben von Patient:innen verbessern. Du machst Roche mit Deinem Beitrag einzigartig. Deswegen bieten wir außergewöhnliche Benefits, die Dich unterstützen, Dein Leben, Deine Finanzen und Deine Gesundheit so zu gestalten, wie Du es möchtest. Finde hier mehr heraus:
https://go.roche.com/Kandidaten-Benefits-DE

Deine Bewerbung
Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:

• Aktueller Lebenslauf oder Workday-Profil

• Deine offiziellen (Bildungs-) Zeugnisse & Nachweise

Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt. Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden können.
Bewirb Dich jetzt – wir freuen uns!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

jobs.title: Customer Operations Agent (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Du möchtest in einem dynamischen Umfeld arbeiten und aktiv dazu beitragen, unsere Servicequalität auf das nächste Level zu heben? Als Customer Operations Agent bei Roche Diagnostics übernimmst du eine Schlüsselrolle, um einen reibungslosen End-2-End Prozess in der Auftragsabwicklung zu gewährleisten.

Die Position ist vorerst auf 2 Jahre befristet und wird über ein Partnerunternehmen abgewickelt.

Was dich erwartet:

• Operative Auftragsabwicklung in SAP sowie Bearbeitung telefonischer und schriftlicher Kund:innenanfragen

• Selbstständige Betreuung eines zugewiesenen Kund:innenbereichs sowie Bearbeitung von Retouren, Gutschriften und Reklamationen

• Bearbeitung von Abrechnungsrückmeldungen der österreichischen Gesundheitskassen sowie Befundabrechnung im Labor- und Krankenhaussegment

• Engpassmanagement zur Sicherstellung und Optimierung der Liefertreue und enge Zusammenarbeit mit globalen Logistikteams, dem Außendienst sowie dem lokalen Material- und Produktmanagement und externen Logistikpartner:innen

• Exception Handling: Monitoring und Bearbeitung von Systemfehlern in internen und externen Anwendungen sowie Abstimmung mit relevanten Schnittstellen und Fachbereichen

• Anlage, Pflege und Aktualisierung von Kund:innenstammdaten im Patient:innenmanagement

• Unterstützung bei der Einführung, Automatisierung und Weiterentwicklung digitaler Bestellmöglichkeiten in der Auftragsabwicklung

• Prozessverantwortung für definierte End-to-End-Prozesse (E2E)

Wer Du bist:

• Kaufmännische Ausbildung, FH-/Universitätsabschluss oder relevante Berufserfahrung im Bereich Auftragsabwicklung und Kund:innenbetreuung

• Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten für die Zusammenarbeit mit internen Abteilungen sowie externen Kund:innen und Logistikpartner:innen (Deutsch C1, Englisch B2)

• Erfahrung im Umgang mit ERP-Systemen (idealerweise SAP) sowie Kenntnisse in Google Workspace, Office 365 und Salesforce von Vorteil

• Strukturierte, effiziente und selbstständige Arbeitsweise mit ausgeprägtem Organisationstalent und hoher Detailgenauigkeit

• Hohe Kundenorientierung sowie eine zuverlässige und kommunikative Teamplayer-Persönlichkeit

• Analytisches Denkvermögen, Belastbarkeit und eine ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise

• Aufgeschlossene Persönlichkeit mit lösungsorientierter und eigenverantwortlicher Arbeitsweise

Es erwartet dich ein Jahresgehalt ab € 48.000,00 brutto Vollzeit, sowie ein leistungsorientierter Bonus und attraktive Benefits. Pensionskasse, Betriebsrestaurant, flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, betriebliche Gesundheitsförderung und vielfältige Sportangebote, sind nur einige davon. Abhängig von Qualifikation und Erfahrung besteht die Bereitschaft zur Überzahlung

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Intern - KI in der Qualifizierung
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Die Organisation “Site Network Basel/Kaiseraugst”, Teil der globalen Group Function “Corporate Strategy, Sustainability & Sites”, stellt die Infrastruktur und Services für den gesamten Standort bereit und entwickelt diese kontinuierlich und auf innovative Art weiter. Wir arbeiten mit allen Anspruchsgruppen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette zusammen, von der frühen Forschung bis zur Versorgung der Patient:innen. Bei uns kannst du dich auf ein modernes Organisationsmodell freuen, in welchem du in Eigenverantwortung deine Talente in sinnhafter Arbeit einbringen kannst. Wir garantieren Gestaltungsspielraum und Entscheidungsfreiheit in unserer Organisation. Klassische Vorgesetzte suchst du bei uns vergebens.
Innerhalb der Organisation “Site Network Basel/Kaiseraugst” gestalten wir im Cluster “Business Solutions” gemeinsam mit unseren Anspruchsgruppen massgeschneiderte Lösungen.

Innerhalb der Abteilung Pharma Engineering – Qualifizierung Drug Substance (DS) am Standort Kaiseraugst betreuen wir die Erstqualifizierung von Produktionsanlagen und Systemen. In einem dynamischen Umfeld bieten wir dir die Gelegenheit, als Praktikant:in oder im Rahmen einer Bachelorarbeit aktiv an der digitalen Transformation unserer Abteilung mitzuwirken. Der Fokus liegt dabei auf der Steigerung der Effizienz und Qualität durch den Einsatz von Künstlicher Intelligenz (KI) sowie der Standardisierung unserer Dokumentationsprozesse.

Die Möglichkeit
KI-gestützte Prozessoptimierung und Standardisierung

• KI-Integration: Du arbeitest aktiv bei der Optimierung von Qualifizierungsabläufen mit, indem Du KI Applikationen evaluierst und implementierst, um die operative Effizienz zu steigern.

• Standardisierung: Du unterstützt uns bei der Erarbeitung von Konzepten zur Vereinheitlichung von Qualifizierungstätigkeiten durch technologische Hilfsmittel.

• Innovations-Management: Du wirkst bei der Identifikation von Potenzialen mit, um manuelle Prozesse in digitale, KI-gestützte Workflows zu überführen.

Dokumentenwesen und Template-Optimierung

• Smart Documentation: Du unterstützt bei der Konzeption und Umsetzung von Lösungen, um Qualifizierungsdokumente automatisiert mittels KI erstellen zu lassen.

• Lifecycle-Management: Du analysierst und optimierst bestehende Templates sowie Standarddokumente hinsichtlich Nutzerfreundlichkeit und Automatisierbarkeit.

Compliance und GxP-Standards

• Richtlinien-Einhaltung: Du hilfst dabei, die Einhaltung und Dokumentation von GxP-Richtlinien sowie internen Standards bei der Einführung neuer KI-Tools sicherzustellen. Du unterstützt uns bei der Erstellung einer lückenlosen Lifecycle-Dokumentation für die qualifizierten Systeme.

Anforderungen / Kenntnisse

• Grundverständnis für den Bereich Qualifizierung / Validierung sowie Interesse an GxP-Richtlinien.

• Affinität zu KI-Technologien und modernen Software-Tools und deren Anwendung

• Eine strukturierte, selbstständige Arbeitsweise

• Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten für den Austausch in einem interdisziplinären Team.

Wer Du bist

• Du bist aktuell immatrikulierte/r Student:in (Bachelor/Master) oder hast dein Studium in den Bereichen Life Sciences, Pharmazie, Ingenieurwissenschaften oder einem vergleichbaren Fachbereich innerhalb der letzten 12 Monate erfolgreich abgeschlossen.

• Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind zwingend erforderlich; gute Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

Zusätzliche Information

• Startdatum: Nach Vereinbarung (ideal Q3 2026)

• Dauer: 6 Monate

• Im Rahmen des P

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione L’organizzazione “Site Network Basel/Kaiseraugst”, parte della funzione “Corporate Strategy, Sustainability & Sites”, fornisce l’infrastruttura e i servizi per l’intero sito e li sviluppa continuamente e in modo innovativo. Lavoriamo con tutti gli stakeholder lungo tutta la catena del valore, dalla ricerca precoce alla cura dei pazienti. Con noi si può aspettare un modello organizzativo moderno, in cui è possibile contribuire i vostri talenti nel lavoro sensuale. Garantiamo la libertà di progettazione e di decisione nella nostra organizzazione. Stai cercando dei superiori classici. All’interno dell’organizzazione “Site Network Basel/Kaiseraugst” creiamo soluzioni su misura nel cluster “Business Solutions” insieme ai nostri stakeholder. All'interno del Dipartimento di Ingegneria Farmacia – Qualificazione Drug Substance (DS) presso il sito Kaiseraugst, sosteniamo la qualificazione iniziale di impianti e sistemi di produzione. In un ambiente dinamico, vi offriamo l'opportunità di partecipare attivamente alla trasformazione digitale del nostro dipartimento come stagista: in o come parte di una tesi di laurea. L'obiettivo è aumentare l'efficienza e la qualità attraverso l'uso dell'intelligenza artificiale (AI) e standardizzare i nostri processi di documentazione. La possibilità Ottimizzazione e standardizzazione dei processi basati su AI
• Integrazione dell'intelligenza artificiale: si sta lavorando attivamente per ottimizzare i processi di formazione, valutando e implementando applicazioni AI per aumentare l'efficienza operativa.
• Standardizzazione: Lei ci sostiene nello sviluppo di concetti per la standardizzazione della formazione mediante strumenti tecnologici.
• Gestione dell'innovazione: è possibile identificare i potenziali per trasferire i processi manuali ai flussi di lavoro basati su AI digitali. Documentazione e ottimizzazione dei modelli
• Smart Documentation: Supporti la concezione e l'implementazione di soluzioni per creare automaticamente documenti di qualificazione utilizzando AI.
• Gestione del ciclo di vita: analizza e ottimizza i modelli esistenti, nonché i documenti standard relativi alla facilità d'uso e all'automazione. Standard di conformità e GxP
• Conformità delle policy: l'utente aiuta a garantire la conformità e la documentazione delle politiche GxP e degli standard interni durante l'introduzione di nuovi strumenti AI. Ci supporta nella creazione di una documentazione completa del ciclo di vita per sistemi qualificati. Requisiti / conoscenza
• Comprensione di base per la qualificazione / validazione e l'interesse per le linee guida GxP.
• Affinità per tecnologie AI e strumenti software moderni e la loro applicazione
• Un modo di lavoro strutturato e indipendente
• Buone capacità di comunicazione per lo scambio in un team interdisciplinare. Chi sei
• Sei attualmente uno studente immatricato: in (Bachelor/Master) o hai completato con successo i tuoi studi nei campi delle scienze della vita, della farmacia, delle scienze ingegneristiche o di un soggetto paragonabile negli ultimi 12 mesi.
• Le competenze linguistiche tedesche nella parola e nella scrittura sono assolutamente necessarie; le buone abilità inglesi sono di vantaggio. Ulteriori informazioni
• Data di inizio: Con accordo (ideale Q3 2026)
• Durata: 6 mesi
• Sotto la P

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position L'organisation « Site Network Basel/Kaiseraugst », qui fait partie de la fonction de groupe globale « Corporate Strategy, Sustainability & Sites », fournit l'infrastructure et les services pour l'ensemble du site et les développe continuellement et de manière innovante. Nous travaillons avec tous les intervenants tout au long de la chaîne de valeur, de la recherche précoce aux soins aux patients. Avec nous vous pouvez vous attendre à un modèle organisationnel moderne, dans lequel vous pouvez contribuer vos talents dans le travail sensuel. Nous garantissons la liberté de conception et de prise de décision dans notre organisation. Vous cherchez des supérieurs classiques. Au sein de l'organisation, le réseau du site Basel/Kaiseraugst, nous créons des solutions sur mesure dans le cluster Solutions d'affaires avec nos partenaires. Au sein du ministère de l'Ingénierie Pharmae – Substance médicamenteuse qualifiée (DS) au site de Kaiseraugst, nous soutenons la qualification initiale des installations et des systèmes de production. Dans un environnement dynamique, nous vous offrons la possibilité de participer activement à la transformation numérique de notre département en tant que stagiaire:dans ou dans le cadre d'une thèse de baccalauréat. L'accent est mis sur l'amélioration de l'efficacité et de la qualité par l'utilisation de l'intelligence artificielle (IA) et la normalisation de nos processus de documentation. La possibilité Optimisation et normalisation des processus basés sur l'IA
• Intégration de l'IA : vous travaillez activement à optimiser les processus de formation en évaluant et en mettant en œuvre des applications d'IA pour accroître l'efficacité opérationnelle.
• Normalisation : vous nous aidez à développer des concepts de standardisation de la formation au moyen d'outils technologiques.
• Gestion de l'innovation : Vous pouvez identifier les possibilités de transférer des processus manuels vers des workflows numériques basés sur l'IA. Documentation et optimisation des modèles
• Smart Documentation: Vous supportez la conception et la mise en œuvre de solutions pour créer automatiquement des documents de qualification en utilisant l'IA.
• Gestion du cycle de vie: Vous analysez et optimisez les modèles existants ainsi que les documents standard concernant la convivialité et l'automatisation. Conformité et normes GxP
• Conformité à la politique : vous aidez à assurer la conformité et la documentation des politiques de GxP ainsi que des normes internes lors de l'introduction de nouveaux outils d'IA. Vous nous aidez à créer une documentation complète sur le cycle de vie des systèmes qualifiés. Exigences / connaissances
• Compréhension de base pour la qualification / validation ainsi que l'intérêt pour les lignes directrices GxP.
• Affinité pour les technologies d'IA et les outils logiciels modernes et leur application
• Une manière de travailler structurée et indépendante
• Bonnes compétences en communication pour l'échange dans une équipe interdisciplinaire. Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes actuellement un étudiant immatriculé:en (Bachelor/Master) ou avez terminé avec succès vos études dans les domaines des sciences de la vie, pharmacie, sciences de l'ingénierie ou un sujet comparable au cours des 12 derniers mois.

We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

jobs.title: Qualification Engineer/Qualifizierungsingenieur (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Unsere Pharma-Vision
Medikamente schnell zu den Patienten zu bringen und das beste Ergebnis für unsere Kunden zu schaffen. Das ist es, was uns in Sterile Drug Product Manufacturing (SDPM) in Mannheim antreibt. So tragen wir auch dazu bei, bis 2029 unser Ziel zu erreichen: 20 bahnbrechende Medikamente zur Behandlung der Krankheiten mit der größten gesellschaftlichen Belastung bereitzustellen. Unsere Arbeit, unser täglicher Einsatz und unser Engagement bedeuten für sehr viele Menschen große Hoffnung und Zuversicht und deswegen müssen wir anders denken und arbeiten. Mit dem Patient im Fokus setzen wir auf eine neue Organisation und zwar #WIRGEMEINSAM in SDPM! ​

Was Dich erwartet:

Als Qualification Engineer/Qualifizierungsingenieur (m/w/d) bist Du Teil des Teams MSAT und sorgst gemeinsam mit den Kollegen*innen dafür, dass unsere pharmazeutischen Anlagen reibungslos laufen und alle gesetzlichen und GMP -Vorgaben eingehalten werden. Werde Teil eines Teams, das nicht nur die Einhaltung höchster Standards sicherstellt, sondern auch aktiv eine Kultur der Zusammenarbeit, des Lean Managements und der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung
(#WIRGEMEINSAM) vorlebt.

Darüber hinaus übernimmst Du folgende spannende Aufgaben:

• Du erstellst selbstständig und verantwortest Qualifizierungs- und
Requalifizierungsdokumente wie Pläne, Berichte und Risikoanalysen für Produktionsanlagen und Equipment anhand der geltenden Anforderungen, regulatorischen Vorgaben und Validierung skonzepten.

• Du vertrittst deine Arbeit souverän bei internen und externen Inspektionen und Audits gegenüber Behörden wie der EMA und FDA.

• Du unterstützt die Weiterentwicklung von Qualifizierungskonzepten hin zu einer kontinuierlichen, datenbasierten Qualifizierung, um die Effizienz zu steigern.

• Du steuerst, beauftragst und kontrollierst externe Dienstleister und interne Schnittstellenabteilungen effizient.

• Du tauschst dich proaktiv mit anderen Standorten aus, um das Fachgebiet weiterzuentwickeln und Best Practices zu etablieren.

Wer Du bist:

• Du hast ein abgeschlossenes technisches Studium (Bachelor, Master) in Pharmatechnik, Biotechnologie , Verfahrenstechnik oder eine einschlägige Berufsausbildung mit mehrjähriger Berufserfahrung.

• Du hast ausgeprägte Erfahrung in der pharmazeutischen Industrie, insbesondere im Bereich der Sterilproduktion und Qualifizierung.

• Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse der pharmazeutischen Herstellungsverfahren und Technologien sowie der GMP , EU und FDA Richtlinien und relevanten Arzneibüchern.

• Du überzeugst mit deinen fließenden Sprachkenntnissen und deinem Ausdrucksvermögen in Deutsch und Englisch (in Wort und Schrift).

• Du besitzt ein hohes Maß an Teamfähigkeit und Verantwortungsbereitschaft.

• Die Fähigkeit zu interdisziplinärem Denken, Konfliktbewältigung sowie Integrations- und Überzeugungsfähigkeit runden dein Profil ab.

Soweit so gut? Es geht noch besser. Wir bieten dir vielfältige Top-Benefits an unseren Standorten. Nur mit dir zusammen können wir das Leben von Patient:innen verbessern. Du machst Roche mit Deinem Beitrag einzigartig. Deswegen bieten wir außergewöhnliche Benefits, die Dich unterstützen, Dein Leben, Deine Finanzen und Deine Gesundheit so zu gestalten, wie Du es möchtest. Finde hier mehr heraus:
https://go.roche.com/Kandidaten-Benefits-DE

Deine Bewerbung
Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:

• Aktueller Lebenslauf oder Workday-Profil

• Deine offiziellen (Bildungs-) Zeugnisse & Nachweise

Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend

jobs.title: PostDoc Position in Bioorganic Chemistry (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you interested in developing novel reagents and workflows for next generation sequencing?
We are looking for a highly talented and motivated postdoctoral fellow (m/f/d) to join our team on
this mission.

The Chemistry Technologies department provides the full spectrum of chemical diagnostic
reagents, ranging from small molecules to biooligomers and polymers. Leveraging modern
synthetic and analytical methods we design and develop tailor-made molecules to find the right
solutions for diagnostic questions and beyond. We work as a team, are driven by passion for
science and commitment to continuous learning to stay at the forefront of research.

Our culture is defined by trust, transparency, and a strong collaborative spirit. We are looking for
a proactive colleague who balances independent critical thinking with team spirit and the
flexibility to collaborate across diverse departments and interdisciplinary teams.

Your tasks

• Design and synthesize complex oligonucleotide-conjugates by contemporary bioconjugation techniques and small molecular entities by chemical synthesis

• Establish DNA templated proximity reactions for initial testing of your new reagent classes

• Collaborate proactively with project partners from biology, analytics and the sequencing test development teams to gain a deep insight into the relationship of structural design and assay performance

• Independently plan, execute and analyze experiments to effectively advance the projects

• Present scientific progress through internal meetings and visit scientific conferences to ensure the state-of-the-art knowledge in the field of bioorganic synthesis, chemical biology and surface chemistry

• Be part of a highly motivated and cross-functional team

Your profile

• You hold a PhD in the field of (bio)organic chemistry, chemical biology or life science.

• You possess profound knowledge in the synthesis of oligonucleotide-conjugates, preferably in context of biomolecules (proteins, peptides, nucleic acids)

• You are well experienced in organic synthesis

• Hands-on experience in the field of DNA-templated reactions, proximity reactions and nucleic acid detection completes your profile.

• Your qualification should be clearly demonstrated by at least one first author paper published or accepted in a high impact journal.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are your strength. You are sensitive to intercultural and interdisciplinary matters - working in a team comes natural to you.

• You are a proactive individual with passion and commitment to innovate healthcare through our Roche Diagnostics Postdoc Program.

• Excellent English skills are required, German is not mandatory.

When does it start?
This position will be filled with effect Septmber 2026 and is limited to 2 years.

Have we aroused your interest?
# If we are convinced, a virtual interview will take place
# If you also manage to convince us here, the last step is an interview and presentation in the
Penzberg area

Your application
Please submit your application by sending an updated CV (including publication list and
references) together with your latest certificates. Before sending your application, please note
that no further documents can be added subsequently.

We are looking forward to your application!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives u

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Developing enzymes for Roche internally as well as externally means for us the development of tailor-made biocatalysts and biological targets for creating the best-in-class molecules for Roche and our clients. Combining several biotechnological methods such as expression profiling, cell cultivation, enzyme purification portfolio, enzyme engineering and biochemical investigations, we always try to improve, to maintain or to design new enzymes. Mandatory, the complete value chain as a platform thought of Roche is given. We are working cross-functional for both the diagnostic and pharma division of Roche worldwide. Being an R&D function we always try to keep close contacts with our clients as with our production for ensuring a fast, but qualitatively high development which should result in functional Roche products finally. As a Post-Doc Position in Novel Enzymes (m/f/d) , you actively shape the development of new enzymes using biotechnological and bioinformatic methods. Become part of an innovative research team that consolidates a platform from dry-lab to wet-lab to develop customized enzymes for our diagnostics. We offer you a unique opportunity to translate your scientific ideas into practice and thus contribute to the improvement of patient health. The opportunity
• You ensure the development of new enzymes using a combination of biotechnological and bioinformatic methods
• You are responsible for the independent production of tailored proteins/enzymes using molecular biological methods or the establishment of new production and screening methods for protein variants
• You support the consolidation of a platform from dry-lab to wet-lab, suitable for the protein engineering of novel enzymes
• You implement new biochemical and biophysical readouts suitable for the screening and development of tailored enzymes
• You pursue scientific and technical education by continuously following and reading the relevant scientific literature Who you are
• You possess a university degree (Dr. / Ph.D.) in a relevant field
• You have specialized knowledge in the areas of protein engineering, bioinformatics, and molecular biology
• Experience in microbiology, downstream and upstream processing, as well as chemistry, is an advantage
• You demonstrate knowledge and expertise in recombinant protein expression, protein purification, and the development of protein analytical methods for protein characterization
• You are willing to provide consultation and troubleshooting regarding enzyme challenges in Research & Development and Production This position is limited to 2 years. Application documents To make the application process as convenient as possible for you please add only a motivation letter and your updated CV . References and certificates are not required at this stage. We look forward to receiving your application! Your contact to us! With people. For people. Do you need further support? Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq . Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver

titleByLocale.it: Gruppo Lead Device Process Engineering - Global MSAT
titleByLocale.en: Group Lead Device Process Engineering - Global MSAT
titleByLocale.fr: Ingénierie des procédés de l'appareil principal de groupe - Global MSAT

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Global MSAT & Engineering function is undergoing a strategic modernization initiative to introduce innovative, efficient, and sustainable manufacturing technologies across our global device manufacturing footprint. As the Group Lead for Device Process Engineering, you will be the architect of our technical talent and process excellence. This is a dual-impact leadership role: you will serve as a senior technical authority for our most complex device programs and lead a world-class chapter of Process Engineers, ensuring they have the skills, tools, and standardized methodologies to deliver next-generation medical devices and drug-device combination products to patients worldwide.

The Opportunity

• Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of process engineers, setting clear expectations for technical excellence and functional capability.

• Define and drive the global process-engineering strategy for device and combination product assembly, packaging, and sterilization across the entire product lifecycle.

• Act as the senior technical authority for complex engineering decisions, balancing quality, compliance, supply, and speed-to-market.

• Drive structured process characterization using DOE and statistical tools to define operating windows and ensure process understanding.

• Establish methodologies for identifying critical process parameters (CPPs) and material attributes to ensure robust control strategies.

• Own design transfer activities, translating design outputs into production specifications, equipment requirements, and manufacturing work instructions.

• Define and govern risk-based validation strategies for manufacturing processes, equipment qualification, and sterilization.

• Manage the process-engineering framework for continued process verification, investigation support, and lifecycle optimization.

• Ensure all engineering practices comply with global regulatory requirements, including FDA QMSR, ISO 13485, and EU MDR.

Who you are
You are a strategic and technically credible leader who moves fluently between executive decision-making and deep engineering problem-solving. You have the ability to explain complex validation decisions to diverse audiences, translating technical risks into clear business impacts. You are a dedicated coach and talent developer who sets high standards for technical rigor while empowering your team to act. As an effective communicator and resilient collaborator, you build trust across matrixed organizations and remain focused on shared objectives even during periods of ambiguity or change.

Further you have the following qualifications and experiences:

• Degree (B.S., M.S., or Ph.D.) in Mechanical Engineering, Pharmaceutical Engineering, or a related technical field.

• 12-15+ years of experience in process engineering or technical operations within regulated medical device or pharma environments.

• Proven track record in formal people leadership and influencing across a matrixed global organization.

• Deep expertise in device assembly, packaging, sterilization, and automated manufacturing from development to commercial scale.

• Strong knowledge of design controls, risk management (ISO 14971), DfM, and technical transfer processes.

• Experience working with global external manufacturing partners and supplier networks.

Are you ready to make a difference for our patients? We are looking forward to your application – join us now and become part of our journey!

Who we are
A healthier future drives u

descriptionByLocale.it: Roche - Opportunità di lavoro Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. Mansioni La funzione Global MSAT & Engineering sta subendo un'iniziativa di modernizzazione strategica per introdurre tecnologie di produzione innovative, efficienti e sostenibili attraverso la nostra impronta globale di produzione di dispositivi. In qualità di Gruppo Lead for Device Process Engineering, sarai l'architetto del nostro talento tecnico e dell'eccellenza del processo. Questo è un ruolo di leadership dual-impact: servirai come autorità tecnica senior per i nostri programmi di dispositivo più complessi e condurre un capitolo di livello mondiale di ingegneri di processo, assicurando loro di avere le competenze, gli strumenti e metodologie standardizzate per fornire dispositivi medici di prossima generazione e prodotti combinati droga-dispositivi a pazienti in tutto il mondo. Opportunità - Lead, coach e sviluppare un team di ingegneri di processo altamente performanti, ponendo chiare aspettative per l'eccellenza tecnica e la funzionalità. - Definire e guidare la strategia globale di ingegneria del processo per l'assemblaggio, l'imballaggio e la sterilizzazione del prodotto di dispositivo e combinazione in tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto. - Agire come autorità tecnica senior per decisioni di ingegneria complesse, bilanciare la qualità, la conformità, la fornitura e la velocità di mercato. - Guidare la caratterizzazione del processo strutturato utilizzando DOE e strumenti statistici per definire le finestre operative e garantire la comprensione del processo. - Stabilire metodologie per identificare i parametri di processo critici (CPP) e gli attributi materiali per garantire strategie di controllo robuste. - Attività di trasferimento di progettazione proprie, traducendo uscite di progettazione in specifiche di produzione, requisiti di attrezzature e istruzioni di lavoro di fabbricazione. - Definire e governare strategie di validazione basate sui rischi per processi di produzione, qualificazione delle attrezzature e sterilizzazione. - Gestire il quadro di ingegneria del processo per la verifica continua del processo, il supporto di indagine e l'ottimizzazione del ciclo di vita. - Assicurarsi che tutte le pratiche ingegneristiche siano conformi ai requisiti normativi globali, tra cui FDA QMSR, ISO 13485 e EU MDR. Chi sei? Sei un leader strategico e tecnicamente credibile che si muove fluentemente tra il processo decisionale esecutivo e la risoluzione dei problemi di ingegneria profonda. Hai la capacità di spiegare complesse decisioni di validazione a diversi pubblico, traducendo i rischi tecnici in chiari impatti aziendali. Sei un allenatore dedicato e sviluppatore di talenti che stabilisce standard elevati per il rigore tecnico, consentendo al tuo team di agire. Come un efficace comunicatore e collaboratore resiliente, si costruisce fiducia tra le organizzazioni matrici e si concentrano su obiettivi condivisi anche durante i periodi di ambiguità o cambiamento. Inoltre, hai le seguenti qualifiche ed esperienze: - Laurea (B.S., M.S. o Ph.D.) in Ingegneria Meccanica, Ingegneria Farmaceutica, o un campo tecnico correlato. - 12-15 anni di esperienza nell'ingegneria dei processi o nelle operazioni tecniche all'interno di dispositivi medici regolamentati o in ambienti farmaci. - Provato record di traccia nella leadership delle persone formali e influenzando attraverso un'organizzazione globale matrice. - Profonda competenza nel montaggio, imballaggio, sterilizzazione e produzione automatizzata da sviluppo a scala commerciale. - Forte conoscenza dei controlli di progettazione, gestione dei rischi (ISO 14971), DfM e processi di trasferimento tecnico. - Esperienza di lavoro con partner di produzione esterni globali e reti di fornitori. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. The Position The Global MSAT & Engineering function is undergoing a strategic modernization initiative to introduce innovative, efficient, and sustainable manufacturing technologies across our global device manufacturing footprint. As the Group Lead for Device Process Engineering, you will be the architect of our technical talent and process excellence. This is a dual-impact leadership role: you will serve as a senior technical authority for our most complex device programs and lead a world-class chapter of Process Engineers, ensuring they have the skills, tools, and standardized methodologies to deliver next-generation medical devices and drug-device combination products to patients worldwide. The Opportunity
• Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of process engineers, setting clear expectations for technical excellence and functional capability.
• Define and drive the global process-engineering strategy for device and combination product assembly, packaging, and sterilization across the entire product lifecycle.
• Act as the senior technical authority for complex engineering decisions, balancing quality, compliance, supply, and speed-to-market.
• Drive structured process characterization using DOE and statistical tools to define operating windows and ensure process understanding.
• Establish methodologies for identifying critical process parameters (CPPs) and material attributes to ensure robust control strategies.
• Own design transfer activities, translating design outputs into production specifications, equipment requirements, and manufacturing work instructions.
• Define and govern risk-based validation strategies for manufacturing processes, equipment qualification, and sterilization.
• Manage the process-engineering framework for continued process verification, investigation support, and lifecycle optimization.
• Ensure all engineering practices comply with global regulatory requirements, including FDA QMSR, ISO 13485, and EU MDR. Who you are You are a strategic and technically credible leader who moves fluently between executive decision-making and deep engineering problem-solving. You have the ability to explain complex validation decisions to diverse audiences, translating technical risks into clear business impacts. You are a dedicated coach and talent developer who sets high standards for technical rigor while empowering your team to act. As an effective communicator and resilient collaborator, you build trust across matrixed organizations and remain focused on shared objectives even during periods of ambiguity or change. Further you have the following qualifications and experiences:
• Degree (B.S., M.S., or Ph.D.) in Mechanical Engineering, Pharmaceutical Engineering, or a related technical field.

jobs.title: Public Key Infrastructure - Junior Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At the heart of our digital security is the trust we build through encrypted communication. As a PKI Engineer, you will join our Identity and Access Management (IAM) team to help manage the core certificate infrastructure. You’ll be instrumental in ensuring that our digital certificates are issued, tracked, and renewed without a hitch. This is a growth-oriented role where you will learn to navigate complex security infrastructures while contributing to the automation of high-volume security tasks.

Job Responsibilities

Scope

• Support the day-to-day administration of Microsoft Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS), including basic template management and standard troubleshooting.

• Use Keyfactor Command to monitor certificate health, identify expiring assets, and assist in bringing untracked certificates into compliance.

• Support the deployment of ACME clients (like Certbot) for automated certificate issuance across web server environments.

• Participate in the automation of routine certificate tasks using Version Control systems and scripting as required (PowerShell or Python).

• Collaborate with senior engineers to orchestrate certificate distribution to load balancers, firewalls, and application servers.

Impact/Strategy

• Collaborate in the automation of routine certificate tasks using basic scripting (PowerShell or Python) and maintain scripts using version control systems.

• Assist in maintaining team internal wikis, standard operating procedures, and runbooks for certificate lifecycle management.

• Collaborate with senior engineers to route, distribute, and install certificates to load balancers, firewalls, and application servers .

​
Complexity

• Focuses primarily on executing defined procedures, troubleshooting routine issues, and escalating complex anomalies to senior team members.

• Contributes to team agility by identifying operational inefficiencies and proposing minor process improvements within immediate daily tasks.

• Demonstrates growing autonomy within the specific domain by translating daily requirements into structured tasks under direct supervision.

​
Business/Technical ability

• Possesses a working knowledge of the relevant business domain and supporting technologies

• Understands sources of influence, comprehending internal and external factors affecting the problem space, and is capable of identifying and analyzing basic business problems or opportunities holistically

​
Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Experience: 1–2 years of experience in an IT Helpdesk, Systems Administration, or junior Security Operations (SOC) role. An internship focused on infrastructure or security is highly valued.

• Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, or equivalent practical experience.

• Working knowledge of relevant business domains and supporting cybersecurity technologies

• Demonstrated ability to independently handle defined tasks and contribute to various stages of the security and business analysis lifecycle

​
Technical Skills

• Understanding of Zero Trust principles, authentication factors and cryptography.

• A solid understanding of cryptography basics (Symmetric vs. Asymmetric, Hashing, Digital Signatures).

• Experience with Windows Server and Active Directory. Exposure to web servers like IIS, Apache, or Nginx. Comfortable using Git for basic file management and collaboration.

• Knowledge of the ACME protocol or experience using tools like Certbot.

• Familiarity with PowerShell o

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This role is based in the Real-World & Clinical Data Strategy (RWCDS) team which drives data excellence and analytics to power enhanced decision-making and evidence-generation within Roche Product Development. We develop and implement data strategies that unlock the value of clinical, operational, and real-world data to accelerate evidence generation, decision-making, and innovation across PD and beyond. By embedding FAIR principles, advancing data governance, and enabling data productization, RWCDS ensures that data is not only findable and usable, but also a driver of scientific rigor, regulatory readiness, and AI-powered transformation. Through deep partnerships with internal functions and external collaborators, we shape a future-ready data ecosystem that supports personalized healthcare and efficient drug development.

The Opportunity:

The Data Strategy & Analytics Specialist contributes to the design and execution of data strategies and analyses that enable decision-making and insight generation across a therapeutic area or molecule portfolio. Working under the Data Strategy & Analytics Lead, you will partner with cross-functional teams to align data strategy with clinical and translational goals, identify key data assets, and support the delivery of integrated evidence plans. You will also contribute to the translation of scientific and business needs into analytical frameworks and data-driven solutions. This role demands a strong foundation in data science, analytics planning and execution, and an ability to bridge scientific questions with practical data solutions.

• You assist in documenting data strategies and requirements for programs and therapeutic areas

• You support data integration and harmonization efforts by applying templates and standard protocols

• You contribute to analytic execution for use cases leveraging multi-modal data sources across real-world, clinical, and operational domains

• You analyze data structure and support the standardization of terminology and metadata

• You collaborate with team members and internal partners to maintain structured and accessible data assets

• You have a strong background in real-world data (RWD)

Lavorando nell'ambito di Data Strategy & Analytics Lead, collaborerai con team interfunzionali per allineare la strategia dei dati con obiettivi clinici e traduttivi, identificare le risorse di dati chiave e supportare la fornitura di piani di prova integrati. • Supporti gli sforzi di integrazione e armonizzazione dei dati applicando modelli e protocolli standard
• Contribuisci all'esecuzione analitica per casi di utilizzo sfruttando fonti di dati multi-modali in ambiti reali, clinici e operativi
• Contribuisci alla mappatura degli esercizi e alla documentazione della linea di dati per supportare il riutilizzo e la qualità dei dati
• Analizzi la struttura dei dati e supporti la standardizzazione della terminologia e dei metadati
• Collaborate con i membri del team e con i partner interni per mantenere asset di dati strutturati e accessibili Chi sei:
• Hai una laurea o un master in Informatica, Scienze della vita, Scienza informatica, o un campo correlato
• Hai uno sfondo forte in dati reali (RWD)
• Hai 2+ anni di esperienza lavorando con i dati strutturati in un ambiente di ricerca o assistenza sanitaria (esclusi gli stage)
• Hai conoscenza di base di R o Python
• Capisci dizionari di dati, mappature, o tagging dei metadati
• Conoscete i sistemi di dati utilizzati nelle impostazioni cliniche o operative

• Esibisci un'eccellente agilità strategica, tra cui capacità di problem solving e di pensiero critico, e agilità che si estende oltre il dominio tecnico
• Lei dimostra il rispetto delle differenze culturali quando interagisce con i colleghi sul posto di lavoro globale
