jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Affiliate: Roche Diagnostics Korea
Division: Core Lab&POC
Work location: Seoul, South Korea

Your key responsibilities
1. Define and execute clinical chemistry and related product marketing plans and perform daily product management tasks.

• Develop and execute product marketing plans and plan of actions

• Develop product key message and sales tools such as brochure, master presentations, advertising films and gimmicks

• Prepare new product launch and manage the product lifecycle from phase in to phase out.

• Price management: distributor prices and delivery prices

• Stock management such as forecast, ordering and allocation during bottleneck

• Manage all regulatory and reimbursement tasks involved during phase in and out

• Support quality issues with S&S and QA

• Monitor and analyze sales performance monthly and yearly

• Coordinate and conduct congress, product seminars and conferences

• Update marketing activities reports regularly

2. Gather market insights through regular customer visits, competitor and market trends monitoring and incorporate these insights into product strategy.

• Conduct market survey

• Gather information about competitors' activities and price strategies to set up counter-proposals

• Visit KOLs and major customers regularly: workshop, product presentation, proposals etc.

3, Align and collaborate with all stakeholders within/outside RDK

• Coordinate training for sales, distributors and all relevant stakeholders

• Cooperate with sales, S&S, SCM, Q&R & MA, DMS, finance etc. regularly

• Liaise with regional and global colleague

• Cooperation with distributors and other business partners.

4. Conduct business in full compliance.

• 100% completion on compliance training

• Well know about updated regulation and compliance information and share to my team

• Meet compliance for all external activities

Who you are

Bachelor Degree in Health/Science disciplines
At least 3 years’ experience as commercial roles(sales or marketing) in healthcare industry
Proficiency in both spoken and written English
Good command of MS office software application and google document, slides, sheet

Submission
자유 양식의 국/영문 이력서 및 국/영문 자기소개서 (하나의 MS Word 혹은 PDF 파일로 제출)
※ 이력서 상단에 반드시 현재 연봉과 희망 연봉을 표기하시기 바랍니다. 누락 시 이력서가 검토되지 않습니다.
※ 이력서 내 이메일 주소와 서류전형 지원 사이트의 입력하시는 이메일 주소를 반드시 동일하게 작성해주시기 바랍니다.
※ 국가보훈대상 및 장애인은 관련 서류 제출시 관련 법규에 의거 우대합니다.
※ 이력서에 개인민감정보 (신체적 조건, 출신 지역, 혼인 여부, 가족관계 등)는 기재하지 말아주십시오.
※ 입사 지원 서류에 허위 사실이 발견될 경우, 채용 확정 이후 라도 채용이 취소될 수 있습니다.

Process
서류 전형▶ 면접 전형 ▶ 종합 심사 ▶ 최종 합격 통지
※ 면접은 서류전형 합격자에 한해 개별 통보합니다.
※ 면접 일정 안내 및 조율을 위해 해외 번호(중국)로 연락이 갈 수 있는 점 미리 안내드립니다.
※채용이 유력한 후보자에 대해서 이력 검증 및 평판 조회, 건강검진 등의 종합심사를 진행하여 최종 합격자를 선정합니다.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Intern - Support to SHE Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Summary
The SHE Intern will support the Safety, Health, Environment, and Security team in the continuous improvement of the SHE management system. This role provides hands-on SHE documentation, contributing to a strong safety culture across the organization.
Key Responsibilities

• Support with critical thinking the identification of occupational health and safety risks.

• Assist in the development, review, and documentation of Critical Tasks procedures, safe work instructions and chemical management

• Collaborate in the development of SHE related documentation.

• Assist in chemical documentation processes, including inventories, labeling SGA, safety data sheets (SDS), and storage compliance.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to promote SHE awareness and best practices.

Requirements

• Currently enrolled student in Occupational Health, Occupational Safety Engineering, or related field.

• Ability to critically identify, analyze, and anticipate occupational safety hazards and risks.

• Understanding of critical tasks, safe work procedures and chemical management.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Good written and verbal communication skills in English.

• Proactive attitude, willingness to learn, and ability to work collaboratively.

• Intermediate level of Google Workspace tools (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drive).

Preferred Skills

• Basic knowledge of SHE standards and regulations (e.g., ISO 45001, ISO 14001, NFPA).

• Experience with documentation control or process mapping

jobs.title: Personalized Healthcare (PHC) Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Scope

I. Team Leadership and People Development

• Lead and Coach : Provide direct line management, coaching, mentorship, development to a team of PHC Partners, fostering a culture of high performance, accountability, and entrepreneurial thinking.

• Performance Management : Set clear performance objectives, conduct regular reviews, and manage the goals/sales performance of the team, ensuring goals/sales and profitability targets are met or exceeded.

• Recruitment and Onboarding : Participate in the recruitment and development of talent

II. Commercial Strategy Execution & Business Results

• Strategic Planning : Translate the overall business strategy into actionable, time-bound business plans and sales/account strategies for your team and territory to drive adoption of high medical value assays and utilization of hospital point-of-care solutions. Closely collaborate with Diagnostics Value Team (Marketing) and other relevant teams to define and review product marketing strategies.

• Sales/Account Strategy Execution : Oversee and drive the execution of the account strategies across the designated hospital accounts, drive cross-functional collaboration in particular with Customer Success Partners for Hospital and Lab, other field colleagues and external stakeholders to ensure cohesive execution and maximize account opportunities.

• Medical Value Delivery: Ensure that the team's strategies deliver demonstrable medical value of high medical value assays to healthcare systems, clinicians, and patients, enabling optimal disease management to achieve better patient outcomes.

• Account and Territory Management: Manage the overall territory plan and key accounts, allocate resources effectively.

• Forecasting and Reporting: Ensure accurate sales forecasting, pipeline visibility, and timely reporting on business performance

• Distributor Management: As distributor owner, collaborate with Strategic Planning, Business and Commercial Excellence Team to drive distributor strategies which enable sales growth

III. Customer Experience Excellence

• KOL (clinicians) Engagement: Working together with Diagnostic Value Team and Medical Team, maintain a high level of market intelligence and a close liaison with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and clinical experts in the industry to gather insights and drive changes in respective hospitals and the Taiwan healthcare ecosystem.

• Customer Advocacy: C hampion customer needs internally, ensuring seamless collaboration with Diagnostics Value (Marketing), Customer Experience Team, Global Service Team (FMI APAC and Global teams) and other functions to improve, resolve issues and enhance the end-to-end customer journey.

IV. Compliance and Integrity

• Conduct all business activities in full compliance with Roche Secure, Roche Behavior in Business, Roche Competition Law Interactive Dialogues, and Roche Safety, Security, Health, and Environmental Protection policies, while demonstrating a solid understanding of compliance requirements and upholding the high standard of integrity.

Requirements

Qualifications:

• Good Compliance track record. No material Compliance violation is identified in the past 5 years

Education:

• A bachelor’s degree in medical/pharmaceutical/Life Sciences/marketing related field. An advanced (master’s or doctorate) degree is preferred.

Working Experience:

• > 7 years of progressive experience in IHC/FMI/NGS/Oncology related field, with a proven track of driving customer centric ways of working.

• > 2 year

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
患者解决方案负责人，负责制定患者整体解决方案相关的策略和团队管理工作，包含但不限于助力和规划疾病教育、支持创新支付解决方案、准入及安全运营，以及上市前后产品的学术平台搭建等活动和项目。通过敏捷工作方式融动跨部门资源，给予团队必要的支持和辅导。通过实现团队工作有效性和合作有效性的提升，最终实现对外部客户、患者及合作机构的更多获益。

A.洞察与策略

• 进行数据整理及分析，洞察业务机会和风险

• 协助区域生态群负责人制定属地化策略，包括：学术平台的搭建和资源布局、准入与安全运营、创新平台和患者可支付性的提升等，所有和提升诊疗水平和患者全程管理相关的举措

B.平台和项目协同

• 确保资源的有效实施和整合，最大化资源使用效率

• 合理布局团队的工作重点，支持生态圈负责人的各项关键任务的落地实施

C.跨部门沟通及合作

• 对接圈外（总部）的医学、法务合规、准入、市场、培训等部门，确保生态圈内外部的信息及时、精准的传递

D.团队管理和人员辅导

• 不断促进团队的工作效能，打造敏捷的工作氛围和方式

我们期待这样的您加入：

• 8年以上医药行业工作经验，有管理经验者优先

• 成长性思维和快速学习能力

• 具备业务敏锐度和市场洞察、规划能力

• 优秀的沟通，合作和资源整合能力

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

工作职责
目标管理

• 根据公司产品管线的整体策略，因地制宜地制定生态群发展目标，并负责实施计划和跟进有效性

区域合作与客户管理

• 与客户及合作伙伴建立广泛的合作和信任，并共同为罗氏产品组合相关领域的规范诊疗水平提高而积极采取行动

• 发展管理区域生态圈合作伙伴，提高当地生态圈医疗质量，提升患者获益

• 和准入团队合作保证区域内治疗药物的可及性

• 对接支持部门，建立沟通机制，确保生态圈内外部信息一致统一

团队管理

• 管理生态圈管理委员会，进行人员及业务管理，并率领团队制定并执行相应计划

• 通过识别正确的思维，能力和背景，吸引和选拔一支高效和多样化的团队

• 辅导和发展员工，打造团队的人才梯队

• 打造一个绩效和影响为先的团队氛围，以实现公司愿景和创新的工作模式

财务和合规管理

• 分配并管理公司资源以实现生态群目标

• 确保业务开展符合公司和国家合规要求，通过必要的合规培训、以身作则和监管，打造一个合规的工作环境

自我管理

• 积极的进行领导技能的学习，以身作则执行公司各项规章制度，进行有效的团队管理

• 践行公司价值观，展现专业素养

能力要求

• 充分践行领导者的角色，即远见者，架构师，教练及促成者

• 拥有正确的思维方式和领导力特质。（思维方式：使命驱动，协作，成长思维。领导力特质：系统思维，成长思维，真诚无畏，协作共赢，辅导培养。）

• 业务规划能力，高效整合资源能力

• 良好的沟通能力

• 10 年以上销售，市场，医学或准入工作经验，医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

• 跨地区/跨部门/多产品管理的工作经验优先

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
IT Business Analyst - RDT Biometrics and Clinical Evidence

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Principal Business Analyst is a senior, high-impact role that sits at the crossroads of clinical science, product strategy, and technology delivery. While positioned as a Business Analyst, this role operates with the breadth, depth, and strategic influence of a seasoned analyst owning the vision, innovation pipeline, and feature delivery of the Study Designer, a flagship product enabling clinical trial teams to design smarter, faster, and more impactful studies.This individual brings a rare combination of deep scientific credibility, product leadership, and technical fluency - capable of earning the trust of Clinical Scientists in one meeting and driving an engineering sprint in the next. They are relentlessly curious, innovation-driven, and passionate about using technology to transform how clinical trials are conceived and executed - ultimately accelerating therapies to patients.

The Opportunity

• Clinical & Scientific Collaboration : Act as the primary link between clinical/scientific teams and product engineering, building long-term relationships and facilitating discovery workshops with medical experts to deeply understand trial design and represent the clinical user's voice.

• Product Feature Innovation: Define and own the feature roadmap by balancing business, scientific, and technical needs; foster innovation through design thinking sprints to identify new opportunities, create compelling business cases, and track feature success metrics/KPIs post-release.

• Feature Design & Requirements Excellence: Author precise, actionable user stories, epics, and acceptance criteria; partner with UX to create wireframes and prototypes, ruthlessly filter requests based on value, and maintain a living product specification traceable to user needs.

• Technology & Engineering Partnership: Act as a technical translator by converting complex clinical workflows into structured requirements, leveraging strong literacy in architecture, data modeling, and APIs to collaborate with engineers on technical risks, dependencies, and solutions.

• Quality Assurance & UAT Support: Partner with architects, senior engineers, and QA leads throughout the development build cycle to ensure feature scalability and quality, while supporting UAT design and execution to meet scientific intent and usability standards.

• Agile Leadership & Delivery: Drive iterative delivery, rapid feedback, and hypothesis-driven development; own and groom a sprint-ready product backl

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione IT Business Analyst - RDT Biometrics e la prova clinica Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è dove l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. Come team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi business-minded impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale della salute di domani. La nostra missione è quella di alimentare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando le potenzialità dell'intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidato da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutti i Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano, e di condurre scoperte che veramente importano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici di ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi. Il Principal Business Analyst è un ruolo senior, ad alto impatto che siede al crocevia della scienza clinica, della strategia del prodotto e della consegna della tecnologia. Mentre si posiziona come Business Analyst, questo ruolo opera con l'ampiezza, la profondità e l'influenza strategica di un analista esperto che possiede la visione, l'innovazione pipeline, e la consegna caratteristica dello Studio Designer, un prodotto di punta che consente ai team di prova clinici di progettare studi più intelligenti, più veloci e più efficaci. Questo individuo porta una rara combinazione di profonda credibilità scientifica, leadership di prodotto e fluidità tecnica - in grado di guadagnare la fiducia degli scienziati clinici in un incontro e di guidare uno sprint di ingegneria nel prossimo. Sono instancabilmente curiosi, orientati all'innovazione e appassionati di utilizzare la tecnologia per trasformare come le sperimentazioni cliniche sono concepite e eseguite - alla fine accelerando le terapie ai pazienti. L'opportunità
• Collaborazione clinica e scientifica: agire come collegamento primario tra team clinici/scientifici e ingegneria dei prodotti, costruire relazioni a lungo termine e facilitare i laboratori di scoperta con esperti medici per comprendere profondamente il design di prova e rappresentare la voce dell'utente clinico.
• Innovazione di funzionalità del prodotto: Definire e possedere la roadmap caratteristica bilanciando le esigenze aziendali, scientifiche e tecniche; promuovere l'innovazione attraverso progetti di pensiero di progettazione per identificare nuove opportunità, creare casi aziendali convincenti, e tracciare metriche di successo / KPI post-release. Eccellenza: Autore storie utente precise e attuabili, epici e criteri di accettazione; partner con UX per creare wireframe e prototipi, filtrare senza scrupoli richieste basate sul valore, e mantenere una specifica di prodotto vivente tracciabile alle esigenze dell'utente.
• Technology & Engineering Partnership: Agire come traduttore tecnico convertendo complessi flussi di lavoro clinici in requisiti strutturati, sfruttando una forte alfabetizzazione in architettura, modellazione dei dati e API per collaborare con gli ingegneri sui rischi tecnici, dipendenze e soluzioni.
• Quality Assurance & UAT Support: Partner con architetti, ingegneri senior e QA porta in tutto il ciclo di costruzione dello sviluppo per garantire scalabilità e qualità delle funzionalità, supportando al contempo la progettazione e l'esecuzione UAT per soddisfare gli standard di intenti scientifici e di usabilità.
• Leadership Agile & Delivery: consegna iterativa di guida, feedback rapido e sviluppo basato su ipotesi; proprio e sposo un backl prodotto pronto sprint

Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position IT Business Analyst - RDT Biometrie und klinische Beweise Roche Digital Technology (RDT) ist der Ort, an dem Innovation den Zweck erfüllt. Als globales Team im Herzen von Roche sind wir eine Community von geschäftsorientierten Technologen, die dazu beitragen, die digitale Zukunft der Gesundheitsversorgung von morgen zu gestalten. Unsere Mission ist es, Roche durch modernste digitale Technologien zu treiben und das Potenzial künstlicher Intelligenz, Daten und skalierbaren Tech-Innovationen zu nutzen. Angetrieben von Zweck und Leidenschaft, bauen wir eine Zukunft, in der digital eine Kernkraft für alle Roche ist, die intelligentere Möglichkeiten der Arbeit ermöglicht, das menschliche Potenzial zu entsperren und Durchbrüche zu treiben, die wirklich für Millionen von Patienten auf der ganzen Welt wichtig sind. Bei Roche bieten wir ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das Flexibilität mit persönlicher Zusammenarbeit verbindet. Wir verlangen, dass unsere Mitarbeiter im Durchschnitt zwei Tage pro Woche in unseren Büros sind. Die spezifischen Bürotage können je nach Bedarf variieren, z.B. Workshops, Konferenzen, Rathause, Teamtreffen und andere kollaborative Veranstaltungen. Der Principal Business Analyst ist eine hochwirksame Rolle, die an der Kreuzung der klinischen Wissenschaft, Produktstrategie und Technologielieferung sitzt. Während sie als Business Analyst positioniert ist, arbeitet diese Rolle mit der Breite, Tiefe und strategischem Einfluss eines erfahrenen Analysten, der die Vision, Innovationspipeline besitzt, und der Feature-Lieferung des Study Designer, einem Flagship-Produkt, das klinische Testteams ermöglicht, intelligentere, schnellere und effektvollere Studien zu entwickeln. Dieses Individuum bringt eine seltene Kombination aus tiefen wissenschaftlichen Glaubwürdigkeit, Produktführerschaft und technischer Glaubwürdigkeit - in der Lage, das Vertrauen der Klinischen Wissenschaftler in einem Treffen zu verdienen und einen Engineering-Sprint im nächsten zu treiben. Sie sind unermüdlich neugierig, innovationsgetrieben und leidenschaftlich über die Anwendung von Technologie, um zu transformieren, wie klinische Studien konzipiert und durchgeführt werden - letztendlich beschleunigen Therapien für Patienten. Die Chance
• Klinische und wissenschaftliche Zusammenarbeit: Akt als primäre Verbindung zwischen klinischen/wissenschaftlichen Teams und Produkttechnik, Aufbau langfristiger Beziehungen und Erleichterung von Entdeckungsworkshops mit medizinischen Experten, um das Testdesign zu verstehen und die Stimme des klinischen Benutzers zu repräsentieren.
• Produkt-Feature Innovation: Definieren und besitzen Sie die Funktion Roadmap durch den Ausgleich von Geschäfts-, wissenschaftlichen und technischen Bedürfnissen; fördern Sie Innovation durch Design Thinking Sprints, um neue Möglichkeiten zu identifizieren, überzeugende Geschäftsfälle zu schaffen, und verfolgen Sie die Funktion Erfolg Metriken/KPIs post-Release.
• Feature Design & Anforderungen Exzellenz: Autor präzise, aktivierbare Benutzergeschichten, Epische und Akzeptanzkriterien; Partner mit UX, um Drahtrahmen und Prototypen zu erstellen, Filteranfragen auf Basis des Wertes lückenlos zu filtern und eine lebende Produktspezifikation zu erhalten, die auf die Bedürfnisse der Nutzer zurückzuführen ist.
• Technology & Engineering Partnership: Act als technischer Übersetzer, indem komplexe klinische Workflows in strukturierte Anforderungen umgewandelt werden und starke Alphabetisierung in Architektur, Datenmodellierung und APIs nutzen, um mit Ingenieuren auf technische Risiken, Abhängigkeiten und Lösungen zusammenzuarbeiten.
• Quality Assurance & UAT Support: Partner mit Architekten, Senior Engineers und QA führt während des gesamten Entwicklungs-Bauzyklus, um die Funktion Skalierbarkeit und Qualität zu gewährleisten, und unterstützt UAT Design und Ausführung, um wissenschaftliche Absichts- und Usability Standards zu erfüllen.
• Agile Führung & Lieferung: Fahren Sie iterative Lieferung, schnelles Feedback und Hypothese-getriebene Entwicklung; eigene und pflegen Sie ein sprint-ready Produkt Backl

Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Analyste des affaires TI - DDT Biométrie et preuves cliniques Roche Digital Technology (RDT) est l'endroit où l'innovation répond à des objectifs. En tant qu'équipe mondiale au cœur de Roche, nous sommes une communauté de technologues d'affaires engagés à aider à façonner demain l'avenir numérique des soins de santé. Notre mission est d'alimenter Roche par des technologies numériques de pointe, en exploitant le potentiel de l'intelligence artificielle, des données et des innovations technologiques évolutives. Poussé par le but et la passion, nous construisons un avenir où le numérique est une force fondamentale dans toute Roche, permettant des façons plus intelligentes de travailler, débloquant le potentiel humain et conduisant des percées qui comptent vraiment pour des millions de patients dans le monde. Chez Roche, nous offrons un modèle de travail hybride qui combine flexibilité et collaboration en personne. Pour l'instant, nous exigeons que nos employés soient dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. Les jours de bureau spécifiques peuvent varier selon les besoins des entreprises, comme les ateliers, les conférences, les mairies, les réunions d'équipe et d'autres événements en collaboration. L'analyste principal des affaires joue un rôle de premier plan à fort impact qui se situe au carrefour des sciences cliniques, de la stratégie des produits et de la prestation de la technologie. Tout en étant un analyste d'affaires, ce rôle fonctionne avec l'étendue, la profondeur et l'influence stratégique d'un analyste chevronné possédant la vision, le pipeline d'innovation et la prestation de fonctions du concepteur d'études, un produit phare permettant aux équipes d'essais cliniques de concevoir des études plus intelligentes, plus rapides et plus pertinentes. Cette personne apporte une rare combinaison de crédibilité scientifique profonde, de leadership de produit et de compétence technique - capable de gagner la confiance des scientifiques cliniques dans une réunion et conduire un sprint d'ingénierie dans la prochaine. Ils sont inlassablement curieux, motivés par l'innovation et passionnés par l'utilisation de la technologie pour transformer la façon dont les essais cliniques sont conçus et exécutés - en fin de compte, accélérer les traitements aux patients. • Collaboration clinique et scientifique : agir comme premier lien entre les équipes cliniques/scientifiques et l'ingénierie des produits, établir des relations à long terme et faciliter des ateliers de découverte avec des experts médicaux pour bien comprendre la conception des essais et représenter la voix de l'utilisateur clinique.
• Caractéristiques du produit Innovation: Définir et posséder la feuille de route des caractéristiques en conciliant les besoins commerciaux, scientifiques et techniques; encourager l'innovation par des sprints de réflexion de conception pour identifier de nouvelles opportunités, créer des analyses de rentabilisation convaincantes et suivre les caractéristiques de réussite métriques/KPI après la sortie.

• Partenariat technologique et ingénierie : agir en tant que traducteur technique en convertissant des flux de travail cliniques complexes en exigences structurées, en tirant parti d'une solide connaissance de l'architecture, de la modélisation des données et des API pour collaborer avec les ingénieurs sur les risques techniques, les dépendances et les solutions.
• Assurance qualité et soutien de l'UAT: Partenaire avec les architectes, les ingénieurs seniors et l'AQ mène tout au long du cycle de construction de développement pour assurer l'évolutivité et la qualité des fonctionnalités, tout en soutenant la conception et l'exécution de l'UAT pour répondre aux objectifs scientifiques et aux normes d'utilisation.

jobs.title: Medical Enabler, APAC Rare Diseases
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Pharmaceutical

At Roche, we are driven by an urgent commitment to delivering medical solutions today while innovating for tomorrow. Our bold new A2 operating model leverages collective capabilities across the enterprise to create rapid, impactful solutions for patients globally. We believe in personalized, sustainable healthcare and are uniquely positioned to integrate pharmaceuticals, diagnostics, digital health, and big data.

We are seeking a passionate Medical Enabler to join our dynamic APAC Rare Diseases team. This permanent, full-time role is an above-country pooled resource position, requiring an 80-100% FTE above country commitment within our network .

Ideally, we are seeking someone who has extensive experience working healthcare systems across Asia and will be located in Hong Kong or Taiwan, however this role offers a thrilling opportunity to focus on cross-border work packages and enablement, collaborating across various regional and Global networks to drive meaningful change.

What You'll be working on:
As a Medical Enabler, (APAC) Rare Diseases, you will:

• Provide strategic input and operational support for late-stage development/near-launch therapies in Rare Diseases.

• Act as a scientific expert for our medicines and solutions throughout their product life cycles.

• Work in virtual, cross-border, cross-functional teams to realize and scale country, regional and Global outcomes.

• Foster meaningful scientific collaborations and value-based partnerships with Therapeutic Area Experts (TAEs), healthcare professionals, patient organizations across multiple healthcare systems.

• Contribute to understanding data gaps and support data generation plans (e.g., Phase IV studies, registries).

• Build high-value continuing medical education programs for external stakeholders.

• Provide strategic medical review and approval for materials and communications.

• ​Liaise closely with global medical colleagues and teams to ensure coordination and consistency to our data dissemination

Who you are:
You are a passionate Medical Affairs professional ready to make a significant impact on Rare Disease health across Asia. As a subject matter expert with the potential for future leadership roles you have an entrepreneurial spirit, identify opportunities, are comfortable with ambiguity and challenge the status quo.

You have:

• Relevant experience in a Medical Affairs role within Pharmaceutical, Diagnostics, Health Sciences, Biotechnology, or related fields.

• Experience of working in Rare Diseases would be very desirable.

• Strong data comprehension, critical appraisal, synthesis, and delivery skills.

• A "System Thinker" mindset, able to build strong internal/external collaborations to drive change.

• Customer-Centric approach, co-creating solutions to address needs and transform clinical practice.

• A culture of humanity, curiosity, and responsibility, thriving in an empowered, dynamic, and agile working environment.

• Proven track record of building, leading, and contributing to high-performing, diverse, agile / matrix teams.

• MD degree; PhD or Bachelor’s degree in science, biology, immunology, neuroscience, or equivalent preferred. Clinical experience in Rare Diseases is a plus.

This is an incredible development opportunity to apply your scientific expertise, collaborate with colleagues and customers from across the globe, and contribute to innovation that will impact families living with rare diseases across Asia and beyond.

Where

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Roche Pharmaceutical A Roche, siamo guidati da un impegno urgente per fornire soluzioni mediche oggi mentre innovare per domani. Il nostro nuovo modello operativo A2 sfrutta le capacità collettive di tutta l'azienda per creare soluzioni rapide e impattanti per i pazienti a livello globale. Crediamo nella salute personalizzata e sostenibile e siamo in posizione unica per integrare prodotti farmaceutici, diagnostica, salute digitale e grandi dati. Siamo alla ricerca di un appassionato medico Enabler per unirsi al nostro team dinamico APAC Malattie Rare. Questo ruolo permanente e a tempo pieno è una posizione di risorse in pool sopra il paese, che richiede un 80-100% FTE sopra l'impegno del paese all'interno della nostra rete. Idealmente, stiamo cercando qualcuno che ha una vasta esperienza di sistemi sanitari di lavoro in tutta l'Asia e si trova a Hong Kong o Taiwan, tuttavia questo ruolo offre un'emozionante opportunità di concentrarsi su pacchetti di lavoro transfrontalieri e di abilitazione, collaborando attraverso varie reti regionali e globali per guidare cambiamenti significativi. Su cosa lavorerai: Come ambulante medico, (APAC) Malattie Rare, si:
• Fornire input strategici e supporto operativo per lo sviluppo del tardo stadio / terapie a distanza in Malattie Rare.
• Agire come esperto scientifico per le nostre medicine e soluzioni durante i loro cicli di vita del prodotto.
• Lavorare in team virtuali, transfrontalieri, interfunzionali per realizzare e scalare i risultati del paese, regionale e globale.
• Promuovere collaborazioni scientifiche significative e partnership basate sul valore con Therapeutic Area Experts (TAEs), professionisti sanitari, organizzazioni dei pazienti attraverso sistemi sanitari multipli.
• Contribuire alla comprensione delle lacune dei dati e sostenere i piani di generazione dei dati (ad esempio, studi di fase IV, registri).
• Costruire programmi di istruzione medica continua ad alto valore per gli stakeholder esterni.
• Fornire una rassegna medica strategica e l'approvazione per materiali e comunicazioni.
• Liaise a stretto contatto con colleghi e team medici globali per garantire il coordinamento e la coerenza alla diffusione dei dati Chi sei: Sei un appassionato professionista medico pronto a fare un impatto significativo sulla salute delle malattie rare in tutta l'Asia. Come esperto di materia con il potenziale per i ruoli di leadership futuri avete uno spirito imprenditoriale, identificare le opportunità, sono confortevoli con ambiguità e sfidare lo status quo. Hai...
• Esperienza rilevante in un ruolo di Affari medici all'interno di settori farmaceutici, diagnostici, scienze della salute, biotecnologie o correlati.
• L'esperienza di lavorare nelle malattie rare sarebbe molto auspicabile.
• Forte comprensione dei dati, valutazione critica, sintesi e capacità di consegna.
• Una mentalità "System Thinker", in grado di costruire forti collaborazioni interne/esterne per guidare il cambiamento.
• approccio Customer-Centric, soluzioni di co-creazione per soddisfare le esigenze e trasformare la pratica clinica.
• Una cultura dell'umanità, della curiosità e della responsabilità, che prospera in un ambiente di lavoro potenziato, dinamico e agile.
• Provato track record di costruzione, leader, e contribuendo a team di alta qualità, diversi, agili / matrice.
• Laurea in scienze, biologia, immunologia, neuroscienze, o equivalente preferito. L'esperienza clinica nelle malattie rare è un vantaggio. Questa è un'incredibile opportunità di sviluppo per applicare le tue competenze scientifiche, collaborare con colleghi e clienti da tutto il mondo, e contribuire all'innovazione che influenzerà le famiglie che vivono con malattie rare in tutta l'Asia e oltre. Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Roche Pharma Bei Roche sind wir von einer dringenden Verpflichtung, heute medizinische Lösungen zu liefern, während wir für morgen innovieren. Unser mutiges neues A2-Betriebsmodell nutzt die kollektiven Fähigkeiten im gesamten Unternehmen, um schnelle, schlagkräftige Lösungen für Patienten weltweit zu schaffen. Wir glauben an personalisierte, nachhaltige Gesundheitsversorgung und sind einzigartig positioniert, um Pharmazeutika, Diagnostik, digitale Gesundheit und Big Data zu integrieren. Wir suchen einen leidenschaftlichen Medical Enabler, um unserem dynamischen APAC Rare Diseases Team beizutreten. Diese dauerhafte, Vollzeit-Rolle ist eine über-Lande-Pool-Ressource-Position, die eine 80-100% FTE über Land Engagement in unserem Netzwerk erfordert. Idealerweise suchen wir jemanden, der über langjährige Erfahrung in der Arbeitsmedizin in ganz Asien verfügt und sich in Hongkong oder Taiwan befindet, aber diese Rolle bietet eine spannende Gelegenheit, sich auf grenzüberschreitende Arbeitspakete und -ermöglichung zu konzentrieren, die Zusammenarbeit zwischen verschiedenen regionalen und globalen Netzwerken, um einen sinnvollen Wandel zu fördern. An was du arbeitest: Als medizinischer Enabler (APAC) Seltene Krankheiten, werden Sie:
• Strategische Input- und operative Unterstützung für späteste Entwicklungs-/Near-Launch-Therapien in seltenen Krankheiten.
• Handeln Sie als wissenschaftlicher Experte für unsere Medikamente und Lösungen während ihrer gesamten Produktlebenszyklen.
• Arbeiten in virtuellen, grenzüberschreitenden, grenzübergreifenden Teams, um Länder, regionale und globale Ergebnisse zu realisieren und zu skalieren.
• Foster aussagekräftige wissenschaftliche Kooperationen und wertbasierte Partnerschaften mit Therapeutic Area Experts (TAEs), Gesundheitsexperten, Patientenorganisationen in verschiedenen Gesundheitssystemen.
• Um Datenlücken zu verstehen und Datengenerierungspläne zu unterstützen (z.B. Phase IV-Studien, Register).
• Aufbau hochwertiger Weiterbildungsprogramme für externe Akteure.
• Strategische medizinische Überprüfung und Genehmigung für Materialien und Kommunikation.
• Liaise eng mit globalen medizinischen Kollegen und Teams zusammen, um die Koordination und Konsistenz unserer Datenverbreitung zu gewährleisten Wer du bist: Sie sind ein leidenschaftlicher Arzt, der bereit ist, einen erheblichen Einfluss auf die Gesundheit von seltenen Krankheiten in ganz Asien zu machen. Als Thema Experte mit dem Potenzial für zukünftige Führungsrollen haben Sie einen Unternehmergeist, identifizieren Chancen, sind komfortabel mit Mehrdeutigkeit und fordern den Status quo. Sie haben:
• Relevante Erfahrung in einer medizinischen Rolle in der Pharma-, Diagnostik-, Gesundheits-, Biotechnologie- oder verwandten Bereichen.
• Die Erfahrung der Arbeit in seltenen Krankheiten wäre sehr wünschenswert.
• Starkes Datenverständnis, kritische Beurteilungs-, Synthese- und Lieferfähigkeiten.
• Ein "System Thinker" Mindset, in der Lage, starke interne/externe Kollaborationen zu bauen, um Veränderungen voranzutreiben.
• Customer-Centric-Ansatz, Co-Creating-Lösungen, um Bedürfnisse zu lösen und klinische Praxis zu transformieren.
• Eine Kultur der Menschlichkeit, Neugier und Verantwortung, die in einem bestärkten, dynamischen und agilen Arbeitsumfeld blüht.
• Bewährte Erfolgsbilanz von Gebäuden, Führungen und Beiträgen zu hochperformierenden, vielfältigen, agilen / Matrix-Teams.
• MD-Abschluss; PhD oder Bachelor-Abschluss in Wissenschaft, Biologie, Immunologie, Neurowissenschaften oder gleichwertig bevorzugt. Klinische Erfahrung in seltenen Krankheiten ist ein Plus. Dies ist eine unglaubliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeit, um Ihr wissenschaftliches Know-how anzuwenden, mit Kollegen und Kunden aus aller Welt zusammenzuarbeiten und zu Innovationen beizutragen, die Familien mit seltenen Krankheiten in ganz Asien und darüber hinaus beeinflussen. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Roche Pharmaceutique Chez Roche, nous sommes animés par un engagement urgent à fournir des solutions médicales aujourd'hui tout en innovant pour demain. Notre nouveau modèle d'exploitation A2 audacieux met à profit les capacités collectives de l'entreprise pour créer des solutions rapides et efficaces pour les patients à l'échelle mondiale. Nous croyons en des soins de santé personnalisés et durables et sommes particulièrement bien placés pour intégrer les produits pharmaceutiques, les diagnostics, la santé numérique et les mégadonnées. Nous cherchons un activateur médical passionné pour rejoindre notre équipe dynamique APAC maladies rares. Ce rôle permanent à temps plein est un poste de ressource commun au-dessus du pays, exigeant un engagement de 80 à 100% ETP au-dessus du pays au sein de notre réseau. Idéalement, nous recherchons quelqu'un qui possède une vaste expérience des systèmes de soins de santé en Asie et qui sera situé à Hong Kong ou à Taïwan, mais ce rôle offre une occasion passionnante de se concentrer sur les paquets de travail transfrontaliers et de permettre, en collaborant à travers divers réseaux régionaux et mondiaux pour conduire un changement significatif. Vous allez travailler sur : En tant que catalyseur médical des maladies rares (PACA), vous :
• Apporter une contribution stratégique et un soutien opérationnel aux thérapies de développement et de lancement précoce des maladies rares.
• Agir en tant qu'expert scientifique pour nos médicaments et solutions tout au long de leur cycle de vie.
• Travailler dans des équipes virtuelles, transfrontalières et transfonctionnelles afin de réaliser et d'élargir les résultats nationaux, régionaux et mondiaux.
• Favoriser des collaborations scientifiques significatives et des partenariats fondés sur la valeur avec des experts des domaines thérapeutiques, des professionnels de la santé, des organisations de patients dans plusieurs systèmes de santé.
• Contribuer à la compréhension des lacunes dans les données et appuyer les plans de production de données (par exemple, études de phase IV, registres).
• Élaborer des programmes de formation médicale continue de grande valeur à l'intention des intervenants externes.
• Fournir un examen médical stratégique et l'approbation des documents et des communications.
• Assurer une liaison étroite avec les équipes et collègues médicaux mondiaux pour assurer la coordination et la cohérence de notre diffusion des données Qui vous êtes : Vous êtes un professionnel passionné des affaires médicales prêt à avoir un impact significatif sur la santé des maladies rares en Asie. En tant qu'expert en matière de leadership potentiel, vous avez un esprit d'entreprise, identifiez les possibilités, êtes à l'aise avec l'ambiguïté et contestez le statu quo. Vous avez :
• Expérience pertinente dans le domaine des affaires médicales dans le domaine des produits pharmaceutiques, des diagnostics, des sciences de la santé, de la biotechnologie ou dans des domaines connexes.
• L'expérience du travail dans les maladies rares serait très souhaitable.
• Une bonne compréhension des données, une évaluation critique, une synthèse et des compétences d'exécution.
• Un état d'esprit "System Thinker", capable de construire de solides collaborations internes/externes pour stimuler le changement.
• Approche client-centre, co-créant des solutions pour répondre aux besoins et transformer la pratique clinique.
• Une culture de l'humanité, de la curiosité et de la responsabilité, prospère dans un environnement de travail dynamique, dynamique et agile.
• Expérience éprouvée de la construction, de la direction et de la contribution à des équipes de haute performance, diversifiées, agiles et matricielles.
• Diplôme MD; doctorat ou baccalauréat en sciences, biologie, immunologie, neurosciences ou équivalent préféré. L'expérience clinique dans les maladies rares est un plus. C'est une occasion incroyable de développer votre expertise scientifique, de collaborer avec des collègues et des clients du monde entier et de contribuer à l'innovation qui touchera les familles vivant avec des maladies rares en Asie et au-delà. Où

jobs.title: Order Process Associate - French speaking
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Opportunity:

• You create, process, maintain, modify and close Purchase Orders

• You review and approve shopping carts for Policy compliance

• You support purchase invoice reconciliation and liaise with the accounts payable department in connection with invoicing procedures

• You make reports on the given activities

• You assist with processing of returns for the Procurement Department as needed

• You are responsible for Order Acknowledgement handling and contact the suppliers in case of need

Who you are:

• You have college or university degree in finance or a related economics subject

• You have a general understanding of finance processes and standards. Experience in procurement processes and using SAP is an advantage

• You have strong communication and advisory skills and you are able to deal with complex issues

• You have end-to-end accountability, problem-solving skills, growth & agile mindset in ambiguous situations

• You have proficiency in English and French

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• 职位职责：

• （3）拥有良好的沟通能力、学习能力、执行能力、抗压能力以及团队合作精神
• （4）熟练运用Excel、PPT、Word等办公应用软件

jobs.title: Regulatory Operation Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
1. Support the daily work of the registration operations team
- Assist in the preparation (translation/proofreading) and archiving of registration operations materials
- Assist in proofreading drug instructions or related documents
- Assist in completing data entry and verification
2. Assist in managing and optimizing operational systems, information platforms and tools
- Assist in work system optimization projects
- Assist in completing report export and production
- Assist in data analysis work
- Assist in designing and developing new work platforms or tools
3. Assist in completing logistical work for the registration operations department
- Coordinate and arrange meetings, book meeting rooms, mailing and printing, etc.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it: A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione 1. Sostenere il lavoro quotidiano del team di operazioni di registrazione - Assistere nella preparazione (traduzione/protezione) e l'archiviazione dei materiali di registrazione - Assistere in istruzioni per la correzione di farmaci o documenti correlati - Assist nel completamento dell'inserimento e della verifica dei dati 2. Assist nella gestione e ottimizzazione di sistemi operativi, piattaforme e strumenti informativi - Assistere a progetti di ottimizzazione del sistema di lavoro - Assistere nella realizzazione di report export e produzione - Assist nell'analisi dei dati - Assistere nella progettazione e nello sviluppo di nuove piattaforme o strumenti di lavoro 3. Assistere nel completamento del lavoro logistico per il reparto di registrazione - Coordinare e organizzare riunioni, prenotare sale riunioni, mailing e stampa, ecc. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

descriptionByLocale.de: Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position 1. Unterstützung der täglichen Arbeit des Registrierungs-Teams - Assist bei der Vorbereitung (Translation/proofreading) und Archivierung von Registrierungsmaterialien - Assist bei der Korrekturlesen von Drogenanweisungen oder verwandten Dokumenten - Assist bei der Dateneingabe und -überprüfung 2. Assist bei der Verwaltung und Optimierung von Betriebssystemen, Informationsplattformen und Werkzeugen - Assist bei Arbeitssystemoptimierungsprojekten - Assist bei der Erstellung von Berichten Export und Produktion - Unterstützung bei der Datenanalyse - Assist bei der Gestaltung und Entwicklung neuer Arbeitsplattformen oder Werkzeuge 3. Bei der Durchführung der logistischen Arbeit für die Registrierungsabteilung - Koordinaten und arrangieren Treffen, Buch-Meeting-Räume, Mailing und Druck, etc. Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation. Gemeinsam sind mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter auf der ganzen Welt der Wissenschaft gewidmet, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat und für Generationen kommen. Unsere Bemühungen führen zu mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen, die mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden, und über 30 Milliarden Tests, die mit unseren Diagnostics-Produkten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die einen globalen Einfluss haben. Wir bauen gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft. Roche ist Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit.
descriptionByLocale.fr: Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position 1. Appuyer le travail quotidien de l ' équipe chargée des opérations d ' enregistrement - Aider à la préparation (traduction/lecture à l'épreuve) et à l'archivage des documents d'inscription - Aider à corriger les instructions ou les documents connexes - Aider à compléter la saisie et la vérification des données 2. Aider à gérer et optimiser les systèmes opérationnels, les plates-formes d'information et les outils - Aider aux projets d'optimisation des systèmes de travail - Aider à remplir le rapport d ' exportation et de production - Aider à l ' analyse des données - Aider à la conception et au développement de nouvelles plates-formes ou outils de travail 3. Aider à mener à bien le travail logistique du département des opérations d ' enregistrement - Coordonner et organiser des réunions, réserver des salles de réunion, envoyer et imprimer, etc. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

Aider à mener à bien le travail logistique du département des opérations d ' enregistrement - Coordonner et organiser des réunions, réserver des salles de réunion, envoyer et imprimer, etc. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

titleByLocale.fr: Internship AI-ML Engineering / GenAI & LLM Applications (m/f/d)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Your department

Your internship will take place in the Biostatistics & Data Science Core Lab & Near Patient Care department, which is part of our organization R&D Roche Diagnostic.
This development unit focuses on Biostatistics & Data Science. During your internship, you will work in the CC HET Biostatistics & Biophysics group.

Your tasks

• Develop machine learning models for anomaly detection in time-series data to identify infrastructure issues proactively

• Design and develop multi-agent systems for automated infrastructure monitoring and troubleshooting

• Build agentic workflows using frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen

• Build conversational interfaces for AI-powered troubleshooting and root cause analysis

• Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) for automated log analysis and summarization

• Build knowledge retrieval systems using RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) techniques

• Design and develop user interfaces for AI-powered troubleshooting tools

• Experiment with different ML algorithms and GenAI approaches to optimize performance

• Present your results and findings to stakeholders and the broader team

Your profile

• You are currently pursuing a Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field

• You have strong programming skills in Python and experience with modern development practices

• You have hands-on experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) and understand prompt engineering concepts

• You have practical experience building applications with agentic AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar

• You understand agentic design patterns (ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, Reflection, Multi-Agent Collaboration, Tool Use)

• You have experience building multi-agent systems or orchestrating multiple AI agents to solve complex tasks

• You are familiar with RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) techniques and vector databases

• You have experience with API integration and working with external tools and services

• You are familiar with natural language processing techniques and text analysis

• You possess excellent communication skills, with required proficiency in both written and spoken German and English

Our offer

• Hands-On Experience: Gain practical experience in ML/AI and GenAI while working on production systems that have a real impact on clinical trial workflows and ultimately the lives of patients

• Cutting-Edge Technology: Work with state-of-the-art AI technologies including Large Language Models, RAG systems, and production-scale ML infrastructure

• Mentorship: Work closely with experienced professionals from Biostatistics & Data Science receiving guidance and mentorship throughout your internship

• Real-World Impact: See your work deployed in production, serving 120+ users in pharmaceutical research and development

• Career Development: Gain valuable experience in pharmaceutical AI/ML that will enhance your resume and prepare you for future career opportunities. Potential for full-time conversion based on performance

• Inclusive Culture: Join a diverse and inclusive workplace that values different perspectives and ideas

Your benefits

• Flexible working hours (37.5 hours/week)

• Attractive recognition grant (2,268 Euro per month for a full-time internship > 3 months)

• Discounted meal prices (- 50%) in our staff canteen

• Fitness studio on campus

• Online/Offline student networking events

• T

jobs.title: Strategic Programs Manager (Procurement Enhancement Programs)

titleByLocale.it: Gestione dei programmi strategici (Programmi di potenziamento degli appalti)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Strategic Programs Manager (Procurement Enhancement Programs)

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next.

The Opportunity:

This role sits within the Strategic Programs Execution team in the Strategy and Solutions Chapter. Our purpose is to guide strategic priorities, advance value delivery through solutions and digital excellence, govern compliance and drive sustainability to deliver continuous improvement and strengthen Global Procurement’s impact on the wider Roche organization. The Strategic Programs Execution team is dedicated to driving complex procurement-led programs that deliver high impact benefits for Roche and result in a step change in how we work with suppliers, use technology, partner with the business or collaborate with each other in Procurement.

As a Strategic Programs Manager (Procurement Enhancement Programs), you will work in partnership with teams from Global Procurement and other Roche functions to accelerate and enhance the delivery of GP led strategic programs. You will have a strong focus on Procurement Enhancement Programs, with the aim to enhance the overall level of effectiveness, efficiency and customer experience of Global Procurement.

• You utilise your expertise and in-depth knowledge in project management methodologies to lead and facilitate the execution of strategic procurement-led programs, focusing on transformative initiatives such as Operating Model Design and Implementation, Technology Deployment and Adoption, and Procurement Strategy Realization.

• You work closely with procurement, business stakeholders, and other relevant colleagues in a matrix setup either as a peer, coach, project / workstream lead, or subject matter lead, to align on needs, create the business case for change, prioritize, execute, and realize project goals.

• You develop change management strategies and integrate change management activities in project execution to drive transformational changes in the organisation. You manage the people-side of the change to drive behavioral changes and adoption.

• You contribute to the further development of project management and change management capabilities in the team, advocate and accelerate the advancement of best practices methodologies.

• You act as a practitioner and catalyst, applying GP’s core procurement capabilities and approaches in the programs you work on, and contribute to continuous enhancement of procurement excellence.

• You act as a role model, demonstrating curiosity, passion, an entrepreneurial spirit, enterprise thinking, inclusive collaboration, and desire for continuous learning.

Who you are:

• You hold a university degree, preferably in business, engineering or technology.

• You have 5+ years procurement, project management, or management consulting experience, ideally within a matrix o

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Senior Procurement Manager - IT Services

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next.

The Opportunity:

This role sits within the Indirect Procurement Delivery group, which covers the core procurement activities from category management, strategic and operational sourcing, supplier management, contracting, content strategy definition, and execution. The Indirect Procurement Delivery group comprises many communities grouping categories of the same value chain or having commonality, including Research & Development, Commercial and Corporate Services, Digital & Technology, and Facilities. The communities are key enablers of strong category expertise while allowing flexibility in the procurement delivery response to the evolving needs of our customers.

As a Senior Procurement Manager in IT Services, you will bring analytical thinking, planning, execution, and focus to the procurement sourcing and delivery capability area. Using your specialized knowledge and in-depth expertise in a specific category or spend areas and procurement overall, you will proactively identify and drive strategies and approaches for managing and sourcing third party spend requirements. You can also play the role of Category strategy owner in charge of driving, coordinating and signing the category strategy.

You will collaborate with internal procurement (such as Customer Excellence, Insights, Analytics, Contracting, etc.) and business stakeholders to build and implement comprehensive category sourcing and spend management strategies that are aligned to business needs and functional objectives.

You will work closely with other team members, as a peer coach, project, or workstream lead to identify opportunities to aggregate customer demand, drive buying channel automation, deliver on day-to day activities, and provide capacity, expertise, and oversight to productivity and other customer oriented projects/solutions.

As a Senior Procurement Manager in IT Services, you will play a variety of roles according to your experience, knowledge, and general business requirements, including but not limited to:

• You are a Category and sourcing subject matter expert in IT Services conducting market and internal analysis to develop strategies, best practices, and guidance on tactical plans for how Roche should source and negotiate for third party goods and services in order to satisfy stakeholder requirements and maximize the value for Roche.

• You are a Procurement delivery practitioner delivering and executing sourcing strategies and major initiatives by leveraging spend, category know-how, robust sourcing, negotiation, contracting, supplier management methodologies and project management skills, and/or supporting team members by coaching them and enhancing their skills and knowledge.

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Senior Procurement Manager - Servizi IT Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. L'assistenza sanitaria si sta evolvendo e Global Procurement risponde continuando ad impegnarsi per le più alte prestazioni possibili, adottando approcci innovativi e strategici per le partnership tra imprese e fornitori. Global Procurement gestisce proattivamente l'intero ecosistema dei fornitori, fornendo un contributo vitale per migliorare i risultati della salute, riducendo i costi per i pazienti e i sistemi sanitari globali, e assicurando che Roche continui a fare ora ciò che i pazienti hanno bisogno dopo. L'opportunità: Questo ruolo si trova all'interno del gruppo Indirect Procurement Delivery, che copre le attività principali di approvvigionamento da gestione di categoria, approvvigionamento strategico e operativo, gestione dei fornitori, contratto, definizione di strategia di contenuto e l'esecuzione. Il gruppo Indirect Procurement Delivery comprende molte comunità che raggruppano le categorie della stessa catena del valore o che hanno una comunitÃ, tra cui ricerca e sviluppo, servizi commerciali e aziendali, tecnologia digitale e servizi. Le comunità sono i principali abilitatori di una forte competenza di categoria, consentendo la flessibilità nella risposta di consegna degli appalti alle esigenze in evoluzione dei nostri clienti. In qualità di Senior Procurement Manager nei servizi IT, si porterà il pensiero analitico, la pianificazione, l'esecuzione e la messa a fuoco per l'area di approvvigionamento sourcing e capacità di consegna. Utilizzando le vostre conoscenze specialistiche e competenze approfondite in una specifica categoria o aree di spesa e approvvigionamento generale, si proattivamente identificare e guidare le strategie e gli approcci per la gestione e l'assistenza dei requisiti di spesa di terze parti. È inoltre possibile svolgere il ruolo del proprietario di strategia di categoria incaricato di guidare, coordinare e firmare la strategia di categoria. Collaborerai con gli appalti interni (come l'Eccellenza del Cliente, l'Insights, l'Analisi, il Contraente, ecc.) e gli stakeholder aziendali per costruire e implementare strategie di gestione di categoria complete che siano allineate alle esigenze aziendali e agli obiettivi funzionali. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con altri membri del team, come peer coach, project, o workstream portare a identificare le opportunità di aggregare la domanda del cliente, guidare l'automazione dei canali di acquisto, fornire attività quotidiane, e fornire capacità, competenze e supervisione alla produttività e altri progetti / soluzioni orientate al cliente. Come Senior Procurement Manager in Servizi IT, si giocherà una varietà di ruoli secondo la vostra esperienza, conoscenza e requisiti aziendali generali, tra cui ma non limitati a:
• Lei è un esperto di materia tematica di categoria e sourcing in Servizi IT che conduce il mercato e l'analisi interna per sviluppare strategie, best practice e la guida su piani tattici per come Roche dovrebbe fonte e negoziare per beni e servizi di terze parti al fine di soddisfare i requisiti degli stakeholder e massimizzare il valore per Roche.
