Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Gestionnaire principal des achats - Services de TI Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. Les soins de santé évoluent, et Global Approvisionnement répond en s'efforçant constamment d'obtenir les meilleurs résultats possibles, en adoptant des approches novatrices et stratégiques pour les partenariats avec les entreprises et les fournisseurs. Global Approvisionnement gère de manière proactive l'ensemble de l'écosystème fournisseur, contribuant de façon essentielle à améliorer les résultats en matière de santé, réduisant les coûts pour les patients et les systèmes de santé mondiaux, et faisant en sorte que Roche continue de faire maintenant ce dont les patients ont besoin. La possibilité : Ce rôle fait partie du groupe chargé de la prestation des achats indirects, qui couvre les principales activités d'approvisionnement liées à la gestion des catégories, à l'approvisionnement stratégique et opérationnel, à la gestion des fournisseurs, à la passation de marchés, à la définition de la stratégie de contenu et à l'exécution. Le groupe de la prestation d'approvisionnements indirects comprend de nombreuses collectivités regroupant des catégories de la même chaîne de valeur ou ayant des points communs, y compris la recherche et le développement, les services commerciaux et ministériels, le numérique et la technologie et les installations. Les collectivités sont des catalyseurs clés d'une solide expertise de catégorie tout en permettant de répondre avec souplesse aux besoins changeants de nos clients. En tant que gestionnaire principal des approvisionnements dans les services de TI, vous ferez appel à la réflexion analytique, à la planification, à l'exécution et à la concentration dans le domaine des capacités d'approvisionnement et de prestation. À l'aide de vos connaissances spécialisées et de votre expertise approfondie dans une catégorie particulière ou dans des domaines de dépense et d'approvisionnement en général, vous définirez et dirigerez de façon proactive des stratégies et des approches pour gérer et acheminer les dépenses de tiers. Vous pouvez également jouer le rôle de propriétaire de la stratégie de catégorie en charge de la conduite, la coordination et la signature de la stratégie de catégorie. Vous collaborerez avec l'approvisionnement interne (telle que l'excellence client, Insights, Analytics, Contracting, etc.) et les intervenants commerciaux afin d'élaborer et de mettre en oeuvre des stratégies complètes de gestion de l'approvisionnement et des dépenses de catégorie qui correspondent aux besoins opérationnels et aux objectifs fonctionnels. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec d'autres membres de l'équipe, en tant qu'entraîneur par les pairs, qu'un projet ou qu'un volet de travail mène pour cerner les possibilités d'agréger la demande des clients, de stimuler l'automatisation des canaux d'achat, de mener des activités quotidiennes et de fournir une capacité, une expertise et une surveillance à la productivité et à d'autres projets/solutions axés sur les clients. En tant que gestionnaire principal des approvisionnements dans les services de TI, vous jouerez divers rôles en fonction de votre expérience, de vos connaissances et de vos besoins opérationnels généraux, notamment :
• Vous êtes un expert en matière de catégorie et d'approvisionnement dans les services informatiques qui mène des analyses de marché et internes pour élaborer des stratégies, des pratiques exemplaires et des conseils sur les plans tactiques pour la façon dont Roche devrait trouver et négocier des biens et services tiers afin de satisfaire les exigences des parties prenantes et maximiser la valeur pour Roche.
• Vous êtes un praticien de l'approvisionnement qui fournit et exécute des stratégies d'approvisionnement et des initiatives majeures en mettant à profit les dépenses, le savoir-faire de la catégorie, l'approvisionnement robuste, la négociation, la passation de marchés, les méthodes de gestion des fournisseurs et les compétences en gestion de projet, et/ou en appuyant les membres de l'équipe en les coachant et en améliorant leurs compétences et leurs connaissances.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a team member of Roche Services (Europe) Ltd. Site Services Department, the Procurement & Car Fleet Management Intern is responsible for:

• Supporting the work of the Strategic Procurement Partner and the Office Executives in administration regarding Procurement tasks and Car Fleet Management.

Responsibilities
Car fleet:

• Managing administrative duties including: monitoring car fleet contract start/end dates, highway tickets, penalties etc.

• Keeping contact with the Leasing companies and following up the incoming messages.

• Informing the employees about the car policy and assisting them with any car fleet related questions.

• Managing and updating the database containing comprehensive car fleet details.

• Supporting the car handover process and performing regular car condition checks.

• Assisting with the request, distribution, and record-keeping of fuel cards and motorway vignettes.

• Supporting the team with ad-hoc projects and tasks as needed.

• Supporting system related activities in MyBuy, eg.: PO creation, reports.

Procurement:

• Supporting the Strategic Procurement Partner providing administrative assistance during the bidding process and organizing tender documentation.

• Analyzing supplier offers and maintaining data accuracy to support decision-making.

• Creating Purchase Orders (POs) and ensuring all transaction details are correct.

• Following up on orders and deliveries with vendors.

• Partnering with various departments to ensure their procurement needs are met efficiently and Ensuring all activities and documentation align with the official Procurement Policy.

Employees are responsible for performing their duties in line with the SHE (Safety, Security, Health and Environmental Protection) Guidelines and the applicable law. It is required to complete the mandatory training courses and follow procedures and instructions accordingly.

What you can bring to our team

• Fluency in English & Hungarian

• You are currently studying in Hungarian University/College on a day-time schedule

• You are available to work 20-30 hours on a weekly basis

• B category driving license with active driving experience

• Stakeholder management skills, ability to multi-task

• Strong service orientation and communication skills

• Precise, focused, accountable way of working, high level of organizational and problem solving skills

• Proactive mindset

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• Team player attitude, accuracy, ability to meet deadlines and set the right priorities

• Ability to adapt changes quickly

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Graphic Designer Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Graphic Design Intern assists in creating visually compelling designs while gaining hands-on experience in a professional design environment. Working closely with senior designers and team members, they contribute to various creative projects across print, digital, and social media platforms.

In this role, the intern supports the team to design scalable Showpad pages, build automated template workflows, explore new Ai key features, and enforce governance across global Roche design assets. This role ensures 100% compatibility with Figma/Illustrator. They have the opportunity to enhance their creative skills, and learn how to create lovable marketing assets for customers using ABX approach.
This internship is ideal for students or recent graduates looking to build their portfolio, work on real-world projects, and collaborate within a dynamic design team.

Key Roles & Responsibilities

• Vector-First Production: Design, build, and migrate Showpad pages and UI assets strictly within Figma and Illustrator, ensuring all global assets are lightweight, editable, and scalable.

• Template Engineering: Turn standard layouts into robust, modular Figma components and design systems so that "simple design tasks" can be executed instantly or self-sourced by affiliates.

• Asset Optimization: Ensure all imagery and graphics comply with Roche UI guidelines

• Assist in designing marketing materials such as brochures, social media graphics, presentations, banners, and other visual assets.

• Support the team in maintaining brand consistency across all design outputs.

• Work closely with senior designers and other team members to understand project requirements and deliver creative solutions.

• Edit and refine design elements based on feedback and brand guidelines.

• Explore AI page creation and section templates in Showpad to scale approach

• Develop a strong understanding of the organization's brand identity and apply it consistently across all design projects.

• Actively participate in design critiques, team meetings, and professional development opportunities to continuously improve skills and knowledge.

• Adapt to changing priorities and work collaboratively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

Who you are

You are a proactive, innovative problem-solver with a focus on sustainable and scalable solutions. You love to stay abreast of the latest digital updates in order to provide partners with cutting-edge design capabilities, being fully aware of the most current design trends.

Further requirements

• Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related field at a Hungarian University.

• You are available to work 30 hours on a weekly basis

• Proficient in design software such as Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign).

• Strong understanding of typography, color theory, and layout design.

• A keen eye for detail and a passion for creative storytelling through design.

• Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

• Strong communication skills and openness to receiving feedback.

• Basic knowledge of digital design principles for web and social media is a plus.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Unsere Mission

Als Produktionsteam an unserem Standort Penzberg verfolgen wir ein gemeinsames Ziel: Menschen weltweit zuverlässig mit lebenswichtigen Medikamenten zu versorgen – sicher, effizient und mit höchstem Qualitätsanspruch. Wir hinterfragen Bestehendes, treiben neue Ideen voran und entwickeln uns stetig weiter – für unsere Patient:innen weltweit.

Deine Rolle als People Lead

Wir suchen People Leader (m/w/d) mit Macher-Qualitäten, die die Prozesse hinterfragen, Dinge proaktiv anpacken und als Servant Leader Teamgeist, Respekt und Vertrauen in unserer Organisation aktiv fördern. Vor allem kommt es uns darauf an, dass diese Position von jemandem mit einer positiv denkenden, lösungsorientierten, integren und selbstreflektierten Persönlichkeit ausgefüllt wird.

Was Dich erwartet

In dieser Position geht es nicht einfach nur darum, eine Führungskraft zu sein. Es geht vielmehr darum, als positives Beispiel voranzugehen und die neue Führungskultur erlebbar zu machen. Mitarbeitende werden von Dir disziplinarisch geführt und gefördert, um Fachexpertisen aufrechtzuerhalten und vor allem um der Organisation dabei zu helfen, heute zu leisten, was unsere Patienten morgen brauchen!

• Die konzeptionelle Ausrichtung sowie kontinuierliche Optimierung der Leistung des Teams, die Begleitung des Teams bei Veränderungen legen wir vertrauensvoll in Deine Hände.

• Du wendest LPS-Methoden (z.B. Gemba-Walks o.ä.) an, überträgst Verantwortungen im Sinne eines proaktiven “empowern” und richtest die Teamziele strategisch aus, um somit das Servant-Leadership-Konzept erlebbar zu machen.

• Coaching, Check-Ins, Weiterentwicklung, Fördern und Fordern sowie Motivieren sind Bestandteil Deiner täglichen Arbeit.

• Du sorgst für ein sicheres Arbeitsumfeld und gehst im Bereich SHE als gutes Beispiel voran.

• Als Change Agent gestaltest Du aktiv unsere Zukunft mit und begleitest Mitarbeitende bei Veränderungen.

• Die Motivation des Teams und eines jeden Mitarbeitenden ist uns ein besonderes Anliegen, daher ist es ebenso wichtig, dass das Team-Zusammenspiel von Dir empathisch begleitet und permanent entwickelt wird. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Tech Supervisors wird auch die Fachexpertise des Teams ausgerichtet und weiterentwickelt.

• Du bist verantwortlich für die Ressourcen- und die Kapazitätsplanung Deines Bereichs.

Wer Du bist

Du hast starkes Interesse diese Position kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln, Ideen einzubringen, neue Wege miteinander zu gehen und diese gemeinsam zu diskutieren und umzusetzen. Für die Stelle bringst Du außerdem ein abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium, einen Meistertitel oder eine abgeschlossene Technikerausbildung mit und hast erste Berufserfahrung in einer Führungsrolle mit Personalverantwortung, vorteilhaft in einem pharmazeutischen Umfeld sammeln können.

• Du hast ein intrinsisches Interesse daran Prozesse zu verstehen, setzt diese in einen Kontext und richtest Dein Handeln an dem Verständnis aus - Erfahrungen in der Durchführung von pharmazeutischen Produktionsprozessen und den begleitenden Qualitätsprozessen sind dabei von Vorteil.

• Deine Stärken liegen in der Beziehungsgestaltung (Mensch) und einer guten Komplexitätsverarbeitung (Überblick / Verstehen).

• Du verstehst Dich selbst als "Inspirierenden Leader", bist fähig situativ zu führen, nimmst Menschen mit, begeisterst und es gelingt Dir, sicherzustellen, dass alle die gleiche Strategie und Ziele verfolgen und als Team zusammenarbeiten.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Internship in protein chemistry: Novel antibody-based formats for in-vitro diagnostics (m/f/d)

Suchst Du ein Praktikum, in dem Du dich sowohl beruflich als auch persönlich weiterentwickeln kannst?

Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig.

Wir suchen jemanden, der uns bei unseren vielfältigen Aufgaben unterstützt. Dies gibt Ihnen die Möglichkeit, die verschiedenen Einheiten innerhalb unserer Abteilung kennenzulernen und einen Überblick über die unterschiedlichen Aktivitäten zu gewinnen.

Die Abteilung

Sie werden in der Abteilung „Proteinchemie“ arbeiten, die zur Einheit „Reagent Research and Design“ von Roche Centralized and Point of Care Solutions gehört und sich auf die Entwicklung von protein basierten Reagenzien für immunologische Diagnostik Tests konzentriert.
Hier entwickeln, realisieren und bewerten wir innovative Lösungen für Diagnostik Systemkonzepte basierend auf dem Roche Cobas e-Analyzer zur zielgerichteten und hochsensitiven Quantifizierung von menschlichen Körperflüssigkeiten.

Ihre Aufgaben

• Sie werden aktiv an Forschungsprojekten teilnehmen, um die Entwicklung von Antikörper basierten Reagenzien für aktuelle und zukünftige Technologien zu optimieren.

• Sie werden verschiedene Techniken zur Antikörperreinigung durchführen.

• Sie werden Antikörper mit sowohl ortsspezifischen als auch unspezifischen Markierungsstrategien konjugieren und anschließend reinigen.

• Sie werden die Leistungsfähigkeit dieser Reagenzien auf Cobas e-Analyzer evaluieren.

• Sie werden wissenschaftliche Literatur überprüfen und bewerten und Ihre Ergebnisse präsentieren.

• Sie arbeiten eng mit mehreren Teams zusammen, die über verschiedene Abteilungen verteilt sind (Chemie, Proteinchemie, Antikörperentwicklung und Enzymtechnologie).

Ihr Profil

Sie sind eingeschriebener Student (m/w/d) in Chemie, Biochemie, Chemischer Biologie oder einem
verwandten Bereich oder in einem vergleichbaren Masterstudiengang oder befinden sich in einem Gap
Year (zwischen Bachelor- und Masterstudium).

Ihre Stärken

• Sie haben Kenntnisse in organischer Chemie und Proteinbiochemie, erste Erfahrungen sind

• von Vorteil.

• Sie haben Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen in instrumenteller Analytik (z.B. UV-Vis, HPLC).

• Grundkenntnisse in Immunologie sind von Vorteil.

• Sie haben Freude daran, auf Menschen zuzugehen und gemeinsam im Team Konzepte zu entwickeln.

• Sie sind kreativ und setzen Ihre Ideen gerne in die Praxis um.

• Sie können sich selbstständig organisieren und Ihren Arbeitsalltag strukturieren.

• Sie besitzen gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Deine Vorteile

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung (37.5 Std./Woche)

• 2268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum

• Vergünstigte Essenspreise (-50 %) in unserer Mitarbeiterkantine

• Fitnesszentrum auf dem Roche-Campus

• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden

• Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und spannende Gastvorträge

• Möglichkeit der Unterbringung im Roche Boardinghaus

Ihre Bewerbung

Bitte laden Sie nur Ihren Lebenslauf online hoch.

Bitte beachten Sie, dass sich dieses Praktikum an Studierende (m/w/d) richtet, die derzeit
eingeschrieben sind oder sich in einem Gap Year befinden (zwischen Bachelor- und Masterstudium).

Zeitraum: Ab Oktober 2026 oder früher für einen Zeitraum von 6 Monaten.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

Bitte beachten, dass Empfehlungen für alle studentischen Tätigkeiten (z.B. Praktika, Abschlussarbeiten, etc.) ausgeschlossen sind.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Network Security product makes Roche’s connectivity accessible and secure through actionable, policy-driven processes. The capabilities we provide enable Roche to identify, inspect, and mitigate network-based risks, manage regulatory compliance, and oversee egress/ingress traffic across all layers. Our solutions are primarily instantiated through leading-edge security platforms and automated orchestration. We work closely with Cloud, Infrastructure, and Incident Response teams to provide enterprise visibility into Roche’s network security posture.
You’ll be working within the Network Security Product area. This area is accountable for the end-to-end delivery of solutions—designing, building, and maintaining the technologies that protect Roche networks and the Internet, whether on-prem or cloud-based. This includes continuous improvement of capabilities like Internet Security Stack, DDoS Protection , Site-to-Site Connectivity (VPN) , Network Access Control and Deep Packet Inspection to stay ahead of an ever-evolving threat landscape.

As a Cybersecurity Engineer within the AI Innovation workstream, you will be a key technical contributor responsible for the hands-on execution of our AI/ML security strategy. Working as part of a specialized team, you will assist in developing and implementing AI capabilities to optimize service delivery across the Design, Build, and Operations phases of our network security solutions. Your role is to help bridge the gap between network security engineering and data science, contributing to the development of intelligent automation that reduces manual intervention and shifts our infrastructure toward a proactive, self-healing model. You will apply your technical expertise to ensure these technologies integrate seamlessly with our core stack, including Cisco ISE, 802.1x, and Palo Alto Networks.

Job Responsibilities

1. AI Strategy & Roadmap Execution

• Strategy Definition: Partner with product owners to define the vision for AI adoption within Network Security (e.g., predictive threat detection, automated policy optimization).

• Hands-on Implementation: Lead the technical execution of AI workstreams, moving from Proof of Concept (POC) to production-ready security enhancements.

• SME for AI Security: Act as the Subject Matter Expert for how AI can be leveraged to improve the efficacy and performance of Cisco ISE, Palo Alto, and 802.1x infrastructures. ​

2. AI-Driven Observability & Inventory

• Intelligent Monitoring: Develop AI/ML models to identify anomalies in network traffic and security appliance telemetry that traditional threshold-based monitoring misses.

• Automated Classification: Enhance asset inventory and device profiling (NAC) by applying machine learning to identify complex IoT and medical device patterns.

• Framework Integration: Integrate AI insights into the existing observability front-end and backend frameworks to provide actionable intelligence to operations teams.

​
3. Proactive Defense & Automation

• Predictive Analytics: Implement tools to predict potential security bottlenecks or infrastructure failures before they impact the global network.

• Policy Optimization: Use AI to analyze firewall and NAC policy usage, recommending automated cleanup or hardening of security rules.

• Continuous Improvement: Lead the "Design, Build, and Improve" cycle for AI-driven security controls, ensuring they evolve alongside the threat landscape.

​

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Educational Bac

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Das Schullabor EXPERIO Roche begeistert ganze Schulklassen mit diversen Workshops im MINT-Bereich, begrüsst jedes Jahr rund 2’500 Besucher:innen und gehört zum Team Marketing und Programms der Roche Berufsbildung.
Als Teil des Schullaborteams wirst du an verschiedenen Aktivitäten und Projekten beteiligt sein, um den Schüler:innen sowie den Lehrpersonen vielfältige Angebote zu ermöglichen.

Die Möglichkeit

• Kreative Workshops gestalten: Du wirst aktiv an der Vor- und Nachbereitung von vielfältigen Workshops im MINT-Bereich (Mathematik, Informatik, Naturwissenschaften und Technik) mitwirken und deine eigenen Ideen einbringen.

• Eigene Projekte leiten: Du bekommst die Möglichkeit, Teilbereiche oder sogar ganze Workshops selbstständig zu konzipieren und durchzuführen und dabei deine Fähigkeiten unter Beweis zu stellen.

• Innovation vorantreiben: Werde Teil des Schullaborteams und unterstütze uns bei der Entwicklung neuer, innovativer Angebote, um noch mehr junge Menschen für MINT-Themen zu begeistern.

• Für eine reibungslose Umgebung sorgen: Du hilfst dabei, die Infrastruktur und das Inventar im Labor und der Werkstatt in Schuss zu halten, damit alle optimal arbeiten können.

• Besucher willkommen heissen: Unterstütze bei der Betreuung verschiedener Besuchergruppen und präsentiere die spannende Welt von EXPERIO Roche.

• Netzwerken und lernen: Arbeite in abteilungs- und berufsgruppenübergreifenden Projekten der Berufsbildung mit und erweitere dein Netzwerk.

• Roche repräsentieren: Vertrete die Berufsbildungsabteilung auf verschiedenen Berufsmessen und inspiriere junge Talente für eine Karriere bei Roche.

Wer du bist

Deine Leidenschaft für MINT trifft auf unsere Begeisterung für Bildung. W enn du dich in folgender Beschreibung wiederfindest, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig:

• Studierende mit Begeisterung: Du bist derzeit an einer Fachhochschule oder Universität in einem Bachelor-Studiengang eingeschrieben oder nutzt ein Zwischenjahr, um dich beruflich zu orientieren und wertvolle Erfahrungen zu sammeln.

• MINT-Enthusiastin oder angehende Pädagogin : Du studierst in einem MINT-Bereich oder Pädagogik/Lehramt und möchtest dein Wissen an junge Talente weitergeben.

• Kreativer Kopf : Du möchtest deine eigenen Ideen einbringen und dich aktiv weiterentwickeln.

jobs.title: Reagent Manufacturing Scientist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Diagnostics Cape Town is seeking a Reagent Manufacturing Scientist to join their team on a 1 year fixed-term contract .

As a Reagent Manufacturing Scientist you will conduct and monitor production activities or laboratory experiments utilizing established and published procedures or batch records and technical and theoretical understanding, whilst maintaining quality and managing schedules and workflow to accomplish assigned objectives.
You will play a vital role in ensuring the high-quality production of life-saving molecular solutions. You will join a collaborative team where technical precision meets a passion for patient impact.

Key Challenges

• Conduct and monitor production activities or laboratory experiments utilizing established and published procedures or batch records and technical and theoretical understanding while managing schedules and workflow to accomplish assigned objectives or schedules.

• Assumes responsibility for the accuracy, quality, and timeliness of production work or testing activities. Summarizes batch or experimental results, and uses technical writing skills to produce clear reports, documents, and summaries.Effectively communicate results/ experimental outcomes and project status to supervisor and/or project leaders, proactively highlighting significant findings or critical problem areas.

• Analyzes and interprets test results, experimental data using various data analysis software, spreadsheets and or applying quantitative methods. Present findings at internal team meetings as required.

• Assumes accountability for batch record, hard copy or electronic lab notebook documentation, ensuring experimental methods and results are recorded timely, accurately and consistently, and according to established formats.

• May troubleshoot issues related to equipment or instrumentation. With guidance, analyzes and brainstorms alternative approaches to solve problems, makes recommendations and implements solutions to solve problems.

• Establish and maintain positive internal, cross-functional, and (where applicable) customer relationships.

• Other duties as assigned by management.

Who You Are as an Ideal Candidate
Qualifications and Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Molecular Biology, Chemical/Biochemical Engineering, or a related scientific discipline or equivalent combination of education and work experience.

• 3 years of relevant industry experience or general laboratory experience

In the absence of relevant qualifications, experience in the relevant field and at the relevant level will be considered.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

• Ability to execute relevant laboratory experimentation. Hands-on experience with standard molecular biology and biochemistry lab techniques.

• Demonstrated ability to follow Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), Manufacturing Instructions (MI) and Work Instructions (WI) documents. Working knowledge of relevant international ISO Standards (13485) would be advantageous.

• Demonstrated competency in reading and completing charts, forms, and other documents.

• Ability to use a personal computer with basic word-processing and spreadsheet applications.

• Excellent written and verbal communication and personal task management skills

• Accountability, the ability to multitask, perform consistently under pressure and work without supervision.

• Experience and understanding of protein purification techniques and enzyme analysis. Experience with AKTAs (FPLC) or HPLC w

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Pharma Technical Operations (PT) involves a range of activities, from Supply Chain to Regulatory Affairs to Finance to People & Culture. Click here to find out the range of departments involved, as well as previous projects worked on. This internship will be in the space of the PTS Pharma Supply Chain and Product Strategy.

Included in the internship will be training on the basic concepts of the work done in the respective departments. The interns will also be able to take advantage of Roche resources on subjects such as interviewing, making presentations, time management, and more. For this internship, we are looking into a more specific and focused scope of supply chain management.
The Pharma Technical Operations Supply Chain (PTS) is a complex, global network that requires seamless coordination and a highly motivated workforce to deliver medicines to patients worldwide. The PTS Chief of Staff office plays a crucial role in ensuring smooth business operations, driving strategic leadership initiatives, and fostering a highly engaged and informed workforce across this global network. Effective communication and strong employee engagement are critical to aligning our global teams with Roche’s strategic vision and ensuring everyone understands how their work contributes to the bigger picture.

The Opportunity
You will directly support the Chief of Staff of PTS, helping to execute internal communication strategies, manage global employee engagement initiatives, and optimize day-to-day business operations for the leadership team.

• Internal Communications: Assist in drafting, editing, and publishing newsletters, intranet articles, leadership messages, and organizational announcements to keep the PTS global community informed and aligned.

• Engagement & Event Management: Support the planning, coordination, and execution of internal events such as global town halls, leadership offsites, team-building activities, and employee recognition programs.

• Business Operations Support: Assist the Chief of Staff with preparing executive presentations, managing meeting agendas, and tracking the progress of key strategic deliverables for the PTS leadership team.

• Content Creation & Design: Develop engaging multimedia content (presentations, graphics, short videos) to help translate complex supply chain and strategic topics into accessible, inspiring messaging for the broader organization.

Who You Are
You are currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, ideally in Communications, Business Administration, Marketing, Human Resources, Public Relations, or Organizational Psychology. Furthermore, you are:

• Proficient in Microsoft/Google applications, especially PowerPoint/Slides. Experience with intranet platforms (e.g., Google Sites, SharePoint) or basic graphic design/multimedia tools (e.g., Canva) is a strong plus.

• Keenly interested in corporate communications, organizational behavior, business strategy, and how leadership teams operate.

• A highly organized, creative team player with exceptional written and verbal communication skills. You should bring a proactive attitude, strong attention to detail, and the confidence to interact with stakeholders at various levels of leadership.

• Proficient in English.

Additional information

• Start Date: August 2026

• Workload: 100%

• Duration: Minimum 3 months, up to 6 months

• Location: on-site or hybrid

• It is not possible to write a thesis during the internship.

• Supporto per le operazioni aziendali: assistere il capo di stato maggiore con la preparazione di presentazioni esecutive, gestire gli ordini del giorno delle riunioni e monitorare il progresso dei principali responsabili strategici per il team di leadership PTS.
• Creazione e progettazione dei contenuti: Sviluppare contenuti multimediali coinvolgenti (presentazioni, grafica, video brevi) per aiutare a tradurre la catena di fornitura complessa e argomenti strategici in messaggi accessibili e ispiranti per l'organizzazione più ampia. Chi sei Attualmente si sta perseguendo un Bachelor o Master, idealmente in Comunicazioni, Business Administration, Marketing, Risorse umane, Relazioni pubbliche, o Psicologia organizzativa. Inoltre, siete:
• Proficiente nelle applicazioni Microsoft/Google, in particolare PowerPoint/Slides. L'esperienza con piattaforme intranet (ad esempio, Google Sites, SharePoint) o strumenti grafici/multimediali di base (ad esempio, Canva) è un vantaggio forte.

• Un giocatore di squadra altamente organizzato e creativo con eccezionali capacità di comunicazione scritte e verbali. Si dovrebbe portare un atteggiamento proattivo, una forte attenzione ai dettagli, e la fiducia di interagire con gli stakeholder a vari livelli di leadership.

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position L'opération technique Pharma (PT) comprend une gamme d'activités, de la chaîne d'approvisionnement aux affaires réglementaires aux finances aux gens et à la culture. Cliquez ici pour connaître la gamme des ministères concernés, ainsi que les projets antérieurs. Ce stage se déroulera dans l'espace de la PTS Pharma Supply Chain and Product Strategy. Le stage comprendra une formation sur les concepts de base du travail effectué dans les différents départements. Les stagiaires pourront également profiter des ressources de Roche sur des sujets comme l'entrevue, la présentation, la gestion du temps, etc. Pour ce stage, nous examinons un champ plus spécifique et ciblé de la gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement. La chaîne d'approvisionnement Pharma Technical Operations (PTS) est un réseau mondial complexe qui nécessite une coordination transparente et une main-d'œuvre hautement motivée pour fournir des médicaments aux patients du monde entier. Le bureau du chef d'état-major du STP joue un rôle crucial dans la bonne marche des opérations, dans la conduite des initiatives de leadership stratégique et dans la promotion d'une main-d'oeuvre hautement engagée et informée dans ce réseau mondial. Une communication efficace et un engagement fort des employés sont essentiels pour aligner nos équipes mondiales sur la vision stratégique de Roche et faire en sorte que tout le monde comprenne comment leur travail contribue à l'image globale. L'opportunité Vous soutiendrez directement le chef de cabinet de PTS, aidant à exécuter des stratégies de communication interne, à gérer des initiatives globales d'engagement des employés et à optimiser les activités quotidiennes de l'équipe de direction.
• Communications internes : aider à rédiger, éditer et publier des bulletins d'information, des articles intranet, des messages de leadership et des annonces organisationnelles afin de tenir la communauté mondiale du PTS informée et alignée.
• Engagement et gestion des événements : Appuyer la planification, la coordination et l'exécution d'événements internes tels que les mairies mondiales, le leadership hors site, les activités de renforcement d'équipe et les programmes de reconnaissance des employés.
• Soutien opérationnel : aider le chef de cabinet à préparer des exposés, à gérer les ordres du jour des réunions et à suivre l'avancement des principaux résultats stratégiques pour l'équipe de direction du STP.
• Création et conception de contenu: Développer des contenus multimédias (présentations, graphiques, vidéos courtes) pour aider à traduire la chaîne d'approvisionnement complexe et les sujets stratégiques en messages accessibles et inspirants pour l'organisation en général. Qui vous êtes Vous suivez actuellement un baccalauréat ou une maîtrise, idéalement en communications, administration des affaires, marketing, ressources humaines, relations publiques ou psychologie organisationnelle. De plus, vous êtes :
• Compétence dans les applications Microsoft/Google, en particulier PowerPoint/Slides. L'expérience avec les plateformes intranet (par exemple, Google Sites, SharePoint) ou les outils graphiques de base/multimedia (par exemple, Canva) est un plus fort.
• Intéressant aux communications d'entreprise, au comportement organisationnel, à la stratégie d'affaires et au fonctionnement des équipes de leadership.
• Un joueur d'équipe hautement organisé et créatif avec des compétences exceptionnelles en communication écrite et verbale. Vous devriez apporter une attitude proactive, une grande attention aux détails, et la confiance d'interagir avec les intervenants à différents niveaux de leadership.

The PHM focus area within the Pharma Technical Operations (PT) focuses on driving the E2E capabilities required to have robust, timely and compliant mitigation of risks across the product’s lifecycle. This role is dedicated to ensure that products and supply chains are designed to deliver a competitive advantage and proactively manage product health from initial launch through late life cycle. You will help build the guidance that enables product teams to measure health, set targets and document it in the existing tools so that we can generate strategic portfolio insights.

The Opportunity

• Framework Evolution : adapt the comprehensive guidance to measure Product Health (PH), including re-definition of metrics and setting the corresponding targets to track how well products meet market needs.

• Digital Implementation : support the gathering of PH metrics and actions in Monday.com as the central monitoring platform and support creating dashboards that visualize PH and their link to brand forecasts.

• Training : design and execute a training plan for the product teams to be able to run their second iteration of PH assessment following the adapted guidance and documentation in Monday.com.

• Execution : conduct the next PH assessment and consolidate the results for the next Portfolio Health Review.

• Strategic Visibility : gain deep exposure to product strategy, portfolio management, and cross-pharma "winning solution" generation.

• Technical Skill Building : develop high-demand skills in digital tool implementation (Monday.com) and the definition of a guide that assesses product management performance.

• Lasting Impact : Establish the oversight mechanism that enables data-driven decision-making for the organization's entire product portfolio.

Who you are
You are currently studying for a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with an interest in healthcare technical operations. Furthermore, you have

• A strong technical interest in business processes, digital dashboards, and product strategy.

• Proficiency in English.

• A creative mindset, and approach challenges with a constructive attitude. In addition, you are a proactive learner and problem-solver.

Click here to find out the range of departments involved, as well as previous projects worked on. This internship will be in the space of the PTS Pharma Supply Chain and Product Strategy. Included in the internship will be training on the basic concepts of the work done in the respective departments. The interns will also be able to take advantage of Roche resources on subjects such as interviewing, making presentations, time management, and more. For this internship, we are looking into a more specific and focused scope of supply chain management. The PHM focus area within the Pharma Technical Operations (PT) focuses on driving the E2E capabilities required to have robust, timely and compliant mitigation of risks across the product’s lifecycle. This role is dedicated to ensure that products and supply chains are designed to deliver a competitive advantage and proactively manage product health from initial launch through late life cycle. You will help build the guidance that enables product teams to measure health, set targets and document it in the existing tools so that we can generate strategic portfolio insights. The Opportunity
• Framework Evolution : adapt the comprehensive guidance to measure Product Health (PH), including re-definition of metrics and setting the corresponding targets to track how well products meet market needs.
• Digital Implementation : support the gathering of PH metrics and actions in Monday.com as the central monitoring platform and support creating dashboards that visualize PH and their link to brand forecasts.
• Training : design and execute a training plan for the product teams to be able to run their second iteration of PH assessment following the adapted guidance and documentation in Monday.com.
• Execution : conduct the next PH assessment and consolidate the results for the next Portfolio Health Review.
• Strategic Visibility : gain deep exposure to product strategy, portfolio management, and cross-pharma "winning solution" generation.
• Technical Skill Building : develop high-demand skills in digital tool implementation (Monday.com) and the definition of a guide that assesses product management performance.
• Lasting Impact : Establish the oversight mechanism that enables data-driven decision-making for the organization's entire product portfolio. Who you are You are currently studying for a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with an interest in healthcare technical operations. Furthermore, you have
• A strong technical interest in business processes, digital dashboards, and product strategy.
• Proficiency in Microsoft/Google applications. Experience with data visualization and storytelling is a plus.
• Proficiency in English.
• A creative mindset, and approach challenges with a constructive attitude. In addition, you are a proactive learner and problem-solver. Additional information
• Start Date: August 2026
• Workload: 100%
• Duration: Minimum 3 months, up to 6 months
• Location: on-site
• It is not possible to write a thesis during the internship. Application process

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity:

Building on over 30 years of industry experience, Roche Custom Biotech uses the powerful multidisciplinary skills found in Roche facilities across the world. The team offers products and solutions for manufacturers in the diagnostics and pharma biotech industry, ranging from raw materials to system solutions for bioprocessing. Leveraging the unique know-how of Roche Diagnostics and Roche Pharmaceuticals, our Strategic Alliance Managers work to partner with leaders in the biopharmaceutical, cell therapy, or in vitro diagnostics markets to enable strategic sourcing deals.

The Strategic Alliance Manager is responsible for building, managing, and optimizing relationships with key strategic partners, ensuring that partnerships align with the company's overall business objectives. This role involves collaboration with internal and external stakeholders to drive joint initiatives, maximize value from partnerships, and promote the company's strategic growth in the biopharmaceutical and molecular diagnostic markets.

• Identify, evaluate, and establish strategic alliances with pharmaceutical companies, biotechnology firms, research organizations, and other relevant partners on new and existing opportunities.

• Foster strong relationships with existing partners, working closely with your leader, Key Account Executives, ensuring consistent communication, trust, and alignment of goals.

Strategic Planning & Execution

• Collaborate with internal teams (e.g., sales leadership, business development, regulatory, R&D, marketing) to define partnership objectives and success metrics.

• Develop business plans and strategies to maximize the value of partnerships in line with company goals.

• Monitor and evaluate alliance results, making data-driven recommendations to improve performance and address challenges.

Cross-functional Collaboration

• Act as the liaison between the organization and partner companies, ensuring seamless communication and coordination.

• Collaborate with the sales team through networking, lead identification, etc.

• Coordinate internal teams to deliver on partnership commitments and milestones, such as co-development projects, joint licensing opportunities, or market entry strategies.

• Support regulatory, operational, and logistical efforts linked to partnership agreements.

Market Analysis & Opportunity Identification

• Conduct competitive intelligence and industry benchmarking to identify partnership opportunities in new and emerging pharmaceutical markets.

• Stay updated on trends, technological advancements, and regulatory changes in the industry to identify potential new partnerships or expansion opportunities.

Issue Resolution & Risk Management

• Address conflicts or challenges in partnerships with a solutions-oriented approach, ensuring smooth progress toward mutual objectives.

• Monitor and mitigate risks associated with alliances, including market, legal, and financial risks.

Reporting & Performance Monitoring

• Prepare and present quarterly reviews and updates to senior management or key stakeholders, highlighting partnership performance and future recommendations.

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. L'opportunità: Basato su oltre 30 anni di esperienza nel settore, Roche Custom Biotech utilizza le potenti competenze multidisciplinari che si trovano nelle strutture Roche di tutto il mondo. Il team offre prodotti e soluzioni per i produttori nel settore della diagnostica e della biotecnologia, che vanno dalle materie prime alle soluzioni di sistema per il bioprocessing. Sfruttando il know-how unico di Roche Diagnostics e Roche Pharmaceuticals, i nostri Strategic Alliance Managers lavorano per collaborare con i leader nei mercati di diagnostica biofarmaceutica, cellulare o in vitro per consentire offerte di approvvigionamento strategico. Lo Strategic Alliance Manager è responsabile per la costruzione, la gestione e l'ottimizzazione dei rapporti con i principali partner strategici, assicurando che le partnership si allineano con gli obiettivi aziendali globali dell'azienda. Questo ruolo coinvolge la collaborazione con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni per guidare iniziative congiunte, massimizzare il valore dei partenariati e promuovere la crescita strategica dell'azienda nei mercati diagnostici biofarmaceutici e molecolari.
• Identificare, valutare e stabilire alleanze strategiche con le aziende farmaceutiche, le imprese di biotecnologia, le organizzazioni di ricerca e altri partner rilevanti sulle opportunità nuove e esistenti.
• Promuovere relazioni forti con i partner esistenti, lavorando a stretto contatto con il vostro leader, Key Account Executives, garantendo una comunicazione coerente, fiducia e allineamento degli obiettivi. Pianificazione e esecuzione strategica
• Collaborare con team interni (ad esempio, leadership di vendita, sviluppo aziendale, regolamentazione, R&D, marketing) per definire obiettivi di partnership e metriche di successo.
• Sviluppare piani di business e strategie per massimizzare il valore delle partnership in linea con gli obiettivi aziendali.
• Monitorare e valutare i risultati dell'alleanza, formulando raccomandazioni basate sui dati per migliorare le prestazioni e affrontare le sfide. Collaborazione interfunzionale
• Agire come collegamento tra l'organizzazione e le aziende partner, garantendo una comunicazione e un coordinamento senza soluzione di continuità.
• Collaborare con il team di vendita attraverso la rete, l'identificazione del piombo, ecc.
• Coordinare i team interni a fornire impegni di partenariato e pietre miliari, quali progetti di cooperazione, opportunità di licenze congiunte o strategie di immissione sul mercato.
• Sostenere gli sforzi normativi, operativi e logistici legati agli accordi di partenariato. Analisi del mercato & Identificazione delle opportunità
• Condurre l'intelligenza competitiva e il benchmarking del settore per identificare le opportunità di partenariato nei nuovi e emergenti mercati farmaceutici.
• Resta aggiornato sulle tendenze, i progressi tecnologici e i cambiamenti normativi del settore per identificare potenziali nuove partnership o opportunità di espansione. Risoluzione dei problemi e gestione dei rischi
• Affrontare conflitti o sfide in partnership con un approccio orientato alle soluzioni, garantendo un buon progresso verso obiettivi reciproci.
• Monitorare e mitigare i rischi associati alle alleanze, inclusi i rischi di mercato, legale e finanziario. Reporting & Performance Monitoring
• Preparare e presentare recensioni trimestrali e aggiornamenti alla gestione senior o agli stakeholder chiave, evidenziando le prestazioni del partenariato e le raccomandazioni future. Questa è una posizione basata sul campo. Il territorio è all'interno

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Pharma Technical Operations (PT) involves a range of activities, from Supply Chain to Regulatory Affairs to Finance to People & Culture. Click here to find out the range of departments involved, as well as previous projects worked on. This internship will be in the space of the PTS Pharma Supply Chain and Product Strategy.

Included in the internship will be training on the basic concepts of the work done in the respective departments. The interns will also be able to take advantage of Roche resources on subjects such as interviewing, making presentations, time management, and more. For this internship, we are looking into a more specific and focused scope of supply chain management.

We are seeking a motivated intern to join the Pharma International Supply Chain (PTSR) organization. This role focuses on supporting the Affiliate Demand Review Process as a critical component of our Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) initiative.

The opportunity
You will help bridge the gap between local market needs and global supply chain orchestration, ensuring that the "voice of the affiliate" is heard and acted upon. Furthermore, you will

• Support the creation and maintenance of standardized process maps and training materials for the Affiliate Demand Review.

• Develop automated methods (potentially exploring AI applications) to consolidate demand insights, Risks, and Opportunities (R&Os) from various global affiliates.

• Ensure consolidated insights are effectively shared back with affiliates to close the communication loop.

• Help identify and prepare critical R&Os for escalation to the Global Demand Review Meeting (gDRM).

Who you are
You are currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree. In addition, you have

• Technical Savvy: Strong proficiency in Microsoft/Google applications (Excel/Sheets and PowerPoint). Experience with ERP systems or an interest in AI/Automation is a plus.

• Business Acumen: A high interest in demand planning, finance and healthcare strategy.

• Proactive mindset: We are looking for team players who think outside the box, share their ideas, and are eager to find new solutions to complex challenges.

Additional information

• Start Date: August 2026

• Workload: 100%

• Duration: Minimum 3 months, up to 6 months

• Location: on-site

• It is not possible to write a thesis during the internship.

Application process

• Please submit your application, including a CV and a motivation letter.

• A certificate of enrollment (if you are currently studying) OR recent graduates are also eligible to start an internship with us within 12 months of their graduation date.

• For non-EU/EFTA citizens: Certificate from the university stating that an internship is mandatory (required due to regulations).

Ready to take the next step? We'd love to hear from you. Apply now to explore this exciting opportunity!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Counterfeit medicines and diagnostic products pose a significant risk to the safety of patients. Counterfeit products can be found in any country and often look identical to authentic versions, making them difficult to detect, particularly for patients. Patients believe they are taking the right treatment, but they are actually at risk. The counterfeits may contain too much or too little of the active ingredients, or none at all, preventing patients from receiving the proper treatment. Even worse, counterfeits are made with toxic substances or ineffective preparations that can cause serious illness or even death.
Counterfeiting is an illegal activity that has serious consequences for public health and patient safety. That’s why Roche is fully committed to working with health authorities and law enforcement agencies worldwide to aid their investigations into the source of counterfeits and prevent their distribution. We employ several anti-counterfeit strategies to combat this global threat to public health and help ensure the integrity of our products, and we are committed to giving healthcare professionals and patients the information they need to safely access them.

The opportunity
You will support the GRACC team in executing vital anti-counterfeiting strategies, ensuring the integrity of our global supply chain, and helping to protect patients from the dangers of counterfeit medicines. Furthermore, you will

• Assist in the ongoing development and monitoring of Roche's anti-counterfeit strategies and supply chain security initiatives.

• Support the creation of educational materials and communications aimed at healthcare professionals and patients to help them recognize authentic products and avoid counterfeits.

• Help coordinate efforts between internal teams, health authorities, and law enforcement agencies to aid in tracking and investigating counterfeit sources.

• Assist in tracking global counterfeiting trends and data to help the team identify potential vulnerabilities in the market.

• Strong proficiency in Microsoft/Google applications (Excel/Sheets and PowerPoint). Experience with data tracking or risk analysis tools is a plus.

• A strong interest in patient safety, global supply chain security, regulatory affairs, and public health policy.

• A team player mindset who thinks outside the box, shares their ideas, and has a strong ethical commitment to safeguarding patient health and well-being.

• Proficiency in English.

titleByLocale.it: Business Support Specialista (Deal Calculation, Tender & Product Support)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

As our Business Support Specialist, you will act as an architect and orchestrator of our Deal Calculation processes. In this role, you will be responsible for driving the end-to-end offer, deal, and price calculation lifecycle, ensuring that complex laboratory solutions are translated into competitive, profitable, and compliant commercial proposals. By facilitating cross-functional collaboration and leveraging your mastery of global systems, you will directly contribute to the success of Roche Diagnostics’ tenders and quotes across different disease portfolios and product areas.

Please note that this is a CONTRACTOR/CONTINGENT POSITION. You will be employed by our 3rd party service provider.

You will work independently within broad guidelines, receiving minimal guidance while managing non-recurring, complex tender requests. By participating in high-level strategy sessions, you will bring your unique practice and knowledge to the table, directly affecting the quality and success rate of our critical affiliate tender activities.

• Lead End-to-End Deal Orchestration: Drive the entire deal calculation process for high-complexity offers and tenders, ensuring all stakeholders (Sales, Marketing, Technical Service, Finance, Supply Chain) are aligned and deadlines are met.

• Generate Complex Financial Modeling: Independently create and evaluate sophisticated financial calculations for large-scale tenders to ensure optimal profitability and competitive market positioning.

• Act as a Consultative Partner: Advisor to Sales and Marketing during the pre-tender phase, providing strategic insights on offer structures and pricing dynamics.

• Serve as a Subject Matter Expert: Act as the local Key User and "Knowledge Anchor" for global, regional, and local deal calculation platforms, participating in international projects to shape Roche’s future commercial tools.

• Ensure Quality and Compliance: Analyze multiple sources of information to ensure every commercial proposal is flawlessly accurate and adheres to the highest ethical and compliance standards.

• Facilitate Consensus: Use tact and diplomacy to exchange sensitive information and build consensus among diverse cross-functional stakeholders during quote and tender preparations.

Who you are

• Educational Background: Hold a BSc/MSc degree in Life Sciences, Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field.

• Laboratory Expertise: Mandatory experience working in a central hospital/clinical laboratory, or a solid background in molecular biology, medical microbiology, pathology, or alternative relevant laboratory fields.

• Commercial Mastery & Systems Literacy: A proven track record in managing complex commercial processes alongside expert-level proficiency in Google Sheets/Excel and advanced analytical tools.

• Analytical Problem Solving: Ability to solve complex problems, interpret large datasets, and bring a fresh perspective to existing commercial solutions.

• Communication & Influence: Excellent negotiation and communication skills, with the ability to explain difficult or sensitive information effectively to internal and external partners.

• Language Skills: Fluency in English and the local language is essential.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub has been newly established within Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design.

As the Social Media Specialist (Community Management) , you would supports the Digital Communities team within Group Communications, you'll play a crucial role in orchestrating digital engagement and shaping the presence of Roche across various social media platforms. You will be working very closely with Digital Communications Engagement Managers and their stakeholders to support and enhance global social media channels and external audience interactions. You will be responsible for managing and growing our online presence across various platforms, the caretaker of our brand’s online presence, fostering a vibrant community, driving engagement through innovative and effective social media strategies, and ensuring positive and productive community interactions.

The Opportunity:

• Monitoring and replying to customer queries received via inbox and/or global social media channels.

• Cultivate and manage online communities by responding to comments, moderating interactions, and fostering meaningful engagement aligned with Roche’s brand voice.

• Building relationships with the Roche executive community, influencers, brand advocates, and partners to amplify brand messaging, and proactively manage potential social media issues by implementing crisis communication plans with the Global Insights/Crisis team.

• Proactively recommending improvements to strengthen digital presence, and identifying process enhancements to ensure innovative approaches across community, channel, and creative aspects while coaching junior colleagues as well.

• Business Process Management: as a center of excellence, establish process governance principles and maintain proper documentation within the scope of responsibility.

Who you are:

• You have a Bachelor's degree and 3 to 5 years of experience in global social media management, proficient in channel management, audience-centric strategies, social media tools, and managing agencies (experience in managing executive profiles is a big plus).

• You have experience with advertisement platforms and are strong in social metrics, content strategies for major platforms, and project management.

• You have excellent German and English communication skills; creative thinking for innovative content.

• You have strong interpersonal skills for teamwork and are skilled in conflict resolution, community moderation, and handling complex issues independently.

• You are a quick learner with a passion for technology, flexible with tools, and adept at adopting new technologies.

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Program Manager (GPM) at Roche/Genentech is a core member of molecule/disease area teams, driving drug or disease area development programs to maximize efficiency, portfolio value, and patient benefit. This role contributes to the company's bold ambition to deliver 20 transformative medicines by 2030 by co-creating and delivering the portfolio effectively and efficiently.

The Opportunity

• Be a core member of one or more molecule/disease area teams and drive drug or disease area development programs as well as established (foundational) product teams to maximize efficiency, portfolio value and patient benefit.

• Provide strategic program management to project teams, framing and assessing options, and identifying inflection points and critical factors for project delivery, decision-making and governance.

• Guide molecule teams, in close collaboration with the respective team leader.

• Build and maintain highly functioning project teams by observing team dynamics, building trust, addressing issues and encouraging open dialogues.

• Keep teams on track to deliver short-, mid-and long-term activities to achieve team objectives and drive key program/project meetings & workshops, team communication and documentation.

• Lead and contribute to functional or company-wide initiative workstreams (may).

• Contribute to portfolio management by reporting and proactively maintaining key project information to support portfolio overview and decisions.

• Maintain program and project management guidelines, standards, and tools as required.

• Drive implementation and execution of program strategy identification and mitigation of program risks.

• Leverage molecule development and market expertise to accelerate high quality decisions, lead effective ways of working, and catalyze change.

• Foster a teaching, coaching, and learning culture and embody OneRoche leadership principles such as VACC - Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, Coach within the MPM community, the PSD chapter and teams.

Addendum for the Evidence GPM Role

• Support Integrated Evidence Planning: This involves a global strategic planning process for evidence generation across functions to ensure broad and sustainable patient access to medicines by defining all necessary evidence for regulatory, access, and clinical practice throughout a product's lifecycle.

Scope of Authority

• The role is accountable for Program Oversight and Planning, Team Management, Communication, Portfolio Context, and Strategic Thought Partnership. It involves influencing R&D across many therapeutic areas and requires interactions with partners across the organization, including Clinical Development, Regulatory, Medical Affairs, and Commercial organizations. The GPM guides molecule teams and contributes to portfolio management and functional or company-wide initiative workstreams, demonstrating influence without explicit authority at various organizational levels.

Who you are

• Talented and passionate, inspired by the shared purpose of being key partners in translating Roche strategies into PD priorities and beyond and delivering the portfolio with excellence.

• Experienced in using different Project Management, Change Management, Business Management or related tools, methodologies & approaches to drive the team’s development of a strategy and achieve the desired outcomes for a program/project/function, effectively and efficiently.

• Solid drug development and potentially commercial experience, and a proven track record

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As Team Lead Engineering Commercial Pharma International Engagement Lead (CRM, Field, VOC, Events) (Senior Engineering Manager) you will focus on capabilities development of your team members that align with the function’s vision. You will encourage your team to self-define their career journey and seek ways to enable development opportunities in the direction of the journey. You will support them in removing roadblocks and by setting focus in their performance management. You make sure to develop your team with the right skills, healthy dynamics and a sustainable pace. You support the software and/or service delivery as a leader setting focus, removing impediments, managing stakeholders and creating efficiencies in collaboration wherever possible.

Description of the area

This role serves as the engagement lead for end-to-end customer engagement within the Pharma International region, encompassing the strategic oversight of CRM, Voice of Customer (VoC), and field integration. As a specialized ecosystem, the CRM space is designed to streamline relationships with healthcare professionals and patients while ensuring strict regulatory compliance across global markets. The system centralizes stakeholder data to enable personalized, omnichannel engagement across digital and in-person channels, supported by automated processes such as strategic account planning and sample management. By integrating VoC insights directly into these workflows, the platform ensures that field teams can refine their account strategies based on real-time customer feedback and preferences. Beyond execution, the CRM acts as a strategic hub for data-based insights, utilizing dashboards to monitor how effectively the organization is delivering on its customer-centricity goals while maintaining audit-ready documentation for legal requirements. Ultimately, this environment breaks down departmental silos to foster seamless collaboration between sales, marketing, and medical teams through a unified source of truth.

Job responsibilities

• Team Member Capability and Career Development 

• Proactively identifies and develops future-focused engineering team capabilities, aligning with long-term strategic goals.

• Mentors team members on long-term career paths, creating new opportunities and roles within the organization to support their growth.

• Addresses and helps resolve complex, systemic roadblocks that impact multiple development teams, and coaches other managers on effective performance management.

• Oversees the technical and soft skill development, ensuring a balanced and high-performing talent portfolio.

​

• Team Health and Sustainability 

• Establishes and monitors metrics for team health and sustainability across several development teams, implementing strategies to ensure long-term balance.

• Designs and implements initiatives to improve collaboration and psychological safety across multiple related development teams or a whole product area.

• Proactively identifies and resolves systemic impediments that affect multiple development teams, improving the overall work environment.

• Manages the talent composition for own and related teams, planning for future needs and ensuring a healthy pipeline of skills.

• Product and Service Delivery Leadership ⚙️

• Responsible for co-creating the long-term technical vision and strategy for a product portfolio, partnering with Product Managers and Leaders who are overall responsible for the roadmaps.

• Accountable for

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Was Dich erwartet:

Die Labordiagnostik ist das Herzstück unseres Gesundheitswesens und von entscheidender Bedeutung für jeden einzelnen Patienten. Schätzungsweise 70 % aller klinischen Entscheidungen basieren auf In-vitro-diagnostischen Tests. Die absolute Zuverlässigkeit unserer Systeme ist daher die Grundvoraussetzung für sichere Diagnosen und medizinische Weichenstellungen.

Für unser Praktikantenprogramm suchen wir motivierte, technologiebegeisterte und wissbegierige Studierende, die unser Service-Team tatkräftig unterstützen und gemeinsam mit uns den Grundstein für eine erfolgreiche Karriere bei Roche legen möchten.

Werde Teil unserer dynamischen Serviceorganisation! Mit viel Energie, Leidenschaft und Innovationsgeist bringen wir die Labordiagnostik in Deutschland voran und gestalten die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens aktiv mit. Bei uns kannst Du tagtäglich Deine eigenen Ideen und Dein theoretisches und praktisches Wissen einbringen, um komplexe technische Fragestellungen im Team zu lösen.

Als Praktikant:in (m/w/d) begleitest Du unsere erfahrenen Mitarbeitenden bei der Planung, Installation, Wartung und Modifikation unserer Analysensysteme cobas® pro und cobas® pure . Darüber hinaus tauchst Du tief in die IT-Vernetzung unserer Systeme ein. Bei den täglichen Einsätzen in verschiedenen Krankenhaus- und Privatlaboren sind Deine Eigeninitiative, Deine ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung und Dein technisches Geschick gefragt.

Dein perfekter Start: Zu Beginn Deines Praktikums erhältst Du eine fundierte Ausbildung auf unseren Immunologie cobas®-Systemen und wirst während Deines gesamten Außendiensteinsatzes von einem festen Mentor oder einer Mentorin intensiv begleitet.

Du wirst im Raum Niedersachsen, Hamburg, Bremen eingesetzt und genießt die Freiheit, Deinen Wohnort innerhalb dieses Gebiets frei zu wählen (idealerweise im Raum Hamburg, Hannover, Bremen ) .

Folgende Schwerpunkte erwarten Dich bei Deinem Praktikum im Service Außendienst:

• Professionelles Training: Du absolvierst im September (28.09. – 02.10.2026) ein spezialisiertes Wartungstraining an zwei Immunologie-Modulen ( cobas® e402 und cobas® e801 ).

• Praktische Technik: Du stellst Dein handwerkliches und technisches Geschick direkt bei Geräteinstallationen und präventiven Wartungen unter Beweis.

• Problem-Solving: Du erhältst tiefe Einblicke in die Analyse sowie Behebung komplexer technischer und applikativer Fragestellungen und unterstützt unser Team aktiv bei der Ursachenforschung.

• Perspektivenwechsel: Du fokussierst Dich auf die Bereiche Klinische Chemie und Immunologie, hast jedoch jederzeit die Möglichkeit, durch Hospitationen auch andere spannende Unternehmensbereiche kennenzulernen.

• Zukunftsthema IT: IT-Netzwerke und IT-Sicherheit wecken Deinen Ehrgeiz – bei der Installation von Firewalls lernst Du direkt von unseren IT-Spezialisten.

• Eigenverantwortung: Du bringst Deine organisatorischen Fähigkeiten ein und übernimmst selbstständig definierte Aufgabenpakete (z. B. die professionelle Einweisung unserer Kunden in die Nutzung unserer Online-Plattform Navify ).

• Kommunikationstalent: Du schärfst Deine Kommunikationsfähigkeiten im direkten Dialog mit unseren Kunden sowie bei der kollegialen Abstimmung im Team.

• Flexibilität: Kleinere Projektaufgaben bearbeitest Du ganz flexibel an einzelnen Tagen im Homeoffice. Die meiste Zeit bist Du jedoch dort, wo unsere Geräte stehen: direkt vor Ort bei unseren Kunden.

• Wachstumsumfeld: Wir bieten Dir ein attraktives und wertschätzendes Praktik
