descriptionByLocale.de:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Was Dich erwartet: Die Labordiagnostik ist das Herzstück unseres Gesundheitswesens und von entscheidender Bedeutung für jeden einzelnen Patienten. Schätzungsweise 70 % aller klinischen Entscheidungen basieren auf In-vitro-diagnostischen Tests. Die absolute Zuverlässigkeit unserer Systeme ist daher die Grundvoraussetzung für sichere Diagnosen und medizinische Weichenstellungen. Für unser Praktikantenprogramm suchen wir motivierte, technologiebegeisterte und wissbegierige Studierende, die unser Service-Team tatkräftig unterstützen und gemeinsam mit uns den Grundstein für eine erfolgreiche Karriere bei Roche legen möchten. Werde Teil unserer dynamischen Serviceorganisation! Mit viel Energie, Leidenschaft und Innovationsgeist bringen wir die Labordiagnostik in Deutschland voran und gestalten die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens aktiv mit. Bei uns kannst Du tagtäglich Deine eigenen Ideen und Dein theoretisches und praktisches Wissen einbringen, um komplexe technische Fragestellungen im Team zu lösen. Als Praktikant:in (m/w/d) begleitest Du unsere erfahrenen Mitarbeitenden bei der Planung, Installation, Wartung und Modifikation unserer Analysensysteme cobas® pro und cobas® pure . Darüber hinaus tauchst Du tief in die IT-Vernetzung unserer Systeme ein. Bei den täglichen Einsätzen in verschiedenen Krankenhaus- und Privatlaboren sind Deine Eigeninitiative, Deine ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung und Dein technisches Geschick gefragt. Dein perfekter Start: Zu Beginn Deines Praktikums erhältst Du eine fundierte Ausbildung auf unseren Immunologie cobas®-Systemen und wirst während Deines gesamten Außendiensteinsatzes von einem festen Mentor oder einer Mentorin intensiv begleitet. Du wirst im Raum Niedersachsen, Hamburg, Bremen eingesetzt und genießt die Freiheit, Deinen Wohnort innerhalb dieses Gebiets frei zu wählen (idealerweise im Raum Hamburg, Hannover, Bremen ) . Folgende Schwerpunkte erwarten Dich bei Deinem Praktikum im Service Außendienst:
• Professionelles Training: Du absolvierst im September (28.09. – 02.10.2026) ein spezialisiertes Wartungstraining an zwei Immunologie-Modulen ( cobas® e402 und cobas® e801 ).
• Praktische Technik: Du stellst Dein handwerkliches und technisches Geschick direkt bei Geräteinstallationen und präventiven Wartungen unter Beweis.
• Problem-Solving: Du erhältst tiefe Einblicke in die Analyse sowie Behebung komplexer technischer und applikativer Fragestellungen und unterstützt unser Team aktiv bei der Ursachenforschung.
• Perspektivenwechsel: Du fokussierst Dich auf die Bereiche Klinische Chemie und Immunologie, hast jedoch jederzeit die Möglichkeit, durch Hospitationen auch andere spannende Unternehmensbereiche kennenzulernen.
• Zukunftsthema IT: IT-Netzwerke und IT-Sicherheit wecken Deinen Ehrgeiz – bei der Installation von Firewalls lernst Du direkt von unseren IT-Spezialisten.
• Eigenverantwortung: Du bringst Deine organisatorischen Fähigkeiten ein und übernimmst selbstständig definierte Aufgabenpakete (z. B. die professionelle Einweisung unserer Kunden in die Nutzung unserer Online-Plattform Navify ).
• Kommunikationstalent: Du schärfst Deine Kommunikationsfähigkeiten im direkten Dialog mit unseren Kunden sowie bei der kollegialen Abstimmung im Team.
• Flexibilität: Kleinere Projektaufgaben bearbeitest Du ganz flexibel an einzelnen Tagen im Homeoffice. Die meiste Zeit bist Du jedoch dort, wo unsere Geräte stehen: direkt vor Ort bei unseren Kunden.
• Wachstumsumfeld: Wir bieten Dir ein attraktives und wertschätzendes Praktik

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Como Estagiário(a) de Estratégia e Soluções Integradas, você terá a oportunidade de entender a jornada do paciente e envolver-se na cocriação e implementação de projetos e soluções. Esta vaga oferece uma trilha de desenvolvimento clara, onde você expandirá o seu impacto e responsabilidades ao longo do programa de estágio.

A Oportunidade
No seu dia a dia, você participa em melhorias de processos internos com foco na agilidade para o cliente e auxilia na implementação de eventos, campanhas e materiais. A sua jornada será estruturada da seguinte forma:

No 1º ano de estágio:

• Você realiza a imersão nas políticas internas e implementa processos end-to-end, como gestão de contratos, cadastro de speakers (PF e PJ) e parceiros de negócios, atuando como ponto focal de pagamentos.

• Você gerencia a abertura de eventos no SalesForce, realiza o upload de materiais no PromoMats para aprovação (de acordo com RDC 96 e PAMDE) e faz o preenchimento do GSD.

• Você colabora com a organização de repositórios nos iHubs, faz a interface direta com fornecedores e instituições patrocinadas, e modera as cerimónias do chapter de ESI.

No 2º ano de estágio:

• Você implementa, de ponta a ponta, projetos e eventos de média complexidade e participa, junto ao analista e coordenador, no desenvolvimento de projetos de alta complexidade.

• Você modera as syncs dos iHubs, atua na governança do guia de processos ESI e faz a interface com estratégias omnichannel.

• Você cria materiais e briefings para parceiros de negócios e realiza a revisão de materiais segundo as normas (RDC 96 e PAMDE).

Quem é você

• Você cursa graduação em áreas relacionadas a Marketing, Administração, Comunicação, Engenharia de Bioprocessos ou na área da Saúde (Farmácia, Enfermagem, Biomedicina, etc.).

• Você tem disponibilidade para cumprir um contrato de estágio de, no mínimo, 1 ano e meio (formatura a partir de Dez de 2027).

• Você possui um nível intermediário do idioma Inglês.

• Você tem conhecimentos básicos nas ferramentas Excel e PowerPoint.

Diferenciais

• Você possui noções e interesse em gestão de projetos.

• Você tem conhecimento de metodologias ágeis.

*Benefícios de relocalização não estão disponíveis para esta vaga.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Questa posizione offre una traccia di sviluppo chiara, dove potrete ammirare l'impatto e le responsabilità lungo il programma di stage. L'Oportunità Nel quotidiano, parteciperete a finali di processi interni con focus sull'agilità per il cliente e aiutaete nell'implementazione di eventi, campagne e materiali. La tua storia sarà strutturata in questo modo: Anno 1 di Stage - Realizzerete l'immersione nelle politiche interne e implementerete processi end-to-end, come gestione di contratti, cattura di speaker (PF e PJ) e partner di business, agendo come punto focale di pagamenti. - Gestionerete l'apertura di eventi nel SalesForce, realizza l'upload di materiali nel PromoMats per approvazione (in base a RDC 96 e PAMDE) e tariffe il preenchimento del GSD. - Collaborerete con l'organizzazione di repositori nei iHubs, farete l'interfaccia diretta con fornitori e istituzioni patrocinate, e modorerete le cerimonie del capitolo di ESI. Anno 2 di Stage - Implementerete, da ponta a ponta, e eventi di media complessità e parteciperete, insieme all'analista e al coordinatore, nel sviluppo di progetti di complessità alta. - Modorerete le sync dei iHubs, agire nella governanza del guida di processi ESI e farete l'interfaccia con strategie omnichannel. - Creerete materiali e briefings per partner di business e realizza la revisione di materiali secondo le norme (RDC 96 e PAMDE). Chi è la persona giusta - Cursate la laurea in aree correlate a Marketing, Amministrazione, Comunicazione, Ingegneria di Bioprocessi o nell'area della Salute (Farmacia, Ingegneria, Biomedicina, ecc.). - adempiere a un contratto di stage di, almeno, 1 anno e mezzo (formatura a partire da Dicembre 2027). - Possedete un livello intermedio del linguaggio inglese. - conoscenze basilari nelle ferramenta Excel e PowerPoint. Differenziali - Possedete nozioni e interessanti in gestione di progetti. - Avete conoscenza di metodi agili. *Benefici di relocalizzazione non sono disponibili per questa posizione. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati a avanzare la scienza, assicurando a tutti l'accesso ai servizi sanitari oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri medicinali e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti Diagnostici. Abbiamo il potere di decidere a esplorare nuove possibilità, di favorire la creatività e di mantenere le nostre ambizioni alte, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni di saluto che hanno un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un Datore di Lavoro Uguale Opportunità.

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Analyst - Monitoring & Incident Response
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Opportunity:

The Global Security Monitoring and Incident Response (MIR) team at Roche strives to keep our networks and users safe from constantly evolving threats.

As a CyberSecurity Analyst -Monitoring & Incident Response , you will help protect proprietary information, patient data, keep computer systems clean, and provide a safe information environment for our users. Combing through massive amounts of signals, you will have to identify signs of abuse or compromise of on-premise as well as cloud resources. All team members share a set of core responsibilities, handling incidents, requests from experts, as well as enquiries from end users. CyberSecurity Analysts are responsible for monitoring security information, identifying threats, and showing initiative to defend all Roche information systems.

Note: As an incident responder, you are expected to take part in an on call rotation during weekends and can be mobilized during major incidents.

Responsibilities:

• Monitoring and Incident Response for a global environment

• Take decisions, often under pressure, given partial information

• Contribute to proactive threat detection efforts

• Lead containment and remediation efforts during active security incidents

• Perform forensic analysis of relevant artifacts to support investigations

• Contribute to detection engineering activities across a global team

• Brief team members and leadership on relevant threats to the Roche group

• Communicate information security concepts and situations to senior management

• Contribute operational feedback to continuously strengthen detection and response processes

• Mentor newer team members

Who You Are:

• Bachelor’s degree in a technical field and 7+ years of experience in information security, including at least 3 years in a SOC/CERT/CSIRT environment

• Familiarity with TLP and information sharing best practices

• Ability to communicate information security-related concepts and situations to a non-technical audience

• Demonstrated ability to analyze, triage, and escalate information security incidents

• Knowledge of detection engineering and threat-hunting concepts

• Scripting and programming skills (Python, Javascript, Go, Rust, …)

• Demonstrated knowledge of operating systems (Windows, Linux, macOs)

• Excellent organization and communication skills.

• Fluent spoken and written English

Preferred Qualifications:

• Network and Endpoint security monitoring experience in a large complex environment

• Prior exposure to privacy frameworks in the context of IT security monitoring

• Knowledge of modern IAM controls and concepts (Zero Trust, Identity Aware Proxies, Active Directory Security, …)

• Knowledge of Cloud security concepts (multi-cloud environments, CSPM, …)

• A passion for the field of computer and network security

• Familiarity with various defensive AND offensive security toolsets

• Public speaking or mentoring experience

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting

jobs.title: Practicante Profesional de Calidad
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Un futuro más saludable. Es lo que nos impulsa a innovar. Avanzar continuamente en la ciencia y garantizar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y en las generaciones futuras.

Crear un mundo en el que todos tengamos más tiempo con las personas que amamos.

Eso es lo que nos hace ser Roche.

Como Practicante Profesional de Calidad en Ate, Perú , te integrarás al equipo encargado de asegurar que nuestros productos mantengan los más altos estándares globales antes de llegar a quienes más los necesitan. En este rol, tendrás un impacto directo en el mantenimiento de nuestro Sistema de Gestión de Calidad, colaborando estrechamente con operaciones locales y flujos de importación en un entorno de aprendizaje continuo.

Oportunidad

• Realizas la inspección física, registro fotográfico y verificación de rotulados e insertos de los productos médicos que ingresan al almacén.

• Elaboras y mantienes actualizados los expedientes de lote ( batch records ) y las órdenes de inspección para los procesos de reacondicionado.

• Verificas los certificados de análisis (CoAs) y reportas oportunamente cualquier discrepancia detectada en los productos.

• Gestionas la segregación y el control del inventario de contramuestras según los requerimientos establecidos.

• Descargas, analizas y notificas el estado de los monitores de temperatura de las importaciones, asegurando la cadena de frío.

• Consolidas la información de los registros de temperatura del almacén y generas los informes mensuales de conformidad.

• Apoyas en la preparación de autoinspecciones y auditorías internas para los procesos de almacenamiento y distribución.

• Colaboras en la actualización de los procedimientos de calidad y en las capacitaciones del personal en buenas prácticas.

Quien eres

• Eres egresado/a de las carreras de Química Farmacéutica, Toxicología o Tecnología Médica.

• Disponibilidad para realizar prácticas profesionales

• Posees un nivel de inglés intermedio.

• Demuestras un manejo intermedio de MS Office, especialmente en el uso de Excel.

• Destacas por tu orientación al detalle, capacidad de organización y un estilo de trabajo colaborativo.

• Conocimiento o familiaridad con herramientas de análisis de datos como Power BI y herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial (Copilot, Gemini, etc.) sería preferible mas no requerido.

Beneficios de reubicación no disponibles.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Treasury & Accounts Receivable Accountant
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Opportunity:

As an Operational Specialist in Treasury & AR , you will play a vital role within our Finance Shared Service Center. You will be responsible for ensuring the integrity, accuracy, and timeliness of financial transactions while supporting the broader Treasury and Accounts Receivable functions. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented professional who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment and is committed to continuous process improvement.
Your key responsibilities will include:

• Operational Execution: Coordinate and support stringent financial tasks, including daily bank postings, interface controls, manual corrections, and the reconciliation of bank and bank suspense balance sheet accounts.

• AR & Treasury Management: Execute customer direct debit payments, cash allocation, and the clearing of AR and bank suspense accounts. You will be responsible for posting and reconciling treasury and AR transactions.

• Accounting & Compliance: Perform day-to-day activities according to agreed service levels and SOPs. This includes AR manual invoicing, GL journal posting, account reconciliations, and FX revaluation.

• Reporting & Communication: Manage intercompany reconciliation and reporting. You will handle incoming calls and emails from stakeholders in a timely, professional manner.

• Team Collaboration: Proactively seek opportunities for effective cooperation across teams and geographies. Provide support to team members to balance workloads and foster a positive team environment.

• Continuous Improvement: Propose process and system improvements and contribute to the overall performance of the Shared Service Center (SSC) through active participation in workshops and meetings.

Who you are:

You are a finance professional with a solid understanding of accounting processes, a customer-service mindset, and the ability to work effectively with limited direction.
Requirements and Qualifications:

• Education: University or College degree, with a concentration in Finance or Accounting .

• Experience: 3-5 years of experience in Finance and Accounting .

• Technical Knowledge: Familiarity with Finance Shared Services and operational accounting processes. Knowledge of technology systems such as SAP and BlackLine is highly desired.

• Languages: Fluency in English and Spanish is required. Proficiency in Portuguese and/or French is a plus.

• Skills: * Strong ability to prioritize and organize work to meet tight deadlines.

• Excellent analytical, presentation, and communication skills.

• Ability to multitask and manage up effectively.

• High level of integrity and commitment to complying with corporate guidelines.

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position
A healthier future is what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Roche Support Network offers an exciting opportunity for individuals who are passionate about problem solving. As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche is dedicated to discovering, developing, and providing innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products. With a commitment to employee development and a work environment that values respect and empowerment, Roche offers exciting career prospects for those seeking to make a significant impact on patient care.

The Opportunity
The Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers. As a Field Applications Specialist you will:

• Acting as the primary liaison/customer representative throughout the implementation process and future histology application support, Includes planning and coordination for the implementation and customer training, as well as problem-solving issues that arise for customers throughout the life cycle of the solution.

• Provide highly visible, self-supervised and self-directed, extensive on-site advisory customer support through the implementation of Roche Tissue instrumentation and tailored customer training on our Roche solutions to meet customer needs based on an individualized assessment of the customer’s personnel, organizational structure, workflow, and maximization of equipment capabilities, which may include: equipment, applications, systems, and IT solutions.

• Act as an advisor on customer issues and drive efficiencies & optimization for the customer and Roche through independent analysis and problem-solving. Additionally, will be responsible for increased sales revenue by identifying opportunities for new system consumables for clients (i.e. reagents, primary antibodies, bio-markers, software). Performs these job duties remotely and independently.

jobs.title: Project Management Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Um futuro mais saudável. É isso que nos motiva a inovar. Promover continuamente a ciência e garantir que todos tenham acesso à assistência médica de que precisam hoje e pelas próximas gerações. Criar um mundo onde todos nós temos mais tempo com as pessoas que amamos. É isso que nos faz Roche.

Como um(a) Project Management Specialist , você será o ponto focal da Roche responsável por planejar, executar e monitorar projetos complexos, garantindo a sincronização perfeita entre as atividades internas e as necessidades dos clientes. Você trabalhará em parceria com diversos stakeholders para traduzir a visão estratégica em planos de ação executáveis e robustos.
Nessa posição, você será o líder operacional que assegura a governança e a entrega técnica dentro do escopo, prazo e custo. Você terá autonomia para liderar times multidisciplinares, estimulando a colaboração e a agilidade para tomar decisões que gerem impacto direto na modernização e eficiência do ecossistema de saúde.

Sobre a Oportunidade:

• Utilizar metodologias de gestão de projetos para o planejamento, execução e monitoramento de cronogramas críticos.

• Garantir a sincronização das atividades internas (Engenharia, TI, Assessoria e Consultoria) e do cliente para o atingimento de indicadores de performance.

• Estabelecer uma governança sólida e dinâmica de trabalho, garantindo clareza de papéis, responsabilidades e engajamento dos times.

• Assegurar uma comunicação efetiva e transparente, tornando o cronograma e as etapas do projeto acessíveis a todos os envolvidos.

• Gerenciar e mitigar riscos de forma proativa, comunicando impactos de escopo, prazo ou custo em tempo adequado para tomada de decisão.

• Promover a busca de soluções criativas e alternativas para problemas ou mudanças que surjam durante a execução do projeto.

• Garantir a rastreabilidade total do processo através da formalização e registro de documentos em ferramentas de gestão de projetos.

• Implementar lições aprendidas e melhorias contínuas, compartilhando insights que sirvam de input para a otimização de processos internos.

Quem você é:

• Graduação completa (Pós-graduação ou MBA serão considerados diferenciais).

• Certificação PMP (Project Management Professional) ativa será um diferencial.

• Possuir experiência relevante em atividades correlacionadas a gestão de projetos complexos de automação e soluções integradas na área de saúde ou diagnóstica.

• Inglês avançado.

• Domínio em ferramentas de gestão como Monday ou similares.

• Conhecimento em metodologias Lean e Agile será considerado um importante diferencial.

• Visão estratégica voltada para resultados, priorizando a excelência na entrega e a satisfação do parceiro externo.

• Habilidade de negociação e liderança de times multidisciplinares para garantir o alinhamento de expectativas.

• Demonstrar alta capacidade de negociação e gerenciamento de conflitos com comportamento proativo e construtivo; possuir habilidade analítica para navegar em ambientes complexos e diferentes níveis hierárquicos, conectando necessidades e soluções de forma sempre colaborativa.

• Disponibilidade para viagens conforme a necessidade de acompanhamento dos projetos em campo.

Os benefícios de realocação não estão disponíveis para essa posição.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Um futuro mais saudável. É isso que nos motiva a inovar. Promover continuamente a ciência e garantir que todos tenham acesso à assistência médica de que precisam hoje e pelas próximas gerações. Criar um mundo onde todos nós temos mais tempo com as pessoas que amamos. É isso que nos faz Roche.

Como Parceiro de Jornada do Paciente (Digital) , você terá como missão transformar a forma como a Roche interage com stakeholders, posicionando-se no centro de uma abordagem inovadora e disruptiva. Em um mercado farmacêutico em constante evolução, você atuará como interface buscando trazer a voz do cliente para dentro da empresa utilizando estratégias e inovações omnichannel, aliadas às ferramentas digitais para otimizar as interações com o ecossistema de saúde.

O PJP Digital é uma posição estratégica e agnóstica em termos de responsabilidade, focada em criar impacto no ecossistema de saúde, indo além das barreiras geograficas, uilizando estratégias omnichannel e insights baseados em dados para melhorar a tomada de decisões e maximizar a eficiência operacional. Com uma visão 360° das contas e stakeholders, você irá colaborar com outros parceiros de negócio para atender ao potencial das contas e alavancar o acesso, destravando barreiras e otimizando a jornada do paciente nos pilares de Prevenção/Diagnóstico, Decisão Médica, Acesso e Financiamento e Tratamento.

Sobre a oportunidade:

• Estabelecer metas desafiadoras e identificar oportunidades de ampliação do acesso a soluções inovadoras em seu território, promovendo maior alcance e impacto para nossos pacientes.

• Gerenciar contas e stakeholders, criando estratégias de engajamento e planos de ação alinhados com os objetivos da Roche, de forma a fortalecer relações e impulsionar resultados consistentes.

• Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos digitais e garantir a eficiência omnichannel nas interações com o ecossistema de saúde, acelerando a entrega de valor e ampliando o acesso às nossas inovações.

• Ser responsável pelo lançamento de informações no EpiCX (CRM) e outras plataformas que otimizem e personalizem a comunicação com profissionais de saúde, garantindo a eficácia das interações e a melhoria contínua dos processos através de visão analítica de dados.

• Contribuir para a ampliação da eficiência omnichannel nas interações com o ecossistema de saúde.

Quem é você:

• Graduação completa e inglês intermediário.

• Experiência em relacionamento com clientes e desejável conhecimento em gestão de projetos.

• Visão intermediária multidisciplinar em Acesso, Médico Científico e Gestão de contas, além de conhecimento do sistema de saúde brasileiro.

• Experiência com diversos stakeholders do setor de saúde (HCP e HCO), com diferencial para atuação virtual.

• Forte comunicação empática e ativa, com habilidade para engajar de forma omnichannel (repetido no original).

• Mindset multicanal e data-driven, com domínio em marketing digital, mídias sociais e ferramentas como CRM (OCE-IQVIA) (repetido no original).

• Experiência na construção de eventos científicos nos formatos presencial, digital e híbrido (repetido no original).

• Persuasão para transformar interações em oportunidades de negócio, com abordagem criativa, resolutiva, proatividade, foco em resultados e agilidade na tomada de decisão.

• Agilidade cultural/organizacional, facilidade para trabalhar em equipe em ambientes ambíguos, flexíveis e fluidos, mantendo o controle emocional e capacidade de gerenciar expectativas.

• Disponibilidade para atua

jobs.title: Head of US Government Affairs & Policy

titleByLocale.en: Head of US Government Affairs & Policy

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

The Head of US Government Affairs & Policy leads Roche Diagnostics’ US government affairs and public policy strategy, shaping the legislative and regulatory environment to advance innovation, protect market access, influence healthcare policy, and mitigate risk.
Based in Washington, D.C., this executive serves as Roche Diagnostics’ principal representative to policymakers, regulatory agencies, trade associations and external stakeholders, while acting as a strategic advisor to senior leadership on political and policy developments affecting the business.
This role reports to the Global Head of Quality, Regulatory & External Affairs, with a dotted-line relationship to the President and CEO, Roche Diagnostics North America.

KEY ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Policy Strategy & Advocacy

• Develop and lead Roche Diagnostics’ US government affairs and policy strategy aligned with business priorities.

• Influence federal and state policy impacting diagnostics, reimbursement, healthcare innovation, trade and regulatory matters.

• Anticipate risks and opportunities and shape advocacy strategies to support growth and patient access.

• Serve as a strategic partner ensuring the US Government Affairs agenda is co-created with commercial leaders; translate complex political and regulatory shifts into strategic implications that inform business planning and investment decisions.

Strategic Trade Association Leadership:

• Evaluate and recommend Roche Diagnostics’ participation in industry trade associations;

• Direct executive engagement within these forums to lead cross-industry efforts on critical medical technology and policy issues.

Government & Stakeholder Engagement

• Serve as Roche’s senior liaison with Congress, Administration officials, federal agencies and state policymakers.

• Lead engagement with key trade associations, coalitions, patient groups and external stakeholders to advance Roche’s policy agenda. Partners with external stakeholders, as appropriate, to build alignment with Roche Diagnostics’ policy positions and encourage external advocacy efforts consistent with those positions. (e.g., non-profit associations, industry organizations, think tanks, coalitions).

• Lead Roche’s presence in government forums and strategically deploy internal subject matter experts (from manufacturing to R&D) to testify, brief officials, and provide technical guidance that advances the company's policy objectives.

Strategic Counsel & Business Partnership

• Advise senior leaders on political, legislative and policy developments affecting Roche Diagnostics.

• Bring external insights into business strategy and translate policy developments into actionable implications.

• Support executive engagement with policymakers and key public affairs opportunities.

Policy Leadership in Partnership with Commercial Organization

• Lead customer communications on policy in partnership with the US commercial team.

• Engage with policy counterparts from key customers as well as laboratory industry trade associations.

• Participate in US Commercial leadership forums including USLT (US Leadership Team) and ELT (Enterprise Leadership Team).

Team Leadership & Capability Building

• Lead and develop a high-performing US Government Affairs and Policy team, including talent development, succession planning, coaching and organizational capability building.

• Assess resource needs and manage use of external advisors, consultants and advocacy partnerships.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Was macht unseren Bereich aus
Diagnostics Operations Penzberg ist als Teil der Diagnostics Global Operations der wichtigste Produzent von qualitativ hochwertigen Einsatzstoffen bis hin zu speziellen Kits für die Diagnostik-Division von Roche. Es erwartet Sie eine vielseitige, interessante und verantwortungsvolle Aufgabe im Bereich Manufacturing. Hier werden biochemische und chemische Reagenzien und Einsatzstoffe für alle Geschäftsbereiche und vor allem die In-vitro-Diagnostik mehrerer Roche Geschäftseinheiten hergestellt.

Das Team
Unser Team im Themencluster Festphasenchemie produziert modifizierte Oligonucleotide, Peptide und Konjugate im kleinen Maßstab unter GMP-Bedingungen. Diese Produkte unterstützen zahlreiche diagnostische Assays wie PCR, Immundiagnostik und Sequencing. Unser Fokus liegt auf der Herstellung qualitativ hochwertiger Produkte, der Einführung innovativer Artikel und der kontinuierlichen Optimierung unserer Produktionsprozesse in einem stark wachsenden Umfeld.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Experte in der organischen Chemie/Festphasenchemie stellst du hochwertige Produkte für die In-vitro-Diagnostik her. Deine Tätigkeiten finden in einem GMP-regulierten Bereich statt.
Neben der Abarbeitung von Produktionsaufträgen unterstützt du unser Team aktiv bei folgenden Themen:

• Übernahme neuer Verfahren und Implementierung neuer Produkte.

• Bearbeitung von Abweichungen, CAPAs, OOS-Fällen und Troubleshootings.

• Prozessverbesserungen, Scale-ups und Changes.

• Erstellung und Überarbeitung von HVs und SOPs.

• Unterstützung bei Validierungen und Qualifizierungen sowie bei technischen Themen.

• Mitarbeit bei der Produktionsplanung und Unterstützung bei Arbeitssicherheitsthemen.

Das bringst du mit

• Du hast dein Studium der Chemie (Bachelor oder Master) erfolgreich abgeschlossen.

• Du bringst theoretische und praktische Erfahrung in der organischen Chemie mit. Idealerweise verfügst du über Erfahrung im Bereich der Festphasenchemie.

• Du besitzt theoretische und praktische Erfahrung in der analytischen und präparativen Chromatographie.

• Berufserfahrung in einem Produktionsumfeld sowie Kenntnisse im Bereich der Arbeitssicherheit sind ein Plus.

• Auf deine sehr guten Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse sowie sehr guten Kenntnisse gängiger EDV-Anwendungen können wir uns jederzeit verlassen.

Die Stelle ist auf 2 Jahre befristet.

Deine Bewerbung
Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:

• Aktueller Lebenslauf

• Deine offiziellen (Bildungs-) Zeugnisse/Nachweise.

Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Health Economics Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Sobre Roche:
Un futuro más saludable. Es lo que nos impulsa a innovar. Avanzar continuamente en la ciencia y garantizar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y en las generaciones futuras. Crear un mundo en el que todos tengamos más tiempo con las personas que amamos. Eso es lo que nos hace ser Roche.
Oportunidad:

• Título del Puesto: Becario / Practicante de Farmacoeconomía

• Departamento: Acceso al Mercado / Farmacoeconomía

• Reporta a: Gerente de Farmacoeconomía

• Propósito del Puesto: Brindar soporte técnico y analítico al equipo de Farmacoeconomía en la generación de evidencia local, optimizando los tiempos de entrega de los dosieres de valor y materiales económicos necesarios para el posicionamiento de las terapias de Productos Roche.

Responsabilidades:

• Investigación y análisis de datos: Realizar búsquedas sistemáticas de literatura científica, guías clínicas y datos epidemiológicos o de costos locales en fuentes oficiales.

• Soporte en Modelaje: Apoyar en la adaptación, control de calidad y actualización de modelos de impacto presupuestal y costo-efectividad.

• Desarrollo de Entregables: Colaborar en la redacción y armado de secciones técnicas de los dossiers de valor para sometimientos institucionales.

• Gestión de Información: Mantener actualizadas las bases de datos internas del área (precios, competidores, resoluciones institucionales).

Quién eres:

• Educación: Estudiante activo de los últimos semestres (con al menos 6 meses a 1 año restante de carrera) en Licenciaturas de Economía, Actuaría, Matemáticas o carreras afines con un fuerte enfoque analítico.

• Habilidades Técnicas: * Manejo de Excel a nivel intermedio-avanzado (fórmulas, tablas dinámicas).

• Comprensión de lectura técnica en inglés (indispensable para la revisión de artículos científicos).

• Deseable (no exclusivo): Conocimiento básico o interés en estadística o economía de la salud.

• Competencias: * Atención al detalle y rigurosidad analítica.

• Proactividad y alta capacidad de organización.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación escrita.

Beneficios de reubicación no están disponibles para esta posición.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Especialista de Dados em Supply Chain, você terá a oportunidade de transformar dados em inteligência estratégica para otimizar a Cadeia Logística da Roche Diagnóstica Brasil. Seu foco está em elevar a experiência do cliente e maximizar a rentabilidade através de decisões fundamentadas. Você será responsável por promover a cultura de dados utilizando desde soluções analíticas clássicas até Advanced Analytics , atuando como um facilitador para parceiros de negócios na identificação de casos de uso de alto impacto. Você é um agente ativo na transformação digital da companhia, convergindo tecnologia e logística para atender às demandas do cliente.

Sobre a oportunidade:

• Supervisão de KPIs, metas e governança de dados para o chapter de Supply Chain, garantindo a integridade dos cálculos.

• Atuação como parceiro estratégico de stakeholders, direcionando soluções de dados alinhadas aos objetivos de negócio.

• Gestão de Produtos de Dados através da manutenção e otimização contínua das ferramentas e produtos de dados da área.

• Desenvolvimento e manutenção de dashboards de visualização para suporte à tomada de decisão.

• Automação através da criação de bots e scripts para extração automatizada de dados em diversas plataformas e sistemas.

• Engenharia de Dados (ETL): Desenho e gerenciamento de rotinas de estruturação, movimentação e organização de dados.

• Mapeamento de fluxos de informação para erradicar tarefas manuais e maximizar o uso de recursos nativos.

• Liderança de projetos do subchapter de Supply Chain Excellence, apoiando a governança e a excelência operacional.

Quem você é:

• Graduação completa em Engenharia, Ciência da Computação, Ciência de Dados, Estatística, Física, Matemática ou similares.

• Experiência relevante em Análise de Dados, administração e manutenção de bancos de dados, aliadas ao desenho de fluxo de informações e processos.

• Proficiente no desenvolvimento de scripts e uso de linguagem de programação.

• Experiência com uso de linguagem de programação para banco de dados e automações, como Python, SQL ou similares.

• Experiência em uso de ferramentas de visualização como Tableau, Power BI, Looker Studio ou similares.

• Desejável experiência com fluxos e conteúdos ligados a operações logísticas, manufaturas e/ou supply chain.

• Inglês avançado

• Disponibilidade para atuar com base na zona sul de São Paulo no modelo híbrido (3x escritório)

Os benefícios de realocação não estão disponíveis para essa posição.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity:
Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers.

• As a Field Engineering Specialist, you will travel and showcase your expertise in technical repair and installation for Roche assigned product lines.

• You will offer valuable service to laboratory customers in your assigned territory.

• The role involves routine technical support, on-site service, repair, and installation of Roche products.

• You will serve as a customer contact for technical and service-related issues and perform preventative maintenance.

• The position requires diagnosing and resolving mechanical, hardware, software, and system failures.

• You will document all activities, contribute to quality improvement, and focus on maximizing customer satisfaction.

Who You Are:

• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or work experience are required.

• 5 years of progressive experience in repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking is necessary. Alternatively, a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field with 1-2 years of progressive experience will suffice.

• Successful completion of training or certification as defined by RD Services Leadership and policy is mandatory.

• The ability to travel, including overnight travel, is a requirement for this role.

Preferred Qualifications:

• 8+ years of progressive experience or a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field plus 4+ years of progressive experience are required.

• Advanced knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, information technology, and basic chemistry.

• The ability to serve as an internal technical resource, provide support after hours and on weekends/holidays, and maintain strong customer relationships is essential.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

This is a field-based role. The territory is within the San Diego area. Ideal candidate must reside in the territory.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of California is $71,000 and $132,000 of hiring range. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law . A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.
Benefits
*LI-MG1

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. At Roche, we thrive to deliver more benefits to our patients as part of our 10-year Pharma vision. An integral part to achieving this vision is to deliver new and innovative data analytics solutions to our scientists across Pharma Technical Operations (PT).

To do so, we have formed a new organization called PT Digital and Operational Excellence (PTE) with the aspiration to build industry-leading digital and lean operations across functions and our entire manufacturing footprint. PTE is the organization that catalyzes global development and execution of PT’s Digital and Operational Excellence strategy to enable PT to realize our performance promises. We build a strong cross-functional and inclusive community, put the power of data into the hands of our people, further develop the Lean and Digital skills across PT, and scale up our Digital and Advanced Analytics solutions, for the benefit of our colleagues and patients. We aim to activate data citizenship and digital mindset, revolutionize our FAIR data ecosystem and systems landscape, re-design excellent processes, and generate transformative insights.

The Opportunity

You will be responsible for driving the digital technology strategy through the delivery of key digital initiatives and use cases in the Quality domain and you take the role of an Agile Product Owner (PO) to partner with customers across PT functions to architect the planning (e.g. diagnose), execution (e.g. design & build), and sustainment of digital solutions to achieve the PT Digital Aspirations.

• Strategic Digital Transformation: Architecting key initiatives and acting as a digital translator between business needs and technical roles by navigating across both domains seamlessly.

• Impact: Defining impact aspirations (e.g. product vision, roadmap, value assessments, business cases) as well as leading deployment of a global solution in a function or site. Enable significant improvements in quality management processes through innovative digital solutions, confirmed through the measurement of key business metrics.

• Requirements Analysis: Utilize your broad Quality end to end Business understanding to perform detailed requirement analyses with the team, with a strong focus on balancing process requirements, stakeholder requirements with digital product simplicity, network scalability and sustainability.

• Prioritization and Team Setup: Conducting use case prioritization and assuming the product owner role to catalyze the implementation of key digital use cases. Coach teams that are developing and deploying digital use cases, e.g. share best practices, agile ways of working, backlog management, sprint planning and ensure full impact capture & coordination between different initiatives. Lead cross-functional project teams with digital experts and SMEs across multiple sites and time zones.

• Compliance and Solution Shaping: Facilitating compliant solutions for data and digital products in the GxP environment.

• Risk Assessment and Mitigation: Identify potential risks associated with digital quality initiatives and develop strategies to mitigate these risks.

• Innovation and Improvement: Continuously explore and assess emerging digital technologies and industry trends. Drive innovation and process improvements within the Quality domain to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.

jobs.title: Scientist II
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come.

Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

As an R&D Scientist in our NGS Library Preparation and Target Enrichment team, you will be a key player in executing sample preparation workflows . You will work within a dynamic environment dedicated to advancing molecular biology research and contributing to innovative development efforts . This is an opportunity to thrive in a collaborative team that values technical excellence and scientific curiosity .

The Opportunity

• Execute NGS library preparation from diverse sample types using various construction methods .

• Perform DNA and RNA extraction from biological samples, optimizing protocols for high yield and purity .

• Quantify nucleic acids accurately using instruments like Qubit and NanoDrop .

• Operate and troubleshoot sequencing platforms for routine laboratory runs .

• Conduct quality control for nucleic acids and libraries utilizing Agilent TapeStation .

• Maintain precise experimental records in laboratory notebooks and digital formats .

• Analyze experimental data to contribute to technical reports and team presentations .

• Collaborate with cross-functional team members on experimental design and troubleshooting .

Who you are

• You hold a Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Molecular Biology, Genetics, Biochemistry, or a related field .

• You possess 2-4 years of relevant laboratory experience, ideally within an industry setting .

• You have hands-on experience with NGS library preparation protocols such as DNA-seq or RNA-seq .

• You are proficient in PCR, nucleic acid extraction, and standard molecular biology techniques .

• You demonstrate strong critical thinking skills and meticulous attention to detail in a fast-paced environment .

Preferred

• Experience with advanced DNA QC instruments like Tapestation and Nanodrop .

• Strong interpersonal skills with a proven ability to work independently or as part of a collaborative team .

• Excellent organizational and time-management skills to meet project timelines .

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting .

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Pleasanton is 68 900,00 - 106 000,00 USD Annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.
Benefits

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an equal opportunity employer. It is our policy and practice to employ, promote, and otherwise treat any and all employees and applicants on the basis of merit, qual

The Position
The Opportunity:
Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers.

• As a Field Engineering Specialist, you will travel and showcase your expertise in technical repair and installation for Roche assigned product lines.

• You will offer valuable service to laboratory customers in your assigned territory.

• The role involves routine technical support, on-site service, repair, and installation of Roche products.

• You will serve as a customer contact for technical and service-related issues and perform preventative maintenance.

• The position requires diagnosing and resolving mechanical, hardware, software, and system failures.

• You will document all activities, contribute to quality improvement, and focus on maximizing customer satisfaction.

Who You Are:

• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or work experience are required.

• 5 years of progressive experience in repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking is necessary. Alternatively, a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field with 1-2 years of progressive experience will suffice.

• Successful completion of training or certification as defined by RD Services Leadership and policy is mandatory.

• The ability to travel, including overnight travel, is a requirement for this role.

Preferred Qualifications:

• 8+ years of progressive experience or a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field plus 4+ years of progressive experience are required.

• Advanced knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, information technology, and basic chemistry.

• The ability to serve as an internal technical resource, provide support after hours and on weekends/holidays, and maintain strong customer relationships is essential.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

This is a field-based role. The territory is within the San Francisco peninsula, East Bay & South Bay areas, or within the Vacaville/Fairfield area. Ideal candidate must reside in the territory.

jobs.title: Regulatory Affairs Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

At Roche Global Regulatory Affairs we strive to be the world's best Regulatory organization, championing patient access to the world's best diagnostics. Our team is tasked with regulatory projects as well as overarching regulatory topics with specific focus in systems and software including hardware-software instrument systems. This role will specifically support our Sequencing portfolio in our Molecular Customer Area. You can expect an open-minded work environment, where you will be working closely with colleagues in other departments and other counties.

The Opportunity

• You oversee regulatory document and submission compilation, which includes the development of submission/product registration dossiers of more complex products/programs. You develop and manage parts of comprehensive global regulatory submissions and registration plans. Specifically, you bring knowledge of USFDA regulations including Research Use Only (RUO) and IVD marketing pathways.

• You interface with external management. You understand the structure, key roles and responsibilities of external customers/stakeholders and communicate timely and effectively the needs of external customers/stakeholders. You build effective and enduring external relationships and apply effective stakeholder management practices. You contribute to audits by supporting preparation, execution and follow up.

• You lead the organization to adapt to the evolving regulatory environment and requirements. You have an understanding of external environmental changes, precedents, to navigate complex situations and influence strategies and decision making. You have the ability to interpret and apply understanding of the regulators' thinking to projects and apply strategies to the different needs of different regions without significant guidance. You proactively create unique/innovative regulatory strategies and influencing approaches to avoid regulatory obstacles and accelerate world wide approvals.

• You effectively partner with end influence stakeholders to understand and provide best solutions. You take initiative to address problems or opportunities and involve collaborators for best solutions. You develop relationships that significantly influence the current and future direction for Roche and our products.

• You have courage to make decisions even outside of scope/comfort zone and proactively initiate activities independently. You embrace good decision making principles.

• You model VAAC Leadership and agility. You identify opportunities to develop VACC competency. You act with integrity, courage, passion and honor commitments and contribute to an inclusive environment which supports all dimensions of diversity.

• You are able to pull people together around a common goal and seek to understand and build on different perspectives to enhance outcomes. You address and resolve conflict by creating an atmosphere of openness and trust. You bring out the best in people and teams.

Who you are

• You have a Bachelor’s / Master degree in Life Science, Data Science or related subject or equivalent experience. Advanced degree preferred.

• You have 3-5 years experience with PhD degree, 5-7 with Masters degree and 6-8 years with Bachelor degree in t

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. A Roche Global Regulatory Gli affari che ci sforziamo di essere la migliore organizzazione regolamentare del mondo, sostenendo l'accesso dei pazienti alla migliore diagnostica del mondo. Il nostro team è incaricato di progetti normativi e di supervisionare argomenti normativi con particolare attenzione nei sistemi e software, compresi i sistemi di strumenti hardware-software. Questo ruolo sosterrà in modo specifico il nostro portafoglio di Sequencing nel nostro Area Clienti Molecolari. Puoi aspettarti un ambiente di lavoro aperto, dove lavorerai a stretto contatto con colleghi di altri dipartimenti e altre contee. Opportunità - Si supervisiona il documento di regolamentazione e la compilazione di presentazione, che include lo sviluppo di presentazione/documenti di registrazione dei prodotti/programmi più complessi. Sviluppi e gestisci parti di presentazioni globali e piani di registrazione. In particolare, si porta la conoscenza delle normative USFDA, tra cui solo i percorsi di ricerca (RUO) e IVD marketing. - Si interfaccia con la gestione esterna. Comprendete la struttura, i ruoli chiave e le responsabilità dei clienti/stakeholder esterni e comunicate tempestivamente ed efficacemente le esigenze dei clienti/stakeholder esterni. Costruisci relazioni esterne efficaci e durature e applichi pratiche efficaci di gestione degli stakeholder. Contribuisci agli audit sostenendo la preparazione, l'esecuzione e il follow-up. - Lei guida l'organizzazione per adattarsi all'ambiente e ai requisiti normativi in evoluzione. Hai una comprensione dei cambiamenti ambientali esterni, dei precedenti, per navigare situazioni complesse e influenzare strategie e processi decisionali. Hai la capacità di interpretare e applicare la comprensione del pensiero dei regolatori ai progetti e applicare strategie alle diverse esigenze delle diverse regioni senza una guida significativa. Proattivamente crei strategie di regolazione uniche/innovative e influenza gli approcci per evitare ostacoli normativi e accelerare le approvazioni mondiali. - Lei collabora efficacemente con gli stakeholder di influenza finale per capire e fornire le migliori soluzioni. Si prende l'iniziativa di affrontare problemi o opportunità e coinvolgere collaboratori per le migliori soluzioni. Si sviluppano relazioni che influenzano significativamente la direzione attuale e futura per Roche e i nostri prodotti. - Hai il coraggio di prendere decisioni anche al di fuori del campo di applicazione / zona di sforzo e avviare proattivamente attività indipendentemente. Abbraccia i buoni principi decisionali. - Modelli la leadership VAAC e l'agilità. Identifichi le opportunità per sviluppare la competenza VACC. Agite con impegno di integrità, coraggio, passione e onore e contribuite a un ambiente inclusivo che supporta tutte le dimensioni della diversità. - Siete in grado di riunire le persone intorno a un obiettivo comune e cercare di capire e costruire su prospettive diverse per migliorare i risultati. Si affronta e risolve il conflitto creando un'atmosfera di apertura e fiducia. Porti fuori il meglio nelle persone e nelle squadre. Chi sei? - Hai una laurea / Master in Scienze della Vita, Scienza dei dati o soggetto correlato o esperienza equivalente. Grado avanzato preferito. - Hai 3-5 anni di esperienza con dottorato di ricerca, 5-7 con master e 6-8 anni con laurea in t

descriptionByLocale.fr: Descrizione Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. Ce rôle soutiendra spécifiquement notre portefeuille de séquence dans notre Espace Client Molecular. Vous pouvez vous attendre à un environnement de travail ouvert d'esprit, où vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec des collègues d'autres départements et d'autres comtés. Plus précisément, vous apportez des connaissances sur la réglementation de l'USFDA, y compris les voies de marketing de l'utilisation de la recherche seulement (RUO) et de la DIV. - Vous interagissez avec la gestion externe. Vous prenez l'initiative d'aborder les problèmes ou les possibilités et de faire appel à des collaborateurs pour trouver les meilleures solutions. Vous développez des relations qui influencent considérablement l'orientation actuelle et future de Roche et de nos produits. - Vous avez le courage de prendre des décisions même en dehors de la zone de champ d'application/de confort et de lancer des activités de manière proactive indépendamment. Vous adoptez de bons principes décisionnels. - Vous modélisez le leadership et l'agilité. Vous identifiez les occasions de développer les compétences de VACC. Vous agissez avec intégrité, courage, passion et respect des engagements et contribuez à un environnement inclusif qui soutient toutes les dimensions de la diversité. - Vous êtes en mesure de rassembler les gens autour d'un objectif commun et de chercher à comprendre et à construire sur différentes perspectives pour améliorer les résultats. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity:

As a Cash Applications & Accounts Receivable Accountant based in San José, Costa Rica, you will be a key driver of financial accuracy within the Roche Services Americas team. This center provides critical Finance and Procurement services to various countries across the Americas region. Your primary mission is to ensure that all incoming payments are identified, matched, and applied to customer accounts with precision, effectively "closing the loop" on the Invoice-to-Cash cycle.

Key Responsibilities:

• Cash Application: Execute daily posting of incoming payments (Wire, ACH, Checks) and accurately match remittances to customer invoices.

• Reconciliation: Manage bank account reconciliations and clear AR/bank suspense accounts to ensure zero unexplained variances.

• Operational AR: Handle manual invoicing, corrections, and customer credit analysis to support regional financial health.

• Dispute Management: Identify and code payment discrepancies (short-pays/over-payments) and resolve inquiries from affiliates and customers.

• Process Improvement: Propose automation and system enhancements (SAP/BlackLine) to improve "auto-match" rates and SSC efficiency.

Who You Are:
You are a detail-oriented professional with a strong understanding of accounting flows and a commitment to high-integrity financial reporting.

Qualifications:

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration or related field .

• Experience: 3+ years in Finance/Accounting; Shared Services experience is a plus.

• Technical Skills: Proficiency in SAP, BlackLine , or similar ERPs, and advanced Excel/G-Suite skills.

• Languages: Intermediate Portuguese is required for the role. Intermediate English is required for the role.

• Competencies: Strong ability to prioritize under tight deadlines and a focus on proactive problem-solving.

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As the Inclusion & Belonging (I&B) Country Partner, you will be a strategic leader responsible for the localized execution and measurable impact of our I&B Strategy. You will partner with senior leaders to translate enterprise standards into meaningful local initiatives, ensuring an inclusive culture is deeply woven into our daily business outcomes. This is a unique opportunity to champion a culture of belonging while holding local leadership accountable for sustainable, inclusive progress.

The Opportunity

• Lead the implementation of the I&B and divisional strategies within your designated country.

• Partner with local senior leaders to strengthen I&B within business units, linking it directly to specific strategic priorities.

• Equip leaders with practical tools and resources to achieve measurable outcomes through tailored KPIs and metrics.

• Provide thought leadership and expertise, ensuring I&B is linked to the local business strategy in areas of greatest impact.

• Diagnose evolving local needs by listening to the organization and developing proactive, localized interventions.

• Serve as an executive coach to senior leaders, building I&B capability and mentoring colleagues across the country.

• Manage resource allocation and prioritization, making strategic trade-offs regarding budget and capacity.

• Embed I&B behaviors into the local organizational culture so they become part of both strategic and daily employee experiences.

Who You Are
You are a visionary leader who understands that inclusion is a driver of culture change and employee engagement. You thrive in international environments and possess the cultural intelligence needed to translate global strategy into local reality.

To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Influence Strategically: Partner directly with senior division leaders to actively shape their people agenda.

• Mobilize Communities: Activate the organization and drive matrixed resources without needing direct authority.

• Deliver Tangible Impact: Move past the "theory" of I&B and deliver concrete, measurable results that empower the business.

• Extensive Leadership Experience: Over 10 years of experience in I&B or a related field, with a significant focus on leading the agenda at a country level.

• Strategic & Data-Driven Mindset: A proven ability to demonstrate ROI by linking data to business outcomes and using insights to drive recommendations.

• Executive Influence: Outstanding skills in collaborating with and influencing management at all levels, including securing commitment for major initiatives.

• International Acumen: Deep understanding of the cultural, social, and economic dynamics within international markets.

• Change Management Expertise: Experience transforming how an organization relates to I&B and integrating these practices into people processes.

• Language Skills: Full professional proficiency in both Chinese and English (written and spoken) is required to effectively partner with local and global stakeholders.
