descriptionByLocale.de: Beschreibung Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Wir sind Roche, verpflichtet, die Wissenschaft voranzubringen, damit wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Unser Team von Global Pharma Strategy (GPS) ist das Herzstück von Pharma, das den Rhythmus für Pharma festlegt – die strategische Ausrichtung von Roche zu prägen und sicherzustellen, dass unser Portfolio weltweit sinnvolle Innovationen für Patienten liefert. Durch die Integration von wissenschaftlichen, kommerziellen und Markteinblicken treibt GPS unternehmensweite Strategie, Portfoliopriorisierung und Unternehmensmodellinnovation an, um Roches Führung in der sich entwickelnden Gesundheitslandschaft voranzubringen. Im Rahmen des Portfolio-, Strategie- und Insights (PSI)-Teams im GPS-Bereich werden Sie als strategischer Denkpartner und vertrauenswürdiger Berater tätig sein, der das Produkt, den Krankheitsbereich, die Pharma- und die Unternehmensstrategie von Roche leitet. Das PSI-Team, bestehend aus Advanced Analytics for Business Insights (AABI), Competitive Intelligence, Ecosystem Insights (EI), Partnering Commercial Assessment Leads und Pharma Portfolio & Strategy, bietet konsistente, gezielte und technologiefähige Erkenntnisse, die die Qualitätsentscheidungsfindung im gesamten Unternehmen vorantreiben und unvoreingenommene, fachkundig kuratierte Intelligenz bereitstellen, um Lifecycle Management, Commercialization Excellence und Portfoliostrategien zu informieren. Das Global Ecosystem Insights (EI)-Team sucht nach einem Beyond Therapeutic Area (TA) Market Insights Leader, der uns bei der Gestaltung der Pharma-Strategie von Roche durch Markt-, Portfolio- und kundenzentrierte Erkenntnisse beitritt. Diese Rolle fungiert als interner Berater und Stratege und arbeitet mit kommerziellen und funktionsübergreifenden Führungskräften zusammen, um Erkenntnisse zu generieren, die sich auf Therapeutische Bereiche erstrecken und Cross-Portfolio-Entscheidungen formen. Die Chance Der Beyond TA Market Insights Leader ist für die operative Abwicklung branchenführender Methoden in der Primär- und Sekundärmarktforschung verantwortlich, um strategische Entscheidungen zu leiten. In dieser Rolle werden Sie innovative Projekte und Workstreams leiten, die neue Methoden wegweisen, neue Technologien anwenden und Analysen erstellen, die Entwicklung und kommerzielle Strategie prägen. Sie werden in EI und anderen PSI-Teams umfassend zusammenarbeiten, um das Engagement, die Embed-Erweiterungen zu fördern und den vollen Wert der entwickelten Lösungen zu realisieren. Sie navigieren eine komplexe globale Matrix, um funktionsübergreifende Partner rund um wirkungsstarke, einsichtsorientierte Lieferungen auszurichten. Sie werden dem EI Beyond TA Enabling Leader melden. Mansion - Insights Excellence: Erhöhen Sie die Qualität und Wirkung von EI-Leistungen durch die Förderung von Forschungspraktiken in Primär- und Sekundärquellen. Sie stellen sicher, dass unsere Forschung in bester Klasse bleibt, indem Sie hocheffiziente Methoden und Tools implementieren, die Einblicke ermöglichen, strategische Geschäftsentscheidungen direkt zu informieren und zu beschleunigen. - Zukunftsbereite Roadmap: Entwerfen und führen Sie eine mehrjährige Roadmap zur Entwicklung von Primary Market Research und sekundären Erkenntnissen. Sie führen Piloten für innovative Forschungsmotoren und skalieren erfolgreiche Methoden weltweit, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere Einsichtsinfrastruktur agil, skalierbar und vor Branchentrends ist. - Cross-Portfolio-Einsichten: Führen Sie die Generierung strategischer Erkenntnisse zu Themen mit Multi-TA-Wirkung, wie Digital Health, Drug Delivery und Next-Generation-Marketing-Modellen. Sie verbinden die Punkte über das Portfolio, um den Geschäftswert zu entsperren - Upskilling and Training: Definieren Sie den Goldstandard für Marktforschung innerhalb der EI. Sie entwerfen und liefern einen umfassenden Lehrplan, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere Fähigkeiten branchenführend und zukunftssicher bleiben - Strategischer Anbieter und Compliance-Übersicht Contattoo (Non fornito)
descriptionByLocale.fr: Descrizione Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Nous sommes Roche, engagés à faire avancer la science afin que nous ayons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. Notre équipe de Global Pharma Strategy (GPS) est le cœur de Pharma, fixant le rythme de Pharma — façonnant l'orientation stratégique de Roche, assurant notre portefeuille offre une innovation significative aux patients du monde entier. En intégrant les connaissances scientifiques, commerciales et commerciales, le GPS stimule la stratégie à l'échelle de l'entreprise, la priorisation des portefeuilles et l'innovation de modèles d'affaires pour faire progresser Roches dans le paysage des soins de santé en évolution. Dans le cadre de l'équipe Portefeuille, Stratégie et Perspectives (PSI) au sein du GPS, vous servirez de partenaire de réflexion stratégique et de conseiller de confiance, guidant Roches produit, domaine de la maladie, pharmaceutique et stratégie d'entreprise. L'équipe de l'ISP, composée de Advanced Analytics for Business Insights (AABI), Competitive Intelligence, Ecosystem Insights (EI), Partnering Commercial Assessment Leads, et Pharma Portfolio & Strategy, fournit des informations cohérentes, ciblées et axées sur la technologie qui stimulent la prise de décisions de qualité dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise, fournissant des renseignements impartiaux et spécialisés pour éclairer la gestion du cycle de vie, l'excellence en matière de commercialisation et les stratégies de portefeuille. L'équipe de Global Ecosystem Insights (EI) est à la recherche d'un chef de file de l'Espace Thérapeutique (TA) pour se joindre à nous pour façonner la stratégie Pharma de Roche par le biais de perspectives axées sur le marché, le portefeuille et la clientèle. Ce rôle joue le rôle de consultant et de stratège interne, en partenariat avec des leaders commerciaux et interfonctionnels pour générer des idées qui couvrent les domaines thérapeutiques et façonner les décisions interportfolio. L'opportunité Au-delà de l'AT Market Insights Leader est chargé de rendre opérationnelles les méthodes de pointe de l'industrie dans les études de marché primaires et secondaires pour guider les décisions stratégiques. Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez des projets innovateurs et des flux de travail qui sont les pionniers de nouvelles méthodologies, appliqueront de nouvelles technologies et créeront des analyses qui façonneront le développement et la stratégie commerciale. Vous travaillerez en partenariat avec les équipes de l'IE et d'autres PSI pour stimuler l'engagement, intégrer des améliorations et réaliser la pleine valeur des solutions développées. Vous naviguerez sur une matrice mondiale complexe pour aligner les partenaires interfonctionnels autour de produits livrables à impact élevé et axés sur les idées. Vous ferez rapport à l'IE au-delà du chef habilitant de l'AT. Mansioni - Insights excellence: Accroître la qualité et l'impact des produits livrables de l'AE en faisant progresser les pratiques de recherche dans les sources primaires et secondaires. Vous veillerez à ce que nos recherches demeurent les meilleures en classe en mettant en oeuvre des méthodologies et des outils à impact élevé qui permettent d'éclairer et d'accélérer directement les décisions stratégiques. - Feuille de route prête pour l'avenir : Concevoir et exécuter une feuille de route pluriannuelle pour faire évoluer la recherche sur les marchés primaires et les capacités secondaires de connaissances. Vous dirigerez des projets pilotes pour des moteurs de recherche innovants et des méthodologies efficaces à l'échelle mondiale, en veillant à ce que notre infrastructure d'information soit agile, évolutive et devant les tendances de l'industrie. - Perspectives transversales : Diriger la production de perspectives stratégiques sur des thèmes ayant un impact multi-TA, tels que la santé numérique, la prestation de médicaments et les modèles de commercialisation de la prochaine génération. Vous connecterez les points à travers le portefeuille pour débloquer la valeur de l'entreprise - Améliorer les compétences et la formation : Définir la norme d'or pour les études de marché au sein de l'IE. Vous allez concevoir et fournir un programme d'études complet pour assurer que nos capacités restent leader de l'industrie et la preuve future - Surveillance stratégique des fournisseurs et de la conformité Contatto (Non fornito)

The Opportunity

The Beyond TA Insights Product Enablement Leader is responsible for harnessing next-gen AI and digital solutions in Primary Market Research, secondary data sources, and forecasting to deliver superior quality insights with increased speed and cost-efficiency. You will navigate a complex global matrix to align cross-functional partners around high-impact, insight-driven deliverables. You will report to the EI Beyond TA Enabling Leader.

Focus areas and responsibilities

• AI capability building: Establish the framework for integrating Artificial Intelligence and advanced analytics into the core of Primary Market Research, secondary insights, and forecasting. descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Siamo Roche, impegnati a promuovere la scienza in modo che tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Il nostro team Global Pharma Strategy (GPS) è il battito cardiaco di Pharma, impostando il ritmo per Pharma - modellando la direzione strategica di Roche, assicurando che il nostro portafoglio offre innovazione significativa ai pazienti in tutto il mondo. Integrando intuizioni scientifiche, commerciali e di mercato, il GPS guida la strategia aziendale, la priorità del portafoglio e l’innovazione del modello di business per far progredire la leadership di Roche nel panorama sanitario in evoluzione. Nell'ambito del team Portfolio, Strategy e Insights (PSI) all'interno del GPS, servirai come partner di pensiero strategico e consulente di fiducia, guidando il prodotto di Roche, l'area malattia, la farmaco e la strategia aziendale. Il team PSI, composto da Advanced Analytics for Business Insights (AABI), Competitive Intelligence, Ecosystem Insights (EI), Partnering Commercial Assessment Leads, and Pharma Portfolio & Strategy, offre intuizioni coerenti, mirate e tecnologicamente abilitate che guidano il processo decisionale di qualità in tutta l'azienda, fornendo informazioni imparziali e curate per informare la gestione del ciclo di vita, l'eccellenza della commercializzazione e le strategie di portafoglio. Il team Global Ecosystem Insights (EI) sta cercando un Beyond Therapeutic Area (TA) Insights Product Enablement Leader per unirsi a noi nella definizione della strategia di Roche Pharma attraverso il mercato, il portafoglio e le intuizioni customer-centric. Questo ruolo funziona come consulente interno e stratega, collaborando con leader commerciali e cross-funzionali per generare intuizioni che abbracciano Aree terapeutiche e modellano le decisioni cross-portfolio. L'opportunità The Beyond TA Insights Product Enablement Leader è responsabile dell'imbragatura di soluzioni AI e digitali di prossima generazione in Primary Market Research, fonti di dati secondarie e della previsione per fornire informazioni di qualità superiori con maggiore velocità e efficienza dei costi. In questo ruolo, guiderai progetti innovativi e flussi di lavoro che pionierizzano nuove metodologie, applichino nuove tecnologie e creeranno analisi che modellano lo sviluppo e la strategia commerciale. Potrai collaborare ampiamente all'interno di EI e altri team PSI, tra cui ABBI per guidare il coinvolgimento, incorporare miglioramenti, e realizzare il pieno valore delle soluzioni sviluppate. Potrai navigare in una matrice globale complessa per allineare i partner interfunzionali intorno ai prodotti ad alto impatto e orientati agli insight. Ti riferirai all'EI Beyond TA Eable Leader. Aree di messa a fuoco e responsabilità
• Realizzazione delle capacità di AI: Stabilire il quadro per integrare l'Intelligenza Artificiale e l'analisi avanzata nel nucleo della Ricerca di Mercato Primario, intuizioni secondarie e previsioni. Si metterà in atto approcci tecno-agmentati che sbloccano intuizioni e creano un vantaggio competitivo distinta per i nostri TA
• Ottimizzazione dei processi: semplifica i flussi di lavoro attraverso soluzioni tecnologiche. Permetterai al team di ruotare dall'analisi dei dati alla consulenza strategica, garantendo attenzione alle sfide aziendali di maggior valore
• Integrazione della soluzione: Identificare, pilotare, distribuire e gestire una suite di soluzioni tecnologiche interne ed esterne. Potrai collaborare con AABI per curare l'Ecosystem Tool Stack, tra cui GenAI e piattaforme di sintesi, per fornire informazioni di alta qualità più veloce e più conveniente
• Flusso di lavoro: guidare l'adozione di nuove tecnologie, colmare il divario tra capacità tecniche e flussi di lavoro di ricerca giornalieri. Ti assicurerai che l'IA e gli strumenti digitali non siano solo implementati, ma profondamente integrati

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are Roche, committed to advancing science so that we all have more time with the people we love.

Our Global Pharma Strategy (GPS) team is the heartbeat of Pharma, setting the rhythm for Pharma — shaping Roche’s strategic direction, ensuring our portfolio delivers meaningful innovation to patients worldwide. By integrating scientific, commercial, and market insights, GPS drives enterprise-wide strategy, portfolio prioritization, and business model innovation to advance Roche’s leadership in the evolving healthcare landscape.

As part of the Portfolio, Strategy, and Insights (PSI) team within GPS, you will serve as a strategic thought partner and trusted advisor, guiding Roche’s product, disease area, pharma, and corporate strategy. The PSI team, composed of Advanced Analytics for Business Insights (AABI), Competitive Intelligence, Ecosystem Insights (EI), Partnering Commercial Assessment Leads, and Pharma Portfolio & Strategy, delivers consistent, targeted, and technology-enabled insights that drive quality decision-making across the enterprise, providing unbiased, expertly curated intelligence to inform lifecycle management, commercialization excellence, and portfolio strategies.

The Global Ecosystem Insights (EI) team is looking for a Beyond Therapeutic Area (TA) Portfolio Insights Leader to join us in shaping Roche's Pharma strategy through market, portfolio and customer-centric insights. This role functions as an internal consultant and strategist, partnering with commercial and cross-functional leaders to generate insights that span Therapeutic Areas and shape cross-portfolio decisions.

The Opportunity

The Beyond TA Portfolio Insights Leader is responsible for analyzing the Global Pharma portfolio to evaluate commercial attributes, identify risks/opportunities, anticipate impact of landscape shifts and shape strategic decisions. You will partner extensively within EI and other PSI teams to develop insights and realize the full value of recommendations generated. You will navigate a complex global matrix to align cross-functional partners around high-impact, insight-driven deliverables. You will report to the EI Beyond TA Enabling Leader.

Focus areas and responsibilities

• Strategic modeling & analytics: Develop sophisticated analytical frameworks and models used to evaluate the global portfolio and inform long-term planning. You will provide a quantitative commercial foundation for commercialization and R&D strategic decisions, ensuring recommendations are rooted in robust data and contextualized for business impact

• Market trend synthesis: Evaluate diverse data sources to identify emerging trends and shifts in the healthcare landscape. You will lead the development of cohesive "outside-in" perspectives that inform how we navigate an evolving competitive environment

• Performance evaluation and risk mitigation: Assess cross-portfolio performance to identify high-potential growth drivers and critical trade-offs. You will highlight potential gaps in the collective strategy and recommend interventions to strengthen our portfolio position

• Decision Support: Act as a specialist consultant for strategy projects, translating complex portfolio analytics into concise, high-impact recommendations. You will serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, turning technical complexity into clear, actionable business strategies

• Unified portfolio narrative: Integrate individual Therapeutic Area insights into a single, cohesive "Beyond TA"

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Siamo Roche, impegnati a promuovere la scienza in modo che tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Il nostro team Global Pharma Strategy (GPS) è il battito cardiaco di Pharma, impostando il ritmo per Pharma - modellando la direzione strategica di Roche, assicurando che il nostro portafoglio offre innovazione significativa ai pazienti in tutto il mondo. Integrando intuizioni scientifiche, commerciali e di mercato, il GPS guida la strategia aziendale, la priorità del portafoglio e l’innovazione del modello di business per far progredire la leadership di Roche nel panorama sanitario in evoluzione. Nell'ambito del team Portfolio, Strategy e Insights (PSI) all'interno del GPS, servirai come partner di pensiero strategico e consulente di fiducia, guidando il prodotto di Roche, l'area malattia, la farmaco e la strategia aziendale. Il team PSI, composto da Advanced Analytics for Business Insights (AABI), Competitive Intelligence, Ecosystem Insights (EI), Partnering Commercial Assessment Leads, and Pharma Portfolio & Strategy, offre intuizioni coerenti, mirate e tecnologicamente abilitate che guidano il processo decisionale di qualità in tutta l'azienda, fornendo informazioni imparziali e curate per informare la gestione del ciclo di vita, l'eccellenza della commercializzazione e le strategie di portafoglio. Il team Global Ecosystem Insights (EI) sta cercando un Beyond Therapeutic Area (TA) Portfolio Insights Leader per unirsi a noi nella definizione della strategia di Roche Pharma attraverso il mercato, il portafoglio e le intuizioni customer-centric. Questo ruolo funziona come consulente interno e stratega, collaborando con leader commerciali e cross-funzionali per generare intuizioni che abbracciano Aree terapeutiche e modellano le decisioni cross-portfolio. L'opportunità The Beyond TA Portfolio Insights Leader è responsabile dell'analisi del portafoglio di Global Pharma per valutare gli attributi commerciali, identificare i rischi / opportunità, anticipare l'impatto dei cambiamenti del paesaggio e modellare le decisioni strategiche. Potrai collaborare ampiamente all'interno di EI e altri team PSI per sviluppare intuizioni e realizzare il valore completo delle raccomandazioni generate. Potrai navigare in una matrice globale complessa per allineare i partner interfunzionali intorno ai prodotti ad alto impatto e orientati agli insight. Ti riferirai all'EI Beyond TA Eable Leader. Aree di messa a fuoco e responsabilità
• Modellazione strategica e analisi: sviluppare sofisticati framework analitici e modelli utilizzati per valutare il portafoglio globale e informare la pianificazione a lungo termine. Fornirai una base commerciale quantitativa per la commercializzazione e le decisioni strategiche R&D, assicurando che le raccomandazioni siano radicate in dati robusti e contestualizzate per l'impatto aziendale
• Sintesi della tendenza di mercato: Valutare diverse fonti di dati per identificare le tendenze e i cambiamenti emergenti nel panorama sanitario. Potrai condurre lo sviluppo di prospettive coessive "outside-in" che informano come navighiamo un ambiente competitivo in evoluzione
• Valutazione delle prestazioni e mitigazione dei rischi: Valuta le prestazioni cross-portfolio per identificare i driver di crescita ad alto potenziale e i trade-off critici. Si evidenziano potenziali lacune nella strategia collettiva e raccomanda interventi per rafforzare la nostra posizione di portafoglio
• Sostegno alla decisione: agire come consulente specializzato per progetti di strategia, tradurre analisi complesse del portafoglio in raccomandazioni concise e ad alto impatto. Potrai servire come consulente di fiducia per la leadership senior, trasformando la complessità tecnica in strategie aziendali chiare e attuabili
• Una narrazione di portafoglio unificato: Integra le informazioni individuali dell'Area terapeutica in un singolo, coesivo "oltre il TA"

The Position

The Global Supply Chain and Product Strategy Organization (PTS) seamlessly connects markets to the global manufacturing network by managing inventory, supply, and replenishment planning. We orchestrate the value streams between sites and affiliates by balancing demand and supply, and ensure right-first-time order fulfillment and delivery of medicines across the global network. In addition, we are also accountable for product strategies, leading in the design of products and supply chains in line with go-to-market strategies and ensuring the health of our products.

The Supply Chain Insights and Performance organization within PTS is established to drive enterprise-wide orchestration, benchmark best practices, and accelerate performance optimization across our end-to-end value streams. La posizione La Global Supply Chain and Product Strategy Organization (PTS) collega senza soluzione di continuità i mercati alla rete di produzione globale, gestendo la pianificazione dell'inventario, dell'offerta e del rifornimento. Organizziamo i flussi di valore tra i siti e le affiliate bilanciando la domanda e l'offerta, e garantiamo il corretto adempimento dell'ordine e la consegna dei farmaci attraverso la rete globale. Inoltre, siamo anche responsabili per le strategie di prodotto, leader nella progettazione di prodotti e catene di fornitura in linea con strategie di go-to-market e garantire la salute dei nostri prodotti. Siamo un'organizzazione agile con chiare responsabilità e una cultura orientata allo scopo che è costruita sulla fiducia e sulla collaborazione, dove le persone sono ispirate a creare soluzioni e sviluppare le capacità necessarie per fornire la nostra missione. L'organizzazione Supply Chain Insights and Performance all'interno di PTS è fondata per guidare l'orchestrazione a livello aziendale, le migliori pratiche di benchmark e accelerare l'ottimizzazione delle prestazioni attraverso i nostri flussi di valore end-to-end. Operando come pilastro centrale all'interno di questo dipartimento, il team di Supply Chain Excellence si concentra sull'integrazione di una cultura permanente del miglioramento continuo, del processo decisionale basato sui dati e della creazione di capacità organizzative. L'opportunità Come lead di eccellenza della supply chain, si riferirà direttamente al capo di eccellenza della supply chain. In questo ruolo, si agirà come agente di cambiamento chiave, identificare le sfide operative e implementare miglioramenti sostenibili e ad alto impatto sulla supply chain globale. Le tue responsabilità specifiche includono:
• Proseguire iniziative di miglioramento continuo e guidare l'efficienza operativa attraverso processi di supply chain end-to-end utilizzando metodologie Lean e Six Sigma.
• Promuovere una cultura del miglioramento continuo e dell'apprendimento, mentre l'orchestrazione di capacità operative di eccellenza costruzione attraverso la supply chain.
• Identificare e privilegiare le opportunità di miglioramento, le principali iniziative di performance aziendali utilizzando il framework DMAIC, e incorporando tali miglioramenti in modo pulito nei processi e sistemi della supply chain.
• Sviluppare e implementare i KPI della supply chain per misurare e controllare le prestazioni in vari livelli di report, definendo una chiara responsabilitÃ in collaborazione con i proprietari di Business Capability.
• Utilizzare il pensiero end-to-end del sistema per catturare, integrare e analizzare i dati per l'ottimizzazione dei processi e delle prestazioni.
• Valutare e interpretare continuamente le variabili interne ed esterne che influiscono sulle prestazioni della supply chain, identificare e implementare sistemi e tecnologie appropriati per raggiungere gli obiettivi.
• Sviluppare e implementare regole, procedure e politiche aziendali per garantire prestazioni operative costanti e gestire in modo proattivo i rischi.

titleByLocale.it: Engagement Marketing Manager - Oncologia e Nefrologia

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Engagement Marketing Manager – Oncology & Nephrology
Roche Nederland B.V. – Woerden

Ben jij op zoek naar een nieuwe uitdaging op het vlak van omnichannel marketing in een leuk team van marketing & digital professionals? Ben jij een expert in marketingexecutie die energie krijgt van het vertalen van strategie naar tastbare impact? Bij Roche Nederland werk je in een agile omgeving aan onze missie: de beste zorg voor de patiënt in Nederland.

Functieomschrijving
Als Engagement Marketing Manager maak je deel uit van het Marketing & Digital Team en ben je de regisseur van onze marketingplannen. Je slaat de brug tussen strategie en uitvoering voor de teams Oncologie en Nefrologie & Reumatologie. Door slimme omnichannel-campagnes (zowel fysiek als digitaal) te lanceren en de impact daarvan direct te meten, optimaliseer je de klantervaring. Jouw doel? Met een mix van creativiteit en een resultaatgerichte mindset zet jij je in voor de beste zorgoplossingen voor de patiënt, de zorgverlener en Roche.

Wat ga je doen?

• Omnichannel Orchestratie : Je ontwerpt en optimaliseert de klanten-touchpoint-journey, waarbij je persoonlijke en niet-persoonlijke interacties integreert om onze klanten te overtuigen van de waarde van onze geneesmiddelen voor oncologie en nefrologie en reumatologie.

• Tactische Executie: Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de volledige 'pull-through' van het omnichannel marketingplan, inclusief de ontwikkeling van gepersonaliseerde content op basis van diepe klantinzichten.

• Content & Campaign Management : In afstemming met ons digital team creëer je impactvolle content die aansluit bij de klanten touchpoint-journey, waarbij je zorgt voor een snelle en compliant marktintroductie via o.a. Veeva PromoMats, rekening houdend met CGR.

• Impactmeting & Optimalisatie: Je kiest en monitort KPI’s en analyseert de effectiviteit van campagnes om datagedreven beslissingen te nemen en lopende tactieken continu te verbeteren.

• Cross-functionele samenwerking: Je werkt nauw samen met collega's van onder andere Medical, Access en Customer Engagement om ervoor te zorgen dat tactieken naadloos aansluiten op de behoeften in het regionale ecosysteem.

• Financieel Beheer: Je draagt bij aan het beheer van het marketingbudget en waarborgt een sterke financiële verantwoording van de uitgevoerde initiatieven.

Wat breng je mee?

• Ervaring: Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in digital/non-digital marketing binnen de farmaceutische industrie. Ervaring in een fieldfunctie is een plus.

• Omnichannel Expertise : Een diepgaande kennis van het executeren van omnichannel campagnes, meten van impact en het vertalen van strategie naar implementatie van taktieken.

• Data-gedrevenheid: Bewezen kennis en kunde in het faciliteren en nemen van beslissingen op basis van data en inzichten op tactisch en uitvoerend niveau.

• Technische & Analytische vaardigheden: Geavanceerde kennis van CRM-systemen (zoals Veeva/Salesforce), marketing automation, digitale tools en AI-oplossingen voor marketing.

• Mindset: Je hebt een passie voor digitale en persoonlijke interactie met onze klanten, een ondernemende 'can-do' mentaliteit, plezier in executie, een sterke focus op de klantervaring en het meten van impact plus het vermogen om te gedijen in een dynamische, agile- cross functionele omgeving.

• Opleiding & Taal: Een afgeronde HBO- of universitaire opleiding (bijv. Business of Science) en uitstekende beheersing van het Nederlands en Engels bij het schrijven van teksten.

Waarom Roche?

Je slaat de brug tussen strategie en uitvoering voor de teams Oncologie en Nefrologie & Reumatologie. Door slimme omnichannel-campagnes (zowel fysiek als digitaal) te lanceren en de impact daarvan direct te meten, optimaliseer je de klantervaring. Jouw doel? Met een mix van creativiteit en een resultaatgerichte mindset zet jij je in voor de beste zorgoplossingen voor de patiënt, de zorgverlener en Roche. Wat ga je doen?
• Omnichannel Orchestratie : Je ontwerpt en optimaliseert de klanten-touchpoint-journey, waarbij je persoonlijke en niet-persoonlijke interacties integreert om onze klanten te overtuigen van de waarde van onze geneesmiddelen voor oncologie en nefrologie en reumatologie.
• Tactische Executie: Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de volledige 'pull-through' van het omnichannel marketingplan, inclusief de ontwikkeling van gepersonaliseerde content op basis van diepe klantinzichten.
• Content & Campaign Management : In afstemming met ons digital team creëer je impactvolle content die aansluit bij de klanten touchpoint-journey, waarbij je zorgt voor een snelle en compliant marktintroductie via o.a. Veeva PromoMats, rekening houdend met CGR.
• Impactmeting & Optimalisatie: Je kiest en monitort KPI’s en analyseert de effectiviteit van campagnes om datagedreven beslissingen te nemen en lopende tactieken continu te verbeteren.
• Cross-functionele samenwerking: Je werkt nauw samen met collega's van onder andere Medical, Access en Customer Engagement om ervoor te zorgen dat tactieken naadloos aansluiten op de behoeften in het regionale ecosysteem.
• Financieel Beheer: Je draagt bij aan het beheer van het marketingbudget en waarborgt een sterke financiële verantwoording van de uitgevoerde initiatieven. Wat breng je mee?
• Ervaring: Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in digital/non-digital marketing binnen de farmaceutische industrie. Ervaring in een fieldfunctie is een plus.
• Omnichannel Expertise : Een diepgaande kennis van het executeren van omnichannel campagnes, meten van impact en het vertalen van strategie naar implementatie van taktieken.
• Data-gedrevenheid: Bewezen kennis en kunde in het faciliteren en nemen van beslissingen op basis van data en inzichten op tactisch en uitvoerend niveau.
• Technische & Analytische vaardigheden: Geavanceerde kennis van CRM-systemen (zoals Veeva/Salesforce), marketing automation, digitale tools en AI-oplossingen voor marketing.
• Mindset: Je hebt een passie voor digitale en persoonlijke interactie met onze klanten, een ondernemende 'can-do' mentaliteit, plezier in executie, een sterke focus op de klantervaring en het meten van impact plus het vermogen om te gedijen in een dynamische, agile- cross functionele omgeving.
• Opleiding & Taal: Een afgeronde HBO- of universitaire opleiding (bijv. Business of Science) en uitstekende beheersing van het Nederlands en Engels bij het schrijven van teksten. Waarom Roche? Bij Roche maak je deel

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
主要职责/责任
客户管理

• 与关键客户建立良好的信息沟通渠道, 探寻医疗卫生专业人士（HCP）观念、学术需求

• 传递专业化医学/疾病/产品信息
a)传递相应疾病领域的科学进展，促进医生制定规范治疗方案
b)传递罗氏产品的关键信息，提高罗氏产品认知，并收集反馈
c)传递疾病领域诊断相关信息，助力生态圈内患者诊断率提升

学科建设

• 了解医院现有疾病领域诊疗路径及专家诊疗观念及流程

• 梳理相关治疗科室及诊疗流程上的痛点

• 通过搭建头部医院交流或跨院培训、教育会议进行医生/科室教育

• 逐步搭建规范化的诊疗平台

计划管理
规划相应生态圈的学术推广计划，和协作同事协商达成最终方案，并进行实施。

• 组织和支持区域专家会议

• 了解医生观念、需求、会议安排；制定会议及覆盖计划；执行会议计划；回访收集反馈

• 按公司规定合理制定预算，并按计划实施完成，确保资源的合理和有效利用

规范诊疗与疾病全程管理

• 推动专家的诊疗观念及行为转变，实现规范化诊疗

• 和患者解决方案经理协同合作，关注并推动疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

自我管理和团队协作

• 成为产品和疾病领域的专家

• 对团队新成员提供辅导和支持

• 主动地与生态圈内外团队成员进行合作和分享，以整合资源，提升团队能力

能力与经验
岗位所需胜任力

• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识

• 良好学习能力

• 业务敏锐度

• 较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力

• 多产品资源整合能力

• 正确的思维和行为 (使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维)

工作年限

• 1年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

教育程度/所获资格证书

• 医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

• 在试用期内通过RDPAC考试

• 在试用期内完成罗氏所有必修课程

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Customer Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Description
Customer Partner

Role Purpose
As the Customer Partner, you will be responsible for growing the market share and achieving sales goals for the assigned territory. You will be responsible for executing the sales process, ensure operation effectiveness and efficiency, with proficient interpersonal and communication skills, and providing effective solutions to establish and maintain relationships that result in customer satisfaction, retention and acquisition.

You demonstrate personal purpose around improving the healthcare ecosystem thinking from an enterprise level, beyond boundaries and borders, to bring the best possible outcomes to the health environment; creating better health outcomes for more patients faster, and by bringing a strong entrepreneurial mentality with outstanding partnering capabilities.

In this role, you will
Account Management

• Responsible in solution/technical/consultative selling.

• Leads sales process including prospecting, qualification, quantification, needs assessment, competitive differentiation, presentation, closing, contracting and implementation and ensuring after sales support is maintained and of the highest standard.

• Build long-term value-based relationships through continuously uncovering customers’ changing needs, improving customer experience, anticipating new opportunities for their business in the future and adding values through creative solutions / products

• Build credibility with customers and other stakeholders at different levels through demonstrating business acumen and professional expertise, confidence and effective communication.

• Develop and build strategic engagement and partnering with KOLs and relevant stakeholders in key accounts. Be a partner/consultant in shaping their plans, decisions and supporting their professional objectives to achieve RDMY business strategy and goals.

• Understand the customers’ working / communication styles and flex one’s style to adapt to that.

• Identify and develop business opportunities within the area of responsibility and collaborate across teams to ensure attainment.

• Implement a sales management process to assist the team in identifying and prioritizing customers and prospects.

• Responsible for developing and leading implementation of annual territorial plans with the goal of achieving sales objectives and future growth.

• Identify new accounts in line with the marketing strategy.

• Retain, extend and acquire customers and accounts through effective identification of opportunities and the creation and implementation of solutions.

• Responsible for profiling accounts, placing RDMY in the strongest position to win tenders and new accounts.

• Update Accounts and contacts in Salesforce regularly to ensure accuracy of data

• Ensure Salesforce activities, business opportunities are entered in REXIS on a weekly basis.

• Monitor all Opportunities to ensure they are up to date.

• Able to conduct Basic troubleshooting.

• Proficient in Global Deal Calculator (GDC) in preparing sales proposal.

• Participation in relevant marketing events/exhibition/trade.

• Responsible for arranging and conducting relevant training or presentation sessions for customers.

Product Knowledge

• Strong knowledge of assigned product portfolio to manage sales process, involving cross function team’s expertise, as needed

• Promote co-positioning of cross-BA products, where applicable, with the objective to maximize RDMY total revenues and profitability

Teamwork

•

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Advances in AI, data and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organizations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CS CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness the transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and life-changing medicines for patients worldwide.

Within the CS CoE organisation, the Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) organization leads the modernization of our computational and data ecosystems by integrating digital technologies across Research and Early Development to empower stakeholders, advance data-driven science and accelerate decision-making.

The Solutions team within the DDC Organization develops modernized and interconnected computational and data ecosystems. The Data Ecosystem is foundational to building solutions that accelerate the work done by our Computational and Bench Scientists and enable ML/AI tool creation and adoption. Our team specializes in building Data Pipelines and Applications for data acquisition, collection, storage, transformation, linkage and sharing.

Join our Data and Digital Catalyst team as a Software Engineer, where you will develop the modernized and interconnected computational and data ecosystems that are foundational to our research. You'll build robust and scalable systems that unlock the potential of our diverse scientific data, directly accelerating the discovery and development of life-changing treatments for patients. This is a unique opportunity to empower our scientists and advance data-driven science through innovative technology.

The Opportunity

• Build and enhance a modern, scalable ecosystem of applications and tools to capture, move, and prepare scientific data for analysis.

• Design and deliver complex, user-friendly data applications and pipelines that integrate diverse data sets across key scientific domains.

• Leverage standard patterns like microservices and event-driven architecture to improve our data workflows and application ecosystem.

• Champion technical excellence by ensuring our solutions are innovative, best-in-class, and seamlessly integrated.

• Integrate diverse data sets to power Artificial Intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and Natural Language Search capabilities.

• Collaborate directly with computational and research scientists to understand their challenges and translate them into effective technology solutions.

• Provide technical leadership on ongoing initiatives and identify new opportunities to build common, reusable solutions.

• Mentor junior developers, fostering their professional growth and upholding high engineering standards.

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. I progressi in AI, i dati e le scienze computazionali stanno trasformando la scoperta e lo sviluppo della droga. Le organizzazioni di ricerca e sviluppo precoce di Roche a Genentech (gRED) e Pharma (pRED) hanno dimostrato come queste tecnologie accelerano la R&D, sfruttando i dati e i nuovi modelli computazionali per guidare l'impatto. La condivisione e l'accesso dei dati senza cuciture ai modelli in GRED e pRED sono essenziali per massimizzare queste opportunità. Il Centro di Scienze Computazionali di Eccellenza (CS CoE) è un gruppo strategico e unificato il cui obiettivo è quello di sfruttare il potere trasformativo dei dati e dell'Intelligenza Artificiale (AI) per aiutare i nostri scienziati sia in pRED che in GRED a fornire farmaci più innovativi e mutevoli per la vita per i pazienti in tutto il mondo. All'interno dell'organizzazione CS CoE, l'organizzazione Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) conduce l'ammodernamento dei nostri ecosistemi computazionali e dati integrando le tecnologie digitali attraverso la ricerca e lo sviluppo precoce per potenziare gli stakeholder, promuovere la scienza dei dati e accelerare il processo decisionale. Il team Solutions all'interno dell'Organizzazione DDC sviluppa ecosistemi computazionali e dati modernizzati e interconnessi. Il Data Ecosystem è fondamentale per costruire soluzioni che accelerano il lavoro svolto dai nostri scienziati Computazionali e Bench e consentono la creazione e l'adozione di strumenti ML/AI. Il nostro team è specializzato nella costruzione di Data Pipelines e Applicazioni per l'acquisizione, la raccolta, lo stoccaggio, la trasformazione, il collegamento e la condivisione dei dati. Unisciti al nostro team Data e Digital Catalyst come Software Engineer, dove svilupperai gli ecosistemi computazionali e dati modernizzati e interconnessi che sono fondamentali per la nostra ricerca. Costruirete sistemi robusti e scalabili che sbloccano il potenziale dei nostri diversi dati scientifici, accelerando direttamente la scoperta e lo sviluppo di trattamenti per il cambiamento della vita per i pazienti. Questa è un'opportunità unica per potenziare i nostri scienziati e promuovere la scienza dei dati attraverso la tecnologia innovativa. L'opportunità
• Costruire e migliorare un ecosistema moderno e scalabile di applicazioni e strumenti per catturare, spostare e preparare i dati scientifici per l'analisi.
• Progettare e fornire applicazioni e tubazioni di dati complesse e facili da usare che integrano diversi set di dati in ambiti scientifici chiave.
• Levare modelli standard come microservizi e architettura orientata agli eventi per migliorare i nostri flussi di lavoro dati e l'ecosistema delle applicazioni.
• Campione di eccellenza tecnica assicurando che le nostre soluzioni siano innovative, di classe migliore e perfettamente integrate.
• Integrare diversi set di dati per alimentare l'intelligenza artificiale (AI), l'apprendimento automatico (ML), e le capacità di ricerca della lingua naturale.
• Collaborare direttamente con gli scienziati computazionali e di ricerca per comprendere le loro sfide e tradurli in soluzioni tecnologiche efficaci.
• Fornire leadership tecnica sulle iniziative in corso e identificare nuove opportunità per costruire soluzioni comuni e riutilizzabili.
• Mentor junior sviluppatori, promuovendo la loro crescita professionale e mantenendo elevati standard di ingegneria. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. Advances in AI, data and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organizations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CS CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness the transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and life-changing medicines for patients worldwide. Within the CS CoE organisation, the Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) organization leads the modernization of our computational and data ecosystems by integrating digital technologies across Research and Early Development to empower stakeholders, advance data-driven science and accelerate decision-making. The Solutions team within the DDC Organization develops modernized and interconnected computational and data ecosystems. The Data Ecosystem is foundational to building solutions that accelerate the work done by our Computational and Bench Scientists and enable ML/AI tool creation and adoption. Our team specializes in building Data Pipelines and Applications for data acquisition, collection, storage, transformation, linkage and sharing. Join our Data and Digital Catalyst team as a Software Engineer, where you will develop the modernized and interconnected computational and data ecosystems that are foundational to our research. You'll build robust and scalable systems that unlock the potential of our diverse scientific data, directly accelerating the discovery and development of life-changing treatments for patients. This is a unique opportunity to empower our scientists and advance data-driven science through innovative technology. The Opportunity
• Build and enhance a modern, scalable ecosystem of applications and tools to capture, move, and prepare scientific data for analysis.
• Design and deliver complex, user-friendly data applications and pipelines that integrate diverse data sets across key scientific domains.
• Leverage standard patterns like microservices and event-driven architecture to improve our data workflows and application ecosystem.
• Champion technical excellence by ensuring our solutions are innovative, best-in-class, and seamlessly integrated.
• Integrate diverse data sets to power Artificial Intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and Natural Language Search capabilities.
• Collaborate directly with computational and research scientists to understand their challenges and translate them into effective technology solutions.
• Provide technical leadership on ongoing initiatives and identify new opportunities to build common, reusable solutions.
• Mentor junior developers, fostering their professional growth and upholding high engineering standards. Who You Are We are looking for a passionate and collaborative software engineer with a talent for building scalable, reliable platforms. descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns zur Innovation. Um die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die sie heute und für Generationen benötigen. Erstellen einer Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns Roche. Fortschritte in der KI, Daten und rechnerische Wissenschaften transformieren die Entdeckung und Entwicklung von Drogen. Roches Forschungs- und Frühentwicklungsorganisationen von Genentech (gRED) und Pharma (pRED) haben gezeigt, wie diese Technologien die FuE beschleunigen, Daten nutzen und neue Rechenmodelle nutzen, um Auswirkungen zu erzielen. Der nahtlose Datenaustausch und der Zugriff auf Modelle über gRED und pRED sind unerlässlich, um diese Möglichkeiten zu maximieren. Das Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CS CoE) ist eine strategische, einheitliche Gruppe, deren Ziel es ist, die transformative Kraft von Daten und Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) zu nutzen, um unseren Wissenschaftlern sowohl pRED als auch gRED zu helfen, innovativere und lebensverändernde Medikamente für Patienten weltweit zu liefern. Innerhalb der CS CoE-Organisation führt die Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC)-Organisation die Modernisierung unserer Rechen- und Datenökosysteme durch die Integration digitaler Technologien in Forschung und Frühentwicklung, um Stakeholder zu stärken, datenorientierte Wissenschaft zu fördern und die Entscheidungsfindung zu beschleunigen. Das Solutions-Team innerhalb der DDC-Organisation entwickelt modernisierte und vernetzte Rechen- und Datenökosysteme. Das Data Ecosystem ist ein Fundament für den Aufbau von Lösungen, die die Arbeit unserer Computational- und Bench-Wissenschaftler beschleunigen und die Erstellung und Annahme von ML/AI-Tools ermöglichen. Unser Team ist spezialisiert auf den Aufbau von Data Pipelines und Applikationen für Datenerfassung, Sammlung, Speicherung, Transformation, Verknüpfung und Weitergabe. Registrieren Sie sich bei unserem Data- und Digital Catalyst-Team als Software Engineer, wo Sie die modernisierten und vernetzten Rechen- und Datenökosysteme entwickeln, die für unsere Forschung von grundlegender Bedeutung sind. Sie bauen robuste und skalierbare Systeme auf, die das Potenzial unserer vielfältigen wissenschaftlichen Daten freischalten und die Entdeckung und Entwicklung von lebensverändernden Behandlungen für Patienten direkt beschleunigen. Dies ist eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, unsere Wissenschaftler zu stärken und datengetriebene Wissenschaft durch innovative Technologie zu fördern. Die Chance
• Erstellen und verbessern Sie ein modernes, skalierbares Ökosystem von Anwendungen und Werkzeugen, um wissenschaftliche Daten für die Analyse zu erfassen, zu bewegen und vorzubereiten.
• Entwicklung und Bereitstellung von komplexen, benutzerfreundlichen Datenanwendungen und Pipelines, die verschiedene Datensätze über wichtige wissenschaftliche Domänen integrieren.
• Nutzen Sie Standardmuster wie Mikroservices und ereignisgesteuerte Architektur, um unsere Daten-Workflows und Anwendungs-Ökosystem zu verbessern.
• Champion technische Exzellenz durch die Gewährleistung unserer Lösungen sind innovative, erstklassige und nahtlos integriert.
• Integrieren Sie verschiedene Datensätze, um die Fähigkeiten der Künstlichen Intelligenz (KI), des maschinellen Lernens (ML) und der Natural Language Search zu stärken.
• Direkt mit Rechen- und Forschungswissenschaftlern zusammenarbeiten, um ihre Herausforderungen zu verstehen und in effektive Technologielösungen umzusetzen.
• technische Führung bei laufenden Initiativen und neue Möglichkeiten zur Schaffung gemeinsamer, wiederverwendbarer Lösungen.
• Mentor Juniorentwickler, die ihr berufliches Wachstum fördern und hohe technische Standards aufrecht erhalten. Wer bist du? Wir suchen einen leidenschaftlichen und kollaborativen Software-Ingenieur mit einem Talent, skalierbare, zuverlässige Plattformen zu bauen. Sie drängen darauf, mit wissenschaftlichen Partnern zusammenzuarbeiten
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. Les progrès de l'IA, des données et des sciences informatiques transforment la découverte et le développement de médicaments. Les organismes de recherche et de développement précoce de Genentech (GRED) et de Pharma (PRED) ont démontré comment ces technologies accélèrent la R-D, tirent parti des données et de nouveaux modèles de calcul pour produire des effets. Le partage de données sans soudure et l'accès aux modèles à travers gRED et pRED sont essentiels pour maximiser ces opportunités. Le Centre d'excellence en sciences computationnelles (CS CoE) est un groupe stratégique unifié dont l'objectif est d'exploiter la puissance transformatrice des données et de l'intelligence artificielle (IA) pour aider nos scientifiques dans les domaines pRED et gRED à fournir des médicaments plus innovants et changeants pour les patients du monde entier. Au sein de l'organisation du Conseil de l'Europe, l'organisation Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) dirige la modernisation de nos écosystèmes informatiques et de données en intégrant les technologies numériques dans la recherche et le développement précoce pour autonomiser les parties prenantes, faire progresser la science axée sur les données et accélérer la prise de décisions. L'équipe Solutions de l'organisation DDC développe des écosystèmes informatiques et de données modernisés et interconnectés. L'écosystème des données est fondamental pour construire des solutions qui accélèrent le travail de nos chercheurs en informatique et en banque et permettent la création et l'adoption d'outils ML/AI. Notre équipe est spécialisée dans la construction de pipelines de données et applications pour l'acquisition, la collecte, le stockage, la transformation, le couplage et le partage de données. Rejoignez notre équipe Data and Digital Catalyst en tant qu'ingénieur logiciel, où vous développerez les écosystèmes informatiques et de données modernisés et interconnectés qui sont fondamentaux pour notre recherche. Vous allez construire des systèmes robustes et évolutives qui libèrent le potentiel de nos diverses données scientifiques, accélérant directement la découverte et le développement de traitements qui changent la vie des patients. C'est une occasion unique d'habiliter nos scientifiques et de faire progresser la science axée sur les données grâce à une technologie novatrice. L'opportunité
• Construire et améliorer un écosystème moderne et évolutif d'applications et d'outils pour capturer, déplacer et préparer des données scientifiques à analyser.
• Concevoir et fournir des applications et des pipelines de données complexes et conviviaux qui intègrent divers ensembles de données dans des domaines scientifiques clés.
• Tirer parti des modèles standard comme les microservices et l'architecture événementielle pour améliorer nos flux de données et l'écosystème d'application.
• Championne l'excellence technique en s'assurant que nos solutions sont innovantes, de qualité supérieure et parfaitement intégrées.
• Intégrer divers ensembles de données pour alimenter l'intelligence artificielle (AI), l'apprentissage automatique (ML) et la recherche en langage naturel.
• Collaborer directement avec les chercheurs et les chercheurs pour comprendre leurs défis et les traduire en solutions technologiques efficaces.
• Fournir un leadership technique sur les initiatives en cours et identifier de nouvelles possibilités d'élaborer des solutions communes et réutilisables.
• Mentor junior développeurs, favorisant leur croissance professionnelle et le maintien de normes d'ingénierie élevées. Qui vous êtes Nous sommes à la recherche d'un ingénieur logiciel passionné et collaboratif avec un talent pour construire des plateformes évolutives et fiables. Vous prospèrez en vous engageant avec des partenaires scientifiques pour résoudre

jobs.title: Information Security Governance Expert
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As an Expert within the Information Security & Privacy Advisory (ISPA) team, you move beyond "checking boxes" to become a strategic partner for global Engineering hubs. You will lead high-impact security and privacy risk assessments, ensuring Roche’s most ambitious digital projects—from GenAI to cloud-native platforms—are resilient, "Secure by Design," and compliant with global regulations.

The Team
The Information Security & Privacy Advisory (ISPA) team serves as the strategic bridge between IT, business, and legal functions at Roche. Our mission is to ensure that Roche’s digital landscape—from cutting-edge GenAI platforms to global enterprise solutions—is secure by design and compliant with international standards. We act as a global center of excellence that translates complex regulatory requirements into actionable security architecture, providing the expert guidance necessary to navigate a rapidly evolving global risk landscape.

Key Responsibilities

• High-Risk Advisory: Lead Security Expert Reviews (SER) for complex architectures, performing deep-dive technical and privacy evaluations to identify and mitigate residual risks.

• Privacy: Bridge the gap between IT, Legal, and Data Protection Officers. Translate complex legal mandates (GDPR, CCPA etc.) into actionable technical and organizational controls.

• Information Security: Contribute to Security Design Patterns and Technical Baselines for emerging technologies like Generative AI and Cloud-native ecosystems.

• Risk Governance: Utilize ServiceNow IRM to ensure the integrity and traceability of security advisory, delivering data-driven, consistent, and audit-ready results.

• Peer Excellence: Foster a "Four-Eye" quality culture through peer reviews and collective knowledge exchange within a global team of experts.

Who You Are

Our Ideal Mindset: A proactive Expert & Influencer who brings deep industry experience to an established team. You have the confidence to lead initiatives independently while thriving in an environment of collective knowledge exchange.

Qualifications:

• Experience: 5–10 years in Information Security/GRC, with a proven track record in Information Risk Assessments and DPIAs in complex, global environments.

• Technical Savvy: Deep understanding of Security Architecture and the ability to translate "Legal-speak" into "Engineering-speak."

• Regulatory Mastery: Expert knowledge of international privacy frameworks (GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, etc.) and security standards (ISO 27001, NIST).

• System Proficiency: Experienced in using ServiceNow IRM to execute and document risk assessments, utilizing the platform to ensure consistent, high-quality, and transparent security guidance.

• Education: Degree in Computer Science or Legal. Certifications like CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CIPP/E, CIPM or ISO27001 Lead Auditor are highly valued.

• C ommunication: Exceptional stakeholder management skills with the ability to drive consensus across a global organization.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthca

jobs.title: Procurement Manager – Research & Lab Materials
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Procurement Manager – Research & Lab Materials
Roche India - Roche Services & Solutions
Hyderabad

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next.

The Opportunity
This role sits within the Materials, Manufacturing & CAPEX Procurement Delivery group, which covers the core procurement activities from category management, strategic and operational sourcing, supplier management, contracting, content strategy definition, and execution. The Materials, Manufacturing & CAPEX Procurement Delivery group comprises many communities grouping categories of the same value chain or having commonality, including Raw Materials, External Manufacturing Services, Logistics, Research & Laboratory Materials, and Engineering (CAPEX).

Within Research & Laboratory Materials, we cover two categories:

• Lab Chemicals & Consumables (LCC)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Bei Roche arbeiten 94’000 Mitarbeitende in 100 Ländern daran, den Begriff Healthcare neu zu definieren. Am Standort Basel Drug Substance Manufacturing der F. Hoffmann-La Roche AG bekommen Sie einen einzigartigen Einblick in die Produktion von chemischen und biologischen aktiven pharmazeutischen Wirkstoffen für die kommerzielle und klinische Versorgung. Unser Standort besteht aus drei Produktionseinheiten (sogenannten Value Streams) und fünf unterstützenden Einheiten (sogenannten Units), in denen sich insgesamt 650 Mitarbeitende darauf fokussieren, Patienten mit Medikamenten zu versorgen.

Die Möglichkeit

Am Standort Basel Drug Substance produzieren wir in drei Value Streams (Monoclonal Antibody (MAB), Antibody Drug Conjugate (ADC) und Single Use Technology (SUT). Die drei Value Streams werden von fünf Units plus Quality unterstützt (Process & Technology, Material Science & Support, Materials Management, Facilities Management & SHE, Business Operations, Quality).

An unserem Standort in Basel bieten wir im Bereich Master Data Excellence & Materials Management eine spannende Praktikumsmöglichkeit an. Auf dich warten abwechslungsreiche wie anspruchsvolle Aufgaben in einem biologischen Produktionsumfeld.

Deine Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

• Unterstützung der produzierenden Betriebe im Supply Chain Management

• Mitarbeit in den Abteilungen Master Data, Planning, Launch & Transfer Management, Logistics, und Compliance Team

• Selbstständige Begleitung und Umsetzung von Verbesserungen mittels Lean Management Methoden

• Technische und inhaltliche Weiterentwicklung der bestehenden Performance Boards zur Performance-Steuerung

• Prozessdokumentation und -mapping

• Aktive Unterstützung des Leitungsteams

• Organisation von Workshops

• Analyse von Prozessen, Kennzahlen und betrieblichen Schwachstellen sowie Einleitung von Verbesserungsmaßnahmen

• Anpassung, Optimierung und Pflege von Kennzahlensystemen und entsprechender Visualisierung sowie Erstellung von Workflows

• Allgemeine administrative Unterstützung des Teams

• Unterstützung bei Datenanalysen, Datenaufbereitung sowie deren Visualisierungen

Wer Du Bist

• Du bist aktuell an einer Universität immatrikuliert oder hast innerhalb von 12 Monaten vor Praktikumsbeginn dein Masterstudium abgeschlossen.

• Sehr gute Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse

• Sehr Gute Google Workspace und gute MS Office Kenntnisse

• Gute Kenntnisse im Umgang mit AI-Tools wie Gemini und Chat GPT

• Teamfähigkeit, Flexibilität und Entscheidungsfreudigkeit

• SAP bzw. SAP S/4HANA Kenntnisse sind ein Plus

• Bereitschaft und Motivation, sich schnell in potenziell neue Systeme und Themenfelder einzuarbeiten

Zusätzliche Information

• Der Standort ist Basel.

• Bevorzugter Start des Praktikums zum 01. Juli diesen Jahres, oder nach Vereinbarung, mit einer Praktikumsdauer von 12 Monaten. Das Praktikum ist in Vollzeit (40 Stunden pro Woche) und Teilzeit (32 Stunden pro Woche) möglich.

• Dieses Praktikum ist nicht für eine Masterarbeit geeignet.

• Nicht-EU/EFTA Bürger (m/w/n) müssen eine Bestätigung der Universität, dass ein Pflichtpraktikum Teil der Ausbildung ist, den Bewerbungsunterlagen beilegen.

Bereit für den nächsten Schritt? Wir freuen uns darauf, von dir zu hören. Bewirb dich jetzt, um diese spannende Möglichkeit zu entdecken!

jobs.title: Software Engineer / Senior Software Engineer

titleByLocale.it: Ingegnere di software / Ingegnere di software senior

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Advances in AI, data and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organizations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CS CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness the transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and life-changing medicines for patients worldwide.

Within the CS CoE organisation, the Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) organization leads the modernization of our computational and data ecosystems by integrating digital technologies across Research and Early Development to empower stakeholders, advance data-driven science and accelerate decision-making.

The Solutions team within DDC Organization develops modernized and interconnected computational and data ecosystems. The Data Ecosystem is foundational to building solutions that accelerate the work done by our Computational and Bench Scientists and enable ML/AI tool creation and adoption. Our team specializes in building Data Pipelines and Applications for data acquisition, collection, storage, transformation, linkage and sharing.

As a Software Engineer on our Solutions Engineering team, you will build robust, scalable, and reusable capabilities for our shared data platform. You will work closely with Data Engineers, Product Leaders, and scientific partners to design and implement systems that unlock the potential of our diverse scientific data. Your work will directly contribute to accelerating the discovery and development of life-changing treatments for patients by building the modern ecosystem that captures, moves, and prepares scientific data for analysis.

The Opportunity

• Ensure technical excellence by delivering innovative, best-in-class data flows and pipelines across key scientific domains.

• Promote the adoption of key trends and technologies by applying an Open Source, Cloud First, API First, and AI First approach to problem-solving.

• Improve our data workflows and application architecture by leveraging standard patterns like microservices and event-driven design.

• Integrate diverse data sets to power AI/ML, Natural Language Search, and downstream visualization and analytics tools.

• Facilitate the implementation of cutting-edge AI models that take advantage of advances in machine learning.

• Influence technical decisions around data workflows and application development in collaboration with key partners.

• Learn and deeply understand our Data Ecosystem to drive continuous improvement and innovation.

Who You Are

You are a passionate engineer who cares about technical and product excellence, with a drive to build highly usable solutions. You thrive in a collaborative environment, leveraging modern development practices to translate complex challenges into effective technology solutions.

• A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a similar technica

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. I progressi in AI, i dati e le scienze computazionali stanno trasformando la scoperta e lo sviluppo della droga. Le organizzazioni di ricerca e sviluppo precoce di Roche a Genentech (gRED) e Pharma (pRED) hanno dimostrato come queste tecnologie accelerano la R&D, sfruttando i dati e i nuovi modelli computazionali per guidare l'impatto. La condivisione e l'accesso dei dati senza cuciture ai modelli in GRED e pRED sono essenziali per massimizzare queste opportunità. Il Centro di Scienze Computazionali di Eccellenza (CS CoE) è un gruppo strategico e unificato il cui obiettivo è quello di sfruttare il potere trasformativo dei dati e dell'Intelligenza Artificiale (AI) per aiutare i nostri scienziati sia in pRED che in GRED a fornire farmaci più innovativi e mutevoli per la vita per i pazienti in tutto il mondo. All'interno dell'organizzazione CS CoE, l'organizzazione Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) conduce l'ammodernamento dei nostri ecosistemi computazionali e dati integrando le tecnologie digitali attraverso la ricerca e lo sviluppo precoce per potenziare gli stakeholder, promuovere la scienza dei dati e accelerare il processo decisionale. Il team Solutions all'interno dell'Organizzazione DDC sviluppa ecosistemi computazionali e dati modernizzati e interconnessi. Il Data Ecosystem è fondamentale per costruire soluzioni che accelerano il lavoro svolto dai nostri scienziati Computazionali e Bench e consentono la creazione e l'adozione di strumenti ML/AI. Il nostro team è specializzato nella costruzione di Data Pipelines e Applicazioni per l'acquisizione, la raccolta, lo stoccaggio, la trasformazione, il collegamento e la condivisione dei dati. In qualità di Ingegnere software del nostro team di Ingegneria Soluzioni, costruirai funzionalità robuste, scalabili e riutilizzabili per la nostra piattaforma dati condivisa. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con Data Engineers, Product Leaders e partner scientifici per progettare e implementare sistemi che sbloccano il potenziale dei nostri diversi dati scientifici. Il vostro lavoro contribuirà direttamente ad accelerare la scoperta e lo sviluppo di trattamenti per il cambiamento di vita per i pazienti costruendo l'ecosistema moderno che cattura, si muove e prepara i dati scientifici per l'analisi. L'opportunità
• Assicurare l'eccellenza tecnica offrendo flussi di dati innovativi e di alta qualità e tubazioni in ambiti scientifici chiave.
• Promuovere l'adozione di tendenze e tecnologie chiave applicando un approccio Open Source, Cloud First, API First e AI First alla risoluzione dei problemi.
• Migliorare i nostri flussi di lavoro dati e l'architettura delle applicazioni sfruttando modelli standard come microservizi e design orientato agli eventi.
• Integra diversi set di dati per alimentare AI/ML, Natural Language Search e strumenti di visualizzazione e analisi a valle.
• Facilitare l'implementazione di modelli AI all'avanguardia che sfruttano i progressi nell'apprendimento automatico.
• Influenza delle decisioni tecniche sui flussi di lavoro dei dati e sullo sviluppo delle applicazioni in collaborazione con partner chiave.
• Imparare e comprendere profondamente il nostro Data Ecosystem per promuovere un miglioramento continuo e un'innovazione. Chi sei Sei un ingegnere appassionato che si preoccupa dell'eccellenza tecnica e del prodotto, con l'obiettivo di costruire soluzioni altamente utilizzabili. Si prospera in un ambiente collaborativo, sfruttando le pratiche di sviluppo moderne per tradurre sfide complesse in soluzioni tecnologiche efficaci.
• Una laurea in Informatica o una tecnica simile
