Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui nous fait Roche. Chez Roche Diagnostics, nous sommes animés par notre vision : innover le diagnostic, façonner les soins de santé et changer les vies. Nous sommes heureux de voir cette vision prendre vie. L'opportunité Rejoignez notre équipe en tant que leader de la tarification stratégique mondiale dans l'équipe Diagnostics Global Access & Policy (GA&P). Vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans le développement d'orientations stratégiques de tarification mondiale pour nos produits et solutions, en collaborant étroitement avec les équipes mondiales, régionales et locales pour optimiser les revenus et assurer un accès durable. Faites partie de l'élaboration de notre stratégie de tarification mondiale et de notre politique pour un avenir meilleur. Votre impact :
• Diriger la conception et la mise en oeuvre de stratégies mondiales de fixation des prix fondées sur la valeur pour les pipelines prioritaires et les produits sur le marché, en utilisant l'analyse pour évaluer l'élasticité, prévoir les tendances et gérer la rentabilité.
• Codiriger le déploiement de stratégies de tarification, y compris des solutions de tarification et de passation de marchés innovantes, en collaboration avec les acteurs de l'accès et du commerce pour stimuler l'accès au marché et la rentabilité.
• Agir en tant que principal responsable de la gestion des exceptions, fournir des orientations claires et aider les affiliés à élaborer une stratégie locale pour surmonter les obstacles à l'accès.
• Être la principale responsable du suivi des prix et de la production d'informations à l'aide de bases de données internes (par exemple DIAprice, sCORE), fournir des informations exploitables aux filiales, aux régions et aux IBT.
• Établir et diriger les réunions du comité des prix, publier des notes de prix et encourager la gouvernance des prix, y compris le maintien et le suivi des politiques de prix, des contrôles et des KPI (par exemple, le prix plancher).
• Mener et exploiter des recherches sur le payeur primaire et secondaire, le remboursement et les prix pour éclairer la stratégie globale et fournir des conseils consolidés en matière de prix et de remboursement aux équipes de produits concernées.
• Partenaire interfonctionnel pour informer les IBT et leurs responsables de produits sur la fixation des prix recommandée, en assurant le respect des processus de gouvernance pertinents. Qui vous êtes
• Au moins 8 à 10 ans d'expérience professionnelle avec une expertise reconnue en matière de prix et de remboursement, de préférence dans l'industrie du diagnostic, du matériel médical ou pharmaceutique. L'expérience d'affiliation et/ou régionale est un plus.
• Avoir un baccalauréat dans un domaine pertinent comme les affaires, les finances, l'économie, l'économie de la santé, les sciences de la vie ou la santé publique. Un MBA ou un autre diplôme d'études supérieures est bénéfique.
• Compréhension financière et commerciale approfondie avec une connaissance approfondie de l'environnement de remboursement mondial, de l'intelligence concurrentielle et de la segmentation du marché pour une fixation efficace des prix mondiaux.
• L'Acumen Stratégique et analytique démontré avec une forte influence, la négociation et Agile compétences de leadership pour exceller dans une organisation matricielle mondiale et diriger diverses équipes multiculturelles.
• S'engage à optimiser en permanence les processus afin d'améliorer les normes de qualité et d'efficacité et de mettre en œuvre les compétences et la sensibilisation en matière de tarification dans l'ensemble de l'organisation par la formation et le soutien. Compétences essentielles
• Strategic & Analytical Acumen: Doit être en mesure de concevoir et de mettre en œuvre des stratégies globales de tarification basées sur la valeur, en utilisant l'analyse pour évaluer l'élasticité, les tendances prévisionnelles et gérer la rentabilité. Une compréhension financière et commerciale approfondie est essentielle.

jobs.title: Production Expert (befristet auf 2 Jahre)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Mit seinen 1400 Mitarbeitenden stellt das Produktionszentrum Kaiseraugst die ununterbrochene Patientenversorgung mit qualitativ hochwertigen Medikamenten sicher.

Werde Teil unseres Teams und trage als Production Expert dazu bei, dass wir die höchsten Standards in der pharmazeutischen Herstellung und Versorgung von über 120 Ländern mit qualitativ hochwertigen, sterilen Biologika-Produkten erfüllen!

Die Möglichkeit

Als Production Expert trägst du gemeinsam mit deinen Kolleginnen und Kollegen die fachliche Verantwortung für den Produktionsbereich Filling Services (Compounding, Raw Materials, Equipment) innerhalb des Sterile Filling und trägst die Verantwortung für folgende Aufgaben:

• Verantwortlich für die zeitgerechte Herstellung von Produktlösungen, die zur Produktion kommerzieller, steriler Biologika-Produkte, beispielsweise Flüssigvials und -spritzen verwendet werden

• Bedienen der Produktionsanlagen, sowie Wiegen und Kontrollieren der Rohstoffe, um sicherzustellen, dass die hergestellten Chargen die richtigen Inhaltsstoffe und Mengen enthalten

• Durchführen prozessbegleitender Prüfungen der hergestellten Produktlösung (IPC), um sicherzustellen, dass die Chargen den Spezifikationen entsprechen

• Unterstützen bei der Validierung von Prozessen, die direkt mit der Herstellung verknüpft sind, einschliesslich Reinigung und Sterilisation

• Dokumentieren der Tätigkeiten gemäss GMP-Anforderungen

• Sorgen für eine Reinraumumgebung, die den behördlichen Anforderungen, der guten Herstellungspraxis (GMP) sowie den Standardbetriebsverfahren entspricht

• Ausführung von Prozessverbesserungen und Anpassung von Vorgabedokumenten unter Anwendung von LPS Tools.

Wer Du Bist
Für diese Stelle bringst du folgende Qualifikationen mit:

• Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung als Pharma- oder Chemietechnologe oder vergleichbare Ausbildung (Pharma/Technik/Mechanik/Automation)

• Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Herstellung steriler Arzneimittel und Erfahrung im GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice)-Umfeld (Arbeiten / Dokumentation)

• Gutes technisches Verständnis und Fähigkeiten im Umgang mit hochautomatisierten Produktionsanlagen beziehungsweise sicherer und routinierter Umgang mit IT-Systemen (MES, Google-Anwendungen, Lagerverwaltungssysteme, SAP, Anlagensteuerungssystemen)

• Bereitschaft in einem Schicht-Modell zu arbeiten

• Fließende Deutsch-Kenntnisse in Wort und Schrift gelten als Voraussetzung.

Bewirb dich jetzt mit deinem aktuellen Lebenslauf und releventen Zeugnissen und werde Teil unseres Teams, um gemeinsam die Zukunft zu gestalten!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Con i suoi 1400 dipendenti, il centro di produzione Kaiseraugst garantisce una cura continua dei pazienti con farmaci di alta qualità. Diventa parte del nostro team e contribuisce come esperto di produzione per soddisfare i più elevati standard di produzione farmaceutica e fornitura di oltre 120 paesi con prodotti biologici sterili di alta qualità! In qualità di esperto di produzione, voi e i vostri colleghi assumete la responsabilità tecnica per i servizi di riempimento (Compounding, Raw Materials, Equipment) nell'ambito del riempimento sterile e assumete la responsabilità dei seguenti compiti:
• Responsabile per la produzione tempestiva di soluzioni di prodotto utilizzate per la produzione di prodotti commerciali, prodotti biologici sterili, come i viali liquidi e le siringhe
• impianti di produzione operativi, pesando e controllando materie prime per garantire che i lotti prodotti fabbricati correttamente
• Formazione professionale completa come ingegnere farmaceutico o chimico o formazione comparabile (Pharma/Technik/Mechanik/Automation)
• Almeno 3 anni di esperienza nella produzione di farmaci sterili e di esperienza nell'ambiente GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) (Working / Documentation)
• Buona comprensione tecnica e competenze nella gestione di impianti di produzione altamente automatizzati o gestione sicura e ordinaria di sistemi IT (MES, applicazioni Google, sistemi di gestione del magazzino, SAP, sistemi di controllo degli impianti)
• Pronto a lavorare in un modello a turni
• Flusso tedesco-knowledge in parola e scrittura è un prerequisito. Unisciti al tuo CV attuale e alle testimonianze pertinenti e diventare parte del nostro team per plasmare il futuro insieme! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere alti i nostri ambiziosi, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità.

jobs.title: Product Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity:

At Roche Diagnostics, we understand that behind every test result is a patient. Our Regional Customer Support Center (RCSC) is looking for a Hungarian-speaking Product Specialist who wants to transition from the laboratory bench to a regional expert role. Whether you are an engineer or a lab professional, your expertise can help shape the future of diagnostics.

Please note that this is a CONTRACTOR/CONTINGENT POSITION. You will be employed by our 3rd party service provider.

Special Focus: Are you a Lab Professional looking for a career shift?

• Tired of shift work? Join us for a structured, professional office/hybrid environment.

• Ready to drop the lab coat but keep the expertise? Your hands-on experience with analyzers, reagents, and daily lab challenges is exactly what our customers need.

• Want to see the bigger picture? Move from running tests to mastering the entire diagnostic ecosystem, including IT integrations and cutting-edge software.

Your Impact:

• Technical & Application Support: Provide expert remote guidance for Hungarian laboratories and hospitals on IVD systems.

• Agile Problem Solving: Use your diagnostic "gut feeling" and our remote tools to prevent system downtimes.

• Knowledge Sharing: Be the bridge between complex technology and the people who use it every day.

• Professional Travel: Combine a structured office/hybrid setup with occasional customer site visits - using them as perfect opportunities for hands-on learning and staying connected to the lab reality

Who You Are:

• Background: Degree in Biochemistry, Medical Biology, Laboratory Diagnostics, IT, or Engineering .

• Language: Native-level Hungarian is essential; strong English for international training and collaboration.

• Experience: If you have worked in a clinical laboratory (Biochemist, Lab Technician) or in technical support, you have a head start!

• Mindset: You are empathetic to customer needs, curious about how things work "under the hood," and enjoy a collaborative "Agile" culture.

• Mobility: You possess a valid driving license and are ready to hit the road when duty calls, turning occasional customer visits into a change of scenery

What’s in it for you?

• A prestigious career path in a global healthcare leader.

• Comprehensive technical training (we teach you the engineering part; you bring the lab logic).

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Information Security & Privacy By Design team is the engine behind Roche’s security governance. We design, deliver, and support the digital frameworks that protect our organization, including IRAAM (Information Risk Assessment And Mitigation), PETRA (Policy Exceptions Tool for Risk Asse ssment ), OIA ( Outsourcing Impact Assessment), and our cutting-edge GenAI security agents.

As a Process Operations Coordinator , you are the "Chef d’Orchestre" of our technical execution. Your mission is to facilitate the seamless flow of our security frameworks, ensuring that process deliverables are triggered on time, users are supported, and reporting is accurate. You are the operational backbone that ensures our security processes are not just defined, but are actively understood, automated, and data-driven.
You are a proactive facilitator who enjoys "connecting the dots" between complex technical systems and human workflows. You believe that security governance only works when the user experience is smooth and the data is reliable.

Description of the Area

The Information Security & Privacy By Design team makes Roche’s information security governance accessible through actionable processes. The capabilities we provide enable Roche to identify, assess, monitor, and mitigate information risks, manage regulatory compliance, and oversee third-party and personal data processing risks. Our processes are primarily instantiated in the ServiceNow IRM Platform . We work closely with Information Security, Privacy, Risk & Compliance, and IT teams to provide enterprise visibility into Roche’s information risk posture.
You’ll be working within the Information Security Governance (ISG) area. ISG is responsible for defining the strategic agenda for information security and privacy topics at the Roche Group level. This is realized within the global Information Security Management System (ISMS) which aligns business and IT strategies, business and technical projects, policies, standards, directives, procedures, governance, legal / regulatory, compliance, and other requirements at a global level.
The Information Security & Privacy by Design area is accountable for co-developing, in collaboration with key stakeholders, and stewardship of the strategic direction of the Information Risk Assessment processes based on organizational objectives, industry practices and legal / regulatory requirements - e.g IRAAM, PETRA, OIA. This includes oversight, awareness, direction and continuous improvement to the end-to-end processes and their relevant risk modules in alignment with the global ISMS, corporate directives and Roche management systems (e.g. privacy, quality, risk).

Job Responsibilities

1. Operational Facilitation & Workflow Orchestration

• IRAAM Fulfillment: Actively "chase" and monitor the delivery of critical artifacts, such as control attestations, to ensure the process flow remains uninterrupted.

• SER Triage Management: Facilitate the Security Expert Review (SER) Triage process, prioritizing and coordinating the assignment of Information Security & Privacy Advisors (ISPA) to execute reviews.

• Process Lifecycle Oversight: Monitor the end-to-end execution of IRAAM, PETRA and OIA processes, ensuring milestones are met and bottlenecks are addressed proactively.

​
2. Request Management & Platform Support

• ServiceNow Orchestration: Manage and maintain the service request management tool and its related artifacts within ServiceNow.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Within People & Culture (P&C), People Insights & Technology (PI&T) unleashes exponential people and business impact through data-driven decision-making, actionable insights, and embracing people-centric technology.

We are looking for a motivated and curious intern to join our People Insights Area of Practice for a 6 months internship based in Basel, Switzerland, starting August. In this role, you will collaborate closely with Organisational Scientists on applied research and people analytics initiatives. In this role, you will support the team by conducting literature reviews, collecting and analyzing employee data, uncovering actionable insights, and supporting evidence-based decisions that improve employee experience and organizational effectiveness.

The Opportunity
Literature Review & Knowledge Synthesis

• Conduct targeted literature searches and synthesize evidence on key topics (e.g., impact of AI on workforce and leadership, employee experience)

• Maintain and update shared literature repositories for ongoing team use

Research Design & Execution

• Support design and execution of research approaches (e.g., surveys, experiments), including identifying validated measurement scales

• Contribute to hypothesis generation and assess feasibility of research approaches

Data Analysis & Insights Communication

• Support the analysis of people data to uncover meaningful insights

• Summarize and visualize findings for clear stakeholder presentations

Who You Are

• An ambitious Master’s student currently pursuing or having recently completed a degree in Industrial/Organizational Psychology, Organizational Behavior, HR, or related disciplines (within 12 months of the start date). Alternatively, PhD students currently enrolled in a doctoral program are also encouraged to apply.

• You have a solid foundation in research methods (e.g., surveys, experiments, psychometrics) and statistics,developed through academic training, thesis work, or hands-on application; experience with statistical programming (e.g., R, Python) is a plus.

• You are comfortable working with scientific literature and can critically evaluate and translate research findings into clear, practical insights for a business audience

• You are passionate about People & Culture topics (e.g., impact of AI on workforce/leadership; employee experience)

• You bring strong analytical and critical thinking skills, paired with excellent communication and writing abilities in English

• You are able to work independently, manage multiple tasks, and thrive in a dynamic environment

• You have a genuine eagerness to apply scientific thinking in a real-world business context

Additional Information
What We offer:

• Hands-on experience working with experienced Organisational Scientists and People Analytics professionals

• Exposure to real business challenges with opportunities to contribute meaningful impact

• A collaborative, international, and purpose-driven work environment

• Dedicated learning opportunities and professional development

• The chance to apply research and analytical skills in a global healthcare company committed to innovation and people development

Application process

• To be considered, please send us your CV, cover letter and your certificate of enrollment (in case of ongoing studies) with your application.

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione All'interno di People & Culture (P&C), People Insights & Technology (PI&T) scatena le persone esponenziali e l'impatto commerciale attraverso il processo decisionale, le intuizioni attuabili e l'abbracciamento della tecnologia orientata alle persone. Siamo alla ricerca di uno stage motivato e curioso per unire il nostro People Insights Area of Practice per uno stage di 6 mesi con sede a Basilea, in Svizzera, a partire da agosto. In questo ruolo, collaborerete a stretto contatto con gli scienziati organizzativi sulle iniziative di ricerca applicata e di analisi delle persone. In questo ruolo, supporterai il team conducendo recensioni di letteratura, raccogliendo e analizzando i dati dei dipendenti, scoprendo intuizioni attuabili e sostenendo decisioni basate su prove che migliorano l'esperienza dei dipendenti e l'efficacia organizzativa. descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Within People & Culture (P&C), People Insights & Technology (PI&T) unleashes exponential people and business impact through data-driven decision-making, actionable insights, and embracing people-centric technology. We are looking for a motivated and curious intern to join our People Insights Area of Practice for a 6 months internship based in Basel, Switzerland, starting August. In this role, you will collaborate closely with Organisational Scientists on applied research and people analytics initiatives. In this role, you will support the team by conducting literature reviews, collecting and analyzing employee data, uncovering actionable insights, and supporting evidence-based decisions that improve employee experience and organizational effectiveness. The Opportunity Literature Review & Knowledge Synthesis
• Conduct targeted literature searches and synthesize evidence on key topics (e.g., impact of AI on workforce and leadership, employee experience)
• Maintain and update shared literature repositories for ongoing team use Research Design & Execution
• Support design and execution of research approaches (e.g., surveys, experiments), including identifying validated measurement scales
• Contribute to hypothesis generation and assess feasibility of research approaches Data Analysis & Insights Communication
• Support the analysis of people data to uncover meaningful insights
• Summarize and visualize findings for clear stakeholder presentations Who You Are
• An ambitious Master’s student currently pursuing or having recently completed a degree in Industrial/Organizational Psychology, Organizational Behavior, HR, or related disciplines (within 12 months of the start date). Alternatively, PhD students currently enrolled in a doctoral program are also encouraged to apply.
• You have a solid foundation in research methods (e.g., surveys, experiments, psychometrics) and statistics,developed through academic training, thesis work, or hands-on application; experience with statistical programming (e.g., R, Python) is a plus.
• You are comfortable working with scientific literature and can critically evaluate and translate research findings into clear, practical insights for a business audience
• You are passionate about People & Culture topics (e.g., impact of AI on workforce/leadership; employee experience)
• You bring strong analytical and critical thinking skills, paired with excellent communication and writing abilities in English
• You are able to work independently, manage multiple tasks, and thrive in a dynamic environment
• You have a genuine eagerness to apply scientific thinking in a real-world business context Additional Information What We offer:
• Hands-on experience working with experienced Organisational Scientists and People Analytics professionals
• Exposure to real business challenges with opportunities to contribute meaningful impact
• A collaborative, international, and purpose-driven work environment
• Dedicated learning opportunities and professional development
• The chance to apply research and analytical skills in a global healthcare company committed to innovation and people development Application process
• To be considered, please send us your CV, cover letter and your certificate of enrollment (in case of ongoing studies) with your application.
• Due to regulations, non-EU/EFTA citizens must provide a certificate from the university stating that an internship is mandatory as part of the application documents, and mus

Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. • Herausforderungen in realen Geschäftsbereichen mit Möglichkeiten, sinnvolle Auswirkungen beizutragen

• Un étudiant ambitieux qui poursuit ou a récemment obtenu un diplôme en psychologie industrielle/organisationnelle, comportement organisationnel, RH ou disciplines connexes (dans les 12 mois suivant la date de début). Par ailleurs, les doctorants actuellement inscrits à un programme de doctorat sont également encouragés à postuler.
• Vous avez une base solide dans les méthodes de recherche (p. ex. enquêtes, expériences, psychométrie) et les statistiques, développées par la formation académique, le travail de thèse ou l'application pratique; l'expérience de la programmation statistique (p. ex. R, Python) est un atout.
• Vous êtes à l'aise de travailler avec la littérature scientifique et pouvez évaluer et traduire les résultats de la recherche en idées claires et pratiques pour un public d'affaires
• Vous êtes passionné par les sujets de People & Culture (p. ex. impact de l'IA sur la main-d'œuvre/leadership; expérience des employés)
• Vous apportez de fortes compétences analytiques et critiques, jumelées à d'excellentes capacités de communication et d'écriture en anglais
• Vous pouvez travailler de manière indépendante, gérer plusieurs tâches et prospérer dans un environnement dynamique
• Vous avez une réelle envie d'appliquer la pensée scientifique dans un contexte commercial réel Informations complémentaires Ce que nous offrons:
• Expérience pratique en collaboration avec des scientifiques d'organisations et des professionnels de l'analyse des personnes
• Exposition à de réels défis commerciaux avec des possibilités de contribuer à un impact significatif
• Un environnement de travail collaboratif, international et axé sur l'objectif
• Possibilités d'apprentissage et de perfectionnement professionnel
• La possibilité d'appliquer des compétences en recherche et en analyse dans une entreprise mondiale de soins de santé engagée dans l'innovation et le développement humain Processus de demande

jobs.title: Procurement Manager - Clinical Laboratories
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next.

The Procurement Manager - Clinical Laboratories role sits within the Indirect Procurement Delivery group, which covers the core procurement activities from category management, strategic and operational sourcing, supplier management, contracting, content strategy definition, and execution. The Indirect Procurement Delivery group comprises many communities grouping categories of the same value chain or having commonality, including Research & Development, Commercial and Corporate Services, Digital & Technology, and Facilities. The communities are key enablers of strong category expertise while allowing flexibility in the procurement delivery response to the evolving needs of our customers.

The Opportunity:

• You will bring analytical thinking, planning, execution, and focus to the procurement sourcing and delivery capability area. Applying both general procurement and specialized knowledge or expertise in a specific commodity or spend area, you will ensure effective and efficient delivery of core procurement services and continuous improvement of automation and content availability.

• You will collaborate closely with internal procurement (i.e. Chapters and capability areas such as customer relationship management, contracting, solutions, analytics, etc.) and business stakeholders to translate business needs into sourcing and spend management activities and content enhancement.

• You will work closely with other team members to support customer demand, improve the customer buying experience, deliver on day-to day operational activities, and provide capacity and expertise to deliver productivity and other customer oriented projects/solutions.

• You are a Category and sourcing subject matter specialist in Clinical Laboratories conducting market and internal analysis to develop strategies and tactical plans for how Roche should source and negotiate for third party goods and services in order to satisfy stakeholder requirements.

• You are a Procurement delivery practitioner delivering and executing sourcing strategies by leveraging spend, category know-how, robust sourcing, negotiation, contracting, supplier management methodologies and frameworks and project management skills.

• You develop content and automation, translating sourcing outcomes and opportunities into content and automated buying channels that improve business adoption, satisfaction, and overall efficiency.

Who you are:

• You hold a university degree, preferably in business or a scientific related discipline like Biological/Life Sciences, Chemistry, Biochemistry or related field.

• You have proven procurement experience in strategic sourcing, category strategy building and strategic project execution with general contracting understanding and proficiency or relevant related commodity experience, preferably in the Pharmaceutical industry.

• You have experience in procurement systems, processes and skills in project management.

• You possess knowledge and experience in the Clinical Laboratories commodity area (Genomics and Genetics, Bio

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Für unseren Bereich Instrumental Analytics - Spectrometry and Separation Science suchen wir Dich als engagierte Persönlichkeit für eine Schlüsselrolle in unserer Forschung und Entwicklung. Der Fokus dieser Position liegt auf der Bearbeitung komplexer analytischer Fragestellungen jenseits der Routine.

Als R&D Spezialist (m/w/d) HPLC bist Du maßgeblich an der Entwicklung und Optimierung robuster Methoden zur Charakterisierung chemischer und biochemischer Einsatzstoffe beteiligt. Bringe Deine exzellente Fachexpertise ein, um die hohen Qualitätsstandards unserer Diagnostik nachhaltig zu sichern und zu prägen.

Das erwartet Dich in der Rolle

• Du verantwortest die Entwicklung und Optimierung neuer und bestehender Analysemethoden (HPLC, UPLC, ESI-MS).

• Planung und selbstständige Durchführung anspruchsvoller chromatographischer und spektrometrischer Analysen.

• Du bist verantwortlich für die Validierung und den Transfer der Analysenmethoden in andere Abteilungen (z.B. QC).

• Auswertung von Rohdaten, Interpretation der Ergebnisse und Erstellung aller notwendigen technischen Dokumente (Berichte, SOPs) in Deutsch und Englisch.

• Die Pflege, Wartung und das Troubleshooting der komplexen Analysegeräte fallen in deinen Aufgabenbereich.

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Auftraggebern und aktive Beteiligung an der Arbeitsorganisation und den Sicherheitsfunktionen.

Wer du bist

• Du hast ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor, Master oder Diplom) in Chemie, Lebensmittelchemie oder Pharmazie.

• Mehrjährige relevante Berufserfahrung in der instrumentellen Analytik (mindestens 2–4 Jahre, je nach Abschluss).

• Du verfügst über fundierte theoretische und praktische Kenntnisse in HPLC/UPLC/LCMS und Massenspektrometrie, insbesondere in der Methodenentwicklung.

• Vertrautheit mit Anforderungen im regulierten Umfeld (GxP) und relevanten Qualitätsrichtlinien der Pharmaindustrie sowie Prozessaffinität.

• Deine Persönlichkeit zeichnet sich durch hohe Motivation, Flexibilität, eigenständiges Arbeiten und Freude an der Teamarbeit aus.

• Sehr gute Deutsch- sowie gute Englischkenntnisse runden Dein Profil ab.

Diese Position ist auf zwei Jahre befristet.

Deine Bewerbung

Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:

• Aktueller Lebenslauf und Zeugnissen.
Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt.

Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden können.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Senior Talent Acqusition Partner - LATAM

titleByLocale.it: Partner senior per l'acquisizione di talenti - LATAM

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.

We have co-created a forward-looking recruitment model designed to secure top-tier talent while prioritizing the needs of our customers and patients. Our services are tailored to organizational requirements, with a commitment to quality and efficiency. As a Talent Acquisition Partner, you will work across borders within an empowered, self-organized environment. You will support team development and deliver exceptional candidate and stakeholder experiences by leveraging diverse talent and specialized expertise.

The Position

• Drive the end-to-end global standardized recruiting process while providing customized talent acquisition strategies, employer branding, and expert candidate selection and offer negotiation.

• Act as a professional consultant and strategic partner to global teams for comprehensive talent acquisition needs, including proactive sourcing and hiring.

• Demonstrate leadership by partnering with hiring managers and senior business leaders to build, develop, and sustain high-performing teams.

• Lead cross-regional recruitment initiatives and manage complex transformation projects, interpreting business challenges to recommend best practices that enhance our ability to attract top-tier talent.

• Collaborate seamlessly with Rewards, People Services, Business Partnering, and People Relations to execute global recruitment strategies.

• Empower and coach team members to drive organizational growth, proficiently mentoring individuals and global teams within the recruiting function.

• Proactively develop talent pipelines using advanced applicant tracking and sourcing tools, while staying at the forefront of global recruitment trends.

Who you are

• University degree with 6+ years of proven recruiting experience in a corporate, biotech, or pharmaceutical environment.

• Fluency in Spanish and English is mandatory; Portuguese language skills are highly desirable.

• Proven recruiting experience across different countries in Latin America

• Superior stakeholder management capabilities, with a focus on effective communication, influencing, and collaborative partnering.

• High learning agility, capable of spotting patterns, processes, and influencing outcomes.

• Technical expertise in diverse sourcing, direct sourcing, web recruitment tools, offer process/systems management, and proactive talent/candidate sourcing with various ATS systems, Workday and Phenom preferred

• Possesses an enterprise mindset, excelling in ambiguous situations, and demonstrating strong business acumen.

• Strong consultative problem-solving skills, an agile mindset, and the ability to champion organizational change.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Il Ruolo El Especialista en Experiencia del Paciente (Patient Journey Partner - PJP) È al centro della nuova organizzazione di Roche, dando un nuovo orientamento al ruolo che svolgiamo detta società nella, passando da offere farmaci di qualité mondiale principalmente a un ruolo di maggiore collaborareazione, innovazione e leadership nella creazione disruzioni creative. In questo modo, il PJP sarà direttamente responsabile di ottenere i migliori risultati per i pazienti, la loro comunità, l ́ecosistema e l'organizzazione con maggiore rapidità. Localizzazione e Residenza Questa posizione può essere situataa in Veracruz o in Puebla, Messico. La persona deve stare in una di queste località. --- Mansioni
• Il ruolo del PJP è di rilevanza all
• Si concentra sull'importanza della prospetiva esterna, associandosi con altri attori per scoprire tutte le possibilità possibili per trasformare i risultati per i pazienti più velocemente. Inoltre, condividi con l ́ecosistema tutta l ́esperienza, la scienza e i conoscimenti di Roche.
• Acte come socio di fiducia e punto principale di contatto (non esclusivo) tra gli attori dell-ecosistema e Roche. Convivendo la necessità della comunità dei pazienti e di altri attori, priorità e assicura i risorse, e promove soluzioni che pronounouno più risultati rapidi.
• Se associati e collaboraa con altri attori coinvolti nell'esperienza del paziente per eliminare gli ostacoli e sfruttare le opportunità di aggiungere valore ai pazienti e alla comunità.

• Questa funzione è valida ad attrarre esperienza e interna risorse a livello locale e di rete, secondo necessità, anche in collaborazioneazione con altri PJP.

• Titolo di studio: laurea in Scienze, Economico-Administrativo/Cienze della Salute. Studi avanzati in Scienze della Salute e/o MBA sono un vantaggio aggiuntivo.
• Esperienza diferenziale: conoscenza intermedia-avanzata dell'inglese.
• Competenza: capacità di comprendere ed utilizzare strumenti digitali.
• Conoscenza e visione del business: solida esperienza in commercializzazione, affari medici e eccellenza nella creazione di esperienze per i clienti.
• Habilità relazionali: eccellenti capacità di relazione con tutte le parti interessate, tra cui l'associazione con Expertos de Área Terapeutica (TAE) e organizzazioni, con profonto conoscenza dell'esperienza dei pazienti e dei trattamenti relativi a malattie speciciche, consenttentogli generare solidi legami a livello dispecialti.
• Conoscenza e esperienza: lavoro ravvicinato con il settore delle istituzioni privati (assicurazioni, torri di controllo, amministrazioni).

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Missions:
Dans le cadre de l’application de la réglementation Française, des directives du Groupe et des normes, le spécialiste SHE définit et garantit le bon fonctionnement et le suivi des procédures liées à la Santé, la Sécurité, l’Hygiène et l’Environnement (SHE) afin de prévenir et réduire les risques SHE au sein de l’entreprise.
Par ailleurs, le spécialiste SHE fait vivre la politique SHE du Groupe Roche au sein de la filiale.

Principales Responsabilités:

DU et Prévention des Risques Physiques et Psychosociaux au travail

• De manière générale, le spécialiste SHE est responsable de définir et mettre en oeuvre la politique de gestion et de prévention des risques professionnels au sein de l’entreprise et vis à vis de nos clients, dans le respect des normes et procédures applicables et la diffusion d’une culture de la prévention dans l’entreprise le spécialiste SHE pilote en outre l'organisation SST et guides et serres files (formation, zoning….)

• Il est également responsable de l’analyse et de la prévention des risques inhérents aux postes de travail, que ce soit au siège, en itinérance ou chez nos Clients, en lien avec notre DUERP, afin de mener des actions ciblés (ex : risque routier, geste et posture, EPI, ergonomie, etc)

• Il participe à la détection, la prise en charge et le suivi des potentiels cas de RPS en lien avec les parties prenantes que sont les RH, les élus et le pôle santé

• Il a la responsabilité partagée du suivi de l’accidentologie et la gestion administrative associées (enquête suite à accident, déclaration, tenue des registres, reporting etc…) et d’identifier si besoin les actions correctives immédiates afin de limiter le risque - notamment en lien avec les initiatives groupe

• Il organise des visites périodiques des installations avec les parties prenantes pour s’assurer de la bonne conformité et application des mesures de sécurité du site.

Onboarding des nouveaux collaborateurs et Veille règlementaire

• Organisation des formations SHE : identification des besoins, planification, suivi démarche d'accueil des nouveaux embauchés, mais également suivi et organisation des formations de recyclage (habilitations électriques, SST, etc)

• Est responsable que l’entreprise soit toujours à jour des évolutions réglementaires dans les domaines sécurité des personnes et environnement, dans ses pratiques et procédures ainsi que dans la mise à jour de la plateforme du Groupe.

Gestion des déchets

• Amélioration de nos processus et solutions pour réduire la production de nos déchets sur le site et suivi des déchets chez nos prestataires (notamment DEEE)

Reporting

• Définit et réalise en temps et en heures les reporting associés à son activité

• (reporting SHE, et contribution au rapport RSE, BDES etc...)

RSE interne et Externe

• Participe au comité de pilotage RSE et à l’élaboration du rapport annuel

• Actions de communication sur l’ensemble des activités

• Partie client (plan de prévention)

• Prépare les sujets CSSCT en lien avec son expertise

Audit SHE et SQB

• Mise en place d’audits auprès des fournisseurs critiques (dans le cadre d’une qualification ou d’un suivi : audit documentaire ou physique)

• Participe au Supplier Quality Board (SQB)

Biosafety Officer

• Evaluation et gestion des risques biologiques et chimiques

• Conformité et réglementation : veiller au respect strict des lois locales et internationales

• Sensibiliser, former les collaborateurs aux bonnes pratiques

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Missions: Dans le cadre de l’application de la réglementation Française, des directives du Groupe et des normes, le spécialiste SHE définit et garantit le bon fonctionnement et le suivi des procédures liées à la Santé, la Sécurité, l’Hygiène et l’Environnement (SHE) afin de prévenir et réduire les risques SHE au sein de l’entreprise. Par ailleurs, le spécialiste SHE fait vivre la politique SHE du Groupe Roche au sein de la filiale. Principales Responsabilités: DU et Prévention des Risques Physiques et Psychosociaux au travail
• De manière générale, le spécialiste SHE est responsable de définir et mettre en oeuvre la politique de gestion et de prévention des risques professionnels au sein de l’entreprise et vis à vis de nos clients, dans le respect des normes et procédures applicables et la diffusion d’une culture de la prévention dans l’entreprise le spécialiste SHE pilote en outre l'organisation SST et guides et serres files (formation, zoning….)
• Il est également responsable de l’analyse et de la prévention des risques inhérents aux postes de travail, que ce soit au siège, en itinérance ou chez nos Clients, en lien avec notre DUERP, afin de mener des actions ciblés (ex : risque routier, geste et posture, EPI, ergonomie, etc)
• Il participe à la détection, la prise en charge et le suivi des potentiels cas de RPS en lien avec les parties prenantes que sont les RH, les élus et le pôle santé
• Il a la responsabilité partagée du suivi de l’accidentologie et la gestion administrative associées (enquête suite à accident, déclaration, tenue des registres, reporting etc…) et d’identifier si besoin les actions correctives immédiates afin de limiter le risque - notamment en lien avec les initiatives groupe
• Il organise des visites périodiques des installations avec les parties prenantes pour s’assurer de la bonne conformité et application des mesures de sécurité du site. Onboarding des nouveaux collaborateurs et Veille règlementaire
• Organisation des formations SHE : identification des besoins, planification, suivi démarche d'accueil des nouveaux embauchés, mais également suivi et organisation des formations de recyclage (habilitations électriques, SST, etc)
• Est responsable que l’entreprise soit toujours à jour des évolutions réglementaires dans les domaines sécurité des personnes et environnement, dans ses pratiques et procédures ainsi que dans la mise à jour de la plateforme du Groupe. Gestion des déchets
• Amélioration de nos processus et solutions pour réduire la production de nos déchets sur le site et suivi des déchets chez nos prestataires (notamment DEEE) Reporting
• Définit et réalise en temps et en heures les reporting associés à son activité
• (reporting SHE, et contribution au rapport RSE, BDES etc...) RSE interne et Externe
• Participe au comité de pilotage RSE et à l’élaboration du rapport annuel
• Actions de communication sur l’ensemble des activités
• Partie client (plan de prévention)
• Prépare les sujets CSSCT en lien avec son expertise Audit SHE et SQB
• Mise en place d’audits auprès des fournisseurs critiques (dans le cadre d’une qualification ou d’un suivi : audit documentaire ou physique)
• Participe au Supplier Quality Board (SQB) Biosafety Officer
• Evaluation et gestion des risques biologiques et chimiques
• Conformité et réglementation : veiller au respect strict des lois locales et internationales
• Sensibiliser, former les collaborateurs aux bonnes pratiques
• Superviser les protocoles de décontamination et d

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

he Scientific Comms & Engagement pillar within our global Patient Safety & Medical Affairs (PSMA) organization builds the high-scale digital engines that protect patients and accelerate science. This organization delivers the global platforms essential to modern, data-driven medical affairs, including enterprise scientific communication workflows, global medical information management and AI-enabled content architecture across dozens of global affiliates.

We are seeking an elite, tech-first Head of Product (Senior Product Leader) . This is a high-visibility, executive-level people-leadership position. It is not an administrative business relationship management function. We are looking for a visionary technology executive and organizational leader who can command a room of senior medical executives, manage large scale cross-functional engineering teams, dismantle legacy application silos and architect a modern, scalable product ecosystem.

You will own the end-to-end technology lifecycle and the people ecosystem for this vital portfolio. Your core challenge is driving organizational transformation: converting complex, global business requirements into robust technical specifications, while building the engineering talent, governing the global vendors and managing the cultural change required to execute a modern content and data strategy.

Key Responsibilities & Strategic Objectives

• Enterprise Leadership & Business Partnering: Act as an equal, authoritative technology partner to senior Medical Affairs business executives. Provide the digital thought leadership necessary to push operational boundaries, automate complex workflows and aggressively consolidate fragmented legacy systems.

• In-House Engineering Talent Transformation: Inherit, mentor and actively scale a high-performing global team of product leaders, software engineers and domain experts. Execute a strategy designed to upskill internal talent and strategically insource core software development and configuration capabilities

• Global Vendor & Managed Service Governance: Maintain strict operational and financial accountability for multi-million-dollar budgets. Oversee, evaluate and hold accountable global managed service providers and software vendors, ensuring absolute alignment with our internal software engineering principles.

• Tech Strategy & Landscape Consolidation: Shape the mid-to-long-term technical roadmap for the portfolio. Lead your teams to actively migrate the legacy landscape away from fragmented, aging infrastructure onto a single, modern and highly integrated product ecosystem.

• Architecting the Content "Golden Source": Drive the technical strategy and global implementation for our enterprise content blueprint, anchoring our data architecture in modern cloud frameworks to eliminate operational duplication and ensure seamless asset lifecycle management.

• Advanced AI & Cross-Platform Convergence: Lead the technical evaluation, production scaling and cross-functional alignment for next-generation automation initiatives. This includes directing teams to deploy AI-enabled narratives and intelligent content generation tools globally, while merging early-stage insight platforms onto a unified, high-performing text and data stack.

• Compliance & Proactive Digital Oversight: Oversee the expansion of specialized compliance tracking and digital oversight platforms that leverage automation to process open-text fields across digital portals and web applications, automatically c

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione lui Scientific Comms & Engagement pilastro all'interno della nostra organizzazione globale per la sicurezza dei pazienti e gli affari medici (PSMA) costruisce i motori digitali di alto livello che proteggono i pazienti e accelerano la scienza. Questa organizzazione fornisce le piattaforme globali essenziali per gli affari medici moderni e basati sui dati, compresi i flussi di lavoro di comunicazione scientifica aziendale, la gestione globale delle informazioni mediche e l'architettura dei contenuti abilitata all'IA in decine di affiliati globali. Stiamo cercando un elite, tech-first Head of Product (Senior Product Leader) . Questa è una posizione di alto livello di visibilità, dirigente-leadership persone. Non è una funzione di gestione delle relazioni commerciali amministrative. Siamo alla ricerca di una tecnologia visionaria leader esecutivo e organizzativo che può comandare una stanza di dirigenti medici senior, gestire team di ingegneria cross-functional su larga scala, smantellare applicazioni legacy silos e architetto un ecosistema di prodotto moderno e scalabile. Possiederai il ciclo di vita della tecnologia end-to-end e l'ecosistema delle persone per questo portafoglio vitale. La vostra sfida principale è la trasformazione organizzativa: la conversione di requisiti aziendali complessi e globali in solide specifiche tecniche, mentre la costruzione del talento ingegneristico, il governo dei fornitori globali e la gestione del cambiamento culturale necessario per eseguire una moderna strategia di contenuti e dati. Responsabilità chiave & obiettivi strategici
• Enterprise Leadership & Business Partnering: agire come partner di tecnologia uguale e autorevole ai dirigenti aziendali di affari medici senior. Fornire la leadership di pensiero digitale necessaria per spingere i confini operativi, automatizzare i flussi di lavoro complessi e consolidare aggressivamente i sistemi legacy frammentati.
• In-House Engineering Talent Transformation: Inherit, mentore e scalare attivamente un team globale di leader di prodotti, ingegneri software e esperti di dominio. Eseguire una strategia progettata per upskill talento interno e strategicamente insource core software sviluppo e capacità di configurazione
• Global Vendor & Managed Service Governance: Mantenere una rigida responsabilitÃ operativa e finanziaria per i bilanci multimilionari. Superare, valutare e tenere responsabili fornitori di servizi gestiti globali e fornitori di software, garantendo un allineamento assoluto con i nostri principi di ingegneria software interni.
• Strategia Tech & Paesaggio Consolidamento: Formare la roadmap tecnica a medio-lungo termine per il portafoglio. Condurre i vostri team a migrare attivamente il paesaggio legacy lontano da frammentate infrastrutture di invecchiamento su un unico, moderno e altamente integrato ecosistema di prodotti.
• Architettare i Contenuti "Golden Source": Guidare la strategia tecnica e l'implementazione globale per la nostra business content blueprint, ancorando la nostra architettura dei dati nei moderni framework cloud per eliminare la duplicazione operativa e garantire una gestione senza interruzioni del ciclo di vita degli asset.
• Convergenza avanzata AI & Cross-Platform: condurre la valutazione tecnica, scalare la produzione e allineamento interfunzionale per iniziative di automazione di nuova generazione. Questo include dirigere i team per implementare narrazioni abilitate all'intelligenza artificiale e strumenti di generazione di contenuti intelligenti a livello globale, fondendo le piattaforme di intuizione del primo stadio su uno stack di testo e dati unificato e altamente performante.
• Compliance & Proactive Digital Oversight: supervisionare l'espansione di piattaforme di monitoraggio della conformità specializzate e di supervisione digitale che sfruttano l'automazione per elaborare campi di testo aperto su portali digitali e applicazioni web, automaticamente c

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position er Scientific Comms & Engagement Säule in unserer globalen Patientensicherheit & Medizin (PSMA) Organisation baut die hochgradigen digitalen Motoren, die Patienten schützen und die Wissenschaft beschleunigen. Diese Organisation bietet die globalen Plattformen, die für moderne, datengesteuerte medizinische Angelegenheiten unerlässlich sind, einschließlich unternehmenswissenschaftlicher Kommunikations-Workflows, globales medizinisches Informationsmanagement und AI-fähige Content-Architektur auf Dutzenden globaler Partner. Wir suchen einen Elite, Tech-first Head of Product (Senior Product Leader) . Dies ist eine hochvisible, geschäftsführende Position. Es ist keine administrative Geschäftsbeziehung Management Funktion. Wir sind auf der Suche nach einem visionären Technologie-Exekutiv- und Organisationsführer, der einen Raum leitender medizinischer Führungskräfte beauftragen kann, große funktionsübergreifende Ingenieurteams verwalten, Legacy-Anwendungssios abbauen und Architekt ein modernes, skalierbares Produktökosystem. Sie besitzen den End-to-End-Technologie-Lebenszyklus und das Menschen-Ökosystem für dieses lebenswichtige Portfolio. Ihre Kernherausforderung treibt die organisatorische Transformation voran: Um komplexe, globale Geschäftsanforderungen in robuste technische Spezifikationen umzuwandeln, das Engineering-Tal, die Steuerung der globalen Anbieter und die Verwaltung des kulturellen Wandels, der zur Umsetzung einer modernen Content- und Datenstrategie erforderlich ist. Schlüsselkompetenzen & Strategische Ziele
• Enterprise Leadership & Business Partnering: Act als gleichberechtigter Technologiepartner für Senior Medical Affairs Business Executives. Bereiten Sie die digitale Gedankenführung vor, die erforderlich ist, um operative Grenzen zu verschieben, komplexe Workflows zu automatisieren und zersplitterte Legacy-Systeme aggressiv zu konsolidieren.

Exécuter une stratégie conçue pour accroître les compétences internes et les capacités stratégiques de développement et de configuration de logiciels de base
• Gouvernance mondiale des fournisseurs et des services gérés : maintenir une responsabilité opérationnelle et financière stricte pour les budgets de plusieurs millions de dollars. Surveiller, évaluer et tenir responsables fournisseurs de services et fournisseurs de logiciels gérés à l'échelle mondiale, en assurant l'alignement absolu sur nos principes internes d'ingénierie des logiciels.

jobs.title: Security Engineer - RDT Vulnerability & Exposure Management

titleByLocale.it: Security Ingegnere - RDT Vulnerability & Exposure Management
titleByLocale.en: Security Engineer - RDT Vulnerability & Exposure Management
titleByLocale.de: Security Ingenieur - RDT Vulnerability & Exposure Management
titleByLocale.fr: Security Ingénieur - RDT Vulnerability & Exposure Management

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Security Monitoring and Incident Response (MIR) team at Roche strives to keep our networks and users safe from constantly evolving threats. As a Security Engineer on the Vulnerability and Exposure Management Team, you will help protect sensitive data and defend computer systems and web applications from existing and emerging threats. You will not just be managing scanner output. You will help manage and reduce existing risks, assess and evaluate the weaponization of emerging risks, and act as a core builder of our future capabilities.

The Opportunity
As an integrated part of the Vulnerability and Exposure Management team, your main responsibilities include :

• Triage, investigate, and respond to critical vulnerabilities affecting Roche.

• Evaluate and prioritize vulnerabilities found through our tools, including our bug-bounty program.

• Research emerging vulnerabilities and develop methods to confirm exploitability against our attack surface.

• Communicate risk and work with system owners and other stakeholders to mitigate security vulnerabilities.

• Assess company systems and web applications using both automated and manual tools.

• Maintain, improve, and engineer our scanning, detection, and automation solutions.

• Participating in security monitoring for a global environment.

Who you are

• You hold an Associate Degree in a relevant field or 5+ years of experience in the information security field .

• You possess a demonstrated ability to triage, analyze, and escalate security vulnerabilities.

• You have experience with attack surface management in a large and global environment.

• You bring programming experience (e.g., Python, Node.js, JavaScript) combined with a familiarity with modern, AI-assisted code development and engineering workflows.

• You display a strong emphasis on web application, network, and computer security, along with experience validating vulnerabilities and basic exploit development.

• You have a track record of contributing to open-source security projects and writing custom detection logic/templates/scripts.

• You have hands-on cloud security experience and a genuine passion for the field of computer and network security.

• You exhibit strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex risks to non-technical audiences, balancing operational tasks with research projects.

• You are fluent in English.

Preferred

• Industry certifications in the field of offensive security (e.g., OSCP, GWAPT, OSWE).

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
Let’s build a healthier future, together! By combining our unique strengths, we are redefining healthcare through sustainable action and innovation. For a behind-the-scenes look, check out this video to see how we at Roche are making personalized health care a reality.

The mySugr GmbH was acquired by Roche in 2017 and our Vienna office is one of Roche's global sites. You will be located here, in the heart of Vienna, no matter if you work on a mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® or any other Roche product or solution. You can read more about the history of mySugr & Roche here .

Here's what we're looking for:
Anchor Role:

Engineering Management

Who we are and what we care about?

We are committed to providing a healthy, equal and inclusive working environment for our employees to bring true relief to the patient! We care about family friendly career paths, sustainability, a healthy lifestyle and the flexibility of a modern workplace. We maintain a culture of learning and sharing, as well as open and candid feedback. At every level, there are many opportunities to develop and grow - both professionally and personally.

As a healthcare pioneer committed to transforming the lives of billions of people around the globe, we push boundaries to redefine what is possible. We know that early, accurate diagnosis is essential to maintain health, prevent disease and help advance new, targeted treatments and potential cures for the world’s most serious health problems. We have a passion for innovation and a profound commitment to make a lasting impact on society by continuing to improve the standard of care for humankind. Our culture inspires us to create healthcare that is sustainable, efficient and financially viable. Healthcare that is built on people’s needs, strong data and clinical insights. Healthcare that saves lives.

Interested? Great. We’d like to hear from you! Just click that “Apply Now” button and send us your CV in English …. and anything else that you think might impress us.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Bereit, die Zukunft der Gesundheitsversorgung aktiv mitzugestalten? Bei Roche verändern wir das Leben von Patient:innen jeden Tag aufs Neue. Für den Bereich Operations Near Patient Care – eine tragende Säule innerhalb der Global Diagnostic Operations – suchen wir ein kluges Köpfchen, das die Analyse, Stabilisierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Geschäftsprozessen sowie den zugehörigen Geschäfts- und Logistiksystemen unterstützt. Als funktionale Brücke zwischen Business und IT trägst Du maßgeblich dazu bei, produktionskritische Abläufe zu sichern. Werde Teil unserer Reise innerhalb der Digital Operations und sorge mit Deinem praktischen Wissen für ein starkes Fundament, auf dem nachhaltiges Wachstum entstehen kann.

Dein neues Team:
Unser Team innerhalb der Digital Operations im Bereich Operations Near Patient Care lebt von Vielfalt, gegenseitigem Vertrauen und einer engen, cross-funktionalen Zusammenarbeit. Wir sind ein dynamisches Team, das gemeinsam an zukunftsweisenden Lösungen feilt, Best Practices teilt und sich gegenseitig unterstützt. Hier erwartet Dich ein lebendiges Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Deine Stimme zählt und neue Ideen ausdrücklich erwünscht sind.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich

• Du unterstützt die Bereitstellung und Koordination des lösungsspezifischen Supports für zugewiesene Geschäfts- und Logistiksysteme.

• Du analysierst und behebst funktionale Störungen sowie Prozessunterbrechungen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Fachbereichen und der IT.

• Du bearbeitest funktionale System- und Prozessthemen im SAP ECC 6.0 Umfeld, insbesondere in den Bereichen Materialwirtschaft, Produktionsplanung, PP-PI und Fertigungssteuerung.

• Du unterstützt die Identifikation von wiederkehrenden Problemen oder Systemstörungen, um zu nachhaltigen Lösungen für produktionskritische Abläufe wie MES-Schnittstellen, Scan- oder Drucklösungen beizutragen.

• Du begleitest die Definition und Pflege von Standards für die unterstützten Systeme und Prozesse im Rahmen von kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsinitiativen.

• Du wirkst bei der Bewertung von Geschäftsanforderungen mit, unterstützt die Durchführung von funktionalen Tests sowie Regressionstests und stellst eine nachvollziehbare Dokumentation sicher.

• Du erstellst und pflegst Schulungsunterlagen sowie Systemdokumentationen und führst Wissenstransfers für Key-User und Endanwendende durch.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit

• Ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium der Wirtschaftsinformatik, Betriebswirtschaftslehre, des Wirtschaftsingenieurwesens, Supply Chain / Operations, der Informatik, des Ingenieurwesens oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

• Relevante Berufserfahrung (3–5 Jahre mit Bachelor bzw. 2–4 Jahre mit Master), idealerweise mit ersten Erfahrungen in der Projektarbeit.

• Fundierte konzeptionelle und praktische Kenntnisse im Geschäftsprozessmanagement sowie im Bereich von Geschäfts- und Logistiksystemen, idealerweise in einem ERP-Umfeld.

• Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung (mindestens 3 Jahre) im SAP ECC 6.0 Support, insbesondere in den Modulen SAP MM, PP und PP-PI (wie Bestandsführung, Fertigungs- und Prozessaufträge oder Chargenmanagement).

• Praktisches Verständnis von Fertigungsumgebungen sowie der Unterstützung von Schnittstellen, MES-Prozessen, IDoc-Verarbeitung oder dem Output-Management.

• Strukturierte Fähigkeiten zur Problemlösung, ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung sowie die Kompetenz zur klaren Kommunikation zwischen technischen Teams und den Fachbereichen.

jobs.title: Finance Enterprise Partner Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

Purpose: As the FEP Lead, you will bridge the gap between commercial strategy and financial expertise. Your mission is to partner with the business to drive strategic commercial decisions incorporating an end-to-end view while simplifying how we operate daily and ensuring that every decision supports the sustainable growth of the company.
In this role, you will lead a team of 5 professionals and report directly to the Finance Manager as their strategic sparring partner while collaborating closely with the Sales and Marketing teams.

The Opportunity:

• Coach team members: Mentor the 5 Finance Enterprise Partners in your team to accelerate their professional development and drive high performance.

• Drive operational change: Foster a culture of simplicity and continuous improvement by challenging old habits and refining team processes.

• Strengthen governance and risk: Ensure compliance with financial practices and established processes, maintaining lean, "fit-for-purpose" operational processes.

• Support commercial growth: Partner with the commercial organization on product launches and customer pricing decisions, evaluating individual commercial opportunities to ensure sustainable business outcomes.

• Drive P&L improvements: Propose and scale initiatives to optimize the P&L, focusing on upselling opportunities, efficiency and waste reduction, and risk mitigation.

• Elevate performance management: Lead the sales planning and reporting processes in close collaboration with the Performance Finance Enterprise Partner Lead, monitoring commercial results and advising on corrective actions to meet financial objectives.

Who you are:

• University degree in Finance, Business, Engineering or a related discipline, with 5+ years of relevant professional experience.

• Experience in finance business partnering and proven ability to collaborate beyond the finance function; prior mentoring or guiding of small teams is highly valued (formal leadership not required).

• Fluency in Spanish and English.

• Coaching & empowering leadership style: develops people, elevates performance, and drives a unified, consistent way of working; challenges the status quo with a continuous improvement and process optimization mindset (simplifying, standardizing, and automating with an enterprise view).

• Strategic business partner who connects financial insights with business realities to confidently challenge decisions and advise stakeholders as a trusted partner; shortlisted candidates will be invited to a video assessment.

#LI-DC1

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
