jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Beneficios de relocalización no están disponibles para esta posición.

OBJETIVOS DEL CARGO: Instalación, configuración, capacitación y puesta en marcha de equipamientos, aplicaciones y sistemas en clientes. Identificación y solución de problemas complejos asociados al uso de los equipos y de sus aplicaciones en todos los clientes.

Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad:

• Ejecutar la instalación y configuración de equipos desde el enfoque de aplicaciones, asegurando el cumplimiento de estándares de calidad del fabricante en coordinación con Servicio Técnico e IT.

• Capacitar a clientes en el uso de equipos, técnicas y aplicaciones mediante programas estructurados de entrenamiento, promoviendo la correcta operación y adopción de las soluciones.

• Brindar soporte técnico y científico especializado, resolviendo consultas y reclamos complejos, asesorando en calidad analítica, eficiencia del laboratorio y participando en demostraciones y presentaciones técnicas.

• Gestionar el registro, documentación y cierre oportuno de casos en Rexis, asegurando trazabilidad, cumplimiento de procesos y entrega de evidencias requeridas.

• Asegurar el cumplimiento de normativas y políticas corporativas, incluyendo gestión de notificaciones, actualización técnica continua, transferencia de conocimiento y control de manejo de sustancias y residuos peligrosos.

Tu Perfil:

• Título universitario en el área de la salud (Química y Farmacia, Bioquímica, Tecnología Médica, Biología u otras carreras afines).

• Experiencia de al menos 2 años en laboratorios clínicos o empresas del sector en roles similares.

• Nivel de inglés intermedio y manejo de herramientas Office a nivel intermedio.

• Conocimiento en calidad analítica, sistemas de gestión de calidad y manejo de sustancias y residuos peligrosos.

#LI-DC1

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Regulatory Project Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This role sits within our Regulatory Affairs division . We operate with a holistic approach to project and product realization, ensuring that we maintain strict compliance while continuously accelerating innovation for our customers and patients .

The Opportunity
As a Regulatory Affairs Project Manager, your day-to-day focus will center on managing stakeholders, navigating complex compliance pathways, and driving product approvals . Your core responsibilities will be distributed across the following key areas:

• Regulatory Submissions : Oversee the development of medium-to-high complexity submission and product registration dossiers; apply a deep understanding of global healthcare regulatory frameworks to secure marketing approvals from health authorities .

• Teamwork & Collaboration: Pull cross-functional groups together around common goals, build on different perspectives to enhance project outcomes, and resolve conflicts by creating an atmosphere of openness and trust .

• Stakeholder Management: Effectively communicate and partner with internal and external teams to understand requirements and deliver optimal solutions, developing relationships that significantly influence the future direction of Roche products .

• Communication & Agile Frameworks: Use agile principles to drive regulatory activities . Foster an open exchange of ideas amongst key stakeholders to shift perspectives, reach common outcomes, and reflect multiple viewpoints on complex issues .

• Decision Making & Leadership: Work day-to-day with minimal guidance to correctly execute scheduled and unscheduled activities . Live the spirit of "We all lead" using VACC principles, persuading and supporting colleagues over whom you have no direct authority .

• Problem Solving & Agile Mindset: Independently troubleshoot operational issues, develop cost-effective solutions to maintain compliance, and actively simplify processes to increase productivity across Q&R .

Who you are

• You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Life Science, Data Science, or a related subject (or possess equivalent qualification/completed training as a laboratory technician) .

• You bring at least 5 years of professional experience (5–10 years preferred) working within Regulatory, R&D, Quality, Operations, and/or Clinical environments .

• You have a proven track record handling healthcare regulatory affairs and can confidently manage high-complexity work or global projects .

• You are capable of working independently with minimal supervision, taking the initiative to generate new ideas, try fresh approaches, and present well-formulated solutions .

• You possess strong communication and social competencies, with the ability to navigate direct, open discussions and guide diverse viewpoints to a unified direction .

• You are willing and able to accommodate business travel as required by project demands .

Preferred

• Familiarity and experience with FDA IVD regulations and EU IVDR regulations highly preferred.

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting.

jobs.title: Field Applications Specialist-Core Lab-Allentown, PA

titleByLocale.fr: Spécialiste des applications sur le terrain-Core Lab-Allentown, PA

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This is an exciting time to join the Roche Support Network. If you are passionate about problem solving then this is the position for you! As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche discovers, develops and provides innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products and services that deliver significant benefits to patients and healthcare professionals - from early detection and prevention of diseases to diagnostics, treatment and treatment monitoring.

Roche is a successful company that can offer exciting career opportunities. We encourage and support your development in areas of your interest which will prepare you for the next level in your career path. We know that people are responsible for our success and we value our employees. Our commitment is to create a work environment where feeling valued, respected, and empowered is a daily experience.

As a Field Applications Specialist , you will be a key member of our Customer Support team as the primary scientific and technical representative in the Allentown , PA region for Roche systems in customer laboratories within the Core Lab space. You will be responsible for providing best-in-class on-site customer support, including activities such as, application implementation, operator training, and troubleshooting for diagnostic instrumentation and assays throughout the entire product life cycle.

The Opportunity:

• Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with customer stakeholders, ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction and creating value within the customer’s lab operations. Consult with customers on lab needs and act as a partner by supporting the customer throughout the product lifecycle which could include supporting product upgrades and other changes.

• Perform and/or assist with the installation of complex diagnostic instruments, software, and reagent applications in customer laboratories. Validate system performance to ensure it meets manufacturer specifications. Ensure effective and cohesive application of the newly installed solutions.

• Deliver and, in some cases develop, comprehensive on-site training to laboratory personnel on the proper use and maintenance of Roche systems, including theory of operation, workflow, quality control, and data interpretation.

• Act as the primary on-site resource for resolving complex technical issues related to instrumentation, software, and assay performance. Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions to minimize instrument downtime. Partner with other Roche team members to implement and support total solutions, such as automation, digital tools, etc.

• Provide scientific and applications expertise to laboratory stakeholders (this could include supervisors, managers, directors, technologists) and medical professionals (this could include pathologists, doctors), helping them ensure cohesive lab operations by optimizing workflows, implementing new assays, and interpreting results for Roche's portfolio.

• Serve as the customer liaison and collect feedback from customers on product performance, features, and usability, and then relay this information back to support and commercial teams, maintaining a competitive advantage.

• Partner with the sales team and leverage in-depth technical knowledge during pre-sales activities, including product demonstrations, technical consultations, menu optimization, and other post-sales, revenue-generating opportunities.

• Ensure consistent customer experiences by following Roche protocols

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Questo è un momento emozionante per aderire alla rete di supporto Roche. Se siete appassionati di problem solving allora questa è la posizione per voi! In qualità di società di assistenza sanitaria focalizzata sulla ricerca, Roche scopre, sviluppa e fornisce prodotti e servizi diagnostici e terapeutici innovativi che forniscono benefici significativi ai pazienti e ai professionisti sanitari - dalla rilevazione precoce e prevenzione delle malattie alla diagnostica, al monitoraggio del trattamento e del trattamento. Roche è una società di successo che può offrire interessanti opportunità di carriera. Incoraggiamo e sosteniamo il vostro sviluppo in aree di vostro interesse che vi preparerà per il prossimo livello nel vostro percorso di carriera. Sappiamo che le persone sono responsabili del nostro successo e apprezziamo i nostri dipendenti. Il nostro impegno è quello di creare un ambiente di lavoro in cui sentirsi valorizzati, rispettati e potenziati è un'esperienza quotidiana. In qualità di Field Applications Specialist , sarete un membro chiave del nostro team di assistenza clienti come principale rappresentante scientifico e tecnico nella regione di Allentown , PA per i sistemi Roche nei laboratori del cliente all'interno dello spazio Core Lab. Sarete responsabili di fornire il miglior supporto clienti in loco, tra cui attività come, l'implementazione delle applicazioni, la formazione dell'operatore e la risoluzione dei problemi per la strumentazione diagnostica e le analisi durante tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto. L'opportunità:
• Costruire e mantenere relazioni forti e collaborative con le parti interessate del cliente, garantendo un elevato livello di soddisfazione del cliente e creando valore nelle operazioni di laboratorio del cliente. Consultare i clienti sulle esigenze del laboratorio e agire come partner supportando il cliente durante tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto che potrebbe includere aggiornamenti di prodotto e altre modifiche.
• Eseguire e/o assistere con l'installazione di strumenti diagnostici complessi, software e applicazioni reagente nei laboratori del cliente. Convalida le prestazioni del sistema per garantire che soddisfi le specifiche del produttore. Assicurare un'applicazione efficace e coesa delle soluzioni appena installate.
• Fornire e, in alcuni casi, sviluppare una formazione completa in loco al personale di laboratorio sul corretto uso e manutenzione dei sistemi Roche, tra cui teoria del funzionamento, flusso di lavoro, controllo della qualità e interpretazione dei dati.
• Agire come risorsa principale in loco per risolvere problemi tecnici complessi relativi alla strumentazione, software e prestazioni di analisi. Eseguire l'analisi della causa radice e implementare azioni correttive per ridurre al minimo i tempi di fermo dello strumento. Partner con altri membri del team Roche per implementare e supportare soluzioni totali, come l'automazione, gli strumenti digitali, ecc.
• Fornire competenze scientifiche e applicative agli stakeholder di laboratorio (questo potrebbe includere supervisori, manager, direttori, tecnici) e professionisti medici (questo potrebbe includere patologi, medici), aiutandoli a garantire operazioni di laboratorio coesi ottimizzando i flussi di lavoro, implementando nuovi saggi e interpretando i risultati per il portafoglio di Roche.
• Servire come collegamento al cliente e raccogliere feedback da parte dei clienti sulle prestazioni, le caratteristiche e l'usabilità del prodotto, e poi relay queste informazioni di supporto e team commerciali, mantenendo un vantaggio competitivo.
• Partner con il team di vendita e sfruttare le conoscenze tecniche approfondite durante le attività pre-vendita, tra cui dimostrazioni di prodotto, consultazioni tecniche, ottimizzazione dei menu e altre opportunità post-vendita, generazione di ricavi.
• Assicurare esperienze di cliente coerenti seguendo i protocolli Roche

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Dies ist eine aufregende Zeit, sich dem Roche Support Network anzuschließen. Wenn Sie leidenschaftlich über Problemlösung sind, dann ist dies die Position für Sie! Als forschungsorientiertes Healthcare-Unternehmen entdeckt, entwickelt und bietet Roche innovative Diagnostik und therapeutische Produkte und Dienstleistungen, die für Patienten und medizinische Fachkräfte von der Früherkennung und Prävention von Krankheiten bis hin zur Diagnostik, Behandlung und Therapieüberwachung profitieren. Roche ist ein erfolgreiches Unternehmen, das spannende Karrieremöglichkeiten bieten kann. Wir fördern und unterstützen Ihre Entwicklung in Bereichen Ihres Interesses, die Sie auf die nächste Stufe in Ihrem Karriereweg vorbereiten. Wir wissen, dass Menschen für unseren Erfolg verantwortlich sind und wir unsere Mitarbeiter schätzen. Unser Engagement ist es, ein Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen, in dem das Gefühl geschätzt, respektiert und gestärkt wird, ein tägliches Erlebnis ist. Als Field Applications Specialist werden Sie als primärer wissenschaftlicher und technischer Vertreter in der Allentown , PA-Region für Roche-Systeme in Kundenlaboren im Core Lab-Raum ein wichtiges Mitglied unseres Customer Support-Teams sein. Sie sind verantwortlich für die Bereitstellung erstklassiger Kundenbetreuung vor Ort, einschließlich Aktivitäten wie, Anwendung Implementierung, Bedienertraining und Fehlerbehebung für diagnostische Instrumentierung und Assays während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus. Die Gelegenheit:
• Erstellen und pflegen Sie starke, kollaborative Beziehungen zu Kundenvertretern, um ein hohes Maß an Kundenzufriedenheit und Wertschöpfung im Laborbetrieb des Kunden sicherzustellen. Besprechen Sie den Kunden auf den Laborbedarf und handeln Sie als Partner, indem Sie den Kunden während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus unterstützen, der Produkt-Upgrades und andere Änderungen unterstützen könnte.
• Durchführung und/oder Unterstützung bei der Installation komplexer diagnosischer Instrumente, Software und Reagenzienanwendungen in Kundenlabors. Gültige Systemleistung, um sicherzustellen, dass es den Herstellerspezifikationen entspricht. Gewährleistung einer effektiven und kohäsiven Anwendung der neu installierten Lösungen.
• Bereitstellung und in einigen Fällen eine umfassende Vor-Ort-Training an Laborpersonal bei der ordnungsgemäßen Nutzung und Wartung von Roche-Systemen, einschließlich der Theorie der Operation, Workflow, Qualitätskontrolle und Dateninterpretation.
• Aktivieren Sie als primäre Vor-Ort-Ressource zur Lösung komplexer technischer Probleme im Zusammenhang mit Instrumentierung, Software und Testleistung. Führen Sie Root Ursache Analyse und implementieren Korrekturmaßnahmen, um Instrument Ausfallzeiten zu minimieren. Mit anderen Roche-Team-Mitgliedern werden Gesamtlösungen wie Automatisierung, digitale Werkzeuge etc. implementiert und unterstützt.
• Bereitstellung von wissenschaftlichen und Anwendungen Expertise für Labor-Stakeholder (dies könnte unter anderem Aufsichtspersonen, Manager, Direktoren, Technologen) und medizinische Fachkräfte (dies könnte Pathologen, Ärzte umfassen), die ihnen helfen, kohäsive Laboroperationen zu gewährleisten, indem sie Workflows optimieren, neue Assays implementieren und Ergebnisse für Roches Portfolio interpretieren.
• Servieren Sie als Kundenverbindung und sammeln Sie Feedback von Kunden über Produktleistung, Funktionen und Usability, und übermitteln Sie diese Informationen dann an Support- und Handelsteams, wobei ein Wettbewerbsvorteil erhalten wird.
• Partner des Vertriebsteams und nutzen fundiertes technisches Wissen während der Vorverkaufsaktivitäten, darunter Produktdemonstrationen, technische Beratungen, Menüoptimierung und andere Post-Sales, Umsatzerzeugende Möglichkeiten.
• Gewährleistung einheitlicher Kundenerfahrungen durch die folgenden Roche-Protokolle
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position C'est une période passionnante pour rejoindre le réseau de soutien Roche. Si vous êtes passionné par la résolution de problèmes alors c'est la position pour vous! En tant qu'entreprise de soins de santé axée sur la recherche, Roche découvre, développe et fournit des produits et des services diagnostiques et thérapeutiques innovants qui procurent des avantages importants aux patients et aux professionnels de la santé, depuis la détection précoce et la prévention des maladies jusqu'au diagnostic, au traitement et au suivi du traitement. Roche est une entreprise prospère qui peut offrir des opportunités de carrière passionnantes. Nous encourageons et soutenons votre développement dans les domaines qui vous intéressent et qui vous prépareront au prochain niveau de votre parcours professionnel. Nous savons que les gens sont responsables de notre succès et nous apprécions nos employés. Notre engagement est de créer un environnement de travail où le sentiment de valeur, de respect et d'autonomie est une expérience quotidienne. En tant que spécialiste des applications sur le terrain, vous serez un membre clé de notre équipe de support client en tant que principal représentant scientifique et technique dans la région d'Allentown, PA pour les systèmes Roche dans les laboratoires clients de l'espace Core Lab. Vous serez responsable de fournir le meilleur service client en classe sur place, y compris des activités telles que la mise en œuvre d'applications, la formation des opérateurs et le dépannage des instruments de diagnostic et des essais tout au long du cycle de vie du produit. La possibilité :
• Établir et maintenir des relations solides et collaboratives avec les parties prenantes du client, en assurant un niveau élevé de satisfaction du client et en créant de la valeur dans les opérations du laboratoire du client. Consulter les clients sur les besoins des laboratoires et agir en tant que partenaire en appuyant le client tout au long du cycle de vie du produit, ce qui pourrait inclure des améliorations du produit et d'autres changements.
• Effectuer et/ou aider à l'installation d'instruments de diagnostic complexes, de logiciels et d'applications de réactif dans les laboratoires clients. Valider la performance du système pour s'assurer qu'il répond aux spécifications du fabricant. Assurer l'application efficace et cohérente des solutions nouvellement installées.
• Offrir et, dans certains cas, développer une formation complète sur place au personnel de laboratoire sur l'utilisation et la maintenance correctes des systèmes Roche, y compris la théorie du fonctionnement, le flux de travail, le contrôle de la qualité et l'interprétation des données.
• Être la principale ressource sur place pour résoudre les problèmes techniques complexes liés à l'instrumentation, aux logiciels et aux performances d'essai. Effectuer une analyse des causes profondes et mettre en oeuvre des mesures correctives pour minimiser les temps d'arrêt des instruments. Partenaire avec d'autres membres de l'équipe Roche pour mettre en œuvre et soutenir des solutions complètes, telles que l'automatisation, les outils numériques, etc.
• Fournir une expertise scientifique et des applications aux parties prenantes du laboratoire (y compris les superviseurs, les gestionnaires, les directeurs, les technologues) et aux professionnels de la santé (y compris les pathologistes, les médecins), les aider à assurer la cohérence des opérations de laboratoire en optimisant les flux de travail, en mettant en oeuvre de nouveaux tests et en interprétant les résultats pour le portefeuille de Roche.
• Servir de liaison avec le client et recueillir les commentaires des clients sur les performances, les caractéristiques et la facilité d'utilisation du produit, puis transmettre ces informations aux équipes de soutien et commerciales, en maintenant un avantage concurrentiel.
• S'associer à l'équipe de vente et tirer parti de connaissances techniques approfondies lors des activités préventes, y compris les démonstrations de produits, les consultations techniques, l'optimisation des menus et d'autres occasions de générer des revenus après les ventes.
• Assurer une expérience client cohérente en suivant les protocoles Roche

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. The Position
Key Responsibilities

• Audits expense reports submitted for reimbursement.
• Communicates with supported affiliate employees in a professional manner when corrections or clarification is required on expense report submissions.
• Ensure Travel and Expense Policy is up to date and being enforced in the Concur and TRAM systems
• Communicate and collaborate proactively with various business partners and management to resolve issues or alert of T&E or Healthcare Professionals compliance discrepancies.
• Serve as T&E representative on large or cross functional projects; lead small departmental projects or change initiatives with appropriate improvement requirements .
• Ensures best practices are shared across team members.
• Ensure all business activities comply with Travel & Expense Policy, FGAR, relevant SOPs, local guidelines.
• Ensure SLA audit and compliance principles between SSC and affiliates are met. Qualifications

• Strong ability to prioritize and organize work effectively, adhere to tight and established deadlines.
• Demonstrated communication skills with a focus on customer service.
• Knowledge of Finance Shared Services and operational accounting processes.
• Effective and professional verbal and written communication skills.
• Ability to perform work with limited direction and guidance.
• Ability to prioritize effectively and multitask.
• Works well with others and follow through to execute all tasks to deliver on deadlines.
• Language requirements: English, Spanish and Portuguese desirable.
• University Degree (>2 Years) in Finance, Accounting or Business Administration or equ ivalent work experience. Experience of
2+ years experience in an operational T&E or audit role.
Experience with related T&E SAP systems TRAM and Concur is highly desirable.

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Field Engineering Specialist - Nashville, TN
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Support Network offers an exciting opportunity for individuals who are passionate about problem-solving. As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche is dedicated to discovering, developing, and providing innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products. With a commitment to employee development and a work environment that values respect and empowerment, Roche offers exciting career prospects for those seeking to make a significant impact on patient care.

The Opportunity:

Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers. As a Field Engineering Specialist, you will:

• Showcase your expertise in technical repair for Roche-assigned product lines.

• Offer valuable service to laboratory customers in your assigned territory.

• Provide routine technical support, on-site service and repair of Roche products.

• serve as a customer contact for technical and service-related issues and perform preventative maintenance.

• diagnose and resolve mechanical, hardware, software, and system failures.

• document all activities, contribute to quality improvement, and focus on maximizing customer satisfaction.

This field-based role requires daily travel and up to 70% overnight travel. Our ideal candidate would reside within 20 miles of Nashville, TN.

Who You Are:

• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or equivalent work experience

• 5 years of progressive experience repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking OR a Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemistry or related field plus 1-2 years of progressive experience repairing or servicing complex mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking

• Successfully training or certification as defined by RD Services Leadership and policy

• Ability to travel, including some overnight travel, is required

Preferred Qualifications:

• 8+ years of progressive experience or a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field plus 4+ years of progressive experience are required.

• Advanced knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, information technology, and basic chemistry.

• The ability to serve as an internal technical resource, provide support after hours and on weekends/holidays, and maintain strong customer relationships is essential.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Tennessee is 71,100.00 - 132,000.00 USD Annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.
Benefits

Are you ready to apply?

Relocation benefits are not available for this position.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s

titleByLocale.it: Technical Business Analista Europe - RDT Identity & Access Management

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Description / Description of the Area
We are seeking a skilled and motivated Technical Business Analyst with experience in Customer Identity & Access Management (CIAM) to support the delivery and continuous improvement of customer identity services.
The successful candidate will act as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating business needs into clear requirements and ensuring scalable, secure, and user-centric CIAM solutions. This role combines business analysis, technical understanding, stakeholder engagement, and delivery support in a complex enterprise environment.

Key Responsibilities
Business Analysis and Requirements Management

• Gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to customer identity, registration, authentication, consent, profile management, and access journeys.

• Translate business needs into functional and technical requirements, user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria.

• Challenge and refine requirements to ensure clarity, feasibility, and business value.

• Support prioritization of demand, backlog items, and roadmap initiatives.

Solution Design and Delivery Support

• Work closely with architects, engineers, and product teams to shape fit-for-purpose CIAM solutions.

• Support design discussions by bringing process, customer journey, and business context.

• Ensure requirements are traceable through delivery, testing, and implementation.

• Participate in release planning, change activities, and deployment readiness.

Stakeholder Management and Collaboration

• Engage with business, security, legal, compliance, digital, and IT stakeholders across multiple functions.

• Facilitate workshops, requirement sessions, and decision meetings.

• Communicate progress, risks, dependencies, and options clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

• Build alignment across diverse stakeholder groups.

Governance, Risk, and Compliance

• Support alignment with privacy and regulatory requirements such as GDPR and related frameworks.

• Ensure customer identity processes reflect governance, auditability, and security expectations.

• Contribute to control documentation and evidence gathering where required.

Continuous Improvement

• Identify pain points, inefficiencies, and opportunities to simplify CIAM processes and customer journeys.

• Support KPI tracking, service improvement initiatives, and process optimization.

• Stay informed on CIAM trends, identity standards, and digital customer expectations.

Qualifications
Education

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience is also valued.

Experience

• Proven experience as a Business Analyst, Technical Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role.

• Experience in Identity & Access Management, Customer Identity, digital platforms, or customer-facing systems.

• Experience working in enterprise delivery environments with multiple stakeholders.

Technical Skills

• Strong understanding of CIAM concepts such as registration, authentication, SSO, MFA, consent, profile lifecycle, and access control.

• Familiarity with identity standards such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and SAML.

• Ability to interpret APIs, system integrations, data flows, and technical dependencies.

• Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Visio, Miro, or equivalent collaboration platforms.

• Familiarity with SAP Customer Data Cloud (SAP CDC) or similar CIAM p

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner - LATAM

titleByLocale.it: Partner per l'acquisizione di talenti - LATAM

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. That’s what motivates us to innovate. Continuously promote science and ensure that everyone has access to the health care they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

As a Talent Acquisition Partner , you will work across borders within an empowered, self-organized environment. You will support team development and deliver exceptional candidate and stakeholder experiences by leveraging diverse talent and specialized expertise.

About the opportunity:

• Drive end-to-end standardized recruiting processes across multiple Latin American countries, delivering customized talent acquisition solutions, proactive sourcing, pipelining, and seamless candidate experiences.

• Manage the complete offer and negotiation process with all necessary stakeholders according to local specifications, ensuring compliance, creating proposals, and aligning with our total rewards strategy while securing internal approvals.

• Elevate customer value across the People & Culture suite by incorporating core behaviors and key metrics into every interaction with Hiring Managers, candidates, and stakeholders.

• Influence high-quality hiring decisions by focusing on the moments that matter most in the candidate journey and driving strategic talent conversations to enhance organizational efficiency.

• Leverage a scaled, AI-ready, and knowledge-sharing culture, utilizing and mastering advanced applicant tracking and sourcing tools such as Workday, Phenom People, and LinkedIn.

• Contribute directly to global recruiting priorities by participating in upskilling, talent exchange, or knowledge-sharing activities.

Who you are:

• 4+ years of recruiting experience in a corporate, biotech, or pharmaceutical setting, with a required University Degree.

• Trilingual fluency in Portuguese, Spanish, and English (mandatory).

• Expertise in progressive sourcing options (direct sourcing, web recruitment tools, networking, diversity recruiting) and a proven track record in proactive talent acquisition.

• Demonstrated experience in end-to-end Talent Acquisition across Latin America within corporate or agency settings.

• Technical proficiency in ATS systems, with a preference for Workday and Phenom, alongside offer process and systems management.

• Strong business acumen combined with stakeholder management, consultative problem-solving, communication and influencing skills.

• Agile mindset with the flexibility to adapt, move, and support different functions/capabilities as needed within a matrix environment.

Location: São Paulo – Hybrid model.

Relocation benefits are not available for this position.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position
Sobre Roche
Un futuro más saludable. Es lo que nos impulsa a innovar. Avanzar continuamente en la ciencia y garantizar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y en las generaciones futuras. Crear un mundo en el que todos tengamos más tiempo con las personas que amamos. Eso es lo que nos hace ser Roche.

Oportunidad
Esta es una oportunidad de aprendizaje dentro de nuestro departamento de Finanzas , específicamente en los procesos de cobranza y control financiero. Aquí desarrollarás experiencia técnica con capacitación y acompañamiento continuo, en un ambiente profesional, innovador y colaborativo.

Responsabilidades

• Gestión de Cartera: Administrar la recuperación oportuna de la cartera de clientes de acuerdo con la política de crédito y cobranza.

• Control de Pedidos: Ejecutar la liberación de pedidos en el sistema, revisando importes, límites de crédito y vencimientos, gestionando las autorizaciones necesarias.

• Maestro de Datos: Asegurar que la creación y mantenimiento de clientes sea correcta en el sistema, colaborando estrechamente con RSS, área comercial, contratos y squads.

• Procesos Administrativos: Generación de Notas de Crédito (NDC) por descuentos comerciales.

Para integrarte a nuestro equipo de Finanzas , buscamos el siguiente perfil:

• Perfil Académico: Ser estudiante activo de la carrera de Finanzas , Contaduría, Administración o afines.

• Disponibilidad: Capacidad para realizar la pasantía por un periodo mínimo de 1 año y medio (18 meses) .

• Habilidades: Persona organizada, metódica, con atención al detalle y mentalidad innovadora.

• Actitud: Excelente comunicación, actitud proactiva y un alto compromiso con su desarrollo profesional.

•

Beneficios de reubicación no están disponibles para esta posición.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Sobre Roche Un futuro más saludable. Es lo que nos impulsa a innovar. Avanzar continuamente en la ciencia y garantizar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y en las generaciones futuras. Crear un mundo en el que todos tengamos más tiempo con las personas que amamos. Eso es lo que nos hace ser Roche. Oportunidad Esta es una oportunidad de aprendizaje dentro de nuestro departamento de Finanzas , específicamente en los procesos de cobranza y control financiero. Aquí desarrollarás experiencia técnica con capacitación y acompañamiento continuo, en un ambiente profesional, innovador y colaborativo. Responsabilidades
• Gestión de Cartera: Administrar la recuperación oportuna de la cartera de clientes de acuerdo con la política de crédito y cobranza.
• Control de Pedidos: Ejecutar la liberación de pedidos en el sistema, revisando importes, límites de crédito y vencimientos, gestionando las autorizaciones necesarias.
• Maestro de Datos: Asegurar que la creación y mantenimiento de clientes sea correcta en el sistema, colaborando estrechamente con RSS, área comercial, contratos y squads.
• Procesos Administrativos: Generación de Notas de Crédito (NDC) por descuentos comerciales. Para integrarte a nuestro equipo de Finanzas , buscamos el siguiente perfil:
• Perfil Académico: Ser estudiante activo de la carrera de Finanzas , Contaduría, Administración o afines.
• Disponibilidad: Capacidad para realizar la pasantía por un periodo mínimo de 1 año y medio (18 meses) .
• Habilidades: Persona organizada, metódica, con atención al detalle y mentalidad innovadora.
• Actitud: Excelente comunicación, actitud proactiva y un alto compromiso con su desarrollo profesional.
• Beneficios de reubicación no están disponibles para esta posición. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Die Abteilung Pharma Technical Characterization Cell and Genetherapy (PTCG ) ist verantwortlich für die technische Entwicklung von in vivo Gentherapeutika in der präklinischen und klinischen Entwicklungsphase.

Das Team
Die Funktion Gentherapie-Analytik konzentriert sich auf die analytische Charakterisierung, Qualitätskontrolle sowie die Entwicklung und Implementierung neuartiger analytischer Technologien von präklinischen Studien bis zur Marktzulassung (BLA, Biologics License Application) und Markteinführung für gentherapeutische Modalitäten.

Deine Aufgaben
Wir suchen Dich mit speziellem Fokus auf Liquid Handling und Automation analytischer Methoden für die Testung und Charakterisierung von viralen Vektoren und Plasmiden . Zudem übernimmst du Projektverantwortung für Gentherapie Portfolioprojekte in der Entwicklung.

• Automation & Innovation: Scouting, Evaluierung, Entwicklung sowie die Implementierung und routinemäßige Anwendung innovativer vollautomatisierter E2E Lösungen von Methoden für die Charakterisierung von viralen Vektoren (vorwiegend rAAV) und Plasmiden.

• Portfolio Projektverantwortung: Du bist zentraler Ansprechpartner in präklinischen sowie klinischen Phasen für Gentherapie Portfolioprojekte, agierst als Vertreter der Analytischen Entwicklung und Qualitätskontrolle in den Technical Development Teams (TDT) und koordinierst anstehende Aufgaben innerhalb der Teams unter Berücksichtigung der Timelines.

• Funktionelle Analyse : Vorantreiben der Technologien zur Quantifizierung und funktionellen Charakterisierung in einem hochmotivierten, agilen und interdisziplinären Team.

• Praktische Durchführung: Eigenverantwortliche, selbstorganisierte Durchführung von Experimenten, Methodenentwicklung sowie Gerätequalifizierung und Test-Validierung unter GMP-Anforderungen inklusive der Durchführung der Analysen.

• Strategische Mitwirkung: Mitarbeit bei der Entwicklung und Definition von Kontroll- und Prüfstrategien für gentherapeutische Vektorenprodukte.

• Datenmanagement: Selbstständige Interpretation, Bewertung und Dokumentation von Daten sowie Erstellung von Analyseberichten gemäß den geltenden regulatorischen Vorschriften.

Unser Wunschprofil

• PhD-Abschluss in Biologie, molekularbiologischen oder einer anderen einschlägigen biowissenschaftlichen Disziplin mit > 3 Jahren praktische Erfahrung mit Liquid Handling Systemen für analytische Anwendungen.

• Darüber hinaus bringst du ein grundlegendes Verständnis für Datenbanken und Datenflüsse mit sowie Grundlagen in SQL, VBA, Python oder ähnlichen Programmiersprachen.

• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz und Fachkenntnisse (sowohl theoretisch als auch praktisch) in der Charakterisierung von viralen Vektoren (AAV, Lentiviren etc.) mittels analytischer Methoden.

• Expertenwissen auf dem Gebiet der Plasmide und gentherapeutischen Modalitäten (AAV, Lentiviren, etc.)

• Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen mit den Grundsätzen der GMP (z.B. Datenintegrität, Gerätequalifizierung, Testvalidierung).

• Ein hohes Maß an Eigenmotivation, Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Ergebnisorientierung und Teamfähigkeit.

• Fließende englische und deutsche Sprachkenntnisse (in Wort und Schrift).

Diese Position ist auf 2 Jahre befristet.

jobs.title: Enabling Support Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The P&C Enabling Support Network (ESN) is a self-organized global Network of P&C Enabling Support Specialists supporting the P&C world-wide integrated network. The P&C Enabling Support Specialist is a passionate, agile, client focused professional, located in a global support network which is the foundation of the P&C organization and enabler of its success. This position is future-oriented in business support and administration of the worldwide integrated network, connecting the dots across all functions.

Your Opportunity

• Partnering with different stakeholders using agile methodologies, contributing to strategic project management, planning and managing events.

• Providing technology support and continuous improvement of processes, implementation of embedded technology within the network.

• Taking an active role in developing our self-organized P&C Enabling Support Network further, while contributing to network related initiatives and projects.

• Providing support to global, regional & local P&C colleagues on a variety of tasks and levels of complexity. (e.g. complex travel and expense management, support for large events, complex meeting structures,).

jobs.title: Field Application Specialist | Clinical Chemistry/Haematology
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future. It is what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That is what makes us Roche.

This is a post-sales position in which predominant job responsibilities and requirements occur after the sale of the company’s product to the client. This role provides post-sales technical expertise during the installation, implementation and maintenance of company products, and may be involved in implementing detailed customer installation requirements. Key purpose of the role is to ensure that client’s needs have been met and that the product/solution is fully functioning according to specification and provide follow-up support to company sales staff and customer personnel by disseminating technical information on specific applications.

As a member of our Service and Support Community / Field Applications Specialists team, you will be primarily responsible for providing technical support and expertise to existing and potential customers across NSW & ACT, but also occasionally nationally.

In this Sydney based full time permanent position, you will be using your previous experience and training to install, train and provide troubleshooting assistance for Roche instrumentation, software and reagent systems, in hospitals, private pathology and medical research laboratories.

Who you are

You are someone who wants to influence your own development, is passionate about making a difference and comfortable with a constant changing environment. You are looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests across the functions and geographies, and where a job title is not considered the final destination of who you are, but the starting point.

You will ideally possess a relevant degree / diploma in Science / Laboratory Science plus minimum 3 years’ experience within a Clinical Chemistry/ Hematology Laboratory . You will have demonstrable ability to diagnose applications and operational issues on analytical systems and to successfully resolve issues in a timely manner.

You will have excellent communication skills with the ability to present to groups. Also required is an ability to work independently or as part of a team, and exceptional planning and organizational skills.

Your strong computer literacy with a working knowledge of MS Office, experience in Laboratory workflow assessment / LIS with desirable experience in Digital Imaging and superior customer service skills are pivotal to the success of Roche, therefore we expect our new team member to be customer focused, self motivated and enjoy working in a team environment.

A valid driver’s license is essential.

In return, you will be provided with a rewarding and challenging role, a supportive work environment in which you can grow and develop your skills, the opportunity to work for a market leading organisation, and a competitive remuneration package.

This role is only open to candidates that have full eligibility to live and work in Australia.

We do not accept any unsolicited resumes or enquiries from recruitment agencies. Roche has a dedicated in-house Talent Acquisition team.

What we offer
Roche offers rewarding growth opportunities, a competitive remuneration package and a collaborative culture where people are united in purpose and will stretch you to be brave, speak up and think differently. Feel emp

jobs.title: Filling Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & 
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities
Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:
● Participate in new facility design and construction, including but not limited to process design, FAT, SAT, IOPQ, smoke study, VHP, Isolator EMPQ, APS etc. to contribute to project delivery.
● Support the initial development and optimization of aseptic filling processes.
● Participate in the implementation of operation readiness, eg: draft equipment operation procedures and logbook, 5S, machine cleaning according to readiness plan.
● Trained and qualified on equipment operation and aseptic techniques.
● Perform other duties as assigned.

Routine Operation:
● Ensure routine operation in compliance with Roche’s GMP/SHE and regulation requirements.
● Performing the following tasks: e.g. vial washing, filling and stoppering, capping.
● Train new employees and enhance the professional capabilities of the team.
● Support environmental monitoring activities to ensure that the Isolatore environment meets aseptic standards.
● Handle deviations during production and implement CAPA.
● Diagnose and resolve equipment malfunctions promptly with the support of maintenance engineers to minimize downtime.
● Execute regular validation activities, such as APS.
● Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and traceability for the activities in the GMP area.
● Related IT system operations, such as SAP, MES, Veeva, Cornerstone.
● Perform other duties as assigned.

Education/

jobs.title: Medical Affairs (Field MSL) - Neuro - NSW/QLD
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. Join us in making this happen with:

• Effective customer engagement across NSW and QLD

• Expertise in the field of Neuroscience (Multiple sclerosis)

• Medical Science Liaison (MSL) experience within the healthcare setting

This field based Medical Affairs (MSL) position is internally referred to as the Medical Patient Journey Partner (M-PJP). This is a local customer facing role unlocking value along the patient journey - from mostly offering world-class medicines towards integrated solutions, much more partnering, innovating and leading generative disruption.

The M-PJP is a medical affairs role with a reporting line culminating with the Country Medical Director; this role has a Quality Use of Medicines (QUM) focus and operates at all times with non-promotional intent.

The M-PJP will be directly accountable to deliver better outcomes for patients, the ecosystem and the organisation, faster (the “triple win”).

What you will be working on:
The M-PJP is an empowered leader and the local medical affairs face of Roche who has decision making authority to request resources of Roche. In this role, you will be involved in:

• Scientific Leadership: Serve as a scientific expert for the company’s Neuroscience pipeline and marketed products, providing deep expertise to internal teams and external stakeholders.

• Stakeholder Engagement: Build and maintain relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs), clinical investigators, and academic researchers within the Neuroscience field.

• Education & Training: Provide scientific education and training to healthcare professionals, internal teams, and partners, ensuring accurate, up-to-date information about our products.

• Evidence Generation and Clinical Support: Support clinical trial development by providing scientific insights and collaborating with clinical teams on ongoing and upcoming clinical trials.

• Data Communication: Effectively communicate complex scientific data, including clinical trial results, in a clear, concise manner to a wide range of audiences.

• Field Intelligence: Gather and analyze scientific and clinical insights from the field, and provide feedback to shape product strategy, development, and commercialization efforts.

• Compliance & Documentation: Ensure all interactions comply with industry regulations and ethical standards. Maintain accurate documentation of scientific activities.

Who you are:
As a driven medical affairs professional, you think from an enterprise level, beyond boundaries and borders, in order to bring best possible outcomes to both the local health environment, and more broadly, across Roche globally. You have:

• University degree (life sciences) and/or Healthcare professional qualification with practical understanding of digital innovation methodologies. An advanced degree in Life Sciences and/or MBA is a plus

• At least 5 years of demonstrated experience in the medical affairs or related field (e.g. MSL) within in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry with up to date knowledge of Medicines Australia Code of Conduct

• Scientific and Therapy Area expertise in Neuroscience in mapping patient journeys and related treatments in the assigned TA, enabling engagement at the specialist level

• Ro
