descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Partecipa a Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) come Global Business Process Specialist Financial Compliance – Financial Approvals. In questo ruolo, sarete parte integrante del Capitolo di Compliance Finanziaria di Gestione dei Processi RSS, riportando direttamente al Lead del Capitolo di Compliance Finanziaria. Siamo alla ricerca di un professionista eccezionale pronto a navigare reti globali complesse, innovazione di processo di campione, e salvaguardare la conformità finanziaria. A Roche, troverete un ambiente stabile ma dinamico che offre percorsi di carriera eccezionali, modelli di lavoro flessibili, e l'opportunità di lasciare il segno sulle operazioni globali. Lei sarà: Come Global Business Process Specialist Compliance finanziaria – Finanziaria Approvazioni sarete responsabili per i seguenti:
• Manutenzione e esecuzione dei processi: Sostenere l'attuazione della strategia E2E Business Process Management (BPM) attraverso il dominio Global Financial Approvals e Delegation of Authority (DoA).
• Multi-Platform Configuration: Assicurare che il Financial Approvals Engine funzioni senza soluzione di continuità in una rete integrata di sistemi di chiamata, tra cui myBuy, SAP S/4HANA, Fieldglass e MeetingSelect.
• Agile Delivery & Testing: agire come rappresentante chiave del business all'interno del treno di rilascio Agile (ART). Traduci le esigenze di business regionali in storie di utenti attuabili, collabora a stretto contatto con le squadre di consegna IT e coordina il test di accettazione utente (UAT).
• Compliance operativa & Governance: salvaguardare la conformità finanziaria applicando le protezioni globali ai requisiti locali. Aiuta a implementare complesse regole di approvazione legale e fiscale (come i overrides del hub regionale o la logica specifica di contrassegno) senza interrompere le prestazioni del sistema standard.
• Analisi Root-Cause: Indaga errori di sistema, strozzature di flusso di lavoro e discrepanze di dati master. Eseguire l'analisi delle cause root sulle questioni di conformità o operative e progettare soluzioni pratiche e sostenibili.
• Monitoraggio del processo & Reporting: Rivedere regolarmente le metriche delle prestazioni del processo (ad esempio, tempi di guida del sistema, eccezioni del flusso di lavoro) per identificare le aree per il miglioramento continuo e l'ottimizzazione magra. Chi sei? Cosa puoi portare alla nostra squadra. Stiamo cercando qualcuno che è auto motivato, davvero appassionato del suo lavoro e capisce che fornire un servizio di alta qualità è fondamentale per l'organizzazione. Al fine di fornire soluzioni sanitarie innovative ai nostri pazienti, abbiamo bisogno del miglior talento nella nostra organizzazione. Come membro del team ideale siete open-minded, dedicato a fare la differenza e aperto allo sviluppo costante. Inoltre, avresti:
• Corso di laurea in Finanza, Business Administration, Informatica, Ingegneria o una formazione comparabile . 5-7 anni di esperienza professionale, preferibilmente in Business Process Management, Gestione delle informazioni / IT, Finanza / approvvigionamento, Risk/Internal Control Management, Contabilità, Audit
• Conoscenze di processo solide nei flussi di lavoro finanziari e di approvvigionamento end-to-end, con esperienza pratica o una forte familiarità tecnica con SAP FI/CO o SAP S/4HANA. Prove competenze metodologiche nel miglioramento continuo e nella gestione dei processi (ad esempio BPM, Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen) e nell'esperienza di lavoro all'interno di un quadro Agile (SAFe/Scrum).
• Ottima collaborazione, comunicazione e capacità di influenzare in modo efficace le esigenze degli stakeholder della finanza locale, degli stakeholder globali e dei team di template globali. Forte pensiero analitico e una mentalità innovativa per migliorare il processo creativo, abbinato w
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Join Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) as a Global Business Process Specialist Financial Compliance – Financial Approvals. In this role, you will be an integral part of the RSS Business Process Management Financial Compliance Chapter, reporting directly to the Financial Compliance Chapter Lead. We are looking for an outstanding professional ready to navigate complex global networks, champion process innovation, and safeguard financial compliance. At Roche, you will find a stable yet dynamically expanding environment that offers exceptional career paths, flexible working models, and the opportunity to leave your mark on global operations. You will be : As Global Business Process Specialist Financial Compliance – Financial Approvals you will be responsible for the following:
• Process Maintenance & Execution: Support the implementation of the E2E Business Process Management (BPM) strategy across the global Financial Approvals and Delegation of Authority (DoA) domain.
• Multi-Platform Configuration: Ensure the Financial Approvals Engine functions seamlessly across an integrated network of calling systems, including myBuy, SAP S/4HANA, Fieldglass, and MeetingSelect.
• Agile Delivery & Testing: Act as a key business representative within the Agile Release Train (ART). Translate regional business needs into actionable user stories, collaborate closely with IT delivery squads, and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
• Operational Compliance & Governance: Safeguard financial compliance by applying global guardrails to local requirements. Help implement complex legal and tax approval rules (such as regional hub overrides or specific contract-signing logic) without disrupting standard system performance.
• Root-Cause Analysis: Investigate system errors, workflow bottlenecks, and master data discrepancies. Perform root-cause analysis on compliance or operational issues and design practical, sustainable fixes.
• Process Monitoring & Reporting: Regularly review process performance metrics (e.g., system lead times, workflow exceptions) to identify areas for continuous improvement and lean optimization. Who you are : What can you bring to our team. We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. In order to provide innovative healthcare solutions to our patients, we need the best talent in our organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you would have:
• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Informatics, Engineering or a comparable education . 5-7 years professional experience, preferably in Business Process Management, Information Management / IT, Finance/Procurement, Risk/Internal Control Management, Accounting, Audit
• Solid process knowledge in end-to-end finance and procurement workflows, with hands-on experience or strong technical familiarity with SAP FI/CO or SAP S/4HANA. Proven methodological skills in continuous improvement and process management (e.g., BPM, Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen) and experience working within an Agile framework (SAFe/Scrum).
• Excellent collaboration, communication and influencing skills to effectively manage the needs of local finance stakeholders, global stakeholders and global template teams . Strong analytical thinking and an innovative mindset to drive creative process improvements, paired w
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Mit Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) als Global Business Process Specialist Financial Compliance – Financial Approvals. In dieser Funktion werden Sie ein integraler Bestandteil des RSS Business Process Management Financial Compliance Kapitels sein, das direkt an das Financial Compliance Kapitel Lead berichtet. Wir sind auf der Suche nach einem hervorragenden Profi, der bereit ist, komplexe globale Netzwerke zu navigieren, Prozessinnovation zu Champions und finanzielle Compliance zu sichern. Bei Roche finden Sie ein stabiles und dynamisch expandierendes Umfeld, das außergewöhnliche Karrierewege, flexible Arbeitsmodelle und die Möglichkeit bietet, sich auf den globalen Betrieb zu verlassen. Sie werden : Als Global Business Process Specialist Financial Compliance – Finanzen Sie werden für folgende Zwecke zuständig sein:
• Process Maintenance & Execution: Unterstützung der Umsetzung der E2E Business Process Management (BPM)-Strategie in der globalen Finanzgenehmigung und Delegation der Behörde (DoA)-Domain.
• Multi-Platform Konfiguration: Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Financial Approvals Engine Funktionen nahtlos über ein integriertes Netzwerk von Calling-Systemen, einschließlich myBuy, SAP S/4HANA, Fieldglass und MeetingSelect.
• Agile Delivery & Testing: Aktivieren Sie als Schlüsselunternehmen im Agile Release Train (ART). Übersetzen Sie regionale Geschäftsanforderungen in handlungsfähige Benutzergeschichten, arbeiten Sie eng mit IT-Lieferungseinheiten zusammen und koordinieren Sie User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
• Operationelle Compliance & Governance: Sicherung der finanziellen Konformität durch Anwendung globaler Schutzschienen auf lokale Anforderungen. Hilfe bei der Umsetzung komplexer gesetzlicher und steuerlicher Genehmigungsregeln (z.B. regionaler Hubüberschreitungen oder spezifischer Vertragsunterzeichnungslogik) ohne Störung der Standard-Systemleistung.
• Root-Cause Analyse: Untersuchung von Systemfehlern, Workflow Engpässen und Stammdatenabweichungen. Führen Sie Root-Cause-Analysen zu Compliance- oder operationellen Fragen durch und entwerfen Sie praktische, nachhaltige Lösungen.
• Prozessüberwachung & Reporting: Regelmäßige Überprüfung der Prozessleistungsmetriken (z.B. Systemlaufzeiten, Workflow Ausnahmen), um Bereiche für kontinuierliche Verbesserung und schlanke Optimierung zu identifizieren. Wer sind Sie? Was können Sie zu unserem Team bringen. Wir suchen jemanden, der selbst motiviert ist, wirklich leidenschaftlich über seinen Job ist und versteht, dass die Bereitstellung eines hochwertigen Service für die Organisation entscheidend ist. Um unseren Patienten innovative Gesundheitslösungen zu bieten, benötigen wir das beste Talent in unserer Organisation. Als ideales Teammitglied sind Sie offen, um einen Unterschied zu machen und offen für die ständige Entwicklung. Darüber hinaus hätten Sie:
• Bachelor-Abschluss in Finanzen, Betriebswirtschaft, Informatik, Ingenieurwesen oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung . 5-7 Jahre Berufserfahrung, vorzugsweise in Business Process Management, Information Management / IT, Finanzen / Beschaffung, Risiko/Internal Control Management, Accounting, Audit
• Solide Prozesskenntnisse in End-to-End-Finanzierungs- und Beschaffungs-Workflows, mit Hand-on-Erfahrung oder starker technischer Vertrautheit mit SAP FI/CO oder SAP S/4HANA. Bewährte methodische Fähigkeiten im kontinuierlichen Verbesserungs- und Prozessmanagement (z.B. BPM, Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen) und Erfahrungsarbeit in einem Agile-Framework (SAFe/Scrum).
• Ausgezeichnete Zusammenarbeit, Kommunikation und Einflussnahme von Fähigkeiten, um die Bedürfnisse der lokalen Finanzträger, globale Interessenvertreter und globale Vorlagenteams effektiv zu verwalten. Starkes analytisches Denken und eine innovative Denkweise, um kreative Prozessverbesserungen zu fördern, gepaart mit
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Rejoignez Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) comme spécialiste des processus d'affaires mondiaux Conformité financière – Approbations financières. Dans ce rôle, vous ferez partie intégrante du chapitre Gestion des processus opérationnels du RSS Conformité financière, qui relève directement du responsable du chapitre Conformité financière. Nous recherchons un professionnel exceptionnel prêt à naviguer sur des réseaux mondiaux complexes, à promouvoir l'innovation dans les processus et à préserver la conformité financière. Chez Roche, vous trouverez un environnement stable mais dynamique qui offre des parcours de carrière exceptionnels, des modèles de travail flexibles et la possibilité de laisser votre marque sur les opérations mondiales. Vous serez : En tant que spécialiste des processus opérationnels mondiaux Conformité financière – Vous serez responsable des approbations suivantes :
• Maintenance et exécution des processus : Appuyer la mise en œuvre de la stratégie de gestion des processus opérationnels E2E (BPM) dans le domaine des approbations financières mondiales et de la délégation de pouvoirs.
• Configuration multiplateforme : assurer le fonctionnement du moteur d'approbation financière dans un réseau intégré de systèmes d'appel, y compris myBuy, SAP S/4HANA, Fieldglass et MeetingSelect.
• Livraison Agile & Test: Agir en tant que représentant commercial clé dans le train de libération Agile (ART). Traduire les besoins commerciaux régionaux en histoires d'utilisateurs exploitables, collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de livraison des TI, et coordonner les tests d'acceptation des utilisateurs (UAT).
• Conformité opérationnelle et gouvernance : protégez la conformité financière en appliquant des garde-corps mondiaux aux exigences locales. Aider à mettre en oeuvre des règles juridiques et fiscales complexes (comme les règles de remplacement des centres régionaux ou la logique de signature des contrats) sans perturber la performance standard du système.
• Analyse des causes profondes : Étudier les erreurs du système, les goulots d'étranglement et les écarts de données. Effectuer une analyse des causes profondes sur les questions de conformité ou d'exploitation et concevoir des correctifs pratiques et durables.
• Suivi des processus et établissement de rapports : Revoir régulièrement les paramètres de performance des processus (p. ex., délais d'exécution des systèmes, exceptions au flux de travail) afin d'identifier les domaines à améliorer en permanence et d'optimiser le maigre. Qui vous êtes : Que pouvez-vous apporter à notre équipe. Nous cherchons quelqu'un qui est motivé par lui-même, qui est vraiment passionné par son travail et qui comprend que la prestation d'un service de haute qualité est cruciale pour l'organisation. Afin de fournir des solutions de santé innovantes à nos patients, nous avons besoin des meilleurs talents de notre organisation. En tant que membre idéal de l'équipe, vous êtes ouvert d'esprit, dévoué à faire la différence et ouvert à un développement constant. De plus, vous auriez :
• Baccalauréat en finance, administration des affaires, informatique, ingénierie ou une formation comparable . 5-7 ans d'expérience professionnelle, de préférence en gestion des processus d'affaires, gestion de l'information / TI, finances / achats, gestion des risques / contrôle interne, comptabilité, audit
• Une connaissance solide des processus dans les flux de travail financiers et d'approvisionnement de bout en bout, avec une expérience pratique ou une forte connaissance technique de SAP FI/CO ou SAP S/4HANA. Compétences méthodologiques éprouvées en amélioration continue et en gestion des processus (p. ex. BPM, Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen) et expérience de travail dans un cadre agile (SAFe/Scrum).
• Excellente collaboration, communication et influence des compétences pour gérer efficacement les besoins des acteurs financiers locaux, des acteurs mondiaux et des équipes modèles mondiales. Une pensée analytique forte et un état d'esprit innovant pour stimuler l'amélioration des processus créatifs, jumelé w

jobs.title: Patient Journey Partner-Rare Disease(北區)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Scope

• Health care is changing: Radical innovation, increased openness to change, increasing patient empowerment, multiple sources of medical information, and pressure on public spending. As a result of all this, the needs of our stakeholders continue to evolve.

• The Patient Journey Partner (PJP) is at the center of the new Roche organization, turning upside down the role we play in society - from mostly offering world-class medicines towards much more partnering, innovating and leading generative disruption. By doing so the PJP will be directly accountable to deliver better outcomes for patients, their community, the ecosystem and the organization, faster.

• The PJP is an empowered leader and the local face of Roche. She or he partners closely with all stakeholders directly touching the patient journey (in a given therapeutic or disease area), gaining a deep understanding of their needs in order to connect Roche’s capabilities to co-create meaningful solutions.

• This role is locally embedded in the ecosystem, it is an integrated role, functionally agnostic, (i.e. it does not fit into the traditional concepts of Commercial/Sales or Medical Affairs)

• It has no profitability, sales objectives or incentives

The PJP is a senior level role within the affiliate, who has decision making authority to request resources of Roche (both within the affiliate and broader network) in order to have improved impact on the patient journey

• The PJP focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem.

• Acts as trusted partner and is the primary (but non-exclusive) point of contact between stakeholders and Roche; the PJP shares the patient and stakeholder community needs internally, prioritizes and secures resources, and drives solutions that deliver outcomes faster.

• Partners with patient journey stakeholders to remove roadblocks and unlock possibilities to deliver value for patients and the community.

• Stewards Roche’s products through their lifecycle and supports their appropriate use, which includes sharing their merits with HCPs in a truthful and balanced manner.

• By overseeing the patient journey in its entirety, the PJP acts as a system thinker with the ability to identify shared purpose among stakeholders and leverages this to co-create solutions with stakeholders in the ecosystem.

• The role is empowered to pull in expertise and resources locally and from the network as needed, including in collaboration with other PJPs.

• Ensuring great experiences whenever stakeholders in the ecosystem engage with Roche employees, products and services.

Requirements
Education:

• University degree (scientific, economic, or business degree). An advanced degree in Life science and/or MBA is a plus.

• Practical understanding of digital innovation methodologies

• CCXA Academy (desired)

Skills & Knowledge:

• System thinker and deep listener

• Excellent stakeholder engagement skills including partnering with TAE's and organizations is required. Experience partnering with PAGs is highly desired.

• Experience leading Cross-functional team is required. Experience in both formulating cross-functional strategies and orchestrating cross-functional teams is highly desired.

• Strong business acumen with desired expertise in commercialization, medical and customer expe

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Job Scope
• Health care is changing: Radical innovation, increased openness to change, increasing patient empowerment, multiple sources of medical information, and pressure on public spending. As a result of all this, the needs of our stakeholders continue to evolve.
• The Patient Journey Partner (PJP) is at the center of the new Roche organization, turning upside down the role we play in society - from mostly offering world-class medicines towards much more partnering, innovating and leading generative disruption. By doing so the PJP will be directly accountable to deliver better outcomes for patients, their community, the ecosystem and the organization, faster.
• The PJP is an empowered leader and the local face of Roche. She or he partners closely with all stakeholders directly touching the patient journey (in a given therapeutic or disease area), gaining a deep understanding of their needs in order to connect Roche’s capabilities to co-create meaningful solutions.
• This role is locally embedded in the ecosystem, it is an integrated role, functionally agnostic, (i.e. it does not fit into the traditional concepts of Commercial/Sales or Medical Affairs)
• It has no profitability, sales objectives or incentives The PJP is a senior level role within the affiliate, who has decision making authority to request resources of Roche (both within the affiliate and broader network) in order to have improved impact on the patient journey
• The PJP focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem.
• Acts as trusted partner and is the primary (but non-exclusive) point of contact between stakeholders and Roche; the PJP shares the patient and stakeholder community needs internally, prioritizes and secures resources, and drives solutions that deliver outcomes faster.
• Partners with patient journey stakeholders to remove roadblocks and unlock possibilities to deliver value for patients and the community.
• Stewards Roche’s products through their lifecycle and supports their appropriate use, which includes sharing their merits with HCPs in a truthful and balanced manner.
• By overseeing the patient journey in its entirety, the PJP acts as a system thinker with the ability to identify shared purpose among stakeholders and leverages this to co-create solutions with stakeholders in the ecosystem.
• The role is empowered to pull in expertise and resources locally and from the network as needed, including in collaboration with other PJPs.
• Ensuring great experiences whenever stakeholders in the ecosystem engage with Roche employees, products and services. Requirements Education:
• University degree (scientific, economic, or business degree). An advanced degree in Life science and/or MBA is a plus.
• Practical understanding of digital innovation methodologies
• CCXA Academy (desired) Skills & Knowledge:
• System thinker and deep listener
• Excellent stakeholder engagement skills including partnering with TAE's and organizations is required. Experience partnering with PAGs is highly desired.
• Experience leading Cross-functional team is required. Experience in both formulating cross-functional strategies and orchestrating cross-functional teams is highly desired.
• Strong business acumen with desired expertise in commercialization, medical and customer expe

jobs.title: Head of Operations, APAC Hub
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Head of Operations, APAC Hub

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

We are looking for a strategic and results-driven Head of Operations APAC HUB to lead and oversee our outsourced Global Distribution HUB based in Singapore, serving the Asia Pacific region. This pivotal role is responsible for ensuring operational excellence, driving continuous performance improvement, and strengthening relationships with third-party logistics and distribution partners. The ideal candidate brings deep operational expertise, strong leadership capabilities, and a collaborative mindset to manage complex supply chain dynamics in a fast-paced, high-impact environment.

The Opportunity

• Strategic & Operational Leadership: Oversee and align end-to-end operations of the APAC Distribution HUB with corporate and regional strategies, contributing to the development and execution of long-term distribution plans.

• Performance & Compliance Management: Define, track, and optimize key performance indicators (KPIs) and service levels, while ensuring full compliance with global trade regulations, regional customs requirements, and contractual agreements with 3PL partners.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management: Collaborate with a wide range of internal teams and external partners to streamline processes, enhance customer satisfaction, and manage governance frameworks.

• Financial & Inventory Oversight: Manage a significant annual operating budget (SGD 25M) and an extensive inventory stock (~SGD 200M), balancing cost-effectiveness with service excellence and ensuring accuracy and availability across the region.

• Team Leadership & Talent Development: Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing operations team of more than 3 direct reports, fostering a culture of accountability and building future leadership pipelines.

• Continuous Improvement & Digital Transformation: Champion the adoption of digital tools, automation, and analytics to drive operational visibility, predictive planning, and continuous process improvements.

• Risk Management & Business Continuity: Identify and mitigate operational risks through robust business continuity planning and crisis response strategies.

• Values & Sustainability Champion: Promote a safe, efficient, and inclusive work environment, championing sustainable practices aligned with Roche’s values and ESG goals.

Who you are

• You should possess a minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in operations or supply chain management, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role within a regional or global distribution environment. A Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field is required, while a Master’s degree (e.g., MBA or relevant technical specialization) is preferred.

• Strategic Leadership: Proven ability to lead, mentor, and develop high-performing teams while leveraging advanced analytical skills to drive data-driven decisions and contribute to long-term distribution strategies.

• Operational & Financial Oversight: Demonstrated success in managing complex outsourced operations and third-party logistics (3PL) providers, with a strong focus on optimizing financial performance, service levels, and inventor

jobs.title: Biostatistiker (m/w/d) innerhalb R&D Diagnostics
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Als Biostatistiker (m/w/d) in unserem Team bist du der analytische Motor hinter der nächsten Generation medizinischer Diagnostik. In einem multidisziplinären Umfeld schaffst du die
statistische Evidenz, die für weltweite Zulassungen lebensrettender Tests entscheidend ist. Unser Team an den Standorten Penzberg, Mannheim und Indianapolis lebt eine moderne, hybride Arbeitskultur und arbeitet regionen- und indikationenübergreifend in den Kundensegmenten Core Lab und Near Patient Care.

Das erwartet Dich in der Rolle

• Verantwortung für die Planung und Durchführung statistischer Analysen für komplexe klinische Studien, damit unsere innovativen Diagnostiklösungen weltweit die Zulassungshürden nehmen und zeitnah beim Patienten ankommen.

• Du beherrscht ein breites Repertoir statistischer Standardmethoden und bist in der Lage, dich schnell in komplexe Verfahren einzuarbeiten.

• Professionelle Programmierung statistischer Analysen (primär in R) sowie Ursachenanalyse bei komplexen Fragestellungen während der Studiendurchführung.

• Du agierst als „Statistical Translator“ durch die adressatengerechte Präsentation von Ergebnissen für unsere Partner aus Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Operations sowie bei Behörden.

• Fachliche Anleitung und Mentoring von Teammitgliedern sowie Studierenden zur Förderung des internen Wissensaustauschs.

• Du wirkst aktiv an internen „Communities of Practice“ mit, um beispielsweise methodische und programmiertechnische Standards kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Wer du bist

• Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium oder Promotion in Statistik, Biostatistik, Mathematik, Physik oder einem vergleichbaren quantitativen Fach.

• Mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung (Master 5–7 Jahre / Promotion 3–5 Jahre), idealerweise im Bereich klinischer Zulassungsstudien.

• Du hast fundierte Programmierkenntnisse, idealerweise in R, sowie Erfahrung im Management großer Datensätze.

• Sicherer Umgang mit modernen statistischen Modellierungstechniken und deren Anwendung in einem regulierten Umfeld.

• Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke, um komplexe statistische Theorien und Ergebnisse gegenüber fachfremden Stakeholdern souverän zu vertreten.

• Selbstständige und pro-aktive Arbeitsweise, analytisches Denkvermögen und ein ausgeprägtes Team-Mindset.

Diese Position ist auf zwei Jahre befristet.

Deine Bewerbung

Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:

• Aktueller Lebenslauf

• Idealerweise auch Zeugnisse und ein Motivationsschreiben

Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt.

Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden können.

Bewerbungszeitraum bis mindestens 12.06.2026.
(Bewerbung möglich, solange die Stelle ausgeschrieben ist)

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global imp

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Dein neues Team
Als Mitglied des PDG Country Study Start-Up Teams liegt dein Hauptaugenmerk darauf, einen reibungslosen und hocheffizienten Studienstart sicherzustellen, um so die Bereitstellung klinischer Studien für Patient:innen zu unterstützen. Du bringst klinische Studien innovativ auf den Weg: Du deckst den spezifischen Bedarf in der Start-up-Phase über verschiedene Therapiegebiete hinweg und garantierst einen reibungslosen Ablauf für Patient:innen und Prüfzentren. In dieser Schlüsselrolle vernetzt du dich intensiv mit lokalen und globalen Teams sowie unseren CRO Partnern (Auftragsforschungsinstituten).

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
In dieser Rolle konzentrierst du dich auf die effiziente und rechtskonforme Initiierung von Roche-gesponserten klinischen Studien. Du entwickelst effektive Start-up-Strategien, steuerst die operativen Abläufe und treibst Prozessverbesserungen auf Länder- und Zentren-Ebene voran – immer unter Einhaltung aller regulatorischen Vorgaben.Deine Hauptaufgaben umfassen:

• Strategische Leitung: Du leitest Teams bei der strategischen Planung der operativen Durchführung des Studienstarts, wobei Du die Verantwortung für Risikomanagement, regulatorische Compliance sowie die partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit mit externen Stakeholdern trägst.

• Operative Exzellenz: Du managst die Start-up-Aktivitäten und stellst eine termingerechte Aktivierung der Prüfzentren sowie die regulatorische Compliance sicher. Du verantwortest und steuerst den gesamten Budget- und Vertragsprozess – von der Erstellung der Budgets über die Vertragsverhandlung und Versicherungsdokumente bis hin zur systemseitigen Datenpflege, um die finanzielle und rechtliche Konformität sowie eine präzise Planung zu gewährleisten.

• Globale Ausrichtung: Du arbeitest mit dem globalen Studienteam zusammen und stellst sicher, dass die Zeitpläne eingehalten werden und managst Amendments über den gesamten Studienzyklus hinweg.

• Innovation & Standardisierung: Du identifizierst Chancen zur Prozessoptimierung und Automatisierung und arbeitest mit regionalen sowie globalen Partnern zusammen, um Systeme zu harmonisieren und Zeitpläne zu optimieren.

• Behördenkommunikation: Du stehst im Austausch mit Behörden und Institutionen (z. B. Ethikkommissionen und Gesundheitsbehörden), um Richtlinien und Praktiken bei klinischen Studien aufeinander abzustimmen.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit
Für die Rolle als Study Start Up Lead (SSUL) (m/w/d) bringst du ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium (MD, PhD, Master oder Bachelor) in den Life Sciences oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit. Ein weiterführender Hochschulabschluss (Postgraduate/Master) ist dabei sehr wünschenswert. Folgende Punkte runden dein Profil ab:

• Berufserfahrung: Du verfügst über fundierte Erfahrung im Start-up von klinischen Studien, in regulatorischen Einreichungsprozessen sowie in der cross-funktionalen Zusammenarbeit.

• Fachwissen: Du besitzt ein tiefgreifendes Verständnis der ICH-GCP-Leitlinien, der EU-CTR sowie der lokalen regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen und hast bereits Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Dienstleistern und CROs gesammelt.

• Methoden & IT: Du bist sicher im Umgang mit klinischen Systemen (z. B. Veeva Vault, CTIS, RIM) und zeichnest dich durch starke organisatorische, analytische und problemlösungsorientierte Fähigkeiten aus.

• Mindset: Du bringst eine kollaborative und adaptive Denkweise mit. Es gelingt dir, auch in komplexen, matrixorganisierten und globalen Teams den Überblick zu be

jobs.title: Project Manager - Strategic Operations
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche Diagnostics, we believe that project management is about being the operational backbone of innovation. As a Global Project Manager (GPM), you will be a catalyst for redefining how we deliver impactful diagnostic solutions. We are evolving this role into a strategic orchestration function, where the focus is on enabling value, ensuring end-to-end traceability, and driving operational excellence at a systemic level.
We are looking for operational architects who can challenge the status quo. By taking ownership of the links between strategy and execution, connecting cross-functional teams, and building a "single source of truth," you will help elevate the GPM role into a servant-leader position that ensures teams have the space and focus required to innovate.

Your Challenges
Your mission is to move beyond traditional task-tracking and actively shape the operational health of our global portfolios. Key challenges include:

• Operational Orchestration: Act as a strategic partner ensuring vertical traceability—ensuring that high-level goals are clearly connected to execution units to enable autonomous, high-quality decisions.

• Systemic Flow & Friction Reduction: Proactively identify and resolve structural bottlenecks. You will act as a servant-leader, absorbing operational overhead and administrative friction to protect the core delivery teams.

• Single Source of Truth: Guarantee reliable, consolidated data for tracking investments, capacity, and risks. You will move the organization toward predictive steering rather than reactive reporting.

• Integrated Operating Excellence: Drive the organic adoption of standardized frameworks (Quality, Regulatory, and Methodology) into daily workflows, ensuring compliance is "built-in" rather than an after-the-fact exercise.

• Cross-Domain Connectivity: Facilitate high-level Risk and Opportunity management (ROMA) and coordinate critical integration points between different lifecycles to ensure organizational coherence.

​ Who You Are
We need systems-thinkers who are obsessed with efficiency and data integrity.

• Experience: 3+ years leading complex operational frameworks or portfolios in Biotech/Tech. You are comfortable navigating highly regulated environments.

• Expertise: Mastery of the "Ops Stack" (JIRA, Smartsheet, Monday.com, Aha!) and modern frameworks (SAFe, Lean, or Systems Thinking).

• Strategic Impact: Proven ability to translate complex strategy into clear operational execution plans.

• Mindset: A fierce advocate for team autonomy who views "operations" as a product that needs to be optimized for the user.

Are you a Project Manager who is tired of chasing status updates? Do you believe that the best leaders don't just "check boxes"—they build the systems that make work flow?

At Roche Diagnostics, we are transforming the Global Project Manager role. We are moving away from administrative reporting and toward Operational Intelligence. We are looking for the "Engineers of Value"—people who can connect the dots between high-level strategy and the technical teams delivering life-saving solutions.
In this role, you will be the "Operational Pilot" for our most critical Lifecycles:

• You will build the Single Source of Truth: No more fragmented data. You will ensure that strategy and execution are perfectly aligned in our tools and our minds.

• You will kill friction: Your job is to shield teams from bureaucracy. If there is a bottleneck in the

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das ist es, was uns bewegt, innovativ zu sein. Wir bringen die Wissenschaft ständig voran und sorgen dafür, dass alle Menschen heute und in Zukunft Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung haben, die sie brauchen. Eine Welt zu schaffen, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das ist es, was uns zu Roche macht.

In der R&D-Abteilung Process Technologies and Material Science (Teil von Roche Diagnostics Solutions) entwickeln wir chemische Einsatzstoffe für das gesamte diagnostische Produktportfolio. Das Team Bioorganic Development & Transfer besteht aus 8 Mitarbeitenden mit wissenschaftlichem und technischem Hintergrund. Wir arbeiten an organisch-chemischen Synthesen und Up-scale Projekten und gehen dabei flexibel und zielorientiert vor, um maßgeschneiderte Moleküle für unsere Projektpartner zu entwickeln. Dabei legen wir Wert auf eine hohe Qualität und den Spaß an der gemeinsamen Arbeit.

Deine zentralen Aufgaben

In dieser Rolle bringst Du Deine fundierte Labor-Expertise direkt in die Entwicklung innovativer Diagnostika ein:

• Synthese & Herstellung: Du planst und führst eigenständig organisch-präparative Synthesen im Bereich niedermolekularer Verbindungen und deren funktionellen Bausteinen durch

• Up-Scale Arbeiten: Darüber hinaus bist Du für die Maßstabsvergrößerung chemischer Reaktionen vom Milligramm- bis in den Multigramm-Bereich verantwortlich

• Chromatographie & Downstream Prozesse: Du bringst Deine Expertise in die Aufreinigung komplexer Reaktionsmischungen ein (z. B. Flash-Chromatographie, HPLC) und optimierst Downstream-Prozesse

• Charakterisierung : Du isolierst die Zielverbindungen und nutzt moderne analytische Methoden (z. B. NMR, MS, HPLC/UV) zur Strukturaufklärung und In-Prozess-Kontrolle

• Prozessoptimierung & Transfer: Du optimierst etablierte Syntheseprozesse, um einen reibungslosen Transfer in die Produktion vorzubereiten und erstellst die entsprechenden Verfahrensanweisungen

• Dokumentation & Innovation: Du dokumentierst Deine Ergebnisse präzise, präsentierst diese im Team und setzt Dein Spezialwissen ein, um Projekte innerhalb von Roche Diagnostics voranzutreiben

Dein Profil

• Du hast ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium in Chemie (Bachelor) mit Schwerpunkt Organische Chemie oder eine Ausbildung zum Chemielaborant mit Weiterbildung zum Techniker oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

• Darüber hinaus bringst Du tiefgreifende Kenntnisse und praktische Erfahrung in der klassischen präparativen organischen Synthese mit

• Auf Dein fundiertes Know-how in der präparativen Chromatographie sowie auf Deine Erfahrung beim Up-scale von chemischen Prozessen können wir uns voll und ganz verlassen

• Ein sicherer Umgang mit gängigen Charakterisierungsmethoden (NMR, MS, HPLC) zeichnet Dich aus

• Du hast Freude an der Lösung komplexer chemischer Fragestellungen und am Arbeiten in einem dynamischen Team

• Zuverlässigkeit, Gewissenhaftigkeit und eine strukturierte Vorgehensweise sind für Dich selbstverständlich

• Außerdem bist Du ein Teamplayer mit sicherem Kommunikationsstil in Deutsch und Englisch

Diese Stelle ist auf 2 Jahre befristet.

Deine Bewerbung
Wir machen es Dir leicht: Bitte lade lediglich Deinen aktuellen, aussagekräftigen Lebenslauf sowie das Zeugnis Deines höchsten Abschlusses hoch.
Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Employee Experience Operations is focused on delivering professional IT support for our Roche affiliates in the EMEA region and globally as well in cooperation with our service centers in Costa Rica and Malaysia. Our teams consist of English, German, Spanish, Italian, Polish and French speaking Service Desk Specialists from beginners to highly skilled professionals.

Disclosure Note: The final job title is Employee Experience Operations IT Specialist.

The Opportunity

• Provide first-level support for software and hardware incidents and service requests across Mac, Windows, Microsoft Office, and Google environments.

• Engage with users across multiple channels, including phone, chat, and self-service portal.

• Thrive as a key member of a truly AI-powered IT support operations team.

• Champion the end-users' needs, escalating critical situations as required to ensure swift resolution.

• Keep users updated on their request status, guiding them toward the best solutions for their productivity and satisfaction.

Who you are

We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:

• University education in IT or related discipline is preferred

• 1.5 - 2 years of experience in call center, service desk, or IT desk-side support

• Experience with Apple and Microsoft operating systems, Google suite, Microsoft Office products, SAP, corporate networks, and video conferencing systems

• Strong troubleshooting, task prioritization, and problem-solving skills

• Fluency in German and English

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

​ Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process: https://go.roche.com/budapest-data-privacy-notice-candidate

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
职位名称：罗氏制药生物统计分析实习生
工作地点：上海

实习部门/团队介绍: 整合证据生成与合规团队 (Integrated Evidence Generation and Compliance) 隶属医学事务部，致力于整合临床与真实世界数据，通过科学研究填补证据缺口，论证产品医学价值，赋能医学策略与临床决策。

加入该项目你将：

• 深度参与前沿研究： 与统计师及数据科学家协作，处理多元化的真实世界数据，支持高标准的医学证据生成。

• 统计分析实战： 运用常规及探索性统计方法，完成从数据清洗、标准化到核心分析代码（SAS/R）的编写与调试。

• 工具创新与优化： 运行并优化现有分析工具，针对特定医学需求开发自动化分析插件或模型。

• 数据洞察可视化： 参与构建数据可视化看板（Tableau），将复杂结果转化为直观的科学洞察。

我们期待这样的你：

• 专业背景： 公共卫生、生物统计学、数据科学或相关专业在校研究生。

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Mission:
En tant que Key Account Manager Comptes Publics et rattaché(e) au SubChapter Lead Key Account Manager, vous intégrez une équipe dynamique et êtes Expert(e) des comptes stratégiques.

Vous êtes la voix des clients et représentez Roche auprès de ces derniers. A ce titre, vous avez une compréhension parfaite de la cartographie des interlocuteurs et de la matrice décisionnelle des comptes, de l'environnement, des enjeux et visions stratégiques des clients. Vous avez également une vue précise du positionnement compétitif de Roche vis à vis de ces enjeux, ce qui vous permet de définir et porter la responsabilité de la stratégie commerciale et financière des comptes - existant(s) ou futur(s). Enfin, vous définissez la stratégie de négociation et la mettez en œuvre

Localisation idéale : région Parisienne

Vos principales responsabilités:

• Vous déterminez la stratégie Roche Diagnostics France à déployer pour les grands comptes publics sous votre responsabilité, en identifiant les leviers soutenant le développement d’un partenariat solide et capable de générer de la valeur pour toutes les parties.

• A toutes les étapes de la relation commerciale, vous identifiez et saisissez les différentes opportunités au sein des comptes pour contribuer à l’atteinte des objectifs stratégiques de Roche; en collaboration avec les experts internes, notamment les équipes commerciales, vous co-designez et proposez les solutions Roche adaptées aux besoins des clients et différenciantes. Vous êtes responsable de l'atteinte des objectifs business, de l'évolution du chiffre d'affaires et de la profitabilité des comptes.

• En étroite collaboration avec le chef de projet Appels d'Offres, vous coordonnez l’équipe projet engagée autour de la construction de la réponse et vous vous assurez que celle ci permettra l’atteinte des objectifs commerciaux et financier attendus; Vous vous assurez également de la bonne contractualisation en adéquation avec les règles du groupe et de la filiale.

• Responsable de la bonne exécution des marchés notifiés et de la satisfaction du client, vous mettez en place et suivez les indicateurs de performance pertinents pour les comptes sous votre responsabilité et engagez les équipes sur l’amélioration continue des actions; Vous êtes garant(e) de la pertinence et de l'efficacité du schéma de communication au sein des comptes.

• Squad lead: en collaboration avec les chapter/subchapter leads, vous identifiez les compétences requises et constituez une équipe engagée autour des besoins du client, la stratégie commerciale, l'atteinte des objectifs et du plan d'actions.

• Vous vous assurez de la bonne compréhension, par les membres de la squad, de l’actualité du compte et de notre position compétitive, afin que l’équipe soit en mesure de prioriser ses actions. Vous tenez l’équipe informée des KPIs des comptes et engagez avec elle toutes les actions nécessaires à l’atteinte de nos objectifs et la satisfaction client.

• Ambassadeur Compliance : vous garantissez le respect de la compliance dans les relations avec le client

• Vous garantissez la justesse et l'exhaustivité des information relatives au client dont vous avez la charge dans le CRM

Qui vous êtes:

• Vous possédez une forte compréhension des enjeux stratégiques et business du secteur du Diagnostic In Vitro et, plus largement, de l’industrie de la Santé.

• Vous maîtrisez les techniques de négociation commerciale et de gestion de projet. Une culture scientifique constitue un réel atout.

• Vous faites

jobs.title: Supply Chain Assistant (1 year contract)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Purpose
To provide essential administrative and operational support to the supply chain and logistics team. This role focuses on executing day-to-day routine tasks, including sales order data entry, basic inventory monitoring, and assisting with shipment follow-ups, to ensure the overall supply chain workflow operates smoothly.

Responsibility & Accountability

• Responsible for sales order intake and planning of delivery schedules to ensure timely delivery and commitment to customers' requests.

• Perform accurate data entry for customer orders into the SAP system.

• Maintain good after-sales service and customer engagement.

• Coordinate with 3PL to ensure that inbound shipments are received and stored on time and achieve the KPI target.

• Follow up and communicate with the global headquarters on shipment and delivery statuses.

• Handle export China shipments under the guidance of senior team members.

• Assist in the inventory movement and monitoring process.

• Assist the team in preparing timely reports on all aspects of the Supply Chain.

• Assist in manipulating SAP data for analysis purposes.

• Assist the team to streamline process flows or practices to improve efficiency by learning and exploring new technology.

• Collaborate with different internal and external stakeholders in various projects.

Requirements:
Education:

• HKDSE (Hong Kong Diploma of Secondary Education), Form 5/Form 7 graduate, or a Diploma/Certificate in Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field.

Experience:
0–2 years of working experience in customer service, data entry, or clerical support.

• Fresh graduates with a positive learning attitude are highly welcome.

• Previous experience with SAP or similar ERP systems is an advantage but not strictly required.

Competency:

• Highly detail-oriented with a strong focus on data entry accuracy.

• Proficient in MS Office applications (Word, Excel) and Chinese word processing.

• Good basic command of written and spoken English and Mandarin.

• Patient, responsible, and a strong team player able to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Global Alliance Director
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Corporate Business Development (CBD) is dedicated to sourcing innovation outside of the Company by identifying compounds that fit into our pipeline, looking for technologies that can be integrated into our drug discovery process and diagnostics, establishing connections with academic institutions and other life sciences companies and entering into and managing collaborations. Together with R&D this is a key pillar of the Pharma business and our aim is to transform promising innovation into healthcare solutions of the future. Our approach to partnering is open and flexible. We aim to accelerate innovation in China by helping our partners expand their impact on patient health through joint development and delivery of novel therapies; the Global Alliance Management function within Roche is leading all strategic partnerships across the globe and we are proud to be recognized amongst the best in the industry.
We are looking for a Global Alliance Director (GAD) to join our Global Alliance Management team in Shanghai. You shall have the responsibility of managing a portfolio of China based alliances while closely interfacing with Alliance Directors in Basel and San Francisco. You will interact with senior leadership of partner companies and actively liaise with Asia Partnering as well as other Roche functions including PD, GPS, pRED, gRED, CiCor and Dia Partnering. The incumbent for the role shall be strongly connected to the China ecosystem including biotech companies and VCs and act as a facilitator and catalyst for our efforts and partnerships in China. This role will report to Beth Odeh-Frikert and is based in Shanghai.

Your responsibilities shall include:

• Successfully lead and manage a portfolio of China-based alliances.

• Establish and nurture strong, trust-based relationships with Chinese partners to align expectations, anticipate challenges, and effectively resolve operational issues as they arise. Drive alliance governance and operational processes, proactively identify and address key risks and issues, and lead by influence across cross-functional teams. Ensure adherence to contractual obligations and proactively manage conflicts and escalations in the best interest of the alliance.

• Partner closely with Basel and SSF based Global Alliance Directors (GADs) to support their alliance portfolios with Chinese partners. Act as an internal advisor and facilitator for Basel/SSF-led alliances and provide local context to help the global GADs navigate language, cultural nuances and business etiquette.

• Act as a center of expertise for China partnerships and systematically share local market insights, regulatory knowledge and relationship best practices to empower and upskill global GADs in Basel and SSF.

• Actively build and sustain high-value relationships within the Chinese biotech and VC ecosystems to drive collaborative initiatives and identify scalable partnership opportunities

• Identify, lead negotiations and implement necessary contractual amendments, and/or subsequent agreements in coordination with BD, Finance, Legal and all relevant internal stakeholders

• Brief Roche senior management on the strategy and status of assigned China alliances as needed

• Represent Corporate Business Development in public forums (conferences, congresses, other presentation opportunities) in China

In order to be successful in this role, you have:

• Advanced degree (i.e. Master, Diploma, MD, PhD, PharmD) in business, finance or science related field

• Significant

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Technical Manager - Regional Customer Support Centre

Are you looking for an exciting challenge?

Are you ready to lead a specialist team in delivering world-class diagnostic support across the UK, Ireland and Northern Europe?

Roche Diagnostics is looking for a Technical Manager to lead our SWA/Core Lab Hardware remote support team. Based within our Regional Customer Support Centre (RCSC) in Burgess Hill, you will be the strategic lead for a team of 16 specialists providing critical technical and systems support for the Roche Core Laboratory portfolio.

The Role
As Technical Manager, you will lead a team of 16 specialists who provide remote technical and systems support for the Roche Core Laboratory portfolio, alongside customer and staff training. You will be the driving force behind the team’s operational and strategic success, ensuring we deliver a "best-in-class" customer experience.

You will be accountable for the successful delivery of service requirements across the UK, Ireland, Nordics and the wider EMEA-LATAM region.

Key Responsibilities:

• Leadership & Coaching: Use your skills to empower your team, remove obstacles and foster high performance.

• Line Management: Drive recruitment of ideal skill sets, manage performance and take ownership of the team's professional development.

• Strategic Collaboration: Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Regional Service Managers to ensure the technical service offering aligns with broader business goals.

• Operational Excellence: Oversee the delivery of high-value remote support and the implementation of Roche Global standards.

Location & Flexibility
This is an office based role with an expectation of a minimum of 2 days a week in our office in Burgess Hill, Sussex.

Who you are
You are a resilient leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment. You don’t just manage tasks; you inspire innovation and possess a "questioning" approach that challenges the status quo to exceed customer expectations.

Essential Requirements:

• Education: A degree in a relevant field OR a proven track record of technical mastery and leadership in an engineering environment.

• Experience: A minimum of 3 years experience of leading technical teams

• Technical Background: A proven track record of supporting complex healthcare instrumentation and/or deep experience within a Blood Sciences laboratory.

• Leadership: Proven experience in line management or a clear ability to demonstrate the leadership competencies required to coach and develop a high-performing team.

• Technical Proficiency: Strong IT skills, including Microsoft Office, Google Suite, and CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce).

• Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders in a matrix environment.

• IT Literacy: Strong digital skills, including Microsoft/Google Suite and CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce).

Investing in you
Roche is a company that invests as much in its people as it does in R&D (over £6.5 billion worldwide). In addition to a competitive salary and benefits package, you will receive recognised product training and continuous support to build your knowledge and potential.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billio

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for an enthusiastic and agile successor for our People Support Solutions Team Lead position within the People Support Solutions German Network . In this role, you will lead a team of HR generalists providing first-line support to our German-based employees, managing a diverse and high-impact portfolio.

The Opportunity

• Lead and inspire a team of HR specialists providing first-line support across the entire German network.

• Manage a diverse portfolio encompassing Employee Lifecycle Management, Compensation, Payroll, Time & Benefits, and Compliance.

• Navigate an extensive stakeholder network , partnering closely with Business & Talent Acquisition Partners and various Project Teams.

• Drive operational excellence by supporting your team in solving complex cases and engaging in demanding professional conversations.

• Benefit from a broad professional scope , moving beyond a single vertical to master a diversified P&C service landscape.

• Empower your team to take E2E accountability, fostering an environment where self-management and initiative are the norms.

• Act as a catalyst for growth , helping team members navigate transformations and reorganizations with confidence.

Who You Are

• A seasoned People Leader with at least 1 year of direct Line Management experience and a passion for developing others.

• Fluent in German (near-native/C1-C2) with the ability to communicate with sophistication and nuance in a regulated business environment.

• Highly proficient in English , enabling you to collaborate effectively within our global corporate structure.

• An empathetic leader who prioritizes empowerment, coaching, and a people-first mindset in your daily leadership practice.

• A strategic navigator comfortable managing complex stakeholder networks and diagnosing organizational needs.

• A disciplined professional with a university degree (HR or Business preferred) and a strong grasp of logical reasoning.

• An agile specialist who may come from a Second Level background but is ready to master the diverse, fast-paced world of Front Line HR.

In Exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process: https://go.roche.com/budapest-data-privacy-notice-candidate

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we commit ourselves to achieving access to medical and diagnostics innovations for all. Together with our regional and country organizations, we are building health systems ready to provide the future of care and make access a reality, thus, enabling people and patients around the world to live their best lives.

This global leadership position is responsible for bringing our diagnostics solutions to the forefront of care and growing access, reimbursement and funding effectively for our established portfolio as well as our ground breaking innovations.
The incumbent will closely collaborate with the global functions in Medical, Commercial, Market Access and Health System Policy enabling our affiliates to effectively co-design and apply the global tools, setting specific access targets in their respective environments and pulling through effective plans for their realization in mutual accountability.
As you are versatile in many environments and wish to impact external access delivery, you will closely accompany affiliates in their efforts to build the health system of tomorrow. Through this lived proximity to market realities, you will enable better global tools and deliverables, always pushing for the next level in furthering our affiliate support.

The Opportunity

Your responsibilities include:

• Market Analysis and Opportunity Identification : Research and analyze access coverage, reimbursement levels, health and payer policies, competitive access landscapes to identify business opportunities enabled through access and assess the probability and impact of affecting positive change.

• Access Insight and Strategy Development : Apply expertise in consolidating and providing relevant access insights and supporting the development and execution of global access strategies and impactful access tools including the Access Reimbursement Toolkit.

• Strategic Access Engagement Leadership : Act as a catalyst and coach for regional and affiliate implementation of global access strategies, identifying gaps, tailoring approaches, and accelerating time to reimbursement and the effective funding for your prioritized products.

• Global-Regional-Affiliate Interface : Create frameworks for efficient transfer of global strategies and catalyze learning, sharing, and collaboration across organizations and territories by leading the Access Nexus pilot of your area - our key interface to the Regions and Countries driving your work in achieving reimbursement and funding.

• Affiliate Support : Support regions and affiliates in executing payer-relevant access approaches, addressing access, reimbursement and funding barriers holistically, and leading projects to enhance local access capabilities with delivering tangible business growth through the realization of access opportunities.

• Shaping Sustainable Healthcare Systems : Support regions and affiliates in building plans and networks that aim for the creation of sustainable Health Care Systems in affecting the regulatory frameworks of payers, Health Technology Assessment bodies and their advising network.

• Requires travel of up to 20%

Who you are

• Master’s degree in business economics, life sciences, public health, marketing, or a related discipline; additional educational programs in market access preferred

• 5+ years of commercial and/or access experience in the diagnostic/pharmaceutical or related industry. Additional experience in related functions such as Strategy, Marketing, or Health Policy preferred.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Dein Team

Du unterstützt unser Vertriebsteam in Deutschland und arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Key Account Managern sowie dem Regionalen Vertriebsleiter (RVL) zusammen. Wir pflegen eine Kultur des Austauschs, in der eigenverantwortliches Handeln und Teamgeist Hand in Hand gehen.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich

• Eigenes Verkaufsgebiet: Du übernimmst die Umsatz- und Profitverantwortung für Dein eigenes Gebiet mit Fokus auf die strategische Entwicklung

• Methodik & Strategie: Du wendest moderne Vertriebsmethoden nach Miller-Heiman (BlueSheet/GreenSheet) an, um Verkaufschancen systematisch zu nutzen.

• Leadgenerierung: Durch digitales Marketing und die Präsenz auf Kongressen identifizierst und qualifizierst Du aktiv neue Geschäftspotenziale.

• Netzwerkarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit dem Key Account Management und dem Service zusammen, um eine ganzheitliche Kundenbetreuung sicherzustellen.

• Projekte: Du bringst Dich aktiv in die Optimierung von Unternehmensprozessen und Geschäftsfeldstrategien ein.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit

• Fundament: Du hast ein Studium im Bereich Wirtschaft, Technik oder Naturwissenschaften abgeschlossen oder verfügst über eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit mehrjähriger Berufserfahrung.

• Erfahrung: Erste praktische Erfahrungen im Gesundheitsmarkt und Vertriebsumfeld sind von Vorteil; alternativ bringst Du mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in einem vergleichbaren Aufgabenfeld mit.

• IT-Skills: Du bist sicher im Umgang mit MS Office/Google Workspace und hast idealerweise bereits Erfahrung mit CRM-Systemen (wie Salesforce) oder SAP.

• Persönlichkeit: Du arbeitest selbstständig, bist kommunikationsstark und schätzt die Arbeit im Team.

• Du hast auch Lust auf administrative Aufgaben der Kundenbetreuung und Spaß an der Interaktion mit Kunden und Netzwerken.

• Sprachen & Mobilität: Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch und bringst die Bereitschaft für Kundenbesuche im Inland mit

Deine Bewerbung

Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente: Aktueller Lebenslauf. Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt.

Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden können.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
