jobs.title: Executivo de Vendas - Mercado Público
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Executivo de Vendas, você será responsável por superar os objetivos comerciais da Roche Diagnóstica por meio do desenvolvimento e implementação de estratégias comerciais de impacto. Você irá colaborar para o crescimento do negócio, através de metas que visam garantir a sustentabilidade do negócio e a retenção/conquista de novos clientes, além de assegurar continuamente a melhoria da experiência dos clientes com os nossos produtos e serviços. Você terá também a responsabilidade de apoiar o Gerente de Contas Estratégicas na execução da estratégia nacional voltada ao cliente público, com foco especial no Ministério da Saúde, suas secretarias vinculadas, autarquias reguladoras e centros de referência. Além da atuação comercial, você deverá desenvolver um relacionamento institucional de alto nível, identificar oportunidades estratégicas, apoiar a execução contratual e atuar como elo entre os diversos stakeholders internos e externos, assegurando a sustentabilidade e expansão dos negócios com o setor público.

Sobre a oportunidade:

• Identificar oportunidades e promover soluções para sustentar e ampliar a base de clientes, priorizando clientes foco e metas definidas no "Valor em Ação".

• Construir planos de contas com base nas necessidades, metas, estratégias e ambiente de negócios dos clientes, fortalecendo o relacionamento.

• Cumprir metas de desempenho relacionadas a vendas, rentabilidade, NPS e outros indicadores, promovendo iniciativas sustentáveis para aumento de resultados.

• Liderar e executar Planos de Contas Estratégicas alinhados aos objetivos de crescimento da empresa, com foco em impacto de curto, médio e longo prazo.

• Gerenciar informações e contatos dos clientes no CRM, garantindo transparência, consistência e pipeline de vendas atualizado.

• Criar e manter relações transparentes e duradouras com KOLs (Key Opinion Leaders) e conectar os clientes a diferentes áreas da Roche.

• Identificar oportunidades em eventos, gerenciar leads e assegurar transições eficazes entre segmentos ou equipes, garantindo excelência no atendimento.

• Prover informações estratégicas, atender auditorias e melhorar KPIs de eficiência operacional para oferecer uma ótima experiência ao cliente.

Quem você é:

• Apoio à Estratégia do Ministério: Você irá apoiar o gerente de contas estratégicas na execução da estratégia do MS, identificando sinergias com estados e municípios em ações descentralizadas. Acompanha iniciativas de políticas públicas de saúde que impactam a atuação da empresa, sugerindo ações proativas

• Prospecção de Oportunidades: você vai identificar editais, projetos-piloto, chamadas públicas e parcerias estratégicas, conectadas com a agenda do Ministério da Saúde. Monitorar e relatar iniciativas estaduais e locais alinhadas com diretrizes federais (ex: Planos Estaduais de Saúde, programas estratégicos

• Biologia Molecular: você tem experiência comprovada no segmento de biologia molecular, relacionamento com os principais stakeholders e decisores no Ministério da Saúde, bem como nos centros de referência tais como: INCA, Fiocruz, IAL (Instituto Adolf Lutz, etc). Representa a empresa em reuniões, fóruns, câmaras técnicas e eventos públicos relevantes.

• Execução Operacional e de Contratos: você acompanha a execução técnica de contratos públicos, garantindo aderência aos SLAs e resolução de entraves técnicos e administrativos. Contribuir na coleta de dados para análises de desempenho, elaboração de relatórios, estudos técnicos e processos de ren

The Position

As the Workforce Strategy & Planning Lead, you will be the strategic intelligence behind how Roche's Digital & Technology (RDT) organization anticipates, plans, and shapes its future workforce. This is a senior global individual contributor role responsible for translating RDT's business strategy into actionable workforce implications – providing scenario insight and planning coherence to make informed decisions about talent supply and demand across the organization.
You will lead by influence and connecting long-term business ambition to workforce reality – maintaining the workforce dashboard logic that enables RDT-level visibility. By anchoring every workforce decision in data-driven foresight, you will be shaping how a global digital organization plans, adapts, and builds for the future.

Job Responsibilities

• RDT Workforce Dashboard & Intelligence: Define, build, and maintain the logic behind the workforce dashboard, ensuring it delivers accurate, timely, and strategically relevant insight to RDT leadership. Ensures dashboard outputs are integrated with capability data and reflect a holistic view of RDT's talent landscape.

• Strategic workforce planning coherence: Act as the steward of planning coherence across the RDT organization, ensuring that workforce planning assumptions, methodologies, and outputs are consistent across functions, sites, and geographies. Translate complex planning outputs into clear, compelling narratives for senior stakeholder consumption.

• Federated planning enablement: Equip HR partners, site leads, and functions with the frameworks, tools, and guidance needed to execute workforce planning consistently across the federated RDT model, enabling local teams to contribute meaningfully to the global workforce picture. Leverage the RDT site network to ensure planning insights reflect both global strategy and local talent realities.

• Workforce Intelligence: Responsible for designing and deploying a Skills Intelligence Platform (SIP) that serves as a centralized 'Digital Twin' of the RDT workforce. Integrates data from multiple HR, learning, finance, and workforce systems to build a holistic and dynamic picture of RDT's talent landscape. Develop scenario models and predictive analytics that generate forward-looking insight to support strategic workforce and capability decisions.

• Stakeholder Management: Identifies and engages key stakeholders, including management, across organizational boundaries. Shapes strategy as a trusted advisor to leadership, actively navigates conflicts to achieve alignment, and empowers teams in stakeholder management.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Extensive experience overseeing initiatives with autonomy, coordinating complexity and scale, and driving alignment across highly ambiguous spaces.

• Demonstrated advanced knowledge of Business Analysis Advisory/Consultancy concepts and practices.

• Proven track record of recommending optimal technology solutions for sustainable business transformation and working on unusually complex problems with highly innovative solutions.

• Ability to apply systems thinking to provide holistic and enterprise-wide consulting advice.

• Exceptional stakeholder management skills, acting as a role model in teamwork, and driving good collaboration across Informatics and business structures.

• Strong dedication to actively contributing to organizational development.

#RDT2026

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Hast du eine Leidenschaft für die Sicherstellung der Patientensicherheit und die Einhaltung von höchsten Qualitätsstandards im dynamischen Umfeld der Arzneimittel- und Diagnostikaproduktion? Als IT Compliance Manager (m/w/d) in Penzberg bist du ein zentraler Ankerpunkt für unser Team und trägst maßgeblich dazu bei, unsere Computersysteme GMP-, Security- und Legal-konform zu halten.

Deine Chance | Das erwartet Dich
In dieser Position bist du maßgeblich daran beteiligt, die Qualität unserer Computersysteme sicherzustellen. Wir vertrauen dir wichtige Aufgaben an, die den gesamten Lebenszyklus der Systeme betreffen. Deine Tätigkeit hat einen direkten Einfluss auf die Qualität der Roche-Produkte, die das Leben von Patient:innen verbessern.

• Qualitätssicherung : Du erstellst, bearbeitest und schließt Änderungen, Abweichungen, Korrekturen und Vorbeugemaßnahmen ab. Du führst Qualitätssicherungsaufgaben für Labor-, IT- und Automatisierungssysteme durch und stellst die Datenintegrität sicher.

• Risiko - und Dokumentenmanagement : Du erstellst Risikoanalysen im Quality Risk Management Umfeld und stellst sicher, dass alle GMP-relevanten Dokumentationen den Vorschriften entsprechen.

• Audit & Validierung : Du bereitest Audits und Inspektionen vor, begleitest diese und unterstützt Validierungs- und Qualifizierungsprojekte. Du wirkst aktiv bei der Etablierung neuer Systeme mit.

• Wissenstransfer : Du bleibst durch interne und externe Weiterbildungen auf dem neuesten Stand und teilst dein Wissen aktiv mit deinen Kolleg:innen.

Das bist Du
Du bist ein:e proaktive:r Teamplayer:in, der/die sich mit hohem Engagement für Compliance im Produktions- und Laborumfeld einsetzt. Du behältst auch in komplexen Situationen den Überblick, verfügst über Durchsetzungsvermögen und hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.

• Erfahrung : Du bringst mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der pharmazeutischen oder diagnostischen Industrie mit, speziell mit dem Schwerpunkt Qualitätssicherung von Computersystemen (GMP Support). Kenntnisse in GMP, GAMP, Softwareentwicklungsprozesse und CSV sind für dich somit selbstverständlich.

• Ausbildung : Ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Naturwissenschaften, Biotechnologie, Bioinformatik, Informatik oder ein Technikerabschluss mit relevanter Berufserfahrung sind die Grundlage für diese Position.

• Fachwissen : Du besitzt tiefgreifendes konzeptionelles und praktisches Wissen in der Qualitätssicherung von Computersystemen und bringst Grundwissen in Bereichen wie Automatisierungstechnik oder komplexen IT-Systemen mit.

• Kommunikation & Stakeholdermanagement : Du kommunizierst ausgezeichnet auf Deutsch und Englisch, über alle Hierarchieebenen hinweg. Stakeholdermanagement ist für dich selbstverständlich - so stellst du z.B. sicher, dass alle relevanten Parteien eingebunden sind.

• Proaktivität : Du bringst Eigeninitiative mit, packst Dinge selbstständig an und hast eine Affinität zur Verbesserung von Prozessen.

• Reisebereitschaft : Gelegentliche Reisen zwischen den Standorten Basel, Kaiseraugst, Mannheim und Penzberg sind für dich kein Problem.

Die Position ist bis 31.08.2028 befristet.

Deine Bewerbung
Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:

• Aktueller Lebenslauf

• Deine offiziellen (Bildungs-) Zeugnisse/Nachweise.

Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt. Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden können.

Bewirb Dich jetzt – wir freuen uns!

Your contact to us! With people. For peop

Du behältst auch in komplexen Situationen den Überblick, verfügst über Durchsetzungsvermögen und hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Diagnostics Site Management | Wer wir sind
Das „Biep“ beim Öffnen des Drehtores. Stimmengewirr auf der Baustelle. Das Klirren von Metall auf der Werkbank. Das Glänzen der Photovoltaik auf dem Dach. Der Duft von frischen Bohnen in der Kaffeebar.
Im Site Management sind wir weit mehr als ein operativer Dienstleister: Wir verstehen uns als aktive Gestalter und Befähiger an unserem Standort. Für alle Mitarbeitenden am Standort, bspw. als Teil unserer Produktions- und Forschungseinheiten – also für unsere Business Units – schaffen wir ein integriertes Ökosystem, das nahtloses Arbeiten ermöglicht, Innovationen fördert und die Produktivität stärkt. Dabei verbinden wir tagtägliche Betriebssicherheit zuverlässig mit zukunftsweisenden Themen wie Digitalisierung, Nachhaltigkeit und modernen Arbeitsumgebungen. So leisten wir einen strategischen Beitrag zu qualitativ hochwertigen Diagnostika und pharmazeutischen Produkten zum Wohle unserer Patient:innen weltweit.

StartUp your Career - bist Du ready? | Das erwartet Dich
Mit unserem StartUp Trainee Programm bieten wir Dir spannende standortübergreifende Projekte und Perspektiven innerhalb der Standortfunktionen wie beispielsweise Facility Management, Instandhaltung, Automation, Risk Management, Safety, Health & Environment Compliance und Engineering. Vom ersten Tag an gestaltest Du Dein 24-monatiges Programm aktiv mit. Dabei übernimmst Du folgende spannende Aufgaben:

• Verantwortung übernehmen: Du arbeitest selbstständig sowie im Team in bis zu sechs verschiedenen Bereichen unserer Standorte und übernimmst von Beginn an eigene Aufgabenpakete.

• Projekte steuern: Du wählst Deine Projektschwerpunkte proaktiv, planst diese selbstorganisiert und führst sie zielgerichtet zum Erfolg.

• Netzwerk aufbauen: Du wirst Teil einer lebendigen Trainee-Community und knüpfst auch darüber hinaus wertvolle Kontakte zu Kolleg:innen über Funktionsgrenzen hinweg.

• Perspektiven erweitern: Du nutzt die Möglichkeit, Deine Fähigkeiten an einem unserer internationalen Roche-Standorte einzubringen und dort ein eigenständiges Projekt zu begleiten.

• Entwicklung gestalten: Du steuerst Deine persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklung eigenverantwortlich, unterstützt durch ein personalisiertes Entwicklungsportfolio sowie ein Mentoring aus dem Senior Management.

• Zukunft sichern: Du profitierst von einer langfristigen Förderung – unser StartUp Trainee Programm startet direkt mit einem unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit
So vielfältig wie unsere Services, so vielfältig sind auch unsere Mitarbeitenden. Für unsere Trainees ist ein Master-Abschluss die Grundvoraussetzung - Du musst diesen zum Start abgeschlossen haben, kannst Dich aber noch während des Studiums bewerben. Darüber hinaus suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit mit einem inneren Antrieb und dem Potenzial, Großes zu bewirken. Daher suchen wir Dich:

• Du hast ein Masterstudium im (Wirtschafts-)Ingenieurwesen, in den Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder der Wirtschaftsinformatik erfolgreich abgeschlossen, idealerweise mit einem Schwerpunkt in den Bereichen Facility Management, Data Analytics, Energie-/Ressourcenmanagement oder Automation.

• Du bringst erste praktische Erfahrungen durch relevante Praktika im In- oder Ausland mit, vorzugsweise gesammelt in Ingenieurbüros, Industrie- oder Dienstleistungsunternehmen.

• Du hast Freude daran, innovative Lösungen in einem komplexen Umfeld zu entdecken, denkst unternehmerisch und begreifst Veränderungen als Entwicklungschan

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Roche Diagnostics Site Management | Chi siamo The “Biep” quando si apre il cancello rotante. Votando sul cantiere. Il taglio di metallo sul banco di lavoro. La lucentezza del fotovoltaico sul tetto. Il profumo di fagioli freschi nel bar del caffè. In Site Management, siamo molto più di un fornitore di servizi operativi: ci comprendiamo come progettista attivo e persona capace al nostro sito. Per tutti i dipendenti del sito, ad esempio nell'ambito delle nostre unità di produzione e di ricerca – cioè per le nostre unità aziendali – creiamo un ecosistema integrato che permette un lavoro senza soluzione di continuità, promuove l'innovazione e rafforza la produttività. Uniamo in modo affidabile l'affidabilità operativa quotidiana con argomenti previsionali come la digitalizzazione, la sostenibilità e gli ambienti di lavoro moderni. Così, forniamo un contributo strategico alla diagnostica di alta qualità e prodotti farmaceutici a beneficio dei nostri pazienti: sia in tutto il mondo. StartUp your Career - sei pronto? | Con il nostro programma StartUp Trainee, vi offriamo interessanti progetti e prospettive multi-sito all'interno delle funzioni di localizzazione come la gestione delle strutture, manutenzione, automazione, gestione dei rischi, sicurezza, salute e conformità dell'ambiente e ingegneria. Dal primo giorno in poi, si forma attivamente il vostro programma di 24 mesi. Prendere le seguenti attività eccitanti:
• Assumere la responsabilità: Si lavora in modo indipendente e nel team in fino a sei aree diverse delle nostre posizioni e prendere le proprie attività fin dall'inizio.
• Progetti di controllo: selezioni le priorità del progetto in modo proattivo, pianificale auto-organizzate e guidarle al successo.
• Costruire una rete: Si diventa parte di una comunità di tirocinanti viventi e anche collegare contatti preziosi con colleghi attraverso confini funzionali.
• Estendere le prospettive: Si utilizza l'opportunità di introdurre le vostre competenze in una delle nostre sedi Roche internazionali e di accompagnare un progetto indipendente lì.
• Sviluppo di progettazione: Si controlla il vostro sviluppo personale e professionale in modo indipendente, supportato da un portafoglio di sviluppo personalizzato e un mentoring da senior management.
• Assicurare il futuro: Si beneficia di una promozione a lungo termine – il nostro programma StartUp Trainee inizia direttamente con un contratto indefinito. Qualificazioni | Questo ti porta con diversi servizi, diversi come i nostri dipendenti. Per i nostri tirocinanti, una laurea magistrale è il requisito di base - si deve aver completato questo all'inizio, ma si può ancora applicare durante i vostri studi. Inoltre, stiamo cercando una personalità con un'unità interna e il potenziale per raggiungere la grandezza. Pertanto ti stiamo cercando:
• Hai completato con successo un master in ingegneria (economica), economia o informatica aziendale, incentrati idealmente sulla gestione delle strutture, analisi dei dati, gestione energetica/risorsa o automazione.
• Porti la prima esperienza pratica attraverso stage rilevanti in patria o all'estero, preferibilmente raccolti in uffici di ingegneria, aziende industriali o di servizio. Siete lieti di scoprire soluzioni innovative in un ambiente complesso, pensare imprenditoriale e comprendere i cambiamenti come ingegnere di sviluppo
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The position Roche Diagnostics Site Management | Who we are The “Biep” when opening the rotary gate. Voting on the building site. The cutting of metal on the work bench. The gloss of photovoltaics on the roof. The scent of fresh beans in the coffee bar. In Site Management, we are far more than an operating service provider: we understand ourselves as an active designer and capable person at our site. For all employees at the site, for example as part of our production and research units – i.e. for our business units – we create an integrated ecosystem that allows seamless work, promotes innovation and strengthens productivity. We reliably combine daily operational reliability with forward-looking topics such as digitalization, sustainability and modern working environments. Thus, we make a strategic contribution to high-quality diagnostics and pharmaceutical products for the benefit of our patients: both worldwide. StartUp your Career - are you ready? | With our StartUp Trainee program, we offer you exciting multi-site projects and perspectives within the location functions such as facility management, maintenance, automation, risk management, safety, health & environment compliance and engineering. From the first day on, you actively shape your 24-month program. Take the following exciting tasks:
• Take responsibility: You work independently as well as in the team in up to six different areas of our locations and take on your own tasks from the start.
• Control projects: You select your project priorities proactively, plan them self-organized and guide them to success.
• Build a network: You become part of a living trainee community and also connect valuable contacts to colleagues across functional boundaries.
• Extend perspectives: You use the opportunity to introduce your skills to one of our international Roche locations and to accompany an independent project there.
• Designing development: You control your personal and professional development independently, supported by a personalized development portfolio and a mentoring from senior management.
• Ensure the future: You benefit from a long-term promotion – our StartUp Trainee program starts directly with an unlimited work contract. Qualifications | This brings you with as diverse as our services, as diverse as our employees are. For our trainees, a master's degree is the basic requirement - you must have completed this at the start, but you can still apply during your studies. In addition, we are looking for a personality with an inner drive and the potential to achieve greatness. Therefore we are looking for you:
• You have successfully completed a master's degree in (economic) engineering, economics or business informatics, ideally focusing on facility management, data analytics, energy/resource management or automation.
• You bring first practical experience through relevant internships at home or abroad, preferably collected in engineering offices, industrial or service companies. You are delighted to discover innovative solutions in a complex environment, think entrepreneurially and understand changes as a development engineer

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Roche Diagnostics Gestion du site de Qui sommes-nous? Vote sur le chantier. La coupe de métal sur le banc de travail. La brillance des photovoltaïques sur le toit. Le parfum des haricots frais dans le bar à café. Dans la gestion du site, nous sommes bien plus qu'un fournisseur de services d'exploitation : nous nous comprenons comme un concepteur actif et une personne capable sur notre site. Pour tous les employés du site, par exemple dans le cadre de nos unités de production et de recherche – c'est-à-dire pour nos unités d'affaires – nous créons un écosystème intégré qui permet un travail sans faille, favorise l'innovation et renforce la productivité. Nous combinons de façon fiable la fiabilité opérationnelle quotidienne avec des sujets prospectifs tels que la numérisation, la durabilité et les environnements de travail modernes. Ainsi, nous apportons une contribution stratégique à des diagnostics et à des produits pharmaceutiques de haute qualité au profit de nos patients : tous deux dans le monde entier. Commencez votre carrière - êtes-vous prêt? Avec notre programme StartUp Trainee, nous vous offrons des projets et des perspectives multi-sites passionnants dans les fonctions d'emplacement telles que la gestion des installations, la maintenance, l'automatisation, la gestion des risques, la sécurité, la conformité et l'ingénierie. Dès le premier jour, vous façonnez activement votre programme de 24 mois. Prenez les tâches passionnantes suivantes:
• Prenez la responsabilité: Vous travaillez de manière indépendante ainsi que dans l'équipe dans jusqu'à six domaines différents de nos emplacements et prenez vos propres tâches dès le début.
• Projets de contrôle : Vous choisissez vos priorités de projet de manière proactive, les planifiez auto-organisées et les guidez vers le succès.
• Construire un réseau: Vous devenez membre d'une communauté de stagiaires vivants et connectez également des contacts précieux avec des collègues au-delà des frontières fonctionnelles.
• Prolongez les perspectives : vous profitez de l'occasion pour présenter vos compétences à l'un de nos sites internationaux de Roche et y accompagner un projet indépendant.
• Développement : vous contrôlez votre perfectionnement personnel et professionnel de manière indépendante, avec le soutien d'un portefeuille de développement personnalisé et d'un encadrement de la haute direction.
• Assurer l'avenir: Vous bénéficiez d'une promotion à long terme – notre programme StartUp Trainee commence directement par un contrat de travail illimité. Qualités Cela vous amène avec autant de diversité que nos services, autant de diversité que nos employés. Pour nos stagiaires, une maîtrise est l'exigence de base - vous devez avoir terminé cela au début, mais vous pouvez toujours postuler pendant vos études. En outre, nous recherchons une personnalité avec un élan intérieur et le potentiel d'atteindre la grandeur. Par conséquent, nous vous recherchons:
• Vous avez obtenu avec succès une maîtrise en ingénierie (économique), économie ou informatique d'affaires, idéalement axée sur la gestion des installations, l'analyse des données, la gestion de l'énergie/ressources ou l'automatisation.
• Vous apportez une première expérience pratique à travers des stages pertinents à domicile ou à l'étranger, de préférence collectés dans des bureaux d'ingénierie, des entreprises industrielles ou de services. Vous êtes heureux de découvrir des solutions innovantes dans un environnement complexe, de penser en entreprise et de comprendre les changements en tant qu'ingénieur en développement

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Please note this is a fixed-term role for 1 or 2 years.

The Opportunity:
As an Accounts Payable Accountant you are responsible for high quality services to Roche suppliers and internal partners. You will be responsible for booking complex invoices in accordance with Roche and local standards so that the supplier receives the funds in time for the goods supplied and the services rendered. You will have the possibility to have full responsibility for the end-to-end AP process and handling both internal and supplier queries received by phone or mail in local language.

• Process and validate PO based and direct invoices and payment requests, manage and run payments

• Manage vendor accounts

• Audit, report and support AP invoice resolution

• Handle affiliate’s internal invoice queries

• Act as a point of contact, promoting strong collaborative relationships between the affiliate’s finance teams and all other internal SSC teams

• Participate in process improvement and ongoing projects, opportunity to take part in knowledge transfer

• University degree in Finance or relevant professional experience

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Die Organisation “Site Network Basel/Kaiseraugst”, Teil der globalen Group Function “Corporate Strategy, Sustainability & Sites”, stellt die Infrastruktur und Services für den gesamten Standort bereit und entwickelt diese kontinuierlich und auf innovative Art weiter. Wir arbeiten mit allen Anspruchsgruppen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette zusammen, von der frühen Forschung bis zur Versorgung der Patient:innen.

Wir suchen dich als studentische Aushilfe zur Unterstützung bei der Dokumentenmigration! Im Rahmen der Migration bestehender, technischer Dokumente von einem bisherigen in ein neues Dokumentenmanagementsystem wirst du Teil eines Teams von 2-3 Personen sein.

Die Möglichkeit
Es erwarten dich folgende spannenden Tätigkeiten bei uns:

• Extraktion der bestehenden, technischen Dokumente aus dem bisherigen Dokumentenmanagementsystem

• Anpassung der Dokumente an neue technische Anforderungen

• Vorbereitung der Dokumente zur Besprechung in einem Fachgremium

• Besprechung der entworfenen Dokumente mit Fachexpert:innen

• Übertragung der Dokumente in das neue Dokumentenmanagementsystem

• Gemeinsam mit Fachexpert:innen wirst du diese neuen Anforderungen umsetzen und wertvolle Erfahrungen sammeln.

Wer Du Bist
Du bist immatrikuliert an einer Hochschule oder Universität, weiterhin hast du:

• Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Deutsch, und sprichst gut Englisch

• Schnelle Auffassungsgabe für technische Zusammenhänge und im Umgang mit spezifischen IT-Systemen im Bereich Dokumentenmanagement. ​

Zusätzliche Informationen
Der Standort ist Basel. Die Stelle basiertauf einem 50%-Vertrag. Die wöchentliche Arbeitszeit darf während dem Semester 15 Stunden nicht überschreiten. Die wöchentliche Arbeitszeit kann in den Semesterferien auf bis zu 40 Stunden erhöht werden.
Die Bewerbungsvoraussetzung von nicht-EU/EFTA-Bürger*innen ist, dass das Studium an einer Schweizer Bildungseinrichtung erfolgt.
Frühestes Startdatum: 1 August 2026

We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Im Bereich Near Patient Care (NPC) Development bist Du bei uns Teil einer internationalen, kollaborativen Community, die gemeinsam die Zukunft der Diagnostik neu denkt.
Als Subchapter Lead Mechanical Development (w/m/d) Near Patient Care (NPC) übernimmst Du eine zentrale, führende Rolle innerhalb des Bereichs Near Patient Care Development. In dieser Position führst Du ein hochqualifiziertes Team aus technischen Expert:innen und entwickelst effektiv und effizient die Kompetenzen rund um die Mechanikentwicklung weiter. Du gibst in dieser verantwortungsvollen Rolle fachliche, innovative Impulse, bist Coach und “Architekt:in des Wandels” für unsere moderne, agile Arbeitsweise. Mit Deiner außerordentlichen Expertise gestaltest Du aktiv die Zukunft der Diagnostik bei Roche.

Deine Aufgaben

• Führung von mehreren Teams von Führungskräften und Spezialisten im Bereich Mechanik.

• Verantwortung für die Teamleistung und Ergebnisse im eigenen Verantwortungsbereich.

• Setzen und Umsetzen kurzfristiger Abteilungsziele und Prioritäten unter Berücksichtigung des Budgets.

• Etablierung und Verwaltung von externen Partnerschaften in Übereinstimmung mit den Anforderungen und der Strategie des Projekts

• Formuliert die Vision für das Subchapter und unterstützt bei Schlüsselprojekten zur Entwicklung von Geschäftseinheitsstrategien und Unternehmensprozessen.

• Eigenständige Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Entscheidungen zur Problemlösung im Verantwortungsbereich.

• Förderung der Kompetenzentwicklung im Team durch gezieltes Skill-Management.

Dein Profil

• Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Maschinenbau, Mechatronik oder einer ähnlichen Fachrichtung. Ein Masterabschluss oder eine Promotion ist von Vorteil.

• Mindestens 8 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung, bevorzugt im Bereich der Medizintechnik.

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Führungserfahrung, einschließlich Personalverantwortung.

• Vertiefte Kenntnisse in der Maschinenentwicklung und -betreuung, bevorzugt im Bereich Sondermaschinenbau mit Schwerpunkt auf vollautomatisierten Produktionsmaschinen.

• Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch.

• Ausgeprägte Führungsfähigkeiten und Erfahrung in der Anleitung und Mentoring von Mitarbeitenden.

• Teamorientierte Arbeitsweise und Fähigkeit zur effektiven Zusammenarbeit.

• Analytisches Denkvermögen und Fähigkeit zur Entwicklung von Strategien für die Einheit.

Ganz pragmatisch: Bitte lade online nur Deinen Lebenslauf hoch oder bewirb Dich mit Deinem Workday-Profil. Zum aktuellen Zeitpunkt benötigen wir kein Motivationsschreiben, Zeugnisse oder Ähnliches.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Portfolio and Customer Engagement Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As the Portfolio and Customer Engagement Lead, you will hold ultimate accountability for shaping and executing the commercial strategy within your assigned portfolio. You will champion a deep understanding of business drivers, the local market landscape and competitive dynamics to optimize customer experiences and drive long-term strategic success.

The Opportunity

In this role, you will:

• Set the strategic vision, high ambitions and clear outcomes for your teams by leveraging insights from internal and external stakeholders across the wider enterprise.

• Manage full P&L accountability and take ownership of the financial ambitions and investment health of your designated portfolio.

• Deliver exceptional impact and steer the outcomes of cross-functional engagement teams with an enterprise-wide mindset.

• Build, coach and inspire a high-performing community, providing visionary leadership that fosters an environment where cross-functional collaboration thrives.

• Optimize fluid, impact-driven resource allocation and prioritization, carefully balancing customer engagement models with broader portfolio priorities.

• Champion an enterprise growth mindset and show resilience, turning every stone to uncover innovative possibilities for patients, customers and healthcare systems.

Who You Are

You are a visionary leader and a strategic thinker who thrives on turning bold ambitions into reality. You are deeply passionate about customer centricity, healthcare innovation and possess the business acumen required to lead complex, cross-functional ecosystems.

To excel in this role, you bring:

• Advanced Academic Foundation: A Master’s degree in Business, Science, or a related field.

• Strategic & Commercial Expertise: Solid experience (minimum of 10 years) in creating product and portfolio strategies, with a proven track record in the development, launch, or management of products within the pharmaceutical industry.

• Proven Leadership: Demonstrated ability to build trust as a leader and inspire seamless teamwork and collaboration across diverse networks.

• Market & Customer Insights: Extensive experience in strategic planning, product management, or market research—ideally combining local market knowledge with global perspective, supported by a strong background in customer-facing roles.

• Communication & Collaboration Skills: Professional fluency in written and spoken English and Finnish, enabling you to connect authentically with local and international stakeholders.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This is a pivotal leadership role within our UK Pharma Commercial team. You join at a moment of radical healthcare transformation — where market access, government affairs, and health economics converge to determine whether life-changing therapies reach the patients who need them. You lead a multidisciplinary function that shapes the UK's position as a priority destination for global pharmaceutical investment.

The Opportunity:

• Shape the future of UK pricing and reimbursement by leading the organisation's strategy across NICE, SMC, and AWMSG — ensuring our portfolio remains commercially viable and accessible to patients

• Lead high-stakes negotiations for Commercial Access Agreements that protect and grow a billion-pound revenue stream through sustainable, innovative funding models

• Influence government policy at the highest levels maintaining strategic relationships across the Department of Health and Social Care, HM Treasury, and the broader political landscape

• Build a world-class Access engine that serves as the gold standard for our global headquarters — proving that the UK is a priority launch market

• Drive health equity and system transformation by leading initiatives that improve patient outcomes, enhance population health, and reduce per-capita costs in partnership with the NHS

• Pioneer innovative access models including outcome-based agreements, value-based pricing, and real-world evidence frameworks that can be exported globally

Who you are:

• You bring extensive senior leadership in market access, health economics, or government affairs within the pharmaceutical or life sciences sector

• You have deep expertise in UK HTA processes and the commercial mechanics of industry-government pricing frameworks

• You are a proven political advocate, comfortable engaging at ministerial and senior civil servant level to shape policy outcomes

• You are an enterprise thinker who balances access decisions against commercial, medical, and supply chain considerations across a complex portfolio

• You lead with purpose — translating strategic patience into tactical urgency to deliver patient access today while building frameworks for tomorrow

Preferred:

• Experience navigating the post-Brexit regulatory and trade landscape as it impacts pharmaceutical operations

• Background in Real-World Evidence generation and its application to HTA submissions and lifecycle management

• International or global headquarters experience demonstrating cross-market strategic influence

If you're ready to shape the future of patient access in the UK, we'd like to hear from you. Apply today.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Roche:
We believe it’s urgent to deliver medical solutions right now – even as we develop innovations for the future. We are passionate about transforming patients’ lives. We are courageous in both decision and action. We believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work each day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigour, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow.
We are proud of who we are, what we do, and how we do it. We are many, working as one across functions, across companies, and across the world.
We are Roche.

About the Role:

Roche Products (Ireland) Limited is the sales & marketing arm in Ireland of the pharmaceutical division of Roche. We market and sell prescription medicines across a range of therapeutic areas including oncology, neurology, ophthalmology, rheumatology and spinal muscular atrophy. We are an agile organisation that brings together great people who are passionate about innovation, and who thrive in dynamic, cross-functional, and purposeful teams. These teams work together to deliver outstanding value to our business, patients, and customers.

This role is working within the Finance & Business Operations team which includes Finance, Supply Chain, Quality, Procurement, Business Support and Administration. The team provides support across the business and you will be working with multiple stakeholders. This 8 month contract role arises as the incumbent has been seconded to another role within the organisation.

In this role you require a broad set of skills in communication, interpersonal relationships, managing business relationships, managing a diverse workload and an ability to manage your time effectively. Comfortable working both as a part of a team as well as on your own initiative, you will have proven organisational capability & high levels of personal effectiveness. You will have strong intellectual, analytical and thinking skills, good commercial and business acumen and will be experienced working across the MS Windows and Google platforms. Previous experience using SAP would be an advantage.

What you could be working on:

You will act as an enabler within the affiliate carrying out a range of Finance & Business Operations activities, specifically Business Finance and Business Insights, working in a networked way to identify solutions that will help the business to drive towards delivering better outcomes. You work will include the following:

• Validating employee expenses via Concur, both credit card and cash expenses – checking coding, mileage claims, etc.

• Preparation of data on payments to HCPs & HCOs for external reporting in line with EFPIA requirements

• Preparation and circulation of the Daily Sales Report

• Support the Finance Enterprise Partners in tracking and monitoring the business

• Work with the Finance Enterprise Partners to produce regular monthly product and market updates for all promoted products for circulation and presentation

• Editing and amending POs as required

• Maintaining pricing (standard and contracting) in SAP/Vistex

• Maintaining background tables for SAP approvals

• Preparation and submission of monthly Intrastat

• Preparation & submission of quarterly Repak return and CSO returns

• Completion of annual Form 46G to Revenue

• COGS invoices & certification of entry

• Liaising with Country Chief Accountant in the shared services centre on Finance related activities of the affiliate

jobs.title: Access Partner - Specified Purpose (Approx. 18 Months)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity:

The Access Partner is an enthusiastic advocate of his/her area of expertise. His/Her mission is to get our medicines to patients as fast as possible for as long as possible. He/she will work as part of the cross-functional team to drive our North Star and lead the Access agenda within the cross functional team (CFT).

In this role you will:

• Lead the development and execution of high-quality P&R strategies and HTA submissions to deliver on the CFTs mission

• Lead CFT engagement with national Access stakeholders i.e. NCPE, NCCP and support the wider squad in value messaging at a regional level

• Build fast and maintain market access for Roche’s specialist products through targeted communication with various stakeholders in the Irish health system: regional and national

• Identifying new ways of working together with our key stakeholders and identification of new projects that support Patient Access to Roche medicines

• Aligns Access strategies with commercial and medical strategies and pricing guidance from HQ

• Development of new strategic initiatives securing Roche’s long term commitment to secure all eligible patients access to Roche products

• Represent Market Access in Squads according to the Agile Operational model acting as the point of contact driving the Market Access agenda

• Work with CFT members to develop and deliver value messaging and engagement plans for all stakeholders throughout the Access journey

• Shape the payer environment and share relevant information to inform and shape opinion regarding the value of our products

• Responsible for own Market Access projects as agreed with The Head of Access

As a member of Roche Products Ireland Limited:
You will contribute to a combination of communities and teams that comprise of the larger Roche Products (Ireland) Limited and/or the wider Roche community. You will also participate in or lead local and/or global work package teams with a focus on delivering value for patients, external stakeholders and Roche via:

• Contributing and enabling the delivery of programmes across the business by providing operational and/or strategic input to the teams as well as helping to architect our ten year ambition that enables a better future for patients.

• Cultivate meaningful peer-to-peer collaborations to drive a deeper understanding of patient and employee needs across RPIL and beyond. In doing so, nurture a culture of curiosity to enable faster, simpler, and more patient-centric ways of working to deliver on high impact work.

• You may serve as a partner to local internal and external stakeholders inside and outside of Ireland and help support local business needs so that Roche operates as one larger community.

• Inspire and empower talent by working with colleagues across RPIL and the Roche family to promote communication, community and networking in a global environment.

• Optimising growth opportunities and capabilities to successfully contribute and operate in a diverse and global environment. Drive new thinking by identifying new opportunities and options to embrace value creation.

Who you are:

• Degree in Economics or Science, Pharmacist or equivalent professional background

• Patient focus

• Ability to apply the key concepts of economic evaluation including economic modeling

• Interest in and knowledge about the Irish health care system

• Ability to work in an agile environment

• Demonstrates Roche Core Values

• Strong strategic thinker

• Good sense of numb

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
International Product Manager – Personalized Healthcare Solutions (PHCS)
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

Who We Are:
Advancing precision medicine through diagnostics for over 25 years.
In collaboration with leading pharmaceutical companies, Roche Personalised Healthcare Solutions (PHCS) identify and develop innovative precision diagnostics to help radically improve the lives of patients.
As the global diagnostic partner of choice, we deliver diagnostic confidence through a broad menu of high medical value assays across Immunohistochemistry (IHC) and In Situ hybridization (ISH), PCR and NGS. We are a global partner of choice in Oncology, including tissue diagnostics, as well as Neurology & Cardiology. Roche PHCS brings unmatched value as a collaborative partner to pharmaceutical organizations developing treatments across critical areas of highest unmet medical need.

The Opportunity:
As an International Product Manager (IPM) within the PHCS Lifecycle Team, you are the primary driver of our mission. You sit at the critical intersection of diagnostics and therapeutics, transforming complex technology into clinical reality.
Your primary responsibility is to drive the global commercialization of our Companion Diagnostics (CDx) portfolio related to Tissue Diagnostics in direct partnership with pharmaceutical customers. Beyond the core product management of the Tissue Diagnostic portfolio, you will act as a strategic leader, driving initiatives that grow the PHCS organization and innovative pipeline, and support the broader Roche Diagnostics network.

Key Roles & Responsibilities:

• External Pharmaceutical Partnering: Act as the dedicated commercial lead for pharmaceutical partners. Co-create and align CDx launch plans with drug therapy timelines to ensure seamless "day-one" testing readiness.

• Country & Regional Collaboration: Partner with Roche Diagnostics regional and country stakeholders to drive successful CDx pull-through. You will help markets overcome barriers to adoption, deliver pharmaceutical partner objectives and ultimately drive precision medicine innovation.

• Commercial Strategy Leader: Drive the commercial strategy for IHC-based companion diagnostics, ensuring our value proposition resonates with pathologists, laboratory managers, and pharma stakeholders.

• End-to-End Product Lifecycle Management: Provide technical and strategic guidance throughout early assay development and lead commercial product delivery from concept to commercialization. Responsible for on-market product strategy, supply topics, quality issues, incorporating global regulatory updates, label expansion and end-of-life product management.

• PHCS Strategy Leadership: Lead design and execution of our overarching strategy in collaboration with PHCS leadership and senior stakeholders. Analyze global market trends, customer needs, and competitive landscapes to define long-term strategies.

• Cross-functional Collaboration: Drive high-impact growth projects that define how Roche Diagnostics delivers value beyond the individual test, collaborating closely with lifecycle teams and stakeholders across the organization.

jobs.title: Data & Analytics Specialist (Clinical Operations)

titleByLocale.fr: Spécialiste des données et des analyses

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As a Data & Analytics Specialist, you will sit at the intersection of Forecasting, Advanced Data Analytics, and Product Management. This is a high-impact role designed for a strategic thinker who can provide operational insights with minimal supervision. You you will act as a strategic partner to Clinical Operations, turning complex datasets into narratives that guide the future of our clinical portfolio.

The Opportunity:

• Act as a thought partner to Disease Area Communities (CODACs) and Portfolio Enabling Communities (COPECs) to diagnose business problems and recommend data-driven actions.

• Partner with Franchise Leads, Study Management, and the Late Stage Portfolio Committee (LSPC) to align analytical output with business priorities.

• Openly share perspectives to elevate team thinking, effectively weighing trade-offs and communicating the "why" behind strategic decisions.

• Increase the sophistication of our analytical methods, utilizing machine learning and scalable prototypes to measure study performance at the speed of business.

• Create and manage time-series and patient-based forecasts, incorporating trial design elements, competitor activity, and country/site selection impacts.

• Apply statistical methods to multiple data sources (primary and secondary) to answer complex business questions and optimize the value of clinical investments.

• Manage the lifecycle of analytical solutions from ideation through implementation.

• Stay current with emergent methodologies and tools to ensure our approach remains "fit-for-purpose" and impactful.

Who you are:

• Bachelor’s Degree (Business, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, or Physical Sciences or related field is a plus); MBA or Graduate-level Degree is preferred

• Advanced English

• Mastery in specialized areas such as Patient/Investigator Insights, Forecasting, or Statistics, with a focus on informing clinical and business decisions.

• Proficiency in high-level programming and analytical tools (Python, R, SQL, SAS) to perform autonomous, sophisticated data exploration beyond traditional analysis.

• Proven ability to translate complex datasets into compelling narratives and visualizations that simplify technical concepts for stakeholders.

• Experience navigating international, cross-functional environments (Scientific, Business, Operational) by using influence without authority to drive results.

• Acting as an entrepreneurial consultant to the business, managing outside vendors, and identifying the right analytical methods for specific problems.

• Ability to merge disparate data sources with meticulous attention to detail, ensuring all findings are persuasive, accurate, and actionable.

• Availability to work in a hybrid model based in São Paulo

Relocation benefits are not available for this position.

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Sao Paulo. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.
Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each oth

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In qualità di Data & Analytics Specialist, ti siederai all'incrocio tra Forecasting, Advanced Data Analytics e Product Management. Questo è un ruolo di alto impatto progettato per un pensatore strategico che può fornire intuizioni operative con minima supervisione. Si agirà come partner strategico per le operazioni cliniche, trasformando complessi set di dati in narrazioni che guidano il futuro del nostro portafoglio clinico. L'opportunità:
• Agire come partner di pensiero per le Comunità di Area Malattia (CODACs) e le Comunità che abilitano il Portfolio (COPECs) per diagnosticare i problemi aziendali e raccomandare azioni basate sui dati.
• Partner con Franchise Leads, Study Management e il Late Stage Portfolio Committee (LSPC) per allineare la produzione analitica con le priorità aziendali.
• Condividere apertamente le prospettive per elevare il pensiero del team, pesare efficacemente i trade-off e comunicare il "perché" dietro le decisioni strategiche.
• Aumentare la raffinatezza dei nostri metodi analitici, utilizzando prototipi di machine learning e scalabili per misurare le prestazioni di studio alla velocità del business.
• Creare e gestire le serie temporali e le previsioni basate sul paziente, incorporando elementi di progettazione di prova, attività concorrente e impatti di selezione paese/sito.
• Applicare metodi statistici a più fonti di dati (primarie e secondarie) per rispondere a complesse domande aziendali e ottimizzare il valore degli investimenti clinici.
• Gestire il ciclo di vita delle soluzioni analitiche dall'ideazione attraverso l'implementazione.
• Mantenere corrente con metodologie e strumenti emergenti per garantire che il nostro approccio rimanga "adatto allo scopo" e impattante. Chi sei:
• Corso di laurea (Business, Economia, Statistica, Matematica, o Scienze Fisiche o campo correlato è un plus); MBA o Laurea Grado è preferito
• Inglese avanzato
• Mastery in aree specializzate come pazienti/Investigatori Insights, Forecasting o Statistica, con l'obiettivo di informare le decisioni cliniche e aziendali.
• La competenza nella programmazione e negli strumenti analitici di alto livello (Python, R, SQL, SAS) per eseguire l'esplorazione dei dati autonoma e sofisticata oltre l'analisi tradizionale.
• comprovata capacità di tradurre set di dati complessi in narrazioni e visualizzazioni convincenti che semplificano i concetti tecnici per gli stakeholder.
• Esperienza di navigazione in ambienti internazionali, interfunzionali (Scientific, Business, Operativo) utilizzando l'influenza senza autorità per guidare i risultati.
• Agire come consulente imprenditoriale per il business, gestire i fornitori esterni, e identificare i metodi analitici giusti per problemi specifici.
• Capacità di fondere fonti di dati disparate con meticolosa attenzione ai dettagli, assicurando che tutti i risultati siano persuasivi, accurati e fattibili.
• Disponibilità di lavorare in un modello ibrido con sede a San Paolo Le prestazioni di trasferimento non sono disponibili per questa posizione. Se si applica la trasparenza dei pagamenti, i dettagli vengono forniti in base alla posizione di pubblicazione primaria. Per questo ruolo, la posizione principale è San Paolo. Se siete interessati a posizioni aggiuntive in cui il ruolo può essere disponibile, forniremo i dettagli relativi di compensazione più tardi nel processo di assunzione. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo ciascuno

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position En tant que spécialiste des données et de l'analyse, vous serez à l'intersection de la prévision, de l'analyse avancée des données et de la gestion des produits. Il s'agit d'un rôle à fort impact conçu pour un penseur stratégique qui peut fournir des informations opérationnelles avec une supervision minimale. Vous agirez comme partenaire stratégique des Opérations cliniques, transformant des ensembles de données complexes en récits qui guident l'avenir de notre portefeuille clinique. La possibilité :
• Agir en tant que partenaire de réflexion des communautés de maladies (CODAC) et des communautés habilitantes de portefeuille (COPEC) pour diagnostiquer les problèmes commerciaux et recommander des mesures axées sur les données.
• S'associer aux responsables de franchises, à la gestion des études et au comité du portefeuille en retard pour aligner les résultats analytiques sur les priorités opérationnelles.
• Partager ouvertement des perspectives pour élever la pensée d'équipe, peser efficacement les compromis et communiquer le "pourquoi" derrière les décisions stratégiques.
• Accroître la sophistication de nos méthodes d'analyse, en utilisant l'apprentissage automatique et des prototypes évolutives pour mesurer les performances d'étude à la vitesse des affaires.
• Créer et gérer des séries chronologiques et des prévisions basées sur le patient, intégrant des éléments de conception d'essais, l'activité des concurrents et les impacts de sélection pays/site.
• Appliquer des méthodes statistiques à de multiples sources de données (primaires et secondaires) pour répondre à des questions complexes et optimiser la valeur des investissements cliniques.
• Gérer le cycle de vie des solutions analytiques depuis l'idée jusqu'à la mise en œuvre.
• Restez à jour avec les méthodologies et les outils émergents pour s'assurer que notre approche reste « adaptée à l'usage » et efficace. Qui vous êtes :
• Baccalauréat (Business, Economics, Statistics, Mathématiques, Sciences physiques ou domaine connexe est un plus); MBA ou diplôme de niveau supérieur est préféré
• Anglais avancé
• Maîtrise dans des domaines spécialisés tels que le Patient/Inspection des enquêteurs, la prévision ou les statistiques, en mettant l'accent sur l'information sur les décisions cliniques et commerciales.
• Connaissance des outils de programmation et d'analyse de haut niveau (Python, R, SQL, SAS) pour effectuer une exploration autonome et sophistiquée des données au-delà de l'analyse traditionnelle.
• Capacité éprouvée de traduire des ensembles de données complexes en récits et visualisations convaincants qui simplifient les concepts techniques pour les parties prenantes.
• Expérimentez la navigation dans des environnements internationaux et interfonctionnels (scientifiques, commerciaux, opérationnels) en utilisant l'influence sans autorité pour produire des résultats.
• En tant que consultant en entreprise auprès de l'entreprise, en gérant des fournisseurs extérieurs et en identifiant les méthodes d'analyse appropriées pour des problèmes spécifiques.
• Capacité de fusionner des sources de données disparates avec une attention méticuleuse aux détails, en veillant à ce que toutes les constatations soient convaincantes, précises et réalisables.
• Disponibilité pour travailler dans un modèle hybride basé à São Paulo Les indemnités de réinstallation ne sont pas disponibles pour ce poste. Lorsque la transparence de la paye s'applique, les détails sont fournis en fonction du lieu d'affectation principal. Pour ce rôle, l'endroit principal est Sao Paulo. Si vous êtes intéressé par d'autres endroits où le rôle peut être disponible, nous fournirons les détails pertinents de la rémunération plus tard dans le processus d'embauche. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous responsabilisons chaque oth

Sarete responsabili di fornire il miglior supporto clienti in loco, tra cui attività come, l'implementazione delle applicazioni, la formazione dell'operatore e la risoluzione dei problemi per la strumentazione diagnostica e le analisi durante tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto. - Costruire e mantenere relazioni forti e collaborative con le parti interessate del cliente, garantendo un elevato livello di soddisfazione del cliente e creando valore nelle operazioni di laboratorio del cliente. Consultare i clienti sulle esigenze del laboratorio e agire come partner supportando il cliente durante tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto che potrebbe includere aggiornamenti di prodotto e altre modifiche. - Eseguire e/o assistere con l'installazione di strumenti diagnostici complessi, software e applicazioni reagente nei laboratori del cliente. Convalida le prestazioni del sistema per garantire che soddisfi le specifiche del produttore. Assicurare un'applicazione efficace e coesa delle soluzioni appena installate. - Fornire e, in alcuni casi, sviluppare una formazione completa in loco al personale di laboratorio sul corretto uso e manutenzione dei sistemi Roche, tra cui teoria del funzionamento, flusso di lavoro, controllo della qualità e interpretazione dei dati. - Agire come risorsa principale in loco per risolvere problemi tecnici complessi relativi alla strumentazione, software e prestazioni di analisi. Eseguire l'analisi della causa radice e implementare azioni correttive per ridurre al minimo i tempi di fermo dello strumento. Partner con altri membri del team Roche per implementare e supportare soluzioni totali, come l'automazione, gli strumenti digitali, ecc. - Fornire competenze scientifiche e applicative agli stakeholder di laboratorio (questo potrebbe includere supervisori, manager, direttori, tecnici) e professionisti medici (questo potrebbe includere patologi, medici), aiutandoli a garantire operazioni di laboratorio coesi ottimizzando i flussi di lavoro, implementando nuovi saggi e interpretando i risultati per il portafoglio di Roche. - Servire come collegamento al cliente e raccogliere feedback dai clienti sulle prestazioni, caratteristiche e usabilità del prodotto, e poi relay queste informazioni di supporto e team commerciali, mantenendo un vantaggio competitivo. - Partner con il team di vendita e sfruttare le conoscenze tecniche approfondite durante le attività pre-vendita, tra cui dimostrazioni di prodotto, consultazioni tecniche, ottimizzazione dei menu e altre opportunità post-vendita, generazione di ricavi. - Assicurare un'esperienza clienti coerente seguendo i protocolli e le procedure Roche.

Roche is a successful company that can offer exciting career opportunities. We encourage and support your development in areas of your interest which will prepare you for the next level in your career path. We know that people are responsible for our success and we value our employees. Our commitment is to create a work environment where feeling valued, respected, and empowered is a daily experience. descriptionByLocale.de: Beschreibung Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. La Posizione Dies ist eine aufregende Zeit, sich dem Roche Support Network anzuschließen. Wenn Sie leidenschaftlich über Problemlösung sind, dann ist dies die Position für Sie! Als forschungsorientiertes Healthcare-Unternehmen entdeckt, entwickelt und bietet Roche innovative Diagnostik und therapeutische Produkte und Dienstleistungen, die für Patienten und medizinische Fachkräfte von der Früherkennung und Prävention von Krankheiten bis hin zur Diagnostik, Behandlung und Therapieüberwachung profitieren. Roche ist ein erfolgreiches Unternehmen, das spannende Karrieremöglichkeiten bieten kann. Wir fördern und unterstützen Ihre Entwicklung in Bereichen Ihres Interesses, die Sie auf die nächste Stufe in Ihrem Karriereweg vorbereiten. Wir wissen, dass Menschen für unseren Erfolg verantwortlich sind und wir unsere Mitarbeiter schätzen. Unser Engagement ist es, ein Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen, in dem das Gefühl geschätzt, respektiert und gestärkt wird, ein tägliches Erlebnis ist. Mansion Als Field Applications Specialist sind Sie als primärer wissenschaftlicher und technischer Vertreter in der Alabama-Region für Roche-Systeme in Kundenlaboren im Core Lab-Raum ein wichtiger Bestandteil unseres Kundendienstteams. Sie sind verantwortlich für die Bereitstellung erstklassiger Kundenbetreuung vor Ort, einschließlich Aktivitäten wie, Anwendung Implementierung, Bedienertraining und Fehlerbehebung für diagnostische Instrumentierung und Assays während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus. - Erstellen und pflegen Sie starke, kollaborative Beziehungen zu Kundeninteressenten, um ein hohes Maß an Kundenzufriedenheit und Wertschöpfung im Laborbetrieb des Kunden sicherzustellen. Besprechen Sie den Kunden auf den Laborbedarf und handeln Sie als Partner, indem Sie den Kunden während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus unterstützen, der Produkt-Upgrades und andere Änderungen unterstützen könnte. - Führen und/oder unterstützen Sie die Installation komplexer diagnosischer Instrumente, Software und Reagenzanwendungen in Kundenlabors. Gültige Systemleistung, um sicherzustellen, dass es den Herstellerspezifikationen entspricht. Gewährleistung einer effektiven und kohäsiven Anwendung der neu installierten Lösungen. - Liefern und in einigen Fällen entwickeln, umfassende Vor-Ort-Training an Laborpersonal bei der ordnungsgemäßen Nutzung und Wartung von Roche-Systemen, einschließlich der Theorie der Operation, Workflow, Qualitätskontrolle und Dateninterpretation. - Aktivieren Sie als primäre Vor-Ort-Ressource zur Lösung komplexer technischer Probleme im Zusammenhang mit Instrumentierung, Software und Testleistung. Führen Sie Root Ursache Analyse und implementieren Korrekturmaßnahmen, um Instrument Ausfallzeiten zu minimieren. Mit anderen Roche-Team-Mitgliedern werden Gesamtlösungen wie Automatisierung, digitale Werkzeuge etc. implementiert und unterstützt. - Bereitstellung von wissenschaftlichen und Anwendungen Expertise für Labor-Stakeholder (dies könnte unter anderem Aufsichtspersonen, Manager, Direktoren, Technologen) und medizinische Fachkräfte (dies könnte Pathologen, Ärzte umfassen), helfen ihnen, kohäsive Laboroperationen zu gewährleisten, indem sie Workflows optimieren, neue Assays implementieren und Ergebnisse für Roches Portfolio interpretieren. - Servieren Sie als Kundenverbindung und sammeln Sie Feedback von Kunden über Produktleistung, Funktionen und Usability, und übermitteln Sie diese Informationen dann an Support- und Handelsteams, wobei ein Wettbewerbsvorteil erhalten wird. - Partner des Vertriebsteams und nutzen fundiertes technisches Wissen während der Vorverkaufsaktivitäten, darunter Produktdemonstrationen, technische Beratungen, Menüoptimierung und andere Post-Sales, Umsatzerzeugende Möglichkeiten. - Stellen Sie konsequente Kundenerfahrungen nach Roche-Protokollen und -Verfahren sicher.
descriptionByLocale.fr: Descrizione Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La Posizione C'est une période passionnante pour rejoindre le réseau de soutien Roche. Si vous êtes passionné par la résolution de problèmes alors c'est la position pour vous! En tant qu'entreprise de soins de santé axée sur la recherche, Roche découvre, développe et fournit des produits et des services diagnostiques et thérapeutiques innovants qui procurent des avantages importants aux patients et aux professionnels de la santé, depuis la détection précoce et la prévention des maladies jusqu'au diagnostic, au traitement et au suivi du traitement. Roche est une entreprise prospère qui peut offrir des opportunités de carrière passionnantes. Nous encourageons et soutenons votre développement dans les domaines qui vous intéressent et qui vous prépareront au prochain niveau de votre parcours professionnel. Nous savons que les gens sont responsables de notre succès et nous apprécions nos employés. Notre engagement est de créer un environnement de travail où le sentiment de valeur, de respect et d'autonomie est une expérience quotidienne. Mansioni En tant que spécialiste des applications sur le terrain, vous serez un membre clé de notre équipe de support client en tant que principal représentant scientifique et technique dans la région de l'Alabama pour les systèmes Roche dans les laboratoires clients de l'espace Core Lab. Vous serez responsable de fournir le meilleur service client en classe sur place, y compris des activités telles que la mise en œuvre d'applications, la formation des opérateurs et le dépannage des instruments de diagnostic et des essais tout au long du cycle de vie du produit. - Établir et maintenir des relations solides et collaboratives avec les intervenants du client, en assurant un niveau élevé de satisfaction du client et en créant de la valeur dans les activités du laboratoire du client. Consulter les clients sur les besoins des laboratoires et agir en tant que partenaire en appuyant le client tout au long du cycle de vie du produit, ce qui pourrait inclure des améliorations du produit et d'autres changements. - Effectuer et/ou aider à installer des instruments de diagnostic complexes, des logiciels et des applications de réactif dans les laboratoires clients. Valider la performance du système pour s'assurer qu'il répond aux spécifications du fabricant. Assurer l'application efficace et cohérente des solutions nouvellement installées. - Fournir et, dans certains cas, développer une formation complète sur place au personnel de laboratoire sur l'utilisation et l'entretien appropriés des systèmes Roche, y compris la théorie de l'exploitation, le flux de travail, le contrôle de la qualité et l'interprétation des données. - Agir comme principale ressource sur place pour résoudre les problèmes techniques complexes liés à l'instrumentation, aux logiciels et aux performances d'essai. Effectuer une analyse des causes profondes et mettre en oeuvre des mesures correctives pour minimiser les temps d'arrêt des instruments. Partenaire avec d'autres membres de l'équipe Roche pour mettre en œuvre et soutenir des solutions complètes, telles que l'automatisation, les outils numériques, etc. - Fournir une expertise scientifique et des applications aux intervenants des laboratoires (ce qui pourrait inclure les superviseurs, les gestionnaires, les directeurs, les technologues) et aux professionnels de la santé (ce qui pourrait inclure les pathologistes, les médecins), les aider à assurer la cohésion des opérations des laboratoires en optimisant les flux de travail, en mettant en oeuvre de nouveaux essais et en interprétant les résultats pour le portefeuille de Roche. - Servir de liaison avec les clients et recueillir les commentaires des clients sur la performance, les caractéristiques et la facilité d'utilisation du produit, puis transmettre ces informations aux équipes de soutien et commerciales, en maintenant un avantage concurrentiel. - S'associer à l'équipe de vente et tirer parti de connaissances techniques approfondies lors des activités préventes, y compris des démonstrations de produits, des consultations techniques, l'optimisation des menus et d'autres occasions de générer des revenus après les ventes. - Assurer une expérience client cohérente en suivant les protocoles et procédures Roche.
